description:
About THE FAMILY CHEMIST: 





This is simply not another online pharmacy. The Family Chemist offers a personalised experience which focuses on the individual’s concerns and needs. With a click away you can have your own 1-2-1 consultation with our highly skilled clinician trusting us to put you and your family’s wellbeing our number one priority. We offer Low Online Prices, Greater Anonymity for consumers and Fast, Express, Discreet Delivery. The Family Chemist are passionate about offering quick, simple and confidential solutions to your concerns. Take a couple of minutes of your time to fill in our consultation and select treatments such as erectile dysfunction, period delay, hair loss and more! 


Details:


 FREE DELIVERY
 
We offer free delivery on orders over £10.


 LOWEST PRICE GUARANTEE
We won’t be beaten on price, but if you find a product cheaper elsewhere we’ll refund the difference. 


 SIGN UP TO OUR WEBSITE FOR MORE PROMO CODES AND OFFERS: 
 
 20% off when you sign up to our newsletter online.


 View our Treatments Below 
Erectile Dysfunction
Hair Loss
Morning after Pill
Weight Loss
Stop Smoking
Anti-Malarial

records.title: Highly recommended chemist
records.text: Really easy to complete the online consultation and place the order.The order was approved shortly after then well packaged and quickly dispatched. Safely and efficiently received my order the next day.I also felt reassured by them doing the online consultation so I couldn't order something that isn't right for me, and the product itself is genuine.I also must mention how competitively priced they are.

records.title: Just a good reliable pharmacy
records.text: Initially, they were slower than other providers in delivering medications (price still made me stick with them), but now they are super fast and reliable, plus best price on the market. What do you need more. Hence, I have been with them for over a year and plan to stay as a loyal customer.

records.title: Excellent online pharmacy
records.text: Excellent online pharmacy. Cheapest prices for Mounjaro I can find online. I have been ordering from them for the last 2 months & the whole process has gone very smoothly from start to finish.  Delivery charges are very reasonable too. I would highly recommend The Family Chemist & I will continue to use them for my weight loss medication.

records.title: From start to finish everything was…
records.text: From start to finish everything was clear, I was very happy with how everything went. I made an error on my postage selection but Ash contacted me I explained what I wanted and they made the arrangements. Will be reordering in 3 weeks hope all is smooth again. Highly recommended.

records.title: Great speedy service
records.text: The website was easy to navigate.Pricing was clear.Delivery came a lot quicker than expected over to the Christmas period.Email communication was great, plenty of information and I received the product information leaflets in PDF format so I will always have access to these when out and about.

records.title: Monjaro
records.text: Quick delivery once prescription allowed.  Excellent price.  Comes well packaged with ice pack.  Will continue to go through journey with monjaro and use this chemist.

records.title: Great service and the cost of my weight…
records.text: Great service and the cost of my weight loss program is significantly less than I had originally been paying from another online chemist, that surprised me as I thought I had been paying a respectable price.  Fast and reliable delivery with tracking.  I’ve now recommended this to my direct family.  This is something I never do.

records.title: Family Chemist 2024…
records.text: Been using this Chemist most of 2024 for various items and have had absolutely no problems whatsoever. I made a mistake order one time and they cancelled it for me straight away and issued the refund. Can’t fault them, and that is why I’ve stayed with them.

records.title: The family chemist was so helpful on…
records.text: The family chemist was so helpful on helping me get my order right for a first time buyer off them and the delivery was next day which was fantastic and they kept in touch when I needed advice and when the order had arrived asked me if everything was ok.Definitely be keeping my order going of my weight loss injection.

records.title: An Exemplary Service
records.text: The Family Chemist provides personal consideration and sensitivity which is key to any healthcare situation.  When dealing with any problems which may arise they are thorough and respond quickly, in all respects they are brilliant!Thank you

records.title: A trusted supplier
records.text: The consultation seemed thorough. Its comforting to know that they don't just prescribed mounjaro to anyone. Considering I ordered before Christmas my order arrived in great time as soon as Royal Mail was back up running. Greatly packed. My only minor gripe was that I had no information booklet or instructions which most other suppliers provide. The leaflet inside the medication doesn't instruct how to administer it so YouTube aided me in that respect! But all in all I'm happy I chose this supplier on my weight loss journey

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, however lost one star due to it being more expensive to pick up from post office this makes it difficult due to having to sign for package when at work.

records.title: Been on it since October went from 2.5…
records.text: Been on it since October went from 2.5 to 7.5 loss has stopped stayed same weight since last three weeks can’t get under 75 kg but trying to stick with it have lost nearly three stone

records.title: Good products
records.text: Good products, fair price and fast delivery. The initial prescriber's overly conservative decision to refuse my repeat prescription (and accidentally cancel another unrelated order without explanation) made the experience upsetting, especially as the medication is working well to improve my health and physical wellbeing with no unexpected or undesirable side effects. At my request a second opinion was sought and common sense prevailed. It is right that prescribers are cautious but consideration, sound judgement, good communication and care are appreciated by customers. I will reorder from The Family Chemist when the time comes.

records.title: Delivery is usually very quick
records.text: Delivery is usually very quick, if not I'm sure I could have found out why had I checked my email's.

records.title: Generally very good
records.text: Generally very good, just a little slow at responding and more expensive than others. Generally very helpful and supportive which I don't know if the cheaper providers are. I will continue to use them.

records.title: Generally a good experience
records.text: Generally a good experience but the delivery timeframe can do better. It states it is 1-3 working days but it is definitely 3 working days and no sooner. I go into my account and see that an order has been approved less than a day after I placed it but the order just stays with the pharmacist for about two days before being sent for delivery. Why is it there so long? If it has been approved, surely delivery can happen sooner.

records.title: First time order
records.text: I am impressed with how my order was dealt with. After waiting for just over a week after I ordered, I contacted because I was still waiting for it to be delivered. It was then sent in the post that very day and sent next day delivery even though I hadn’t paid for that.  Thank you for sorting it so quickly

records.title: Hello I have enjoyed using your site…
records.text: Hello I have enjoyed using your site it's really friendly and easy to purchase your products. Thank you.

records.title: Highly recommend as Mounjaro Provider
records.text: It would have been 5 stars, the only niggle I have is when I come to renew my prescription it's not as straight forward. I use The Family Chemist for my Mounjaro prescription, and it's not very straight forward in adding medication to basket. BUT overall the process has been easy, seamless and the delivery has been quick. Takes a day or two for the Chemist to approve, but once done my prescription has been sent out very quickly and always well documented (i.e. I know when to expect it's arrival etc).

records.title: Simple and easy to use service
records.text: Simple and easy to use service. Really pleased, thank you.Post was a bit of a frustration, think that was a RM issue rather than TFC however no way to contact them over the weekend so the refrigerated package wasn’t cold on arrival.

records.title: Excellent communication
records.text: Excellent communication, I received a response to all queries promptly and my order was amended at my request. I am only giving 4 stars as my order took a week from approval to delivery. This wouldn’t deter me from recommending The Family Chemist

records.title: So far there haven’t been any results that l can see in body shape or weight
records.text: So far there haven’t been any results that l can see I am quite disappointed,maybe next month when I go onto a stronger dose, things will start moving.

records.title: Very easy to order
records.text: Very easy to order, good price and quick dispatch.But let down by shambolic service from ParcelforceAlso my order would have fitted through the letterbox if it had been in an envelope rather than a box, which could have avoided the parcelforce issues.

records.title: Quick and easy consultation > delivery…
records.text: Quick and easy consultation > delivery to myself. Only concern I have is that the medication I received only had one month until expiration- which made my dosing regime a little tight for time.

records.title: Good price,great packaging,took a few…
records.text: Good price,great packaging,took a few days for delivery but it was my first order hopping next delivery will be quicker.

records.title: Took a little longer than anticipated…
records.text: Took a little longer than anticipated to be approved and dispatched but was perfectly wrapped.

records.title: Easy to use website
records.text: Easy to use website. Received meds fast. Wish it was easier to communicate for questions.

records.title: Only negative is package couldn’t be…
records.text: Only negative is package couldn’t be left in my safe place other than that very happy with service

records.title: Good company, not so good delivery experience!
records.text: When I was unable to get a doctors appointment for a uti I ordered antibiotics from the Family Chemist. Ordering was straightforward and I completed a health questionnaire. Delivery was free, with an option to pay for an express service. The prescription was authorised after a brief chat to the pharmacist. The only downside was the delivery by Parcel force. They attempted to deliver but couldn't do so due to " insufficient address" which I couldn't understand as all the details I had given were clear. After a long session trying to locate my delivery on the phone I managed to get a redelivery date. This amounted to a long wait for my tablets (5 days) . To be fair Family Chemist did try and chase it up, but this is why I deducted a star. I would use again and recommend but beware of delivery problems with Parcel force.

records.title: Slow..
records.text: Coming back as a repeat customer i would say i was disappointed. The service has become really slow. I had to chase up my order as it had spent 3 days with the pharmacy after being approved. Please go back to the impressive service i first experienced as this can help patients avoid missing a dose due to slow service.

records.title: Competitively priced
records.text: Competitively priced, and overall the experience has been ok. Had to miss a dose due to ordering on Saturday then getting an email the following Tuesday advising they were out of stock. Received the package on Friday so no major drama - just a minor grumble that if they’re out of stock for an item they should inform you at the time.

records.title: Price was a good price and once item…
records.text: Price was a good price and once item had been dispatched it arrived quickly, I unfortunately this happened a week after ordering.

records.title: Communication not great not bad but could be better
records.text: Communication not great, dispatch after approval also took longer than anticipated. When I contacted to enquire when would be dispatched took a couple of days to respond

records.title: Kept me well informed.
records.text: Kept me well informed.  I did have  concerns the expiration date on meds said May 2024 and now September 2024.  I will not finish meds until mid October.  Though accompanying letter did say that the pharmaceutical company have extended expiration date by 6 months.  Not sure if I should order more.    Medication is working.  Delivery was good and information good.

records.title: Took too long to be delivered
records.text: Medication was easy toOrder, however after paying £6.99 for special delivery I did not expect it to be 6 days after ordering for me to revive my order. There was no indication of this when ordering and it was disappointing

records.title: No problem with yourselves but more…
records.text: No problem with yourselves but more with delivery Still not been in receipt of my order as post office in main st new Elgin Moray has it but they have closed down for holidays!!!! How royal mail gets away with this is unacceptable No reply from royal mail on this issue Most disappointing

records.title: They sent me a discount code that…
records.text: They sent me a discount code that didn't work and said it was single use and I'd used one of them on a previous order. Fair enough!! but why send it???Otherwise their usually efficient service.

records.title: Good company but long delivery times
records.text: Good company but not as much aftercare as I thought there would be.  Also delivery times are too long.

records.title: The service was good but next day delivery was not next day
records.text: The service was good, however, paying for next day delivery (an extra £7) did not come to fruition, and my items were delivered two days later.

records.title: Great service fast delivery but did…
records.text: Great service fast delivery but did find a little expensive

records.title: Ordered 5mg got 2:5
records.text: Ordered 5mg got 2:5 ,yes but in my notes it said I would like 5mg

records.title: Grown too quickly to service existing customers
records.text: My initial review was inaccurate. I sent it because I had to deal with these people and they beg for reviews.They have quickly grown beyond their capacity to service their customers well.I apologize for my misleading initial review. I felt trapped.

records.title: The item I received was incorrect
records.text: The item I received was incorrect; it was actually someone else’s order from a different company. It appears the delivery company may have mixed up the packages. When I opened it, there was no sign of the order from your pharmacy. I suggest that the pharmacy consider upgrading its packaging to clearly display the company name to prevent this issue in the future. Unfortunately, I am now without the item I originally ordered.

records.title: Slow Dispatch
records.text: Past orders from family chemist have been great, but this order took much longer to arrive, but cost same amount in postage!  Whilst I understand the medication has to be checked, this is 3rd time I’ve purchased it so shouldn’t have taken so long.

records.title: Poor slow communication and stock control
records.text: I placed an order for meds and received an email confirming the order and presumably dispatch.  Having waited 6 days I then get a phone call to say they are out of stock and would be refunding me. What is concerning is they are important meds that I needed and take daily yet it took them 6 days to let me know they couldn’t provide the prescription. It’s also concerning that the website showed items were in stock yet they weren’t and still took 6 days to let me know. Surely they must have adequate stock control systems in place to know what they do or do not have in stock.

records.title: The product I bought was not up to…
records.text: The product I bought was not up to standard, I have bought the same product I bought from somewhere else was lot better.I waisted my money.

records.title: Not a pleasant experience
records.text: Family Chemist sends their parcels with parcelForce, which is a horrible Couriers company. I still haven't received my medication After a week. Will never use your services.

records.title: Poor service
records.text: Says 5 star service but no one has answered the phone on multiple try’s. No reply to email.

records.title: Mounjaro out of date & Didn’t work
records.text: Ordered 3 month’s supply and extras so spent approx £460 . The “ medication”  arrived and it was out of date and had no impact at all , May as well have been water . Wasted my money will stick with legitimate pharmacies form now rather than look for a “ bargain “ .  So disappointing. Considering a trading standards report.  I have copies of the order email and number to verify this experience . This Company changes its responses / replies rather than taking responsibility , first denying I was a customer then when presented with evidence another excuse . Unsurprisingly I do not recommend.

records.title: Shockingly Dishonest!!
records.text: They took my money , charged me £4.99 for next day delivery , 7 days later no product, poor communication ,  awaiting a refund.  I am very surprised at the high rating here. My experience with them has been substandard. In response to your pathetic dishonest response the my review!! Why didn’t you inform me that the parcel was lost instead of sending me an email saying that you have had to reschedule( no alternative date provided BTW) my telephone consultation , after which you went silent for several days until I emailed you asking for a refund?  Which customer service are you referring to? Do you mean via the phone number provided which you don’t answer?  Shameful!!

records.title: Discrimination across customers
records.text: Discrimination across customers; I was unable to use my 25% discount code at checkout, and had to email back and forth to ask if I could redeem it. I was then told my medication was 'out of stock', despite still being listed online. However, when I called back with a different name my medication was now magically 'in stock' again. Family run scammers.

description: A unique meditation program for improved sleep, wellbeing, and relaxation. Meditainment takes participants on an amazing guided meditation journey to many unique visualised destinations with wide-ranging wellbeing themes to explore. All you have to do is, sit back, close your eyes and enjoy your journey. It's meditation that takes you places, and is as easy as listening to a relaxing story with your eyes closed!

records.title: This is an extremely helpful course to…
records.text: This is an extremely helpful course to take. I used something similar to this app many years ago. Being mindful, and living in the moment ----- something everyone should experience and practice.

records.title: meditation
records.text: I enjoyed the way it made me aware of my stress level and how to combat triggers.

records.title: My experience was very calming
records.text: My experience was very calming. It made me aware of myself. When ever I felt that things were out of my control I would play a mediation melody and collect Mt feelings and self value. Thank you.

records.title: I just loved the meditations! Helped me a lot.
records.text: I loved the sounds, her voice, and the scenery described in the meditations.

records.title: This year has been one of my very worst…
records.text: This year has been one of my very worst years for sleep, relaxation and major anxiety issues thanks to many different areas of concern.  Your entire system of helping others to relax, focus, obtain rest and sleep has been a savior in my life.  My health issues still there but way less in stress and anxieties is so very much appreciated.  Looking forward to a new beginning in 2021 thanks to your Meditainment services........Thank You!

records.title: Very Positive and Innovative Company
records.text: Very Positive and Innovative CompanyI've been involved with Meditainment since the last century(!), and have always loved their ideas, journeys, and ethos.  I've lost count of how many people I have recommended them to over the years.  My favourite thing - which I don't think they do now - when you could tailor your own journey, but that's okay, theyve still taken me to wonderful places in my mind, and left me relaxed and refreshed on many an occasion.  I do use other apps as well these days, but I'll always follow Meditainment, as long as theyre going.

records.title: best thing in treatment
records.text: its amazing how treating the whole person is far more beneficial than trying to help with just using or stopping use. these other areas allow the brain and person to take a look at areas using ight have effected, and how to totally recover

records.title: Love love love
records.text: Love love love! I put off listening to the igloo one because I don’t like the cold but this has actually turned out to be my favourite one! Please can you release some more meditations? Tracking my mood has been interesting, very insightful, thank you.

records.title: Amazing meditations
records.text: Meditainment is an amazing site and I am so grateful I found it. There are a lot of guided meditations out there, but for me, theirs are by far the best. The mix of relaxing music, nature sounds and pleasant, soft voice are perfect. Whenever I have trouble sleeping or I get monkey brain, I tune into meditainment and it always distracts me, helps me relax and even fall asleep. I have been using it for years now and I find that the one-off payment is more than fair for the service they provide. Hope they add some more meditations in the future!

records.title: First experienced a meditainment…
records.text: First experienced a meditainment journey whilst away many years ago. I was then delighted when my friend said she had more and put me towards there website. My daughter used the falling asleep meditation for many years as part of her bedtime routine. I then started using it more regularly to escape even if for 20 mins when time was my own.

records.title: I love your meditations but they are…
records.text: I love your meditations but they are opened too slowly. I'm not new to meditation and I like to do new stuff.

records.title: I love your meditations
records.text: I love your meditations.   I don’t like how the voice in the meditations go soft and then loud in different segments.   I was playing them for my clients during their reiki healing sessions that I was facilitating and I had to stop and turn the volume either up or down off and on during the meditation.  My clients were commenting on that as well.  They loved the meditations but the sound seems to go too loud then too quiet with the voice. Other than that, they are Perfect!!

records.title: A relaxing experience
records.text: As someone who is new to meditation, I found this website really simple to use and navigating is easy.The meditations are great - very relaxing and soothing, plus there's a good selection of experiences depending on how much time you have.My only small suggestion for improvement is that sometimes the bird noises were a bit loud and surprising which momentarily disturbed me (but this is a tiny thing). The narrator has a very nice voice!

records.title: Absolutely excellent but...
records.text: Absolutely excellent and the best meditation I've tried particularly helping to fall asleep. Both my husband and I love falling asleep to one of the many great guided sections. We prefer the guided ones to the non guided ones. The only reason I'm not giving a 5* score is the actual app. It is not 100% reliable,  it's too temperamental and far too frequently just doesn't work at all at night. I get a blank screen as it happened the last two nights. Meditainment are very good in getting back on email with advice but I don't want to have to download the segments as I paid for and prefer to use the actual app. These days apps work so well so I don't understand why Meditainment can't get it sorted? I wish they could as I love the app otherwise!

records.title: I have found certain meditations to help me be more relaxed before sleep!
records.text: I have found certain meditations to assist me to go to sleep quicker and to shut my mind off prior to sleep!! the sleeps I am having now let me wake up completely rested and ready for the day ahead!! It is wonderful!                    Thankyou

Being able to assemble a custom playlist also would be nice. I do say I prefer and miss the app. But, it doesn't stop me from listening almost daily.

records.title: I use the different meditation…
records.text: I use the different meditation scenarios to help me wind down and fall asleep. They always work, unfortunately they return you back to an awakened state mins after lulling me to a peaceful sleep. I wish they would just quietly fade out so I could continue to sleep right through. The only one that does this is #20, Falling Asleep. I'd love more like that for sure.

records.title: We froze in the Igloo
records.text: Your website is great, especially during these troubling times.  This might be a minor issue but I feel that the repetitive items (you are in control, you can return to mental items, etc.) could be eliminated for returning customers.  After experiencing a few meditations I am ready to dive into each meditation without the friendly reminders.  Several of the meditations are not great as others.  We froze in the Igloo meditation.We appreciate your hard work.

records.title: What distinguishes Meditainment from other programs I have tried.
records.text: What distinguishes Meditainment from other programs I have tried is, above all, the choice of the speaker guiding us: I like her clear diction and natural, soothing voice.The quality of the recording of other sounds is also generally good.I use Meditainment mostly at night, so the other welcome distinguishing feature is the ability to choose a single meditation, instead of never-ending, annoying loops: nobody wants a voice, or very unnatural and loud ‘nature' sounds, in their head all night!

description: Releaf is the UK’s first all-in-one medical cannabis e-clinic, offering a wholly online service that simplifies the way in which patients acquire, use and benefit from medicinal cannabis. An innovative monthly subscription offers a convenient and secure way for patients to receive their prescriptions.

records.title: Excellent service provided by relief…
records.text: Excellent service provided by relief very knowledgeable and quick to reply to any messages sent. Medication delivered with no problems at all.Very professional how they treat patients not judgemental at all.Kind and considerate when speaking over the phone will try their very best to sort out any issues you have.The only issue I had is with myself for not contacting relief a lot sooner than I did.Thank you Releaf team.

records.title: Been with releaf for a couple of months…
records.text: Been with releaf for a couple of months and they have been very helpful. They always reply quick and medication always arrives when they state it will. I'm glad I went with them. I will update this if anything changes.

records.title: Very happy with the service provided
records.text: Very happy with the service provided, very helpful when contacted them, 💯 recommend

records.title: I can only say good things..
records.text: I can only say good things... After spending some time being hesitant & wondering if this was too good to be true, after a few checks & questions it was all clearly legit.The level of professionalism, quality of service, product & a streamlined process makes something that should've already been accessible to so many for so long exactly that. I for one definitely appreciate finally being able to drop at least 1 of my horrid pharmaceuticals. So, if you're on the fence, jump off & get stuck in. It's a great service. The only downside I'd say is price but everything could always be cheaper 😅 especially these days... On my last note, the main hangups I had with accessing the service was actually my doctors being difficult with records etc so be prepared if your medial history is as complex as some people's.

records.title: Releaf are an amazing service
records.text: Releaf are a highly professional medical service and I do just want to take the time to say how good they are. They are always so quick to respond and they really care about the treatment they are providing, you can always ask them any questions and they are endlessly helpful. They even made extra effort to make sure medication went out before Christmas!Highly recommend for anyone who thinks medical cannabis can help them; where other treatments weren't successful, this has been life changing for me.

records.title: Professional and helpful.
records.text: I found the phone staff great, helpful and caring. Also the consultant was thorough and helpful. I felt heard and listened to in regards to my issues and concerns regarding cannabis as it was my last resort approach to pain relief and was cautious as never used before. So being able to go at my own pace with product and having options where I am comfortable.

records.title: Great experience from start to finish
records.text: Great experience from start to finish, friendly staff, professional. I’m a happy customer , already shown great positive effects on my life thank you releaf!Highly recommend :)

records.title: Prompt, professional and sensitive clinic
records.text: For me it took only 3 days from signing up to having first consultation and had my first prescription issued on the same day. Dispensing of prescription then takes another two days. Very easy to use and comprehensive website for support, tracking and managing account. Staff are also very friendly, helpful, sensitive and respond promptly to any queries. My consultation was thorough, made me feel truly listened to and all potential risks and benefits taken into account for this mode of therapy. Incredible service and would highly recommend Releaf to anyone considering seeking alternative therapy.

records.title: A lot of time and effort is gone into it
records.text: I’ve been with him over two weeks now and they’re absolutely amazing. Couldn’t fault their product.

records.title: Great team
records.text: From the jump the patient support team have a been a dream, Tegan Brick has been especially helpful, helped me understand processes and put me at ease. Dr Alex is so lovely, my consultation was pleasant, informative and he was understanding, thoughtful and made sure I was comfortable the whole time.

records.title: Good overall experience.
records.text: Seems like a professional business.  Prices were a bit higher than expected.  Would also be nice to have more advice on purchasing a vape, as I had no prior experience and had to do a lot of research.  Ended up getting the Xmax V3 Pro.The onboarding process was pretty seamless.  The doctors I have spoken to have been very sympathetic, professional and knowledgeable. The quality of the oil and flower are very high.Only reason I docked a star is the price and subscription structure.

records.title: Very good communication throughout
records.text: Very good communication throughout. Reviews are met timely. Good at what I need for my health issues.It would be good if the monthly subscription was cheaper as other companies are quite competitive with this. More information on other vapourisers to use would be good.

records.title: Everything was extremely professional
records.text: Everything was extremely professional, no issues whatsoever. The clinician struck the balance between objectivity and having a relaxed informal encounter.

records.title: Never had a problem with any…
records.text: Never had a problem with any prescriptions bar one little hiccup, which was rectified instantly, and delivered speedy to rectify it. Doctors are knowledgeable, friendly and understanding.Would definitely give 5 stars but they do have an issue with limited strains and the ones they do stock 'selling out fast' can sometimes be an issue, but they're always on hand to help and offer alternatives. Top notch service.

records.title: I have just started my medication and…
records.text: I have just started my medication and have found the process relatively easy. I'm just a bit confused. I have had two telephone consultations. My initial consultation was straightforward and I have received my prescription and was to have a consultation yesterday with a psychiatrist due to my daughter having bipolar disorder. However it was with a neurologist who raised my oil to 25mg. My prescription was sent through and is awaiting payment.  Today I had a call to say I've now to speak to psychiatrist for an initial assessment. I really am confused. The medication is working well and has helped the chronic pain I am usually crippled with. I am now wondering why I'm now on a 3rd initial assessment.

records.title: I’ve been with relief now for three…
records.text: I’ve been with relief now for three months and find My doctor and the whole team very professional with good quality medicine, although I’m still trying to find the right nighttime medicine for me, but I’m sure I will get there.  On the other hand, my daytime medicine has Worked wonders and honestly can say I changed my day-to-day life

records.title: Great service, just a little expensive
records.text: Great service really helpful and freindly staff, always answer me pretty quickly and delivery was fast, Only reason i didn't give 5 stars, Is the price of the medication. Would be great if they have discount for low income like others do, Other than that would highly recommend to anyone looking to use a medical cannabis clinic.

records.title: I was treated very well by both the…
records.text: I was treated very well by both the consulting doctor and the customer support service. This is a professional service that makes you feel relaxed and valued as a prospective client or customer. Very impressed.

records.title: Relief has had a massive impact on my…
records.text: Relief has had a massive impact on my life after only a few months.I suffered from chronic pain flare ups related to gut health problems for over a decade, and no medication or pain relief helped with this.The oil provided by releaf acts as a pain killer that not only soothes the pain but can often dial back the severity of the flare up.Their team are always polite, helpful and supportive, and are available to contact at all times of the day

records.title: I’ve been suffering with pain and…
records.text: I’ve been suffering with pain and anxiety for many years and have been taking medication. I first tried the flowers and then oil and then went back to the flowers which is working for me. Ive find  that  I don’t concentrate so much on my pain and  feel relaxed, my constipation has got much better since smoking flower.

records.title: Only 1 issue
records.text: Staff were great,empathetic and response times quick, sorry to leave as no issues whatsoever apart from bigger mark up price on medicine than other clinics aparantly. Other clinics may not have as good other services as releaf. Expensive enough should be passed to patients at minimum price if not free!

records.title: All the basic sign-up stages worked…
records.text: All the basic sign-up stages worked well and would have worked perfectly had I not left a gap of several months between starting the process and completing it. Releaf staff were very quick to sort out the few issues that I did have and very professional.  The only downside was missing the free starter kit by a few days!  I should have moved faster.

records.title: The discussion with the doctor was…
records.text: The discussion with the doctor was thorough and well conducted. I'm still experimenting with the prescribed drops so uncertain as to its efficacy. I'm a little put off by the upfront cost. OK if it works but expensive if it doesn't.

records.title: Happy so far
records.text: I was happy with my initial consultation, however there have been inconsistencies in what I’ve been told eg the doctor during my consultation said that someone would contact me the following day to discuss what  was suitable for me.  I waited for the call but, in the end I ordered it from the email you sent me.

records.title: .My consultant was nice and…
records.text: .My consultant was nice and professional who also made me feel at ease.couldn't believe how quickly the whole process was

records.title: After several delays due to stock…
records.text: After several delays due to stock outages and a long weekend, Releaf seems to have ironed out most of the kinks, although I wish processing times were less. The average seems to be (at least In my case) 7-10 business days from order to delivery, which is more than advertised. Today's delivery arrived on time despite the full address not being on the packaging or invoice. I've got a good post. Prices seem to be generally higher than what is listed on the medbud UK wiki page, and what people say they are paying on the subreddit. I like the single vendor centralised aspect of Releaf, and the customer service to date has been outstanding—prompt, friendly  replies to queries and accurate updates. I would like to see a "Releaf" phone app with the facility to allow patients to see what stock is currently available and place re-orders through the app. All in all, I'm content and plan to stay with Releaf until a clearly better service comes along.

records.title: A company that cares
records.text: A really caring company! I have felt genuinely listened to. Had a bit of a delay with receiving my first initial prescription but this was very well compensated for. Also, my most recent delivery of flower took only 3 days to arrive which is great. Your prescription feels so well curated for YOU. The docs thoroughly listen to you and want to work with you to find the best plan. I’m getting treated for anxiety and it’s incredible the difference this is making. The Omura vaporiser is great as well.

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: Since writing my original review I was contacted by Leah and she has apologised that it wasn’t clearer from the start what was and wasn’t included and has arranged for a starter kit to be sent out to me. I cannot complain about the customer service I received from her which has totally changed my views regarding Releaf, I hope the rest of my experiences going forward are as positive. Original review: From the consultation and ordering and paying for my prescription, which cost more than advertised, there was no update about what happened next and how long till I received my prescription. When I did receive my prescription, it was all I did receive, there was no starter kit included which I was led to believe would come with the first order so although I actually received my prescription I didn’t receive anything to be able to use it. Not very happy. Especially if I am now expected to buy all the other components required to use the prescription! This has turned out to be a very expensive experience.

records.title: Everything has been excellent from…
records.text: Everything has been excellent from booking through to delivery. Great company, no complaints...apart from never being able to get through on the phone! No answer, just recorded msg and then hangs up, any day, any time of day.

records.title: Receiving 1st prescription.
records.text: Was made easy and from start to getting my prescription was surprisingly quick.Just started the whole process so a bit early to leave a big review, but happy with the speediness from initial enquiry to receiving my cannabis prescription.

records.title: How did I qualify?
records.text: I filled in the form to see if I would be eligible for medical cannabis. The only personal information asked for was the name of my GP practice and an email address. I submitted an email address that is not on record at my GP practice, or anywhere else, for that matterWithout even being required to provide my name or my medical condition I was informed that I do, in fact, qualify! How could Releaf possibly make that determination based on the scant details I provided?

records.title: Could do better
records.text: First delivery of SOMAI 10:10 oil arrived and I'm a little disappointed. The press/turn child resist cap on the bottle was extremely difficult to loosen for someone with PD and the lack of a secondary seal on the bottle made accidental spillage very likely. The syringe tip is a sloppy fit into the bottle bung, again risking spillage. It is also somewhat difficult to see what part of the syringe plunger to line up with the millilitres scale.

records.title: Staff and system
records.text: Brilliant! I think that Releaf have a very good set of staff, everybody is very happy to help! But I feel like they could be a bit more consistent with the flower product as it seems I managed to find a flower that I get on with very well and then the next month it’s gone so they try giving me the next best thing and it doesn’t really work for me admittedly I am trying new strains all the time to see what’s best so there’s plenty of options available. Staff are impeccable how ever the “farming” side of things needs to expand.

records.title: Expensive journey with no guarantee
records.text: The packaging of the starter kit and the kit in general is well designed. The phonecalls are easily booked in. Customer service is helpful. Unfortunately for me, the vape burned my throat to the extent that I cannot use it. The lowest dosage drops are not strong enough, but they did influence my cognitive function when driving my car which is dangerous. The prices of the drops are extortionate. All in all, this wasn't for me, and I am now stuck with the starterbox filled with canabis flower, and don't know what to do with it. I feel there should be a form of refund possible to return your kit, when vaping isn't possible for you and this is not your journey.

records.title: Ok nothing special
records.text: Although I thought the initial consultation was very helpful as well as the patient support team I was told that I would receive my medication in 2-4 days it has now been almost a week and I haven’t even received a confirmation email to say it is on the way as someone who is using this service to manage anxiety it’s just not acceptable and currently it has only heightened said anxiety.

records.title: Very helpful to have this clinic…
records.text: Very helpful to have this clinic available however stock often is out by the time I am able to request my repeat prescription so have to wait sometimes days to get sorted with a replacement. Would be helpful to have some similar strains available already to order when others are out of stock so that you’re not forced to email back and forth to complete your order and don’t end up going days without medication.

records.title: Excellent service and comprehensive…
records.text: Excellent service and comprehensive package but they charge above RRP for the medication. I'm happy to pay the £39.99 per month subscription or pay the extra on the medication but not both as it works out bad value compared to the competition. Can't fault the consultant though very good, understanding and knowledgeable. The medication is really helping me which is the most important thing.

records.title: From trying to vape the flower I…
records.text: From trying to vape the flower I couldn't get much from that so resorted to smoking it and got the effect just about straight away and could finally go to sleep, great stuff just not impressed with the vape

records.title: Inconsistent Stock Issues
records.text: I've been with Releaf since July and they're great when they actually have the prescribed flower available (which has only been half of the time), they don't explain why they're unable to offer you what was originally prescribed and just offer you a different prescription without any information regarding the differences of the new strain compared to the one originally prescribed.

records.title: Releaf - let's see.
records.text: *Updated*After posting this review, I received a call from a Leah who was very understanding and empathetic to my starting journey. She has stated this is not the way they like to be known, and I very much respect anyone that holds their hands out and state they got it wrong Things have been amended, and this has won me over on customer service. But I will retain from full stars for now until I experience more and can give a fairer review after more experience.*initial review*I am left unimpressed with Realeaf! And taking the time to warn you all of not using this service and look elsewhere. My wife had recommended this from finding out about it at work as I have been searching for help with issues with panic disorder.Having looked into it, I found the costs  very high. A consultation was 100 pounds. Which is just too much for today's ecomnic problems. However, I was pleased to see a discount code qas offered reducing this to 50 pounds, which is actually a healthy discount. I bookedd my consultation and was pre advised me that this would be a video consultation. Of which I had, although by a doctor driving around in his car. And was not usingbthe video himself.It is very unprofessional and made me wonder what on earth I am paying for after this. However I kept with it.After being told it would take up to a day for a 'board' to approve my case, I was approved with in 30 minutes of the call. I went to check out the presciption, but couldn't because there was an issue with card payment. A fault on their website and not my financials.I was advised to try another web browser, the product was then out of stock.The price of service as well compared to other services out there is just too high. I feel like the carrot and stick syndrome. The cure is there possibly in sight, and yet I feel to have it will cost a fortune and not get the service I am being asked to pay as a premium. My experience is real and not something I take my time to just moan about. This is poor when there are cheaper and more reliable services that are there to explore. Continue at your own cost.

records.title: Good service but slow at times
records.text: Good service but can be very slow at getting prescriptions out. Waited 2 weeks for last oil

records.title: Would have liked a menu to choose…
records.text: Would have liked a menu to choose products. Apart from that it’s great

records.title: Uncertain if this is legit or not
records.text: Uncertain if this is legit or not. I booked and paid for a consultation (Black Friday sale £19.99) I’m getting texts to say I need to login and issue my ID or my consultation will be cancelled. Every time I login it’s asking me to book and pay again.

records.title: Overpriced!
records.text: While they offer a subscription plan called ReLeaf Plus (£40/month), which is cheaper over the year (£540) compared to their pay-as-you-go option (£640), the overall cost is still significantly higher than other clinics.One major issue is the overpricing of flower. Although I was prescribed 10g of flower priced at £6.50 per gram, ReLeaf charges subscribers £8 per gram.Moreover, my experience with the doctor during my second consultation was unprofessional. When I raised my concerns, she dismissively suggested I look elsewhere and failed to increase my dosage despite our discussion about doing so. Thankfully, customer service addressed this issue promptly, but it shouldn't have been necessary.I hope they consider improving their pricing.

records.title: I was served several ads about this…
records.text: I was served several ads about this service and as someone with significant migraine issues, chronic pain and anxiety/depression, I was hopeful it could help. Over £200 is incredibly expensive and inaccessible for me and my income. I was frustrated by the consultant as well as when prompted to fulfill my prescription. I did not find the pricing clear from the outset and would not recommend to other sufferers with tight budgets.

records.title: Best avoided - overpriced, bloated product, poor customer service
records.text: As other reviewers have mentioned, Releaf seems to target first-time customers. They sent a lovely box with everything needed to smoke, but since I only use drops, most of it ended up in the recycling. Their prescription processing is slow, and when I requested a transfer to another pharmacy, they warned it would be difficult—and they were right. The delay has been extremely frustrating, though the new pharmacy has been great, consistently following up and even reaching out to Releaf directly. Their prices are also high, and I found that the products I was interested in were significantly cheaper elsewhere. They are set up to seduce first-time users but once you have some knowledge of the system they are an expensive and slow choice.

records.title: Mixed feelings...
records.text: I don't normally write reviews but wanted to shared my experience with Releaf as feel it is important. They have lots of overwhelmingly positive reviews so wonder if my experience is a blip or others feel similarly but are not sharing.I came to Releaf from another clinic which kept changing its prices. Releaf has strong branding and marketing which persuaded me to give it a go - I also like that they have a provider in the UK. I signed up for the subscription and the initial kit you get is great and very slick.However, I have two main concerns with Releaf - the first has been my experience of appointments. The doctor I saw in my previous clinic was amazing - he clearly had great knowledge of medical marijuana and I felt listened to in a way I never had in a medical setting (chronic conditions - urgh). My first appointment at Releaf could not have felt more different. A bit of googling tells me that the doctor I saw used to be an NHS surgeon and he did not have anything resembling an empathetic approach. I came away not only with many questions unanswered but feeling that he would have prescribed me the same thing regardless of the issues presented. I did not feel heard at all which is disappointing as I know how important this is to many of us who have felt ignored or misunderstood over many years. My second appointment was much much better - the person I saw was personable, knowledgeable and understanding. However, it was with a non-clinical prescriber - while I was paying the subscription which makes the appointments "free", I feel that it should be made clear by Releaf, or a lower price offered, when the appointment is not with a doctor. I think it is problematic that you cannot choose which professional you want to see when booking an appointment on the website, especially as their website lists doctors who are specialists in different areas. Secondly, I have concerns about the prices. While the price for the flower is reasonable (especially happy to pay it for UK grown), I feel the oil is hugely over-expensive. In my last appointment I asked for a T10:C10 which I had had previously used. I felt at the time that £150 for 30ml was expensive but paid the prescription as I was keen to get it. However, I then did a bit of research and found that this oil retails for £80 (which is what I had paid in the previous clinic). Given that the Releaf subscription promises favourable "members only" prices I am not sure how they justify this.Looking into cancelling my subscription and moving to a clinic which offers more favourable prices with a different booking system - my previous doctor has also moved there which is a good sign.

records.title: Will not stop harassing you after account cancellation!
records.text: Having several autoimmune diseases and chronic pain that wasn't being relieved by standard prescribed medication, I'd seen many sponsored adverts on social media about Releaf and the benefits of medical cannabis so I decided to give it a try.My first impressions were good following my initial consultation and I set up a subscription. I was excited to receive my first prescription, which was both oil & flower. However, despite some of the adverts I'd seen saying you got a free vape kit when you subscribed, I didn't get this so had to purchase one. My total initial costs including the initial consultation, oil, flower and kit fell just short of £500.Unfortunately, due to the very negative side effects even at the lowest dose (nausea, vomiting, unable to function the next day due to having a "fuzzy" brain and overwhelming continued tiredness), I had to stop taking it after just a week. Even just the smell made me nauseous & vomit.I there decided that this wasn't for me as it was affecting my ability to work, and I was certainly in no fit state to drive, so I cancelled my subscription and emailed support asking them to remove my details.They did eventually confirm they had done this, yet just a week or so later I received a text offering me a free month's subscription. I again emailed support and received confirmation that my details had allegedly previously been removed but they forgot about the texts & they will contact marketing to make sure I don't receive any more. Yet, at the same time I received another email from them marked "URGENT ACTION REQIRED" asking me to log into my account to update my details ready for my next prescription.  I have emailed them again and hope that now this will all stop. I'm completely unimpressed at the pressure that they seem to try and put on people who this isn't suitable for and I definitely wouldn't recommend them. Addendum - 05/11/24 9:18am - I have just received a telephone call from "Leah" at Releaf calling to check how I was getting on, so my details still have not been removed. I will now be reporting the Company for harassment.

records.title: Teeth Implant treatment
records.text: As someone who has an acute phobia to injections, especially where dentists are concerned, it took me over two years to build up the courage to make an appointment to visit the practices of the Gentle Dental Care Group, which has a surgery close to where I live.My initial appointment was with Dr Mish Sachdev.In my initial meet with Dr Sachdev, I outlined to him that I had long thought about having teeth implants to replace dentures that I had being wearing but which I found uncomfortable. I outlined to Dr Sachdev, my deep fear of having the dental treatment that I suspected having teeth implants would entail.However, after speaking with Dr Sachdev and him being totally honest and transparent with me about what the implant treatment would entail, I was completely satisfied and reassured with his answers to my long list of questions that I had on this matter and was greatly relieved that he would be the person performing this procedure on me.Dr Sachdev went through every minute detail about the cost of treatment, what the treatment would entail, the length of time it may take for my gums to heal before the implants were ready to  implanted and the teeth finally fitted.Nothing was rushed and my needs as a patient were always paramount to both Dr Sachdev and his team when I visited his surgery for my appointments.I was always kept fully informed as to what treatment would to be performed on each and every appointment made during my treatment.Dr Sachdev showed great competency, professionalism, and above all, excellent patient care in all dealings I had with him and his team.I would highly recommend Dr Sachdev and his team to both family and friends If they ever wanted to undertake tooth implant surgery.

records.title: Best dentist I've been too
records.text: The most clean, relaxing, friendly dental practise I've been too. Used to be a patient here a few years back.
