records.title: Issues do eventually get resolved.
records.text: So I had an issue with an allergy testing kit that I bought. Being that I paid for it and didn't get any results for well over 6 months with numerous attempts via email to solve this.I wrote a previous review and someone contacted me soon after. They were really apologetic and sent my partners results as well as my own free of charge. (the instructions weren't clear, it came with up to 4 people who could be tested and there was no option upon purchasing to add more than one person. So I thought I may as well send my sample and if it does cost extra then I'm sure they just won't do it or I will get some correspondence.)From my experience, I can say welzo is not a scam, the product is what it says it is, corrospondence is poor but when you do get through to an actual human they do everything they can to resolve any issues.

records.title: It seems that they are scammers/ Update: issues finally resolved
records.text: It seems that they are scammers. I placed an order, a week later wrote to them to cancel my order as they still had not dispatched it or at least kept me updated about the delay. Of course they ignored my email and posted the parcel few days later- 2 items missing and one item used/ damaged. Wrote to them again to resolve the issue but its over a week now and still there is no response. One star is too much for these clowns. An update:So after i left this review i had an immediate attention to the issue i had. Whilst i really appreciate that everything has been resolved now in a very efficient manner, it is sad that customers must broadcast their negative experiences to the world for the issues with their orders to get noticed. It also means that it is possible to resolve matters without delay and without damaging company's reputation.

records.title: Eventually sorted
records.text: Eventually thanks to Chris Manager at Welzo to look into my non delivery and give me a full refund. it's now being investigated as I wasn't the only recipient that didn't get their delivery. Customer service need to listen to the customer a bit more rather than just repeating the same message. However it's been sorted now and I appreciate being listened to by Chris and sorting it out. Thank you

records.title: I paid for next day delivery but it…
records.text: I paid  for next day delivery but it wasn’t delivered until several days. So there’s no point charging extra fee for “next day delivery” if it’s not going to be delivered as so. Overall, product was  perfect.

records.title: Good price, poor delivery
records.text: I've used Pro Fibre Advanced many times and it is great for regulating your dogs digestion. Regular use = firm poo. Great to use after antibiotics to get gut fauna back on track. However.... Welzo website assured me of next day delivery (if ordered in the next x hours" but it wasn't despatched for another 48hours - and then delivered next day. So 3 day delivery not 1. Then I discovered that it actually came from the supplier I normally use (needed next day and the normal supplier didn't have that option). Price was good but if you need it quickly I'm not sure you can rely on the promise.

records.title: Refused to acknowledge my request to cancel order although done within 13 minutes when they couldn't fulfil the next day delivery I paid for.
records.text: I ordered the item Friday afternoon and payed next day delivery. When order was confirmed they said they didn't dispatch Friday order would be processed Monday.  I immediately emailed to cancel  order as I was going on holiday Monday. I cancelled within 20 minutes of the order (there terms say cancellation within the hour). They replied on the Friday to say order was being processed.    They refused to acknowledge my right to cancel!  Update.Welzo have contacted me and apologised for the confusion and this matter has been resolved.

records.title: The pricing of the Great Lakes…
records.text: The pricing of the Great Lakes Hydrolysate Collagen - 454g - Great Lakes Gelatin Co. was quite expensive

records.title: Instructions difficult to read due to white writing
records.text: I wish they would put the instructions in black writing on a pale background - everything you need to know when doing the test at home is in white text on a pink and purple background and it makes it so difficult to follow. Other than that, the service is really good.

records.title: I ordered graviola supplements from…
records.text: I ordered graviola supplements from welzo. I paid a little bit extra for a next day delivery. The supplements didn't come the next day, it took 4-5 working days. That's the only disappointment.  There is no reason to pay more for a next day delivery, they are not going to come on time.

records.title: I ordered a large Actimove Arthritis…
records.text: I ordered a large Actimove Arthritis care Ankle support only to find when I tried it on it was too tight, I got in touch via Wi-Fi but was told you could not exchange it for a XL one. This item cost me over £20 so I’m afraid I won’t be ordering anything else from your company.Margaret Hopwood

records.title: Product as advertised however paid for…
records.text: Product as advertised however paid for next day delivery. Did not receive next day. Complained however no apology or intention from the company to refund the difference in cost. Would have been a more significant issue if was essential for item to be delivered next day.

records.title: A Bad Experience, Eventually Rectified.
records.text: EDIT.  Eventually received a response to my emails, including a phone number, so I was finally able to speak to a very helpful human. I have since received a full refund for my order.     ORIGINAL REVIEW - I had a bad, frustrating, time consuming, experience with Welzo recently! Only 2 of 4 items ordered arrived and Welzo have completely ignored the content of emails I have sent them. I provided photographs of the shipping label with weight stated, and box measurements, both proof of half the ordered & paid for items not being included. They have even asked me to respond to a request from them, which I have not received. There is no customer service number, in fact there appears to be no customer service!

records.title: Product very good and well priced.
records.text: Product very good and well priced.Delivery was the problem. I paid extra for next day delivery but it took five days for my parcel to be delivered.

records.title: Incomplete results
records.text: Disappointing not to get a full set of results, including no vitamin D result, which seems to be Welzos marketing focus, odd to draw focus to it to sell the tests then not prioritise the result. When speaking to customer service, who have been quick to respond, there are a couple of reasons this could be, but not within my control. I was offered a 60% discount but this would require buying another full set of tests which is costly.

records.title: Was an issue with order , but eventually solved
records.text: Originally had an issue . No product was sent , no emails received fit further information . Issue was only solved after trying to contact my bank and getting a refund . Product was eventually sent a week later than needed . Chris was very helpful in dealing with the issue which seems to be a system / communication issue . Very grateful to Chris for his assistance, however I think systems and processes at the company need to be reviewed to stop this happening for other customers .

records.title: Needed an urgent blood test but results…
records.text: Update to my negative review below - I wrote out of frustration of not being able to get an answer when I needed an urgent blood test and it failed (results said clotted).  Since then someone from the company called and had offered me several options to help resolve the situation , which was very much appreciated. It’s a pity there’s not a helpline when things go wrong but I appreciate the volume of people testing would make this difficult. Anyway, Welzo clearly do care about customer / company reputation as I had a phone call today, which I guess many companies wouldn’t bother doing. Needed n urgent blood test but results came through as ‘clotted’ No one getting back to me in customer services to help me know what to do next. Have emailed customer services twice, no number to call. Very poor service and have had to buy another kit from elsewhere as I need these results before the weekend. Would not have used Welzo if I’d have known the customer service side was poor

records.title: Good customer service after wrong brand sent
records.text: At first I was very skeptical ordering online. I was after a specific brand of Tea tree oil. The picture on the website showed it being the brand I wanted so I placed an order of 4 bottles. However, when they arrived, they were a different brand. Very dissappointed, I tried to find a contact number which was difficult and email responses are slow. Eventually, spoke to Chris on the phone and got a refund and Emily helped in telling me to keep items. Less stars for wrong brand sent and slow service. 3 stars for quick refund and delivery.

records.title: Poor contact methods and IT issues getting my results
records.text: Edited. No way of getting in touch other than leaving a web message via a form. Waiting on test results but it says there are none. No idea what is going on. Edit - response swift after this review, perhaps connected? Turned out we sent the sample on a Thursday day post but it did not get received until Monday so sample coagulated and spoiled. Randox do advise not to take samples Fri, Sat and Sunday, perhaps update welzo should update theirs. I am changing the review as they are sending another sample. For now 1 week later and back to square 1.

records.title: A frustrating experience, although partially my own fault
records.text: I ordered a blood test from Welzo and used it at home. Sadly, I forgot to attach the label with my details onto the blood sample test tube. However, I filled everything else out including the attached form and I registered my test kit. My blood test result came back as “Unlabelled”. I understand that it is my own fault for forgetting to attach the label. However, why is it that my result couldn’t be provided considering that Welzo/the lab were somehow able to link the unlabelled test tube to my account? It just felt like a petty way to reject my kit and get me to pay up for another one. I contacted customer service and I was told they’d give me a 100% off code. This ended up being for only around 50% when I applied it in the basket, and then when I filled in the address details I was told I couldn’t use the promo code and it went back up to full price. A frustrating experience all around. I fully acknowledge it was my responsibility to attach the label to the test tube but it’s not like they weren’t able to figure out my identity from it. It was also frustrating to be told I’d be able to order another kit for free only for the discount code not to work.

records.title: communication poor
records.text: communication poor, after I was told they were reviewing  my order I heard nothing for two  daysand then after another day it was delivered  no further communication  -watch amazon and learncould do better !

records.title: Issue resolved- after negative review
records.text: EDIT feom 1 to 3 stars: Quick reply to the review and call to resolve the issue. Chris fully acknowledged the error on their side and isaued me with a refund. So thank you Chris.I placed my order on friday and paid for NEXT DAY DELIVERY expecting my item to arrive no later than Tuesday. Item was not shipped till Tuesday. Emailed them straight away after receiving email that my itwm was just shipped and asked them to canx the order as they shippedit on 48h service and it should have been here by Tuesday.I paid next day delivery as i was traveling early on Wednesday. I got a reply on Wed stating it was delivered. I was at the airport by that time. They refusing refund for something that was their fault and keep going in circles!Absolutely disgusting

records.title: Item was left in a recycle bin
records.text: Item was left in a recycle bin, in the rain, no note through the door. Only discovered it by accident when putting the rubbish out.

records.title: Gell made no difference
records.text: Gell made no differenceAnd skin is peeling off where i applied itAlso anna said to mention her name

records.title: Dont seem to stock anything
records.text: All the order came from different locations/companies so it drifted in over a week or so with one item missing. After chasing up I got about 2 auto messages saying well get back to you and then nothing. Followed up again and low and behold that particular supplier didnt have any stock and have to wait 7-10 days for a refund. Hard work all in all and will just order from Holland & Barratt next time.

records.title: No good for a emergency.
records.text: No good for a emergency.Ordered meds and was emailed back a question. Answered it. Next day emailed another question. Answered. Two days later get delivery notification. Delivery two days later. Took five days. Website advertises next day or 48 hrs. It's not. It's slow. Of you're desperate try elsewhere.

records.title: Not got an item
records.text: I’ve bought from this company before and had issues before and it was rectified. Another issue I face now is that a bought some medication and I’m still yet to receive it. I bought on the 16/07 and still nothing 19/07. Next day delivery my a**I’ve not even wrote a complaint yet but it’s just poor.A few people have experienced not getting there items are not right items so it’s a growing concern Your order #67644

records.title: Missing items, delayed refund.
records.text: I made an order for 2 supplements. Order was delviered on 20th March with no explanation of why it was missing one of the supplements. I assumed it would be a split delivery and let it pass. 14 days later when I ran out of my vitamins I remembered the split order. I emailed Welzo to enquire what was going on, they refunded the missing item the next day.If I had not bothered to check they would have kept the money. No apology, no explanation, terrible service.

records.title: Worrying
records.text: Ok experience but negligent when it comes to helping you interpret your results. I’m almost three times out of the normal range but they’ve advised it’s ’within the normal range’. Worrying, wonder how many other people have been misadvised.

records.title: Delivery not Next Day
records.text: I placed an order and paid for DPD Next Day as I wanted the items quickly. I expected them to arrive the next day as happens with other online retailers. However customers should be aware that the delivery was 4 days after the order was placed because the the "next day" is from when the order is dispatched, and that isn't on the day of the order.On complaining I was sent a £1 refund.

records.title: I placed an order this morning
records.text: I placed an order this morning, 3/27 on line after much correspondence on the shipping to the USA and the high fees. I did place the order and was advised after the order was confirmed that they do not ship to the USA. They had already charged my credit card and  I was told that it would be 5 to 10 days before they can issue a refund. This charge should never have been charged if they do not ship to the US.  This is unacceptable and I consider it a SCAAM.

records.title: Very poor service, not as advertised
records.text: I ordered a blood test sampling kit, which was advertised as quick, easy and the results would be returned in 48 hours. The kit arrived as expected and I posted the sample on 25th Feb 2024. I received a confirmation email on the 27th. I have not however had my results. I have chased on a number of occasions, and have now been told that the results would be with me in 14 days.The level of service from this company is very poor, as I have not been updated unless I have chased them and there is no capacity to speak to someone in person.After my review, a manager at Welzo contacted me, offering a partial refund and an explanation that information on other websites hasn't been correctly updated as well as a full apology. My experience does not reflect the work of the lab itself.

description:
Goodbody Clinic offers affordable and trustworthy health testing in local communities across the UK.

Our services include private blood test appointments, COVID-19 testing and home test kits - working in partnership with community pharmacies and leading laboratories to provide exceptional customer service and reliable, accurate results when you need them.

By understanding your health now, you can:

 Avoid illness and the need for medication or treatment in the future
 Make changes to improve your health & lifestyle now
 Access additional screening & specialist help now to reduce your risks in future
 Avoid additional burden on the NHS
 Understand the risk to your children from genetic predispositions to illnesses like cancer and heart disease
 Prevent an unnecessary early death


Understanding your health now enables you to take steps to improve it - to give you a longer, healthier life.

Whether you are simply curious about your health and wellbeing, want to monitor an ongoing condition, need to take a test for travel, or are experience symptoms you want to get checked - we have the solution for you.

Looking after your health can sometimes be overwhelming, so we are here to bring affordable private care into your local community, making it easy to speak to a medical professional for advice, get a test when you need it, and follow up your results with convenient, private GP appointments, additional treatment or further tests.
We believe that when you know more, you can live better.

records.title: Excellent overview of general health
records.text: Pick a convenient location and timeslot, turn up, have blood taken, post sample, 4 days later, get results. Amazing service, highly recommend if you want an overview of your general health. Will be using Goodbody Clinic again.

records.title: A good positive experience
records.text: Odd location but overall the staff and experience was pleasant. I'll be back again when my next appointment is due.Manchester Central Location.

records.title: I had a great experience
records.text: I had a great experience, I had my blood drawn Monday morning and my results were back Tuesday afternoon. Great service, I highly recommend.

records.title: It was a good experience
records.text: It was a good experience. The nurses were very nice and helpful.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great experience, had blood test did not feel a thing unlike when I have one at my Gp's friendly staff 100% recommend ⭐

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great experience. Was quick and I was in and out in no time. Very professional.

records.title: Ear wax suction
records.text: Went for ear wax suction. Great service and great results. Reasonable price

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Visited the Bolton clinic recently, to undergo a full blood test. Holly dealt with me that day. She was efficient and explained everything that would be happening. Also, the blood test was pretty much pain free, she’s got skills!!Many thanks.

records.title: Great 👍
records.text: Like many people I'm not a massive fan of needles.  The gent at Easy Medical Center (goodbody partner) that sorted my blood draw was efficient, knowledgeable and really helpful.  Thank you 🙏

records.title: Very impressed, perfectly done.
records.text: I was very impressed by the blood sampling at Goodbody's. I'm used to such tests, but the address image online didn't look like a medical facility so I was a bit apprehensive. However, the blood draw was done perfectly, all procedures correct. A different deeper vein was chosen to usual, but he knew exactly where he was going and hit it perfectly, so I give him top marks.

records.title: I had a Premium Complete Blood Test…
records.text: I had a Premium Complete Blood Test done with themI booked it online it was very easy to book Just receiving the kit section was a bit confusing because on the web it says you will receive it by post and no confirmation in the mail so that's why I had to contact them to confirm they told me the clinician will be bringing the kits that need it to draw the blood they response was so quick I had a nice clinician but unorganized she had some out-of-date tubes and she noticed that in the middle of the blood draw she had to use another one Also, she struggled to find the veins in my arms and had to use it back of my hand She did ask me what hand I used which was right and she used my right hand I think that wasn’t a good idea because it hurt a lot and I wasn’t able to use my right hand all day that’s why one star off from me And I had my result very quickly within 4 working day So I do recommend them

records.title: Blood taken in a professional manner.
records.text: Blood taken in a professional manner.would of given 5 star but floor not clean as expected.

records.title: Blood draw itself was a breeze.
records.text: It was simple to book, but the clinic I wished to use was shut indefinitely, and no Superdrug location was offered. I had to go to Kent from Essex for my appt. (Dartford terrible crossing) At Orpington parking was close by, but needed a phone app. to pay. The clinic was clean and  modern, the phlebotomist was excellent and quick, and helpful. I scarcely had a bruise afterwards from a venous blood draw.

records.title: I actually thought I was booking for…
records.text: I actually thought I was booking for service at Reading Oracle shopping centre, so was surprised that this wasn't what I'd booked ! However, once I'd realised where it was I was able to get there early and get it done, albeit parking was a challenge.  Test / result came as promised.

records.title: SHAME ABOUT MEDICAL LOGISTICS CLINIC
records.text: I am having the truecheck (cancer detection test) done through Goodbody. They are excellent at explaining every step of the process very professional and kind and all in all I am very happy with them, all was running smoothly until their recommendation of the clinic to  have my blood taken :MEDICAL LOGISTICS 1 -5 PORTPOOL LANE. I got the first slot at 8 o'clock since I am a freelance linguist and need to get on with work early in the day. They told me to arrive 15 in advance, so I did, and I rang the bell and nobody was there. No phone number was answering. I was waiting outside for 40 minutes, until a young man in shorts and flip-flops came to open the door and very surprised asked me what I was doing there. When I explained I was meant to have my blood taken 35 minutes ago, he said he did not have the kit, then he started looking in drawers until eventually he found it. I thought I was dreaming the whole experience!!!!,  I am extremely disappointed with MEDICAL LOGISTICS 1-5 PORTPOOL LANE. That is the reason I am not giving 5 stars to Goodbody clinic, although it is not their fault. I paid £1,100 for a blood test and I was  sent to an awful  clinic (recommended by them) which kept me 45 minutes outside. Not very professional!!

records.title: Not a clear instruction to collect from
records.text: The address is not clear, in fact you have to to another place to get the antigen - its not called Goodbody Clinic?  also, i was promised the certificate in an hour but i had to chase via email twice to get it.  Not great as the person was going to travel the next day.

records.title: Great service, could improve website
records.text: My experience was generally quite good when getting a PCR test with Goodbody Clinic. The only issue was that when booking the appointment, the website asked for some information but did not specify this information would be used on the test certificate. I followed what it said and provided my first name, last name and the rest of the information. Therefore, when the test arrived (on time) my middle name was missing. So I called Goodbody clinic immediately and the person on the phone line was fantastic. He was friendly and completely understanding. Changing the information was super easy for them.I would definitely use Goodbody clinic again however, I hope that they can improve they website.

records.title: Ear wax removal
records.text: Quick procedure. Had to return as one ear canal was tricky. You did cancel my pre arranged 2nd visit.For me it was not major issue but a bit annoying to have to change my plans

records.title: Peace of mind results.
records.text: Highly recommended,  easy online booking super fast results overnight. Gives peace of mind before you go.

records.title: Accurate description
records.text: Accurate description, efficient staff, air con too strong while sitting.  Email arrived when stated.

records.title: Very straightforward to complete and…
records.text: Very straightforward to complete and appreciated the phone line for queries - very helpful gentleman talked through a few questions prior to our taking the Fit to Fly tests abroad. The only reason I haven't given it 5 stars is that the included written instructions didn't tally exactly with the process of recording the test itself - fortunately I was able to clarify this in advance via the phone line - would definitely buy again if needed.

records.title: The pharmacist was efficient and…
records.text: The pharmacist was efficient and pleasant and realised that I was in a hurry so attended to me straightaway.

records.title: Friendly
records.text: Friendly, efficient service…..waiting are could do with being tidied up!!

records.title: Easy to book an appointment and good…
records.text: Easy to book an appointment and good attention for the sample taking at Hythe Pharmacy. Results provided in suitable format within specified time period. Only comment would be that an earlier result than the absolute latest (delivered at 02.57 aginst 3.00am target) would have been appreciated especially as sample was an "emergency" and was avialable at the lab.

records.title: Pleased overall with help from the Customer Support
records.text: There were a couple of procedural problems submitting the results (eg used the wrong website!).  So we used the customer support line which was excellent and the lady was very helpful and patient. Overall it worked well, and the speed of receiving the results was 5*.

records.title: Nice service. Special thanks to Gillian for prompt response to my enquiry!
records.text: I have booked for the PCR test via the official website which is user friendly and the instructions are clear. I have got my result in time. Special thanks to one of the staff, Gillian, for prompt response to my enquiry via email. Thank you so much!Just want to mention the address of Med Mart which is given in the email reminder is wrong. As it's in Block 2 of Imperial Place instead of Block 4.

records.title: Covid test
records.text: Test was very quick and easy.  Only took about 5 mins for both of us to be tested.  Just thought the price was rather a lot for what it was.  All done by email and lab was just down the road so could have been cheaper.

records.title: Dodgy location but good service
records.text: The clinic is in a really rough part of town, but otherwise fine and met the promised timelines for sending Covid test results. I was not aware that I would have to administer the test to my son myself in clinic, so a bit of a surprise but otherwise no problems.

records.title: Pcr test and certificate
records.text: Overall service was excellent only problem was the passport was omitted from the certificate. I rang and queried this, gave passport number and new certificate was emailed straight away. Good job I noticed before presenting the certificate at the airport or we would have had a big problem. We would however use Goodbodys again.

records.title: Does the job
records.text: It was taken place at a pharmacy, the staff there was ok, but wasn’t really helpful in given information about the test, only told us to call the clinic if any questions. The clinic customer service was good and reply their online form swiftly. And the result cane back just before 9.

records.title: Lots of bruising.
records.text: Pleasant people but unfortunately the blood draw left a huge amount of bruising that still hasn't cleared. I know this is not my body because I had a blood test at the hospital only 2 months ago with no bruising at all .I've emailed my GP pictures as my hand has fallen asleep several times since at night which is a bit concerning.

records.title: You need well trained nurses to draw bloods please
records.text: I would like to inform you that I’ve had blood samples takes many time in my life time without any issues, I have brilliant veins and easy to access. However, the nurses who take the bloods out at their appointed clinics make mess of my arm, this has happened twice now.  Why? Rest of their arrangement are good.

records.title: Considering that I came to get a PRC…
records.text: Considering that I came to get a PRC test because I thought that I might have Covid the facilities available were woeful. No separation whatsoever and far too many people in both the waiting area and the pharmacy itself, and I had to administer the test myself. Also I had real difficulty finding any parking.

records.title: Unfortunate experience but excellent response.
records.text: I had an unsatisfactory experience when giving a blood sample, which was down to the individual concerned. This was treated with the utmost seriousness by Goodbody when I made them aware of it and they acted immediately with all parties involved to try and ensure there will be no repeat.

records.title: They will happy to take your money give…
records.text: They will happy to take your money give a service. Then if you want more information they are happy to take more money. Go to a company that gives you the full story not just the introduction.

records.title: Very professional blood draw but I was…
records.text: Very professional blood draw but I was kept waiting far too long with no apology or explanation.

records.title: I was really disappointed I was charged…
records.text: I was really disappointed I was charged £65 when there was no blockage detected so my ears did not get syringed.

records.title: Not so good
records.text: The clinic staff did not appear to be very welcoming and also a little distracted with dealing with other events within the clinic.I was asked to carryout my own PCR nasal / throat test using the swab provided which seemed a little unusual and potentially open to interpretation of use, I have completed many PCR tests and in each case the supplier has completed the test to avoid any ambiguity in collecting the nasal / throat samples.

records.title: I booked the Advanced well woman test…
records.text: I booked the Advanced well woman test, which needs a professional to draw your blood, however the test box came with absolutely no information on how to make the appointment, so I contacted customer service and they quickly gave me the information and links needed to make the appointment (apparently the leaflet with this information was missing from my package).There was also no information regarding if I need to fast for the test or not (I fasted just in case).The results were supposed to be sent to my email in 3-5 working days, on the 6th day I still didn’t receive anything (spam folder checked as well) so I contacted customer service again and got the results delivered shortly after.I Cannot talk about accuracy of the tests cause I have no way to compare but seems legit, only a bit disorganized.

records.title: Book direct and save £28
records.text: Found that your costs were well over for acting as a booking agent

records.title: Good service with order and dispatch of product but poor response from NHS.
records.text: Lateral flow order and dispatched.Arrived the next day as expected.Took test which revealed I was positive with Covid.I tried to report this on the NHS website but it would not accept the scanned barcode.The company needs to address this with the government website as everyone who is paying for a private lateral flow test cannot report it so actual covid figures will not be accurate

records.title: Our experience was not that satisfactory
records.text: Our experience was not that satisfactory as we went to the pharmacy expecting to be assisted with making an appointment then and there. We had to return to our hotel make an appointment on line for a half hour later and then go all the way back to the pharmacy only to be handed a box to take back to our hotel to complete the required test for us to travel make the plane journey home

records.title: I booked a test by your good selves but…
records.text: I booked a test by your good selves but your operator made me do the swab myself - she had apparently caught Covid 19 from another customer. Nobody offered me money back given the cheaper price for the do-it-yourself test.The results came through quickly. Thank you. I am surprised you are asking now in July for a test carried out in November 2021.

records.title: Every changing market for PCR Tests…
records.text: My rating are based on the current market situation. As a business we used the clinic on a number of occasion in various location for our staff.As a business traveler your services mean limited service. Meaning we have had to look else where - found places with better service and much more competitively priced all offering service 7 days a week which is now need for people travelling on business on a Monday.

records.title: Rip off
records.text: £40 for one regular antigen test. But because they're government approved you can't do anything but buy it if you need one for travel. And even you do it from home with nothing stopping you doing it on someone else who doesn't have Covid. Someone's making a lot of money

records.title: The spa where I and my 3 daughters all…
records.text: The spa where I and my 3 daughters all had treatment was good and we were all happy.  After that everything went downhill.  No available sunbeds og chairs by the pool, though there was lot of space.  Then we had to wait forever for our High Tee.  The tee was cold, the cappocino coffe undrinkable  (instant coffee we gussed) the service was very poor (the servant had had no training) and the food was a dissapointment). So our girls day out was not as good as we had hoped for.

records.title: Nothing to write home about
records.text: Covid test was done as expected and paid for before travel ..... Nothing special about the reception, welcome or venue however. Not well signposted outside with clear directions. No privacy nor private room provided. Pharmacy chap behaved as though he was too busy & that I was merely a nuisance at this particular Worthing venue. Left me to my own devices to find a corner somewhere at the entrance in order to swab my throat & ignored my choking on the swab ! 🙄

records.title: Felt ripped off
records.text: Really easy to book and staff at the pharmacy were lovely.  However we paid £129 each.  When we talked to other people on our holiday the most expensive COVID fit to fly was £49.  We had no other option in our area but to use Goodbody so I felt we had been taken real advantage of, shame as all other aspects went well

records.title: The pharmacy staff  was not very helpful
records.text: The pharmacy staff did not have any idea of what kind of test required to fir to fly purpose. I had to check myself by going through all kinds of websites including gov.Com I think the companies who provide this service and make a lot money, should also have up to date info about what kind of test required for what country.

records.title: I was surprised to take the test myself…
records.text: I was surprised to take the test myself just watched by the member of staff. Other places it was taken by the member of staff.  It was all a bit offhand.However the result came through promptly.  It was very expensive compared with other facilities.  I would not use your service again unless I as unable to get another appointment.

records.title: This was an entire waste of time...
records.text: This was an entire waste of time in lots of ways.1. Arrived early as told to, but no-one answered the door intercom. When someone exited, I went in but there was no-one in reception. Had to wait around 15min until someone emerged and asked me why I was there (for a booked blood test)!2. The test results were emailed from a personal name, not from Goodbody, so went into spam and were missed, whilst the spammy no-reply email follow ups got through.3. The results said that the first blood test sample was too small to do all the tests, so I had to go back again to finish the tests.4. The second test taken produced a large blood bruise under my skin which went yellow around it.When I was doubtful, the tester said she "had done it one or two times before". It seemed like it!5. The test results seemed to have nothing to do with their title, which had drawn me in for the tests, and no recommendations. 6. So a real annoying waste of time entirely.

records.title: Online system was very easy to use, but package did not arrive…
records.text: Online system was very simple and easy to use.Only problem was, the LFD test package did not turn up!  After a week I called the Goodbody Clinic number in Bath and was informed that there had been a mistake and my order was not on the system; I was promised that the order would be then be sent out express delivery. Four days later, no package and another phone call. More apologies, package had still not made it onto the dispatch list. By this stage I was out of time and had to go personally to a pharmacy in town to pick up my LFD to ensure I had sufficient time. Very stressful. Not good.

records.title: Expensive!
records.text: Seemed very expensive since all they do is hand you a swab! Don’t know much the lab changers them but I know it’s nowhere near £50!!Addition after Goodbody reply.------------------------------------This isn't rocket science, there should be no need for a great deal of "support". I still maintain this is a ridiculous price, readers can decide for themselves!

records.title: Did not insert passport number on the
records.text: Did not insert passport number on the PCR certificate which was rejected ant the anirport. Couldn’t get hold of the company because it was Saturday and they direct you to a voicemail. Ended up needing to redoing an express test to ensure details were correct.

records.title: Awful condition on delivery
records.text: Very disappointed on the condition of the tests when they arrived. They were delivered in a plastic bag when when opened I found that one of the boxes containing tests had been destroyed and the contents were all loose inside the bag. Not what I expected nor paid for. I would be grateful if someone would contact me asap as the only email address provided was a no reply one. Order 35493 Earnshaw

records.title: Not reliable
records.text: I booked a PCT test 9 am next day guarantee for fit to fly for work purpose.I had to do the swap myself and was told to leave unlabelled swap tube on the counter unattended.  I did feel a bit worried when I left! However at 7.30 am next day I received an email stating they didn’t receive my sample for the lab test and it will be at least 3 pm for the result.  Luckily,my employer agree to accept the result by 3 pm.  I was due to fly the day after. However if my flight was due the same day it would have been a disaster! Communication from the lab was excellent, hence 2 star awarded.

records.title: Poor organisation
records.text: Had booked for 10.45 collection. Turned up at the pharmacy, they had my order details but didn’t have confirmation I had paid. Showed them the email invoice but they still weren’t having it. Took them around 30 minutes to sort, almost missed my train. Very poorly organised, won’t use again.

records.title: Far too costly service.
records.text: Thé cost for these tests were astronomical (£129.00 each ). We had no choice but to have them in order to get on the plane. We administered it ourselves in a stock cupboard in a chemist with a shop assistant looking on. A  doctor’s signature was added without seeing this test being given . The results arrived  promptly as promised and without it we could not have taken our flight.

records.title: To be honest was supposed to be tested…
records.text: To be honest was supposed to be tested on site and the local chemist was coming from Sheffield yes Sheffield fir our covid test at 9.30Had to go through a home kit and hassle as we were flying out next day and it was important to get this done a a month  in America  to see our new grandchild was at stakeWe had to get my daughter an NHS nurse to sort it all outVery crap service to put it mildly Would not usei you again Also lost time at work due to this crapService

records.title: My wife and I took a covid test in Bath…
records.text: My wife and I took a covid test in Bath on a Tuesday morning. My result arrived on Thursday night. When my wife  had not received her result by Saturday night  we had to phone to find out why we had not been contacted.Eventually the result,negative, arrived late on Saturday night.This delay meant that we had to isolate for 5 days, half of our stay in England.

description:
Together Dental is a trusted dental care provider with 36 practices across the UK, committed to delivering high-quality dental services in a friendly and welcoming environment. We offer a full range of dental treatments, including general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, orthodontics such as Invisalign, and specialist services. With a team of highly skilled and compassionate professionals, our mission is to make every patient feel comfortable and confident in their care.

Whether you're visiting for routine check-ups, teeth straightening, or advanced treatments, we focus on providing personalized care tailored to your individual needs. At Together Dental, we use the latest technology, including 3D imaging, to ensure the best outcomes and a seamless experience.

We’re proud to offer both NHS and private treatments. Our goal is to make high-quality dental care accessible to everyone, ensuring healthier, happier smiles across the communities we serve.

At Together Dental, your smile is our passion!

records.title: After well over two years  when the…
records.text: After well over two years  when the hospital and dental departmentsWeren’t corresponding to each other Im almost completed my treatment at the together dentist stoke on Trent Have infection in my gums and cheek  bone because of the delaysBut expensive and time consuming

records.title: Regarding Dr Shina & assistant Lorna..
records.text: Regarding Dr Shina & assistant Lorna..I'm now half way through my Invisalign Dental treatment.. they have both gone above & beyond to make my experience comfortable & relaxed.They are extremely conscientious & I'm extremely happy with the results so far..Kind regards Mrs K Wilson Happy New Year to you all x

records.title: Holiday mishap
records.text: I broke a tooth on the Saturday before Christmas. I called into the Ashford, Middlesex branch, expecting to be given an appointment in January, but was delighted to be offered one yesterday, 31st. December at a convenient time, was seen very promptly by Hussein, who patched up the tooth temporarily within minutes. As anticipated, he advised me  a crown would be necessary, and again I was given an appointment with my regular dentist there in just two weeks from now.Excellent service over the holiday period.

records.title: I hadn't been to the dentist in…
records.text: I hadn't been to the dentist in years... I become a terrified mess in the waiting room and have had many unpleasant experiences in other dental practices so I was extremely nervous BUT this experience was completely different. The team were so friendly and understanding. I had to have my first filling and whilst it was uncomfortable, it wasn't painful and I was really made to feel at ease.After my appointment in the Benfleet practice, I registered my husband and my 2 young sons as I feel really comfortable having this team care for my families dental needs.Thank you and happy new year

records.title: My name is Nurul goni
records.text: My name is Nurul goni I would recommend our local dental at Whitchapple I was treated with respect , the receptionist made sure I was sent reminders as well as recived a call.The service was excellent and professional.I have always been greatfull for their kind and respectful service.I have recommended our local dental service to all our extended family.As always greatfull and thank everyone for their great service.N-goni

records.title: Great practice
records.text: I just went for a check up at Reepham Road as I was reassigned to a new dentist there when my regular dentist left the practice after 20 years. It’s a very very relaxed atmosphere, reception staff are lovely. New dentist is lovely - can’t fault the the place!

records.title: 32+ years of treatment with thanks
records.text: I’ve been a patient at Together Dental Surgery, High Rd Benfleet Essex for 32+ years and ALWAYS received first class treatment from true professionals and all the staff, very well done and thanks to all there. Janet R.

records.title: Daventrt branch
records.text: Visited the Daventry branch on 30th December. The dentist was very friendly and personable. He explained everything. An all round good visit.

records.title: Quick emergency appointment
records.text: Quick emergency appointment, friendly and informative about options. The only negative for me is the price, but when you are in pain you have no other option.

records.title: Although being a regular patient.
records.text: Although being a regular patient at this dentist for check ups, I still unfortunately needed an emergency appointment which I got on first phone call that morning, was dealt with kindness and professionalism and my problem although will be ongoing was sorted the same day.Big Thankyou.

records.title: I was very happy with my treatments
records.text: I was very happy with my treatments. I went for a tooth extraction in November this year, I don't remember the date and again on 26th November 2024 for a root canal and filling which I was so much worried about that it was going to be so painful.  To my surprise , for both occasions I did not experience the pain I expected. The tooth extraction and root canal were painless as Dr. Basra took the time to explain everything to me and handled it in an extremely professional manner.Dr. Basra I do appreciate your gentle touch, skill and knowledge as a dentist. All the staff are friendly and the surgery is clean with a conducive atmosphere. Thank you all.

records.title: Nervous@thedentist
records.text: I wouldn't say going to the dentist hygienist could be considered "great" but it had to be done.Once told I was the most nervous patient the hygienist and assistant took their time to explain what they were doing and what to do for after care.Thank you for making it as bearable as it could be.

records.title: Needs better expectation management
records.text: When I booked my appointment, I was not told it would be only for a scale & polish, nor what the price would be. As an NHS patient, I expected to pay something, but not what I was charged. I also expected advice on dental hygiene - none was provided.

records.title: My dentist Nasos is amazing
records.text: My dentist Nasos is amazing, I have historic dental trauma and lifelong dental phobia. I was extremely lucky to have been recommended nasos when we moved to Norfolk 7 years ago. In that time I have slowly learnt to trust him and he is also very respectful and understanding of my phobias. His dental nurses are kind and caring. Although I still struggle with procedures i do have faith that Nasos will look after me. I have met one other dentist at the practice during lockdown and she was amazing with my son. Especially when he turned up to treatment dressed head to toe in an astronaut suit and she played along to put him at ease. I would give Nasos, the dentists and his nurses 5 stars. However 1 star lost due to attitude of one of the receptionists. Who I found to be very dismissive.

records.title: Friendly, professional & efficient
records.text: I was dealt with in a friendly and professional manner. I didn’t have to wait very long to be seen and the treatment was provided with care. My only little issue was that the receptionist announced I was on Universal Credit, thankfully there were only a couple of people in the waiting area. I don’t gave a major issue with it but wondered if other clients might find this a problem.

records.title: Lovely dentist and hygienist
records.text: I’ve been with this dental practice for many years and have always seen Dr Paulson, he has always been caring and will explain each procedure and is honest with what I need. Francesca the hygienist is an absolute angel ! So patient, caring and puts me at ease (nervous patient) she genuinely makes the experience so much more bearable. There are a couple of receptionists who maybe need to review how they speak to patients but that is a small criticism which would never detract me from attending.

records.title: Hygiene appointment
records.text: I've been coming to this dentist for many years now. Have seen the changes of staff & dentists come & go. Has always been welcoming & staff polite & friendly. Now it is under Together dentist it is even more professional & the staff are lovely from reception to dentists, hygienists & dental nurses. I have always had a good treatment, with knowledgeable advice given. Do recommend this practice. :)

records.title: Good appointment

records.title: Appointment was punctual and…

The dentist ran through exactly what the process was and how the appointment would go. When it was our children’s turn she was very patient with them & made the process fun for them so they were comfortable & confident with being checked over.

records.title: Reception staff were friendly and…

records.title: Great dentistry

records.text: Waited a very long time to get an appointment due to maternity leave but was very pleased to get one eventually. Filled with trepidation as it'd had been so long since last appt. But all good, very relieved. Excellent service.

records.title: My recent experience wasn't great
records.text: My recent experience wasn't great, it's not all bad though. I was lucky enough to get a last minute appointment for a problem I could feel brewing. I was advised that their was an infection and my options we're to treat with anti biotics to clear or to remove the tooth to prevent future flare ups. The tooth came out. I left without anti biotics and a week later went back in pain and explained that i was unable to open my mouth wider than a centremetre. I was given anti biotics. A week later I had severe pain and ended up seeing the emergency NHS dentist who diagnosed Trismus (lockjaw) and gave me 2 lots of anti biotics and better advice regarding pain relief. I left here at ease that i had the pain under control and the infection was being dealt with. I felt rushed at together dental on this occasion and not processed with care. I've used them in the past and had no other issues and always find the staff friendly.

records.title: We have been relocated to another…
records.text: We have been relocated to another dental surgery in Norwich, as our original dentist has left our previous practice. The new dental practice is clean and tidy, just a shame there is a very minimal parking space outside, so you will have to parked on the road.  The new dentist we've been allocated is very quick with her examination, I was on the chair for 5 mins and its finished, my daughter was after me and she was in the room and out in 2-3 mins.  Not sure how careful we have been checked, definitely not how we used to from our old practice.Only time will tell.

records.title: The service was good but...
records.text: The service was good but I am a new patient and the first appointment I was seen 20 mins late and the second appointment 15, whereas if I was to show up late I would be charged or the appointment cancelled. It’s telling that I didn’t receive a review link for my last visit, when my hygienist appointment was “less than perfect”. Makes me wonder how accurate your Trustpilot scores might be?

records.title: NHS Patient, Earlham Rd, Norwich
records.text: I have been an NHS Patient at the Earlham Road surgery in Norwich for well over a decade. Anthony Paulsen is a good dentist, and he has treated both my wife and two children regularly with no complaints. Overall I am pleased with the service I receive from a dental perspective. I am very sympathetic to the pressures the dental profession are subject to, though their policy of automatically removing people from the NHS list is too extreme, unaccountable and takes 0 mitigating factors into account.At some point around 2013 I was forced to miss an appointment at short notice due to car trouble. Fast forward to 11 years later, and I had general check-up scheduled but I missed my 08:30 appointment due to waking up with illness. I rang in at 08:32 to advise (as the surgery doesn't open until 08:30).This triggered their "Strict" 2 missed appointment policy and I unceremoniously received an automatic system generated email that I am no longer eligible to receive NHS Dental Services from them. The practice manager was then unavailable for phone calls, and my email reply asking for any consideration was not acknowledged.Following an intervention by the Chief Operating Officer, I am pleased that some sense has prevailed and this automatic trigger has been rescinded. Charley Mitchell has been fair, courteous and reassuring throughout and I am glad and grateful he took the time to reach out to me.

records.title: Terrible parking options and a 25…
records.text: Terrible parking options and a 25 minute wait!!!

records.title: Overpriced but good service
records.text: Overpriced but good service

records.title: Not the best
records.text: Very grateful to have found an NHS dentist for my children. The practice initially told us they would only take our kids on if my husband and I joined as private patients. I felt a little uneasy about this as surely if they had spaces it shouldn’t be on a conditional basis.The dentist my children has been seeing conducts check-ups in 60 seconds per child, which again feels rushed and not very thorough.Finally, my daughter was told she had no baby teeth remaining. She highlighted she still had two, which the dentist dismissed “I’ve been a dentist for more than 20years, I can confirm they aren’t.” Lo and behold a month later they fell out as they were baby teeth. My daughter is now worried to see this dentist, she has no faith in the dentist’s abilities. Not the positive dentistry I had hoped would leave my children feeling confident about visiting a dentist into their adulthood. As they’re the only NHS dentist we can find, I feel we are resigned to accept this level of service.

records.title: The dentist was in a bit of a rush
records.text: The dentist was in a bit of a rush, no pleasantries or platitudes - straight in with the needle and then the tool for tooth removal. I felt that if there were any cost cutting or corners to cut, he would cut them. The assistants were nice, but I barely spoke to them as the dentist was in such a rush. He also hurt me with the injections.

records.title: Unfortunately I felt the hygienist…
records.text: Unfortunately I felt the hygienist appointment was not up to the usual standard. I was in and out within 10 minutes. Quick tartar removal and polish. My previous appointments were much more indepeth and thorough. There was no cleaning in between the teeth, the bits I cannot do myself.Dissapointed.

records.title: The clinic is basically clean and well…

records.title: Poor service

records.title: Kept waiting for over half an hour
records.text: Kept waiting for over half an hour. No-one told me why or how long it would be. Appalling customer service. Dental and hygenist service fine ……eventually

records.title: Clapham Together Dental Review
records.text: I have mixed thoughts on Together Dental in Clapham.  Consistency in good service depends upon the dentist you will see and more often than not it will be a dentist that you haven't seen before.  Although they have a strict cancellation policy and consequences for lateness, they themselves find it hard to maintain keeping to time and often cancel 10mins before an appointment.  However, if you show up and apologise for 5minute lateness you will have to rebook as the dentist refuses to see you.  This dentist practice has very contradictory standards and lacks the personable service that can be found in other dentist practices.

records.title: Together Dental Ashford with rude receptionists
records.text: The dentist at Together Dental Ashford are great and friendly, however the reception staff is not. My wife has been going to the branch in Ashford for a while, and there's a young lady in the reception that is always rude, she doesn't reply back when you say good morning or anything, always upset saying "I told you so" if you ask a question, or upset to be interrupted. Together Dental Ashford building looks great, newly painted, maybe now it's the time for Together Dental to invest in staff with good manners? or at least provide basic training for Ashford receptionists on how to provide basic customer service (it's not hard to reply good afternoon, and not being rude)? - today my wife has been at the branch, and again, the young lady was rude again.

records.title: Inconvenience and improper castings.
records.text: 1st  crown fitted 2 years ago took 2 moulding / attempts and 3 visits.After only 2 years that broke. Not covered under a ‘12 month’ warranty i paid for another. Now had a repeat experience where prepared crown does not fit. 2 visits down and expect to go back for another 2 before getting a fit. Lost business hours with all visits. Apologetic dentist team but no consideration to the accruing inconvenience and lost holiday I’ve had to book as a result of poor product manufacturing (not cheap). Contemplating a letter of complaint but undecided at the moment.

records.title: What A Let Down!
records.text: There was nothing wrong before I went to the dentist. Then I had a problem with the gum after my appointment. I was then charged for the return visit when it was the dentist who caused the sore gum at the first appointment.

records.text: Fix Health online physio. "I cannot express enough gratitude for the life-changing impact that online physio Fix Health, has had on my 95-year-old father's life. After a debilitating fall that left him bed-bound with limited mobility in both his upper and lower body, we were losing hope. However, the exceptional team at online physio turned our despair into a remarkable journey of strength and recovery. Through their personalized exercise plan and unwavering support, my dad's upper body and legs have significantly strengthened. We are thrilled to see him moving more and even standing a little. Their expert guidance, combined with unparalleled patience and encouragement, has been a true blessing. I wholeheartedly recommend online physio to anyone in need of professional, compassionate, and effective physiotherapy services. Their commitment to improving the lives of their patients is truly inspiring, and I will definitely be sharing our success story with friends and family. Thank you, online physio, for giving my dad a new lease on life!"

records.title: Very impressed with results
records.text: I was a bit unsure of how Physio online would work but have been very impressed with the support and the outcomes . Having a daily live video call with 45 minutes of guided exercise was so useful as 1) I was not sure what the ‘pain’ meant and would probably have stopped the exercise and 2) I am a bit lazy so it made sure I did the exercises every day . As well as the personal contact I was given clearVideos of exercises to do myselfEach evening , a call with a seniorPhysiotherapist every 5 or6 sessions to reassess and regularContact from a care manager . It would have been useful to know in advance what equipment was going to be needed so I had it ready but the ‘equipment’ was rolled up towels, exercise band , extra chairs etc so nothing specialized . I recommend the best way to take the calls is using a Smartphone and do lying exercises on a bed - that seemed to give best view . The link is to India but this did not cause any real issues with connection - the coupleOf times that there was a problem one of their IT team was on the call within seconds fixing it . One star down only because of a couple of instances of information not being passed and one time of a poor review experience - but if you remember they are not in the room so speak up straight away if there is pain or discomfort and be clear about what you need and ask any questions that you have at reviews then it will be a good experience . They will recommend 3-4 monthsFor full recovery so factor that in to cost. My knee still needed surgery because of the type of injury but , after 25 sessions with FixHealth I had more than 50% improvement with mobility, strength and pain reduction from a starting point of 2 crutches to only walking stick  for longer walks, and pain relief reduced to only a couple of times a week rather than every day and night . And I will use them again for rehab after surgery as I think it is a very helpful approach .
