records.title: DW Aligners
records.text: My aligners took a lot longer to receive than initially told however since receiving them I am absolutely thrilled with the service I have received and the changes made too my teeth. The App is so simple to use and upload photos and the service is so quick in advising when you’re ready for the next step of aligners. I’m on week 13 currently so two weeks left to get my perfect teeth. Thank you so much.

records.title: Diamond white aligners
records.text: Overall a good experience with the company. I would recommend but with one warning.I would not recommend doing the home moulds for getting your aligners. I think gave me issues with my aligners not fitting as well as they should. Take the time to book a 3D scan in a clinic.Positives: great price compared to other companies, very responsive, convenient with no clinic trips required.

records.title: Great so far!
records.text: I’m on week 6 and so far everything has been great. Very straightforward process and easy to follow, communication is great too. Only knocked off a star as they closed a couple of clinics close to me and I now have to go into London for my appointments, would be good if they opened more clinics

records.title: Easy experience
records.text: Easy experience. Seen results but not expecting them to be exactly like the AI scan so I have heard you can pay extra for tweaking at the end, and for retainers. Would recommend for people needing slight adjustments. Mine was because I previously had braces but lost the retainer so my teeth had started shifting, they look much better now I am near the end of my DW journey.

records.title: Very happy
records.text: Previously I had a bit of a Rocky experience with DW but Ben has been incredible, resolving any previous concerns despite being away on holiday. He really has gone above and beyond for me and shows he really cares about his customers at Diamond whites. Can’t wait to start my aligners!

records.title: Would highly recommend
records.text: Very impressive scan technology and good experience with them. No issues at all with the trays. Only tiny gripe would be that I lost my rubber chewy and they wanted to charge me to buy a new box and chewy.. rather than just sending me a little rubber bit which cant be expensive to make.. Aftercare seemed to be a bit disjointed but It might have been because I finished my treatment as they merged with Impress. Overall would highly recommend though and its a fraction of the price of other companies.

records.title: Overall a good experience
records.text: Process was pretty seemless, possibly could have been quicker but not the end of the world. It was within the timeframes they said it would be when I had my scan (15 to 20 working days)The aligners are good quality compared to what I’d had before so was happy in that department. Downsides would be not a whole lot of communication, just got a fedex shipment email and when the aligners did turn up they were on a different branding not that it matters too much as long as they do the job. My kit also included a whitening kit which was a nice surprise.Overall happy with what I paid for.

records.title: Found this very helpful
records.text: Found this very helpful, would highly recommend going for the scan to start with as I went half way through to correct some bits. Would say that the more robust retainer should be part of the package as the aligners don't hold up well as an option. But otherwise happy with the outcome and process.

records.title: The journey so far
records.text: The service has been very good with prompt responses to my questions. The quality and presentation of the Aligners is excellent. The information on the app is helpful. The progress is good though I am not yet satisfied with the end result. I am waiting for the dentist to review and agree the next steps. I am hoping that I will be satisfied with the response, fingers crossed! I will upload a second review following this given this is a critical part of the service.

records.title: Great aligners
records.text: My experience has been good due to the fast responses from the team on the app to any questions or queries I have. Sometimes my aligners would take longer to straighten my teeth then othe times and in some cases have broken, but I believe this is the nature of aligners. I would recommend insuring your aligners just in case.

records.title: Expectations met and quite affordable
records.text: I’m to aligners away from finish my treatment and so far I’m so happy with the progress…. A bit rocky to book the impressions at the start given the location of the different clinics but once I got them done everything went smooth and with the app progress and transitions are so convenient.Only negative is I lost my case and they asked me to pay for another, shame only one  is provided for a year treatment but it is what it is.

records.title: Good customer service so far
records.text: Good customer service so far , prompt to sort out any issues and answer questions quickly . I was very happy with the price as I assumed what I was paying for for top set only but was also for bottom . Taking a little longer than originally thought and I’m following ever bit of advice to the letter .

records.title: Very happy so far
records.text: I’m only giving 4 stars as I haven’t yet finished my treatment yet but I am more than halfway through. The communication is this company is very good - they normally reply within a day. The quality of the service is very good considering the price, including the quality of the aligners, app, packaging and scan box. It’s also a really easy process, hopefully I’m happy with the end result!

records.title: Before and afters are amazing
records.text: Before and afters are amazing! Customer care team were great & always sent out any replacements needed as quickly as possible.My only reason for not 5 stars is that they cracked often. Replacements were always sent out, just need to be made a bit more durable.

records.title: Only giving 3 stars because the…terrible communication
records.text: Only giving as many as 3 stars because the aligners  do actually work and my teeth are significantly straighter than they were. However when it comes to communication I would give 0 stars. The communication is disgraceful. In my 18 months dealing with diamond whites anytime I needed replacement aligners i would have to chase them up repeatedly, emails were not answered and it would take significantly longer than they said to receive them! I genuinely believe after the initial stages of the process when you need additional aligners etc they forget about you. Each time they would state that I would receive within 6 weeks, I would email after about 4 weeks asking for an update, they never responded. I would call at the six week point and would be told they were just starting production and would be with me in another 6 weeks, suggesting that it was actually my call that prompted them and had I not called they probably wouldn’t have even started production. This happened 3 times with aligners.This has happened again with my retainers at the end of my treatment! I ordered and paid for my retainers 9 weeks ago a d was told 3-4 weeks to receive them. iv emailed 3 times and no response to any of them! I rang last week and was told they would look into it and call me back that day, I heard nothing back, so rang today and they have said it was escalated last week and they are now in production and will be with me in 6 weeks. Absolutely shocking communication and I do genuinely believe that they forget about you after you sign up and they have your business. So whilst their retainers do work, I would not recommend the company to anyone based on what I have explained above

records.title: I have been happy with my aligners but…
records.text: I have been happy with my aligners but I would say communication is not great and waiting for appointments. I am now at the end of my treatment, I felt I needed more aligners but I was discharged anyway. I am not waiting for night retainers but have been told to wear my current aligners even though I have had the attachments removed so they are very loose. One of the aligners have cracked because I’ve had them in so long and they told me to go back to previous aligners even though my teeth have moved to the last weeks aligners. They said the retainers can take up to 6-8 weeks to come which I think is unacceptable considering I’ve paid the full course.

records.title: Initially very happy
records.text: Initially very happy, now on tray 15/15, have contacted via email and WhatsApp message, asking when my retainer (which I have paid for!) will arrive, I have had no response for 2 weeks! Customer service is not great at all.

records.title: The customer service poor
records.text: The customer service is less than acceptable. You don’t respond to emails or live chat. I messaged a week ago and still yet to receive a response. And an email 4 days ago with no response.The trays for impressions where too big which I asked about and still no answer, I struggled and did them anyway. Not a great start to the experience You need to work on this or you will continue to get bad reviews.

records.title: I have been using the aligners since…
records.text: I have been using the aligners since January 2024 and they have been comfortable so far. I'm on 12 out of 18 and can only see very slight changes. So I am hoping everything will be ok. I had hoped for more contact from a Diamond Whites dentist or at least someone from their customer service team. A lot of my queries on WhatsApp are not responded to, which makes me feel uneasy. I will provide a further review once my treatment has completed.

records.title: Not a great experience
records.text: Finished my treatment last year, was happyish with the result but one tooth still not straight. Customer service since finishing has been pretty rubbish to be honest. Ordered a new retainer on 5th Feb (£100) was estimated 3-4 weeks for delivery and its arrived on week 7. I had chased this several times and got ignored several times, was promised calls back that never happened. It was frustrating as 7 weeks is a long time with no retainer and my teeth have moved which really isnt ideal.This really has dimmed my experience.

records.title: I want to thank Selina in particular…
records.text: I want to thank Selina in particular for her stellar customer service and going above and beyond to help me.With that said I was sad my teeth haven’t achieved the desired outcome and I had significant problems with the trays not fitting correctly . Selina kindly arranged for more trays , these did not work either and my front teeth (the whole reason I wanted aligners) didn’t budge at all and are still crooked :( such a shame as it’s a lot of money to pay every month with minimal results . I’m sure they probably work great for some but not in my case .

records.title: Worth reading proper reviews!
records.text: I went with diamond whites through recommendation of someone I know (who’s an ‘influencer’), so they clearly get better service than normal paying customers. I had to wait from November to February to just get my visuals back! To then be told I had to pay an extra £750 for attachments and IPR, which I weren’t happy about as I’d already paid the intial amount upfront. There’s a distinct lack of communication from diamond whites, Cameron was fantastic however. I approved my visuals, waited until late March to receive all of my aligners and then had to wait until start of April to get my attachments and IPR fitted. Now 4 weeks in and my aligners seem to be ok. Only time will tell if my moneys well spent 🫣.

records.title: Disappointed with final results.
records.text: Brilliant communication through out the process. The Diamond Whites team were lovely. As for the straightening process I am disappointed with the final results. At the beginning I was sent through an image to show me what my final results would like but after finishing all my aligners my teeth don’t even look close to that final image. Definitely feel like I needed more aligners which may have then got my teeth like the image that they had sent through.

records.title: good results but not happy as not per…
records.text: good results but not happy as not per original scan. after 18 months and 2 scans was told this was my fault as i had (correctly) missed a couple of scans which affected the 'smile guarantee' which i was never warned about and was cut off from help straight away. paid for original retainers but never received in my second round another pair until i had to ask a few times. not happy as didnt know about the smile guarantee until it was too late and i was right to miss a couple of scans anyway as i had got used to how it worked after a year. unfair as would have to pay more to achieve original scan result.

records.title: Fine until you need refinements
records.text: Edited: I have since had a response from DW and they are now escalating the process which I'm really thankful for. Hopefully I will get my new aligners very soon. I’d had a relatively good experience with Diamond Whites until the refinement stage. After my first round of aligners, I needed refinements as my bottom teeth hadn’t moved into position. I have worn these but I still require further refinements and IPR to ensure I get the results shown in my original scan. It’s been almost a month and there is still no update on where my refinement aligners are and it seems impossible to make contact with someone who can help or to get a response to my emails. I do have to say a huge thank you to Selina though who has done her best to help despite my query being out of her hands. I feel like the communication process is harder than it needs to be and I really hope that I can write another review soon that shows a more positive outcome.

records.title: Had high hopes but now dwindling
records.text: Initial contact was great, really speedy and enthusiastic responses until I got to expect my 3d scans.Now on day 11 and haven’t heard anything aside from a reply to a question I raised which is when can I expect my scans. The response was ‘hopefully some point this week’ when I asked for them to be more specific I haven’t had a reply to my email. It seems they’ve tripped at the first hurdle.Not sure when I will see the next steps of progress…Pretty annoying.

records.title: No updatez
records.text: Booked scan very easy process. Told contact in few days. Over a week . No contact on plan or prices. Not even confirmation they have received scan information.

records.title: The retainer was cut wrong
records.text: The retainer was cut wrong, and it took ages to sort it out. The delayed process has irritated me and no compensation has been given, just excuses of a sheet that all the staff are using.

records.title: Customer service great but hidden…
records.text: Customer service great but hidden extras £££...Set up my loan agreement sent pictures of my teeth and sent impressions, but now been told I need to pay an extra £750 and travel 3 hours to a clinic for interdental filing and attachments to be fitted to my teeth. I had invisalign 10 years ago but my retainer broke during covid and couldn't be replaced so my teeth need minor adjustment (like mine won't be an impressive before and after and I have been quoted 12 steps so not much to do) yet this will probably end up being as expensive as invisalign by the time I am finished. I wonder what proportion of customers need this "extra" and whether it should just be quoted from the off....I just hope I get the results I am after and have been shown in the 3D visual....

records.title: Almost at the end of my treatment with…
records.text: Almost at the end of my treatment with little improvement will wait till completion to be certain. Hopefully it will be a good result all round.

records.title: Ok but have some grievances
records.text: All is ok but wearing them the length of time they say and haven’t been moving on to the next liners after the allotted time. Also takes a while to review scans. Also found out I have to spend more on a retainer for after the treatment otherwise teeth will move back to where they were. Would really expect this to be included for the amount spent on it all.

records.title: DO NOT USE
records.text: After a bad experience with poor communication . They have now gave me a full refund & the money for the moulds back which is much appreciated. They said this would in prove communication for the future so hopefully customers get a better experience then I did .

records.title: I was so excited to start my DW…
records.text: I was so excited to start my DW journey, and all looked smooth sailing from the website, however, I have found that everything is taking an incredibly long time, with no updates.I paid upfront, so I am very keen to ensure I don't lose out on a lot of money, so I did everything I could do asap, the communication was lacking from the start however. I waited several weeks for my scan, then had to chase up my results as I didn't hear anything for another month.I'm now another month past that, and had to email last week to find out when I am going to actually receive my aligners. They emailed back after a few days saying I should receive them 'within the week'. It has now been a week, and no sign of them.What doesn't help, is that there is no way to actually track the progress of the order, just a simple tracking update would put my mind at ease, as it's a lot of money!Anyway, if/ when they arrive I'll happily update this review! Overall, so far, not the worst customer service, but certainly not great or very forthcoming!

records.title: OK - but require improvements
records.text: I’m currently on aligner number 6, although I can see some changes already which is great, Diamond whites need to improve on a few things. When I first sent back my impressions, I didn’t hear back for a month so I chased up & was then advised there was an issue, if I didn’t chase up I’m not sure when I would’ve received an update. We finally agreed all OK and then received my aligners in the post a few weeks later - great. I have today realised the number of the aligner is engraved on the side of each aligner, I have checked my current aligners and a fair few are mixed in the incorrect boxes so I’ve been wearing aligners in the incorrect orders - although Diamond Whites are more cost effective than some other aligner companies, I would still expect simple things like this to be correct.

records.title: Non existent contact
records.text: Good service at first. I started my process in about 2020 now. Now been through multiple sets of aligners and although some improvements, the main crookedness has not improved. Diamond Whites say my teeth are perfectly straight now which is not true. I gave up after about a year or so ago when I could never get hold of them again. Never respond to emails and no number to call. I also paid an extra £100 or so at one point for some shaving off a tooth as the aligners weren’t working. Would not recommend. Very bad service.

records.title: Good to begin with. Somethings gone wrong
records.text: I was really happy with my alligners, I recieved all my 11 stages and completed it. Staff were very responsive throughout and I have purchased 2 retainers since completion both delivered. But now its seems to have all gone tits up. I signed up to a subscription retainer in July 2023 which still has not been delivered, no response or update on my order. Money keeps coming out of my bank. I've tried to make a formal complaint but had no response from that either. I just want what I've paid for and my subscription cancelling.

records.title: Non existent customer service
records.text: Dentist wise, advice and treatment in clinics couldn't be better from Impress. Unfortunately this is massively let down by Diamond Whites customer service - literally non existent. You have to contact them multiple times before they bring themselves to reply, and that's if you eventually do get a reply. I'm still waiting 3 weeks later for an answer to my request. When asking for something that's going to cost them effort and money, they'll avoid you. Example: I lost one of my stages of aligner, I reordered them and by the time they arrived 8 weeks later, I'd advanced 3 stages further on my treatment by the dentist. Typically I asked for a refund and they refused! It was only until I threatened them with an indemnity claim from my credit card they somehow immediately replied and issued a refund no problem? Beyond poor! But yet they claim to be the leading teeth aligner brand?

records.title: Started off well but........
records.text: Their service started off excellent 3 years ago but recently turned to garbage. I would not recommend this company at all. I cancelled their service due to the reduction of scan centre options (no longer provided a centre in my area). Unfortunately they had already taken my subscription and had promised a refund within 30 days. This did not materialise , and after lots of un answered emails and phone-calls had to recoup the refund through my own bank.

records.title: Don't bother.
records.text: They will call you and email you constantly when you initially inquire, then once they have your money, they will completely stop communicating. They sent the wrong aligners which were for somebody elses mouth and teeth. It took 6 months to receive the correct aligners and at the end of it, it didn't really make much of a difference to my teeth anyway. The amount of times I had to go back for new scans because they lost the information was ridiculous and ended up being more expensive than choosing the more reputable and expensive aligner brand.

records.title: Do not use!
records.text: Do not use! Started alignment treatment in August 2023 for very 'minor' alignment. First set of aligners didn't work after completing the course of 15 aligners even though I followed their instructions to the letter so I had to pay £50 for another scan. Now the second set of aligners haven't worked. I was told I now need IPR treatment so I paid £50 for another scan. Had the scan end of July & still haven't had any response from Diamond Whites regarding IPR treatment even though I've emailed several times. Total cost to date £2200. Waste of money

records.title: As per many other reviews - poor service after takeover
records.text: As per many other reviews here, I started the journey nearly 2 years ago, and at first was very impressed with progress and even recommended a colleague.  However my treatment didn’t provide the expected results, the company has been taken over and now having paid for further scans (which is at a makeshift pay per hour office in Peterborough) I am waiting 2.5months for my next steps, no reply to emails, no answer to phones. My ‘real’ dentist is suggesting I need to start from scratch with Invisalign as results are poor and teeth have nowhere to go without filing. As they say, you pay cheap you pay twice. Avoid!

records.title: Good at first, but contact and customer service has vanished
records.text: My daughter has had her aligners and when we had them there was a free retainer offer? they have now said wasn't included and that we have to buy. And have to go for another scan.  I have been trying to sort out for months and months starting with mine, cant get anyone on phone and replies to email are non existent! They also said if she recommended someone (me she would get a free aligner) No reply at all! Very poor customer service and we recommended them to everyone!

records.title: Don’t recommend
records.text: I was very excited about this company as an introvert and had no issues until the end of my aligners. Yes my teeth moved but my teeth never got straight as I was told they would and was left with a tooth that was still very visibly twisted. I tried to contact them to see if they offered refinements even for an extra cost. I never got an email back so contacted them on Instagram to which they told me my email must of got lost and to send another one. Again this was not responded to. I decided just to ask on Instagram about the refinements and my message was read and ignored. Shame, because I was willing to pay the company again to get my teeth straight. In the end it’s a good thing they didn’t respond because I was forced to go with Invisalign and pay more, BUT I know it’s being done properly this time. Just a shame I’ve had to pay twice, should have done Invisalign from the start and saved my money. Don’t waste your money, pay more or pay twice.

records.title: treatment worked ok - customer service poor
records.text: Undertook my surgery with DW February-June 2023 where my main goal was to close a gap issue on my upper teeth, worked well to be fair - although not so well on my bottom set.Purchased retainer's on subscription (£150 every 4 months) this was until June 2024 where I got told id need to do a new sample (90 miles from where I live) so I cancelled my subscription and used a local dentist for my new retainers. Diamond whites took the payment out of account on June 15th and said they would refund me the £150 for the retainers I would never get that month. Despite contacting them multiple times and them having received my bank account details, here we are 3/4 months later and i'm still out of pocket. During the treatment, customer service were often slow in replying.For the price - go fir it, worked for me. Just be prepared for poor customer service. For the retainer at the end of service, id just go straight to my regular dentist and get it done there (cheaper as well)

description: Longevita is a medical travel group based in Central London UK offering affordable and quality hair transplant, plastic surgery and cosmetic dentistry in Istanbul Turkey. Longevita offers face-to-face consultations and aftercare appointments in Central London by Patient Consultants, GMC registered Plastic Surgeons or GDC registered Dentists.

records.title: 5/5 Stars
records.text: 5/5 Stars - Exceptional Dental Treatment in IstanbulI recently had the pleasure of receiving dental treatment in Istanbul, and I am absolutely thrilled with my experience! From the moment I walked into the clinic, I knew I was in good hands. The clinic itself is stunning, with modern facilities and a spotless environment that made me feel at ease.My treatment was for crowns, and I was assigned to the talented Dr. Nuri Gokdemir, who is an absolute sweetheart! He took the time to explain everything in detail, listened to my concerns, and put me at ease with his warm and gentle demeanor. His attention to detail was exceptional, and I felt confident that I was in the best possible care.Gizem, my patient coordinator, was also an absolute delight. She was always checking in on me to make sure I was comfortable and happy throughout my stay in Istanbul. Her kindness and professionalism were top-notch, and she made sure that every aspect of my treatment was taken care of.The entire team at the clinic was wonderful, and I felt like I was part of a big family. The communication was seamless, and I was kept informed every step of the way. The quality of the treatment was exceptional, and I couldn't be happier with the results.If you're considering dental treatment in Istanbul, I highly recommend Longevita.

records.title: Breast Reduction and up-lift
records.text: The expertise of all the medical team and also the concierge team we're second to none for knowledge and advice, and also arranging all appointments with transport....absolutely fabulous 👌 I've already recommended longevita to a friend who will be in 2025 contacting longevita with questions and answers and also arranging with the Team to be looking into treatment for 2025

records.title: Longevita and Prof, Dr Fuat Yuksel are amazing!
records.text: My whole experience with longevita has been amazing from everything was sorted out for us from help with booking flights, transfers and hotel stay alongside just my surgery. My co-ordinator Zuhal was great, very welcoming and looked after me the whole time, spoke very good English too. Prof. Dr. Fuat Yuksel is absolutely the best at what he does and has changed my life, i trusted him 100% and he has done an amazing job!

records.title: I had a breast reduction and my…
records.text: I had a breast reduction and my experience with Longevita was very positive, I was looked after by Zuhal, who was very welcoming and friendly. The surgeon was very informative in his consultation and put my mind at ease which was really reassuring. I am almost 2 months post op and my scars have faded so nicely, which I was the most concerned about, even the shape and size, they are literally perfect. Dr Fuat Yuksel, you have changed my life, the confidence I feel now is unmatched. Best thing I have ever done - thank you

records.title: Highly recommend Longevita!
records.text: I have used Longevita twice now for a breast augmentation and liposuction 2.5 years apart. The service I received both times has been amazing. I felt very comfortable and safe with the care team that supported me. I requested the same surgeon both times - Prof Dr Fuat Yuksel. I felt so at ease, he seemed to understand exactly what I wanted and has done amazing work both times.My breast augmentation has given me such a huge confidence boost, I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. I was very flat chested prior to this surgery and was extremely self-conscious. I would often get upset with my appearance before going out or not be able to wear what I wanted due to not being able to fill a dress or top. Now, I feel so confident wearing outfits that show cleavage. It really has changed my life. My liposuction hasn’t healed yet as I had the procedure less than 2 weeks ago. However, I have been able to send photos and double check the healing process with my surgeon who has promptly answered all of my questions. The patient co-ordinators have been amazing too! They make each appointment less nerve wracking and make sure everything is explained in a way that you understand. For my most recent surgery, I had Gizem supporting me. Gizem has been supportive, responsive and accommodating throughout my journey. I have never been made to feel stupid for asking questions and have been reassured by the team supporting me. I couldn’t ask for a better experience. Getting surgery abroad can get a bad reputation but honestly, I couldn’t recommend Longevita enough. Following my recommendation, my friend also had a breast augmentation and lift with Longevita and is also extremely happy with her results. Thank you to the whole Longevita team and my surgeon for providing amazing service and giving me confidence in myself.

records.title: longevita-The best in the business 100% 👌🏽
records.text: An absolute amazing experience with Longevita. We were looked after by Mert who was such a lovely, genuine person and extremely helpful as were all the longevita staff who looked after myself and family, any questions I had were answered in great detail Honestly couldn’t fault one thing, great experience 👏👏👏  If going anywhere, go here ☺️

records.title: Had my breast augmentation in September…
records.text: Had my breast augmentation in September 2024 and i couldn’t not be happier! Everything went so smooth and dr fuat yuksel was the best he gave me everything I’ve ever wished for and more!Even after being home I had a problem threw a fault of my own and he was nothing but helpful I would recommend this place to anyone so much stigma about surgery in turkey but it’s been the best decision of my life!THANKYOU LONGEVITA

records.title: Exceptional Service and Care with Longevita – Highly Recommend!
records.text: I recently traveled to Istanbul for a Septorhinoplasty procedure through Longevita, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with my experience from start to finish. From the moment I first contacted Longevita, the entire process has been seamless and incredibly professional.The initial consultation was thorough and informative. I was immediately put at ease by the patient consultants, who took the time to answer all my questions and ensure I fully understood every step of the procedure. They were incredibly supportive throughout the entire journey, guiding me with the booking process and providing clear instructions for travel and accommodation. Their attentiveness made me feel confident and well-prepared for the surgery.The procedure itself, performed by the highly esteemed Prof. Dr. Fuat Yuksel, was everything I had hoped for and more. His expertise and attention to detail are unparalleled, and I am beyond ecstatic with the results. I truly feel like I’ve received the nose of my dreams. Dr. Yuksel and his team made me feel comfortable and well-cared for, explaining everything clearly and addressing any concerns I had.Recovery was smooth, and I was discharged with all the necessary information to ensure a quick and safe recovery. The post-operative care was just as attentive as the pre-surgery phase, and I’m so grateful for how well I was looked after throughout.I can’t wait to see the final results over the next 6-12 months, and I would wholeheartedly recommend Longevita and Prof. Dr. Fuat Yuksel to anyone considering this procedure. A huge thank you to everyone involved – your care and dedication have truly exceeded my expectations!

records.title: I went to Longevita for a breast lift…
records.text: I went to Longevita for a breast lift and augmentation in October 2024. The service was excellent and the whole week ran so smoothly thanks to our patient co-ordination Mert. The hospital was spotless and I was made to feel at ease and the surgeon was welcoming, friendly and professional. I had every faith in putting my trust in him to give me the outcome I desired.Would highly recommend to anyone thinking of having surgery in Turkey.Hannah

records.title: Wouldn’t have gone anywhere else
records.text: I had surgery with Longevita a month ago & I couldn’t fault them at any point. I booked my hotel separately as it was cheaper for me, but that’s not always the case so definitely cross check, but they made the whole process so easy. They booked my airport transfers to and from the hotel, they organised all of my appointments with the hospital and clinical team, Zuhal and Baris were great as coordinators. Any questions I had, they answered for me very quickly, the hospital that Dr Fuat Yuksel uses was very clean, very comfortable and very nice. If you’ve been to UK hospitals, this is far beyond even private hospitals here. The surgical team were great, the surgeon himself is kind, caring, and very professional. He’s realistic in what he can and can’t give you results wise and he came round to see me in the hospital whilst I was recovering multiple times which was very nice. He obviously cares and is very compassionate. I wouldn’t go elsewhere for cosmetic surgery again. My surgery wasn’t purely cosmetic, it was medically necessary but the NHS wouldn’t cover it, Dr Yuksel was very caring about this and his whole team were very kind. Couldn’t fault my experience and would really urge people who are considering surgery abroad to look into Longevita and Dr Fuat Yuksel!

records.title: I had breast uplift and implants June…
records.text: I had breast uplift and implants June 2022 contacted  last week about a severely painful highly likely ruptured implant that is getting worse. Aftercare team and surgeon are working together to help to get this matter sorted.

records.title: Rhinoplasty
records.text: I traveled to Istanbul for a Rhinoplasty procedure. 1 week post opp and I am more than happy with the results and the service provided by the Longevita team! My patient care specialist Batuhan was extremely helpful and made the process less stressful and at ease. Overall , brilliant experience!

records.title: Breast Reduction age 20
records.text: Travelled to Istanbul in December aged 20 for a breast reduction. I had an amazing experience, from the pick up to the communication from my patient specialist Seda who was lovely as well as Beran. I travelled with my mother who also got her teeth whitened. I was very nervous at the beginning but after meeting with Dr.Fuat I became very relaxed and even more excited to do the surgery. The hotel was lovely and the hospital too. The only thing I would have liked is a little bit more time on the day of the check up just to ensure everything was alright before travelling home. When I got home, due to the pressure on my breasts from the stitches one side had began to open slightly.Although when I expressed my concern, the aftercare portal responded very quickly and gave me in-depth advice which was great and the wound is full closed now and I am fully healed. Would recommend Longevita.

records.title: Breast augmentation and uplift
records.text: The staff at the hospital were the biggest let down for me. They need training on being more friendly and helpful. Shoving your food half way across the room when you've just woken up from a painful operation and can barely move is not nice. The food was absolutely shocking, if I wasn't given the heads up to harm myself with fruit and snacks, I would have starved. Whilst the hospital itself is clean and modern the food and staff let Longevita down. I felt as though I was more of a pain to the hospital staff than a paying patient and at times felt like they didn't even want to touch me.The bandages, anticeptic solution does not last long enough for the amount of time patients have to use it.  Considering the amount of money paid it would help to have enough for four weeks as its not easy to understand what to look for on returning home.I held off on writing this review as I'm aware that once certain companies get your money they stop answering you when you need them. Whilst I haven't been ignored I'm concerned that both me and the girl I met whilst there both have infections in exactly the same spot. Advice given by the surgeon at Longevita totally contradicts info given in the UK. Longevita advising to shower clean, dry and clean and Nurses here saying to keep the area totally dry. It has been said that the surgeon stiched the area too tight. Scary that this happened to two people on the same day. Overall I do believe Longevita are professional I love the way you can contact them via a scheduled appointment. The drivers who collected me for my transfers were lovely and my rep was also polite. I would recommend as I'm already loving my breast despite still having some swelling (which is natural) my  issue is the fact I now have an infection and a hole under my breast, which I'm having to take regular visits to my gp to have it packed and dressed ) Im aware that this will heal eventually) not helpful as I'm back at work and the regular gp visits is a bit of a nightmare. I know parts of my review sounds negative but I would still recommend. Just make sure someone travels with you to avoid relying on the hospital staff too much and hope you don't get an infection.

records.title: Neutral review stating facts based on my experiences.
records.text: This review will only state the facts, I will not give my opinions, positive or negative, just share my experience neutrally to help others make an informed choice.First time going there, had hotel and transfers included. Airport transfer is luxury, others are not. Traffic and Turkish timing is a bit chaotic. Hotel was good quality, but distance meant getting caught in traffic A LOT.Noone directly asked about me having COVID before coming over, waited until the pre-op assessment. I have been informed it was within something I signed, but I don't personally remember seeing this. At least, it was not obvious to me. I had COVID about a month before surgery but was not poorly with it. I was told I could not have my surgery. Went with partner who was having teeth done so couldn't just come back home. I was also just have a single crown done which at the time was one third of the UK cost, so had those appointments and tried to enjoy it as a holiday.Enjoyed Istanbul, particularly Kadikoy, Asian side.Had to rebook surgery. This time I booked my own hotel and used Uber as was much cheaper. Went alone as partner had to do childcare this time. Had surgery. Was very nervous. Booked extra night in hospital as was on my own. This meant I was last into the theatre. I was doctor's 4th patient of the day. Considering he then does consultations all evening, the surgeon works a lot and gets little rest. Straight away I noticed one breast was very different to the other. One was higher. Was told it would settle and not to worry. Was in a lot of pain so got my partner to fly out to be with me on day 3. I struggled to go to the toilet and do basic things as I recover slower than most from surgery and have an extremely low pain threshold.The surgeon tidied up a pointy bit of skin I had at the end of a scar from previous tummy tuck surgery, for no extra charge. Doctor changed dressings and checked breasts again on last day. I was concerned about one breast being very different to the other but he said it is just swollen and will be ok. Once I was home and let them recover for 6 months, I could still see the strange shape and position of one breast. I also had one nipple noticeably much larger than the other, on my other breast.I paid £600 ( discounted from £1000) plus flights and hotel and went back to Istanbul for revision surgery, wasn't sure exactly what would be done until I was assessed in person. Was told at the consultation the night before surgery there would be another long scar under 1 breast in an attempt to make them more symmetrical and reduce the size of the larger nipple. The nipple was reduced, however there is a lot of fat behind the nipple since, so it now looks fat while the other looks flat. On the breast being fixed, not much changed, apart from a long scar I now have underneath just this one breast. It is still an unnatural shape. For an idea of what my breasts are like, my RHS breast is a FF cup while my LHS breast is a F cup. Possibly too much fat was taken from the left. It looks that way. The LHS breast projects forward with no finger space underneath, but there is a scar under, whereas the RHS breast sits naturally with fingerspace underneath. I have found it difficult to wear a bikini due to this. My LHS nipple looks normal, while the RHS nipple looks chubby. However, the left no longer feels as obviously higher than the right breast. You can not notice these differences in normal clothes, but the difference is very obvious without clothes on. [Edited: I am not able to comment on other people's experiences]I must mention, although my partner's crowns were put in very close together making it hard to maintain dental heigene, they looked very good and he has been extremely happy with them. From previous dental experience, I'm aware it's hard to create much space between crowns. My crown actually popped out yesterday whilst eating a bagel, but I do have short teeth which makes it harder for the crown to stay in.The dentist we thought would be doing the work did not, but another dentist who worked at the practice did the work on both of us. Please research thoroughly your provider AND surgeon, read possitive and negative and neutral reviews. Take not just negative but also positive reviews with a pinch of salt, and bare in mind the reasons you may find many more positive reviews than others. You can never do enough research! At the end of the day, the service provider can only deal with the service element. The surgeon is the one with your life and your body in their hands. Also try not to have high expectations when having surgery abroad.

records.title: I am writing this review upon returning…
records.text: I am writing this review upon returning home to the uk on 25th August, on 29th August my dental crown came out, it’s not easy to get in contact with aftercare, I have still not had contact with anybody to help me, I am very disappointed in this as I feel the aftercare plan is not what it offers

records.title: After leaving a bad review
records.text: After leaving a bad review, they contacted me again to resolve still at a higher price. It took over 10 emails to get this far. They then said If I didn’t delete my HONEST Review they will charge me 5000! Please stay well away from this company

records.title: Please everyone avoid Longevita
records.text: Please everyone avoid Longevita! I have been severely botched by them. They do not take any accountability for anything. Prof Fuat has destroyed me….. These are the words of the surgeon I have had to see back here in the UK. It is that bad that he is unable to fix it. I have a double bubble on each breast, far too much tissue taken away especially on one breast, my nipples and breasts are different shapes and sizes and one higher then the other, My breasts are flat underneath and the scars going onto my ribs which are 6cm wide, and also Symmastia! I’m am literally in tears and shocked. My confidence has been completely destroyed. Please be aware of this surgeon!

records.title: Booked a £250 deposit for a hair…
records.text: Booked a £250 deposit for a hair transplant on November 25th 2022, I had not book the procedure as I become unwell not long after. Just before Christmas I was diagnosed with cancer and starting treatment meaning my hair is going to fall out. I contacted today longevita to explain there is no chance of having the procedure and the first thing that was said is the deposit is non refundable. I would have preferred them so wish me well first but seems money is more important to them. From that I decided I will get my money back as it is out of my control not to have the transplant. My wife spoke with a solicitor costing £130 for 2 hours and was advised we can take them to small claims court and sue for damages due to the circumstance. It seems pointless as I have more to worry about than £250 but it's the principal of that being my money and they can not profit from a sick individual. I truly look forward to there defense in court and sad excuses to why the feel they can treat a cancer patient this way.

records.title: Would not reccomend
records.text: I had a really bad experience with this company. My stitches burst open because I wasn’t given the amount required to hold the excess skin. My aftercare host was very rude and dismissive of my concerns post surgery but was the sweetest person pre-op. I met my surgeon for less than 10 minutes before I went under. My areolas look as though they were thrown on and are weird shapes. The scarring is awful due to the issue with the stitches. When I experienced sharp pain on one side consistently past the time I was told everything would settle, I was told to have a MRI??? I would highly advise you to avoid this company. I need another surgery to revise the ‘breast lift and augmentation’ I got here. There is no point paying cheap, only to have to buy twice, with added insecurities. Don’t be fooled by reviews left under pressure or even possibly fake!Edit: After requesting my contact information, which I promptly forwarded on to them- I have not received any attempts to contact me. Instead, they have made various attempts to have this review removed. Thankfully, as per the additional  information I sent through, Trustpilot have confirmed my review as legitimate, so anyone reading this can rest assured that I was in fact, a customer of Longeveita.EDIT: There is no confusion or self-conflicting in my experience neither on this platform, or the trauma I have been left with. Mobile, email & name were forwarded, and as previously stated, verified through Trustpilot. If this company did not trust this platform, they wouldn’t be trying so hard here to accuse me of illegitimacy. Again, as previously stated- when I reached out with my concerns following my surgery, I was made to feel silly and then subsequently advised to pay for an MRI, so there’s no need for me now to ‘reach out directly’ again. This is my last edit, despite what Longeveita wish to add to their standard reply. They have had enough of an impact on my life, I won’t be wasting more time here with them.

records.title: No wonder no negative reviews, £5000 fine in terms and conditions
records.text: Horrible company. I first engaged with Longevita on Monday 16th October, having received a quotation for treatment plan via email & then a quick phone call on the same day which they call a ‘consultation’.It’s not a consultation at all - the people at the end of the line are simply a bookings team & know nothing about the procedure itself, so can’t answer questions.Having told them that I’d been referred to them by someone who had undergone a procedure with them, they took the plaudits & failed to make clear that they themselves are not the service provider, and instead a middle man who will book you in with a surgeon/clinic whom you’ve been able to conduct no research whatsoever, let alone speak to.After my ‘consultation’ phone call, I was hurried into paying the deposit & within an hour of my call, whilst busy running my own business, they were messaging me hurrying me to make the payment to avoid losing the booking slot - so I did.At no point had they made me aware of their terms and conditions, so I simply saw this as a holding deposit of sorts. The next day I received their terms and conditions which I was requested to sign, at which point I saw numerous clauses which meant I would never go ahead with this company.Firstly they remove all liability for themselves, as they’re not the service provider, just a middle man. Secondly, they install a clause to ensure nonnegative reviews from customers, with a £5000 penalty for anyone who has mouths the company online or otherwise. Massive red flags.Within 24 hours of being rushed to make the deposit, I contacted them to ask for my deposit back, since they’d effectively breached their own agenda terms by not clearly providing me with the terms and conditions before paying the deposit.They refused my request, which seems utterly ridiculous given that no time/costs would've been incurred within the 24 hour period.I’ll now open a HM tribunal & courts case to get my deposit back from what seems to be a scam artist, meat factory like, business.

records.title: Refused treatment due to a mental health condition
records.text: So firstly I was impressed by the team and was ready to put down a deposit as we went through the health check list I informed them I have bipolar, they then refused to do treatment. I asked them to explain why and they told me that it would affect healing time which of course makes no sense, I use medication that increases the serotonin in my brain the thing that makes you feel happy, that cannot affect healing time. I have been accepted for treatment in the UK with some of the biggest brands and also accepted by some of the leading brands in Turkey because the medication I am on does not medically affect surgery (confirmed by dr In pre surgery health assessment) Having a mental health condition as long as you are capable to make decisions and are healthy should not affect your treatment don’t be discouraged, you can have treatment just not currently with this company. May I add the complainants team where amazing took my complaint very seriously and are working internally to make sure they can be more inclusive and I believe that their team wants to be inclusive and understands the importance of this. Unfortunately as they still can’t offer me treatment I cannot remove this review as it still stands but I do believe in future this will not be the case and hope to remove this soon.

records.title: Very poor hair transplant
records.text: Not a good experience. Cheap hair transplant but parts of it failed and I also experienced some negative side effects. Essentially the donor area was over-harvested and then the procedure was badly performed. Aftercare was horrendous and despite promises of fixing, I was expected to bear the costs of the transfer and accommodation. For the past year I've had several emails asking me to sign a non-disclosure agreement as they clearly want to avoid negative publicity. Avoid at all costs.

records.title: TOTAL SCAM!! Botched boobs and no bbl
records.text: Age 20 (at the time of the surgery ) I had i breast reduction 2 years ago and a “BBL” i had the worst job done. one nipple is bigger than the other and have dog ears hanging from sides of my breast and this terrible scar underneath and around my areola I woke out of surgery with the doctor claiming he gave me a BBL but didn't feel any pain or discomfort as if i have liposuction or any discomfort in my bum all. My bum looked the exact same. I tried to explain this to the doctor but he said that its swelling and everything will calm down and i will see results and knew was lying because i never felt like i had liposuction or anything done to my bum. When i got back to the uk i asked for refund but the told about terms and conditions and said they couldn’t offer me a refund. This company has ruined my life and my confidence i came there to fix my biggest insecurity what was my very large breast (34j )also gave me back and shoulders problems and my  insecurities worst. And not only that i paid for something i didn't have done. This company is a scam and needs to be shut down!!!!

records.title: This company doesn't even warrant one…
records.text: This company doesn't even warrant one star !!!!!!!!2 years ago I went and had a leg lift due to excess skin from being overweight in the past plus breast implants , whilst i was treated well when i was out there , when i came back to UK my wounds opened and severe infection appeared , they promote 12 month aftercare which is absolute rubbish ,no help at all, thank god for NHS other wise i could have been dead !was on antibiotics for 3 months plus having the nurse dress my wounds for 3 months  just glad it wasnt this year , Im left with bad scarring plus no difference in legs , wish i never went !AS I CANT RESPOND TO YOUR REPLY IVE EDITED MY REVIEW , THE HOLES IN YOUR REPLY WERE AS BIG AS MY HOLES IN MY THIGHS AND YOU SAYING ABOUT SEEING YOUR NURSE BACK IN UK .. I DONT KNOW ANY NURSE THAT ROCKS UP IN JEANS AND JUMPER WITH 2 INCH PAINTED FINGER NAILS TELLING ME  I HAVEN'T GOT INFECTION WHEN THERE IS GREEN /YELLOW PUSS RUNNING DOWN MY LEGS FROM THE WOUNDS !AND FOR YOU TO SAY I AM DIRTY ..THAT IS SO OFFENSIVE AND AS FOR THESE SELFIES PLEASE PROVIDE AS I KNOW I DID NO SUCH THING !! LIARS !!!!!

records.title: You will be sued £5000 for leaving an honest review
records.text: You won’t see a negative review of Longevita here as by paying them a deposit for surgery, you sign a disclaimer which states you will owe them £5000 in damages by sharing your GENUINE experience with Longevita. I am writing here about my genuine experience and am thankful to say I dodged a bullet before I went ahead and had surgery with their contracted surgeon. In a bid to ‘poach’ me from a rival company, the coordinator I spoke to at Longevita sent me information about said company which showed them in an unfavourable light. Needless to say I was worried as I was heading abroad for surgery and wanted the best care possible - this would not have been achieved my choosing this cowboy company. They told me they’d had several individuals which had needed revision surgery which was ‘botched’ by the other company. I have now realised this was just a tactic as I was lucky enough to get out of the contract when I did and go back to the company I had chosen who have done the most amazing job and provided 5 star aftercare. I’ve heard many tales about Longevita recently and not one of them good. If I save just one person from going ahead with surgery at Longevita, this will be review well written. DO NOT choose the company that is the cheapest - there is a reason the company is the cheapest! AVOID

records.title: Food for thought
records.text: So ordered a kit to try and narrow down what I think is a gluten intolerance . I was expecting a box in the post like in the picture on the advert so waited a while for the post man  . After a while we realised no box would be arriving as it’s in an email and you can just bag up your hair and send it to their address , our fault I guess  but not overly clear in my opinion thought email was just a confirmation email of our order  , results arrived and wow they are very clear and extensive with great help on what to eat and not,  how to improve your diet, vitamin inballences etc    , I’m still working though the list to find the main food culprits that up set me . Can’t fault the results !! However I was a bit disappointed that after buying this test suddenly on my timeline on my phone are another 2 tests I could have ? An ultimate test and another one in addition to the standard one ? Would these of been better ? Would they give different results ? Did I do the right test for me ?am I missing results I may need ?  Seems a shame I never saw these other tests before I purchased the standard test . Would have been nice to compare these . Other than that the test was informative and I’m hoping it results help thanks .

records.text: Had troubles submitting second person for couples test, Angel was fast and efficient in helping get to where I needed to be!  Thank you can’t wait to submit and see results!

records.title: I have been waiting for my confirmation…

records.title: Satisfactory customer service by Terry due to my missing confirmation e-mail and instructions
records.text: I ordered the tests but did not receive the confirmation e-mail.
