records.title: Sensitivity Check offers decent…
records.text: Sensitivity Check offers decent customer service, with staff like Emily, Shawn, Kai, and Terry providing helpful and quick responses for various issues. Although there were some initial problems like missing items or email mix-ups, these were resolved efficiently. However, while individual staff members are commendable, some consistency in service delivery could enhance the overall experience.

records.title: Easy and straightforward
records.text: Process was easy and straightforward, results were fairly quick in about 10 days from postage. I didn't really learn anything about my sensitivities as 2 of the main items that came up are things I don't have anyway as I don't like them.

records.title: No definite answers but might give you something to think about
records.text: Easy to complete the test. Took about a month to get the results back. Felt overwhelmed by the results given how many reactions were flagged. How a reaction might present itself is also vague. I'm advised not to have chia seeds even though I've never had any problems with them. My partner's very definite sensitivity to dairy also never showed up in the results. A couple things I did suspect I was sensitive to did show up though so I'm not eating these for a while. We'll see how it goes. All up I think take it with a massive grain of salt. You won't get any definite answers but it might give you something to think about.

records.title: Purchased a retest with the sensitivity…
records.text: Purchased a retest with the sensitivity kit. contacted customer service,  as there were no reference to retest inside the kit. The bloke Avery took ages to confirm that retest had actually been purchased and to explain me how I should submit my hair sample for retesting. It seems that there's no proper procedure in place, so fingers crossed when I resend my sample in the future,  it gets to the lab ok.

records.title: Convenient testing but inaccurate results
records.text: The process was easy and convenient and online results is great however I am very uncertain about the validity of the results. I bought this to try and find which types of pollen I am more sensitive to, as I've had sever hayfever since a child. I also have known cat hair allergies. The results have shown no results from the environmental section and I just can't see how this would be accurate!

records.title: Some changes to think about
records.text: I think there needs to be a bar code that you need to cellotape to the envelope. This should be scared at its arrival to the collection point and scanned when it leaves for England and when it arrives at its destination.  And visible on the app.. the app is just dead until you do the results.  In this day and age I thought ...we been scammed out of our money... because there was nothing...also the fact that it shows up as a new zealnd sensitivity test is misleading and the fine print is too fine that says tests are done in England. Reading people's questions I think I am not the only person

records.title: A little dubious
records.text: I am a little concerned about the validity of this company. I paid for couples testing. The results took weeks. I’m not 100% convinced of accuracy; I’m peri menopausal; no hormonal imbalances according to the test. Not sure that makes sense. I then learnt it wasn’t a NZ company. I don’t mind, but feel they should be more open. Advertising as Sensitivity Check NZ is misleading. Posting pics of an empty lab set up makes it look even more suspicious. In this era of prolific scammers companies should be fully transparent to avoid misleading people. It would help with building credibility & trust.

records.title: Test results were disappointing.
records.text: Test results were disappointing.It only showed up with two food items and nothing else.I'm just glad I got this sensitivity test on offer. It wouldn't be worth full price. Results came back quickly and online form was easy to use. Simple instructions.

records.title: Understanding the results
records.text: Too much I didn't understand about the results. What I did understand is that what I am supposed to be sensitive to, but I don't think I need to change anything.  As I have allergies I am careful what I eat. Also I only eat to live, I am not a lover of most food.

records.title: Still waiting for my test to arrive…
records.text: Still waiting for my test to arrive after ordering a number of weeks ago. I don't think the whole order process is particularly clear. Luckily, I was helped by someone called Casey who was able to identify what I hadn't yet done and now the test should be on its way. I'm looking forward to taking the test and getting my results. Thanks for the help Casey, if I was just reviewing you it would be 5*

records.title: Seems like a great thing to try but the…
records.text: Seems like a great thing to try but the results are completely wrong...I can't eat coriander, I'm lactose intolerant, I have a sibo so I've done the elimination test and nothing I know I cannot eat was in the results a lot of different others were though. My husband also had some odd results.

records.title: The report is great
records.text: The report is great, showing you where you have sensitivity, the app to get results on is painful to use and the time it takes to get results is epic! And you don't get an email when the results are ready either. So patience is key to getting this service to work for you!

records.title: Don't bother with paying for priority outside UK
records.text: I ordered it through "Allergy Test Australia" thinking it was going to happen in Australia, so I paid for the priority processing. Even paid extra to Australia Post for priority delivery of the results. It was not clear anywhere on the website that it would be sent to the UK for testing, meaning I would have to wait weeks... Wasted the money on priority processing. Website should be much clearer so people don't feel ripped off. Jordan explained clearly when I contacted webchat - not their fault, so I don't blame them - but I do feel a bit cheated about the lack of clarity on the website.

records.title: Taken too long to get my results
records.text: majority of representatives were unhelpful but the last one called Riley made a difference. I wont be making any further purchase git my results back after 2 months of sending my sample.  Keep trying to get hold of the customer service is taking so much of your time to resolve anything. Last person I spoke with only answered my questions sent my my results finally.

records.title: It was interesting to read the results
records.text: It was interesting to read the results, however, the lists of foods that I supposedly have a low tolerance for didn't match with my experience.  There were a lot of foods on the list that I eat regularly and I don't believe I've ever reacted to any of them.  I'm still glad I did the test though, as it made me consider all the areas covered.

records.title: Not sure about the accuracy…
records.text: Going to try some of the food ideas but only Guinea pigs came up for allergies to animals (I’m super allergic, as in react to hair on someone else’s clothes, to cats, hamsters, rabbits, dogs, horses) and also terrible near hay, grass etc but these didn’t show up either. Makes me wonder about the accuracy of the report in general…

records.title: I was disappointed
records.text: I was disappointed either way this. I expected an easily digestible review, which it was not. Didn't really know what to do with  the results , other than no soya sauce and massive lack of potassium. Dr said last blood test said was fine

records.title: Misleading advertising- website says…
records.text: Misleading advertising- website says ‘Our technicians will process your sample and within 3-5 working days, you will receive an email with your results’The sample first has to be sent to the UK facility which can take up to 20 days. My sample took 20 days to arrive then had to wait 5 working days for results. Frustrating having to wait over a month for results with a misleading website. Every time I contacted the company I just got sent an automated response

records.title: Intolerance Test Scam
records.text: Right so I decided to look into the science after getting my results - while the process was really easy and fast, the results seem to have absolutely no scientific basis. Food intolerances cannot be tested from hair. Scam

records.title: Really disappointed
records.text: Really disappointed.  I dont feel the test gave me much to go on.  It didn't identify a food that I am definitely intolerant to and the hormonal imbalance section was completely blank which I didnt feel was right either.  Made me actually think it wasn't my test result so couldnt possibly recommend it to others. Felt I wasted my money.

records.title: Waste of time and money
records.text: Took nearly a month before I finally got the results. Told me I had reactions to foods , metals and environmental elements which I don’t and stuff I do react to I was supposed to be ok with. They said I react to silver nope it’s to gold ( my fingers swell if I wear rings or crash if other jewellery ) also told me I react to berries etc when I’m fine, but totally missed that I react to banana.Really wouldn’t recommend this type of test it was a total waste of time and money.

records.title: I had actual bioresonance testing done…
records.text: I had actual bioresonance testing done by experienced practitioner and results different

records.title: Would not recommend
records.text: Ordered a physical test kit, and 2 weeks later was still waiting.Contacted them and was sent another kit which arrived very quickly.Mailed off samples in early April, and still awaiting results in early September.Contacted them and was told to "be patient" as they have a 27 business day turnaround... I've been waiting almost 5 months!!Very unhelpful customer service, who blamed it on delays in the UK processing our samples... No mention on their site that this is not based in Australia when it is an Australian address to post samples back to.My sister in law also purchased for her family and is experiencing the exact same thing, so not an isolated incident by far.Would not recommend based on my experience.

records.title: Questionable accuracy
records.text: Some interesting info. But don't know about the accuracy??! Said I was deficient in things I know I'm not (had resent nutritional blood tests) And didn't pick up the intolerances and allergies I medically know I have! Hmmm.....

records.title: Really quite a lot slower than they…
records.text: Really quite a lot slower than they indicate and what looks like an NZ process is actually ultimately sent to the UK for processing which now explains the delay.I wouldn't mind, I am in no rush but they should make it a lot clear on purchase what the realistic turnaround time is.As an example, mine was purchased 10/6/24, the kit was not dispatched until 14/6/24, not received until about 24/6/24.Was posted back next day, now 10/7/24, they say you get confirmation when received at the processing site but I have not received any confirmation as yet.Like I say, I don't mind the delay but it has not met the expectations they set.

records.title: I went into this sensitivity check with…
records.text: I went into this sensitivity check with known sensitivities, and compared their results to what I've eliminated and it's really missed the mark. It didn't advise sensitivity of onion or garlic or anything of that complex sugar. I'm sensitive to mushroom, legumes, and the report doesn't mention anything of the sort.Gut biome, no data...Digestive health, no data...Hormonal imbalance, no data...What did I even pay for?I ordered the couples one for my partner and she's yet to get her results back, she's just sent off an email to follow up. Overall, from my experience, I can't recommend this test for food sensitivities.

description: Healthcare was never designed for women. So we’re here to change that. We're giving absolute clarity to every [female] body through science-backed hormone testing and care that fits conveniently into the lives of as many women as possible. Our vision is to reinvent healthcare for every woman, to raise standards and nurture possibility. So we’re setting a new standard of scientific rigour and education in female health, nurturing the Mother of all movements - one powered by a new generation of women who back their bodies and their life choices. Welcome to the Reproductive Revolution!

records.title: Testing kit
records.text: I spoke to Courtney this morning after making a mistake with my Hertility testing kit (my fault) and was met with calm reassurance. Courtney took the stress out of a stressful situation. My new test kit is on its way and I was recommended to book a complementary video call to walk me through the process. Thank you so much for your help today, I can't wait to get started!

records.title: Seamless process and so informative
records.text: The testing process was very easy and straightforward. The report was clear and easy to understand. Irish life health made it seemless through their app. I had a video consult with Siobhan soon after my results and she was so knowledgeable. I’d highly recommend the service as I now know it’s likely I have PCOS.

records.title: The best customer support from Ella and…
records.text: The best customer support from Ella and the company. Got my results and it’s been interesting to see the difference between these private results on a set day and the NHS ones

records.title: Really impressed with my Hertility…
records.text: Really impressed with my Hertility experience! Feel a lot more at ease now that I’ve had my results back and the call with the advisor was very informative. Would recommend to all my friends!

records.title: Wish I did this sooner…finally diagnosed
records.text: Did my test in August, all delivered on time and results on time. Needed a follow up scan and there in 48 hours. Quick customer service responses and got to the heart of the issue quickly with comprehensive report. Thanks Hertility, after tests I’ve had over the years with NHS, this is worth every penny to get clear answers in quick times

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: Whilst we haven't used the service itself yet, we had an issue with an almost expired gift card that we had misplaced. The Hertility customer service was second to none, helping us resolve the problem and going out of their way to ensure we were kept informed and ended up with a successful result (even extending the expiry date on the gift card).My thanks to all, and especially to Ella for her friendly and efficient support.

records.title: Fantastic company
records.text: Fantastic company. The service was impeccable. The test came very quickly and was extremely easy to complete (despite me needing to prick myself a fair few times!). The turn around on testing was also very quick and smooth. I had my test analysis sent through and this was not only just my result data but also full explanations as to what it means and what each test looks for/why it’s important. My personalised plan was a great guide as to what to do next. I opted for a video consultation and Victoria was absolute delight! She was so supportive and friendly with an amazing understanding of female health. Her advice was very much needed and I valued every second. We have decided on the next steps and I’ll be continuing my journey with Hertility as well as testing every 12 months to keep an eye on my hormones!

records.title: Simply the best option on the market to…
records.text: Simply the best option on the market to get the answers you need.

records.title: A stepping stone to proper answers
records.text: I've been trying to get answers on my hormone health for ages but trying to see a doctor or find one that won't blow me off and just tell me to "have a baby and my hormones will settle down" was virtually impossible. To have the knowledge I do now, helps me to manage my overall health better and focus on what my body needs to help my hormonal health and fertility. This was such an easy test to do and I did require help cos I faint with blood withdrawal but it was quick and easy. The instructions were clear and it was nice to know my sample reached the lab safely. I'd recommend doing this for any woman that's concerned about her fertility and hormone health, as its a great first step to proper answers and diagnosis.

records.title: Warm, friendly and informative service
records.text: I ordered a hertility test kit to find out more about factors relating to fertility that the NHS do not investigate. I have been extremely satisfied with the service from start to finish. I initially struggled with blood testing and ended up needing a replacement kit which was provided for free alongside a sample collection video call to support me through the second collection. I also paid for a video consultation to understand more about my blood results after my blood sample was tested. I can honestly say I now feel more confident about our journey to growing a family after using Hertility. 10/10 would recommend!

records.title: Amazing experience to do
records.text: I got my test results back on the 18th December. They were extremely easy to understand and they give you information about each section. Each section was talking about different topics of your hormones. The test results also included some aftercare to do in the months after and what you can do to improve your hormones. I definitely recommend doing a Hertility test because it gives you a sense of what is happening in your body.

records.title: Really simple and easy to use.
records.text: I brought the test on Monday 2nd December and it came Wednesday 4th December.I wanted to see what my body is up to and how it is doing so once I found Hertility I had to do this because everyone should know their bodies. Really simple and easy to use.The instructions are straightforward and very easy to read and understand and use.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service. Unsure of accuracy of thyroid test. My thyroid was worryingly very high, way out of normal on Hertility test  Went to GP to repeat thyroid tests 4 days later as they had concerns of thyrotoxicosis. NHS result showed thyroid was in normal range. Complimentary follow up call with nurse was great, and requested a refund for 20 min follow up call. All sorted really easily.

records.title: brilliant company with a wonderful offering for women!
records.text: So quick and easy to book, collect your sample and get your results. I also booked a pelvic scan which was easy and got the results within a few days. You get the option of a call with an expert to go through your results which was really helpful in understanding what your results mean. Perhaps a slightly longer call might have made the experience 5 stars! Overall a brilliant company with a wonderful offering for women!

records.title: Seamless process
records.text: Smooth process of sending bloods and receiving results. Complimentary consultation following my results which allowed me to talk though things. Followed on with a scan arranged locally through hertility - again seamless. Only downfall is I feel iv been given a 'likely diagnosis' but no advice with what that means for my fertility going forward or what options there are to help me to conceive. If money weren't an issue then I assume this could be done via consultations. However I am.unabke to fund any either support so have gone back to my GP.

records.title: Not for the faint hearted
records.text: Personally I found the process of collecting blood painful and v difficult, it left me bruised fingers and I fainted.  The team was great over the phone to help collect the sample though. I wish they offered the stick on succion system to get blood out like some other labs do. Otherwise great experience.

records.title: Really helpful and insightful
records.text: Really helpful and insightful - the process for the test was fast and straight forward. The instructions for the tests took you through step by step clearly. The fertility expert I spoke to was so lovely - friendly, knowledgeable and someone I felt comfortable talking to.  Really great service. Thank you!

records.title: Everything has been great- the website
records.text: Everything has been great- the website, the customer service, the booking services except for the actual blood taking part via finger pricking. My mum is a nurse and supervised me while doing my test and she couldn’t believe how much blood was required from the finger pricking. I think a nurse visit to take the blood would be better if it was included in the price or there was a reduced priced for this service.

records.title: Easy to do & informative
records.text: It was really straight forward to do, I was really nervous about it but it was absolutely fine. I wanted to know about my fertility and my hormone levels but I feel like it goes more in depth into your hormones. The results came back a little earlier than expected and they were useful and easy-ish to understand. It would be really helpful if there was the option to download your results as a file instead of having to go back to the website any time you wanted to look into something further an/or discuss with your GP. Overall v helpful.

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: **Updated to four stars after an excellent response from Hertility. As you can see here, the customer service is really very good.It's ok the service is quick and the user interface is very nice and easy to use. My main problem with it is that the diagnostics aren't used to give any answers from a big picture point of view. For example, I ordered a test to check for perimenopause, but my results don't tell me if I'm in perimenopause or not. They give results for each individual hormone, but not what that means for me. For that you have to have another consultation, which costs an additional £39. I feel that if I've spent over £100 on a test for perimenopause, that test should be enough to tell me definitively whether that's the case, without paying extra.

records.title: Hertility is a fantastic company…
records.text: Hertility is a fantastic company providing a fantastic service. The instructions were clear, the packaging well thought out and the turnaround time very quick and efficient. The results were explained well and in layman’s terms. Definitely worth getting a second opinion on some of the results, though. My TSH levels came back as slightly elevated, but a follow up test with my NHS GP contradicted this.

records.title: It is a good and affordable way to…
records.text: It is a good and affordable way to understand your hormones! Quicker than waiting for a doctors appointment. It is explained very well, just the added extras are abit much. Before buying an extra like a pelvic exam or a phone call try to look around. I found a private scan for £95 only. £124 cheaper than what Hertility quoted. But for blood test only it is a good service. It has sped up a suspected PCOS diagnosis.

records.title: Collection tricky but worth it overall
records.text: Getting enough blood to fill the tube was definitely harder than I thought it'd be! So be prepared for that. However, once you get through it, the rest of the process is simple and results came in the time stated. Information with each result was informative enough I thought - some reviews I saw beforehand expressed disappoint with this aspect but if your results are within range there's not much else they can say i think! You can pay for a more in depth consultation if you want, which is fair enough. Overall, I found the results reassuring for me personally and worth the cost given you can't get these tests immediately on NHS or for cheaper at a fertility clinic.

records.title: Peace of Mind
records.text: I decided to get tested for peace of mind due to age.Great price point and straightforward testing. Report was easy to read and understand.Communication from the team was really good with any queries I had.4 stars given as unable to provide a digital copy of the full report

records.title: Better comms needed around junk mail
records.text: I originally rated this a one star because of lack of communication. But it turns out their comms go to junk. Need to get a line out to users when they book to instruct them to ensure your email address is marked as safe. It prevents any delays in an already anxious period. Otherwise, I’m really pleased!

records.title: I have sent the sample twice but both…
records.text: I have sent the sample twice but both times my blood was haemolysed. Hertility were lovely and understanding and have provided a complimentary nurse to come take my bloods. However I will be honest, and if I knew how it's so likely for the blood to be haemolysed and how difficult it would be to do the test for certain people whose blood doesn't flow as easily, I probably would not have done it.

records.title: Insightful results, great customer service
records.text: Initially I was disappointed with the service, as my results took longer than the 10 days advertised.However Maxine was very quick to help me once I reached out to them. Their CEO Helen even directly called and messaged me to offer her apologies and a complimentary DR appt to go through my results, which I really really appreciated!Thank you.

records.title: Great experience!
records.text: Overall my experience with Hertility has been fantastic. The report and online meeting I had were in depth and the nurse was extremely knowledgeable and supportive, it was great to be spoken to as an adult and not talked down to, it was very comforting. I received a full breakdown of my results and possible next steps which has already come in use!The only reason I haven’t given the full 5 stars is that there wasn’t enough communication after I sent my test. I assumed I would receive an automated email to let me know that my test sample had arrived, and also when my results were ready to view online. However, I didn’t. As I’d completed my test over a bank holiday, I was unsure of the 10 day window, so that would be a really useful feature and opportunity to improve.

records.title: Informative and helpful, but basic.
records.text: Informative and helped put my mind at ease. Don't expect too much, just basic results for where your levels are and a rough guide as to what that means. For example, egg reserve just tells you if you are in range for your age, not much more. Would be helpful to know what that means regarding time scales etc but appreciate this is a limited service and I assume you might get more insight by paying for an additional consultation on your results. Overall, it's helped put my mind at ease but don't just be realistic with your expectations. Results were fast and for the peace of mind I recommend.

records.title: It was amazing looking at the results…
records.text: It was amazing looking at the results and gives me a lot better peace of mind when I change some things and if the doctors can help. Very thorough report and lots tested for the money. Negatives - getting the blood out was difficult and it was hard getting it into the container maybe the container could be changed so that the blood goes in rather than the outside? The prices to have your results spoken about etc. by a professional are extortionate. When you have already spent over £100 then to get a professional opinion over another £100 with the cost of living crisis I think this needs to be reviewed.

records.title: Quick process - room for improvement.
records.text: I found the process very quick and easy. Partner clinics were professional and empathic. However, a negative side is you receive the results via e-mail without being able to talk to anyone straight away which can create a lot of anxiety for the user.

records.title: I really wanted to like this company...
records.text: I really wanted to like the concept of the company - helping women understand their fertility but have been disappointed for 3 main reasons:1. Generic results - your results are placed in a range "for someone your age", which isn't insightful for whether they are healthy levels2. Generic analysis - automated copy and paste explanations of hormone levels, linking it to symptoms that you've stated in the pre-assessment questionnaire3. Over-selling and bombarded by marketing - almost daily emailsThis leaves me not much better informed and unwilling to invest in their extra services if the information is going to be the same level of helpfulness

records.title: Not convinced - reach out to your GP instead
records.text: Following some results from hertility i sought advice from my GP and requested some tests - all tests came back within normal range. Am wondering why hertility test results implied there was something wrong and needed further investigation (which, if i went through them would incur a cost). To be honest, am kicking myself for paying as i should have just reached out to my GP

records.title: Information - basic & generic
records.text: Very quick delivery - the parcel came the day after I ordered and I received confirmation email the day after I posted it back of its arrival. Blood test was easy enough to do and instructions were good. Results then took about a week. The lower score is because I found the information given quite basic. Obviously, the blood work results were useful but the suggestions given were very easily google-able and generic.

records.title: Be Careful of the Blood Taking Process
records.text: I found the instructions to be very informative and the insights to be helpful, however I don’t feel that the instructions apply to everyone. I followed them as instructed but I ended up fainting and hurt myself in the process. The instructions informed people to stand for the best blood flow (or along those lines) but this is certainly not for everyone (like myself unfortunately)! I feared that I would need to retest (thankfully not) but if i needed to, I don’t think I would have been able to!

records.title: I love this concept but am disappointed with service
records.text: Hertility make it relatively straight forward to get some hormone levels measured.  Though I struggled taking the blood and when I called the helpline there was no answer I was prompted to give my number for a call back and received no callback.  Further after receiving the analysis and paying for a consultation follow up I still had to wait 3 weeks to get the consultation phone call scheduled.  Honestly my GP would have responded faster so I'm a little disappointed given the costs involved.

records.title: Helpful to give results but report is less helpful
records.text: I already have a diagnosis of PCOS but wanted to check several of my hormone levels. The kit quickly arrived and was easy to do. It helped provide me with an idea of what my current hormone levels are doing however the report provided felt generic and more of a copy and paste of a summary they just have for each result rather than a personalised one. Unfortunately the information and recommendations were mostly things I already knew and had tried with little luck. Other steps such as a consultation to discuss your results cost more.

records.title: Very basic results for the price
records.text: Very basic results I was in the middle of near enough every scale, lots of add on products offered after like an extremely expensive pelvic scan, I can see how someone with abnormal results may be vulnerable to pay for this.Blood collection wasn’t easy as the vile is pretty big, not painful at the time but my finger tip was bruised and tender for days after.Overall happy I don’t seem to have very abnormal hormones but sad I paid £140 to learn next to nothing.

records.title: It is not what they say it is.
records.text: I am editing my review.Even though I have ordered a HORMONES & FERTILITY test, I only had results of hormones, I think company should have rethink the name of this test, as people in situations like I am, need to get their answers. Regardless, I have had my consultation, and still did not get answer about my fertility. Customer service is nice and friendly, but I would not order the test again.

records.title: Good customer support, not much detail
records.text: Good customer support. I found it hard to get enough blood out (and the little needles really slice!)The results were much less in depth than I thought they’d be. They do offer the opportunity to talk them through, but I just wanted results without that. You get sent a “message from the doctor” etc but it all feels a little copy and paste.For the cost, not bad, you get thyroid and hormone results but little explanation or detail beyond that unless organising sessions with them to go through it all.

records.title: Good for Thyroid but fertility whilst on the pill is not a good idea
records.text: It was a quick turn around however if you are on the hormonal contraceptive pill and have been for a long while, (I have been for 10 years) your AMH hormones will most likely be low which means that you have a smaller than average ovarian reserve. Don't let that concern you as Hertility do point out, this can be an effect from the pill. If I had known this before I would have come off the pill for 3 months and taken the test then to get a more accurate result on my ovarian reserve. I don't know if I'll spend another 150 pounds doing this though...

records.title: Felt like the review was a tick box…
records.text: Felt like the review was a tick box exercise. Had already indicated in my questionnaire that I had PCOS, yet my results said that they were due to PCOS… so learnt nothing new. Would have liked to see maybe what you can do to change these or even what type of PCOS. Just more customised insight. Results were just tick boxes for generic comments.

records.title: Not completly true diagnosis
records.text: I have been diagnosed of possible patologies that I am sure I don't have because I have yearly controls with my gynecologist. In particular, they told me that I could possibily have endometriosis and polycistics ovaries. These patologies can be visualized  using a scan and I am sure I don't have them. I guess this exam is a good starting point for who doesn't do regular check ups. It's not bad neither good, but you should know your body otherwise you can be easily duped.

records.title: I was a little disappointed to be…
records.text: I was a little disappointed to be honest. I feel like for the price you don’t get a lot of insights, nor explanations. In order to actually get feedback, instead of a very obvious one sentence statement about the hormone levels, you need to pay extra for an online session, which you also have to book weeks in advanced since it’s booked on most days and requires you to take some time off work if you have a 9-5 job. Overall I’ve had better experiences from other providers, which allowed me to get more personalized feedback without having to pay extra charges.

records.title: I understand what goes into this but I…
records.text: I understand what goes into this but I do think it’s rather expensive. Taking blood was super easy and great instructions. I got my results within 12 days which was great.  I went to see my GP regarding the results for more info and turns out the results weren’t completely correct so need to redo my bloods which is a shame when you pay over £100.

records.title: okay
records.text: the test kit is easy to use and results came back in good time, i paid extra for a consultation and although the doctor was fine, he was 10 mins late for an appointment i paid for and we were done in 15-20 mins. he said he would email me the notes with further advice and what i could suggest my GP but its been more than a week and i never received such email. so i wouldn't recommend booking a consultation afterwards, perhaps best to save £250 and go to your GP.

records.title: At first seemed simple enough
records.text: At first seemed simple enough. I managed to fill the tube provided to just past the line. I was surprised when I got the notification that it was an insufficient sample with no proper explanation as to why there was not enough in the tube. I had to contact customer service and push for an answer.The second kit arrived too late for my next cycle so with a 3 months delay from first stating the test process. On the positive, once my sample was received on both occasions the results were pretty quick. The report is simple to read with a handy within range/low/high bar scale.I didn't use the follow on services as I had no questions based on the report.

records.title: Good company but STOP making young women worry
records.text: For over a year i have been bombarded by ads for hertility and gaslit by online accounts telling me I was likely running out of eggs and should consider freezing them. Out of anxiety I caved and purchased a test from Hertillity health that I really can’t afford. As I am on the mini pill they could only do thyroid and AMH tests. Obviously everything was absolutely fine and I according to the tests I have completely normal levels of AMH and therefore probably plenty of eggs. Hertility is now pushing additional tests and follow up appointments with their consultants for MORE money.I’m sure that this is a great company for those who have the cash and time to worry about fertility but personally the push for hormone and fertility testing just made me feel stressed for no reason. If you are a young woman and otherwise healthy like me then DONT fall for all these fertility and hormone testing companies making you think that you need to take these tests.

records.title: Tough to draw blood and lack of support
records.text: The process was drawing blood was pretty difficult. You can only draw blood on a specific day of your cycle - third day of period - and this falls on a weekend. The instruction says to call for support if blood isn’t filling the whole tube but no customer service is available on the weekends. Would have loved for my experience to be great as I’ve been trying for a few years now but this isn’t as simple as I hoped.

records.title: More confused, more costs
records.text: I took this test to understand what my egg reserve is after a worry of mine and the adverts constantly reminding me. The test was relatively easy. My result came back as high, which I thought could be good (thinking I have higher than average egg reserve for my age) but it infact advised me that this isn't good and could be a sign to some issues. This has worried me and rather than answering my question, I now have more. I was rather disappointed that the advice I was given was to have a private ultrasound (previously had one) or to pay to discuss my results with a nurse. I'd have thought a phone consultation would have been included in the price at a minimum, especially if you don't have clear results (I've had intolerance tests where you receive consultations with nutritionists in the price which was similar to this test)

records.title: Dissatisfied
records.text: I’m quite unsure. My Fertility call with a Nurse sounded quite rushed, scripted & impersonal. I was then encouraged to book a pelvic scan, via their clinic. It does make me think whether the results can be altered to encourage you to have further investigation following blood tests. Does anyone receive normal range blood tests? I’m just unsure at this point. I think the Fertility Call put me off, it was 15 minutes of being spoken at, at no point was I asked how I was feeling in regard to these results, only asked at the start why I decided to have the tests. The results were prompt and informative, I’m just left feeling quite dissatisfied.

records.title: The initial blood test is good but…
records.text: The initial blood test is good but anything after that is a total waste of time, don’t waste your money. I won’t share the advice I got on here as it’s personal, but it was useless, and I’m now £200 out of pocket. I’m only giving two stars because the lady who did the pelvic ultrasound was lovely, otherwise it would be one.

records.title: BIG FAIL
records.text: Two stars because it wasn’t a complete failure, but honestly, what a letdown. The blood sample process was anything but intuitive, and after finally managing to fill and send the vial, I was told the sample wasn’t usable because of my type of blood(???), despite following every instruction to the letter! When I asked for a refund, customer service was initially dismissive, then confusingly offered partial options. It felt disorganized and insincere, not what you’d expect from a mission-driven, digitally native brand. Very disappointing.

records.title: Terrible ordeal, misleading adverts
records.text: It was a terrible ordeal getting enough blood out for the test, my desk looked like a crime scene by the end of it. When ordering, the test made no mention of me having to wait till the 3rd day of my period to test or the difficulty and stress of obtaining a sample. I managed to get enough out to get a report but I will never use the service again or recommend it to any of my friends. I just wish it was frank from the start -  Terrible sales tactics for a company that claims to be honest to women.

records.title: Not really worth the price with the one worded answers as “results”
records.text: Although results were quick (7days after receiving sample). They were one worded answers of what they were. That’s where they get you, you have to pay more to speak to someone to find out what they mean. It was a lot of money for what you get in return. Wouldn’t really recommend if you’re wanting in depth information on it all without having to pay a fortune. Wish I just went to my GPs for the testing in the end. Really good idea, but for the price, more information should be provided instead of “normal” or “low” etc.

records.title: Blood sample impossible
records.text: Found it impossible to collect enough blood by stabbing myself in the finger multiple times which is what’s required for this ‚super easy‘ at home test. Bottle rim not wide enough / no way to collect blood so it went everywhere but the test tube. In my view this makes the test unfeasible and therefore a total waste of  money.

records.title: I don’t think Hertility does a good job…
records.text: I don’t think Hertility does a good job at detailing what the tests involves, the blood sample required is significant. I passed out trying to collect enough blood, the lancet made me bleed A LOT but it was very hard to collect the blood in the tube. I found the whole experience pretty traumatising. Had I had been shown how much blood was required I never would have purchased. Furthermore I agree, if you are not on contraception then this might be worth doing but advising you can complete the test while using hormonal contraception but then saying loads of your readings won’t be accurate because of your contraception seems very pointless. Pretty gutted by the whole experience.

records.title: Dissapointed
records.text: Such a let down. I was told that this test would give me insight into my hormones. Although it does provide results in terms of hormone levels in your body - they do not give you insights into what that means to you. I wanted explanations and clarity into my hormonal issues, but sadly, these have been left unanswered.

records.title: Generic report provided
records.text: The experience promised is a bespoke tailor made product unique to the individual. However apart from the actual lab results I felt the advice and report produced was fairly generic. It was basic information that can be found on the internet which I was already familiar with. It didn’t address the issue I wanted to find out more about and the option given is to spend more money by using the consultant sessions. Given the cost of the initial test I was expecting more. I could have gotten the same result using a competitor at a lower price point.I’m not recommending this to anyone I know.

records.title: Honest
records.text: Honestly, a bit disappointed. I received blood test results, I could have received from any doctor, with multiple optional fees to get further explanation for those results. Either way, for me, £149 was worth knowing I have a healthy egg count for my age but I would research and find that out in a different way in future. The answers to any hormonal issues were not met. Potentially they were, but I didn’t want to pay a further £69 to find out to be met with further fees, but it’s a good thing to give to my GP when I eventually get an appointment. Haha.Honestly, do your research and spend your money better elsewhere. If you pay all the fees it’s probably a similar yet less trustworthy way of going private (UK patients)The tens of emails you’ve sent looking for a review have now been answered (Y)

description:
The first female-focused Weight Loss Programme in the UK

records.title: Loving the supported sign up & monitoring calls
records.text: Living thy sign up & monitoring calls, makes me feel like I'm being supported. Only on week 3 & no weight loss as yet but my hunger has decreased so I'm eating less & I've no side effects. I'm feeling well prepared for the the dose increase & comfy enough with the app & check is, to be able to discuss concerns or side effects. A very good start for week 3 X

records.title: Amazing up to now everything is so well…
records.text: Amazing up to now everything is so well organised and the support is great. The boxes come with different things in to help ease any side effects you may have.

records.title: The support from SheMed has been…
records.text: The support from SheMed has been fantastic. I spoke to Calinda on the online chat and she helped me get an issue sorted with an hour. She was kind, patient and one of the best customer service agents I've dealt with. Thank you for your help and I recommend SheMed.

records.title: Live Agent experience
records.text: The agent was very helpful and understanding, they explained everything clearly and had no problem explaining things more than once. It’s amazing that you know you are in good hands

records.title: Speedy and great app
records.text: I purchased the home screening kit and it arrived promptly, once I scanned the box and downloaded the app I was able to have a chat with a real person who guided me through taking my blood sample. I was amazed that it didn't hurt at all and my results came back a few days later, all in all a very smooth experience!

records.title: Amazing support
records.text: I have joined SheMed only a week ago in that time I have been connected to a real person who talked me through taking my blood sample. Which was painless. Results in 2 days and now accepted on the program I cannot wait to see the new me in 6 months. thanks

records.title: swift and efficient service
records.text: swift and efficient service. everything arrived on time and in great packaging. Felt supported from start to finish

records.title: Updating my payment details
records.text: I had to phone twice to update my payment due to fraudulent activity on my bank card & waiting for a new card. I spoke to Ash on both occasions & he was very friendly, professional, supportive, polite & helpful. Thanks Ash for helping me sort this.

records.title: medication dosage query
records.text: Arshana was very helpful, quick to respond to my queries and resolved my issue swiftly and without fuss

records.title: I've had a good experience with the…
records.text: I've had a good experience with the weight loss programme from eMed. The results are truly remarkable and visible! I've lost more than 3 stones so far. It's also reassuring to know that the programme is reviewed by the same NHS doctors than GP at Hand. The support is very helpful and the medications are sent at home. Highly recommended!

records.title: So not impressed with shemed
records.text: So not impressed with shemed Got my glp1-6 kit . Ready to start on 2nd Jan . Been trying to get through to the app since 9am . Tried calling . No answer or call back in over an hour . It is now 10.45 and the app is now down . Obviously they can't cope with possible large influx of new customers. Not impressed shemed . Can I have a refund of test as prob going to visit my local pharmacy LOL

records.title: I didn’t sign up for this
records.text: I don’t have much of a complaint about the company itself but I signed up for Babylon and all of a sudden I’m seeing this company in my invoice. I didn’t consent to it and don’t want to share any personal information with this company. I’ve raised it a couple of times and nothing has been done so I’m rating you one star. I value my privacy, especially with medical information.

description:
We are Ascenti. The leading provider of physiotherapy  - helping thousands of people to elevate their health and live active lives every day.

Whatever your physiotherapy and wellbeing needs, we’re here to help. 

With speedy access to advanced therapies and affordable treatments, our clinicians can get to the heart of your problem and treat it fast. 

Enjoy convenient access to highly trained physiotherapists wherever you need to be, with same-day appointments available either face-to-face or online as part of our award-winning virtual service.

With more than 20 years’ experience serving both the public and private sectors, we are industry leading experts and passionate believers in our distinct clinical philosophy. 

Ascenti is a dynamic and progressive company – advancing physical therapies by making them more accessible to all, raising standards and pioneering new digitally enabled physiotherapy and musculoskeletal (MSK) services. 

Our amazing people make us who we are and lift us above the competition – with a national network of 300 directly employed Ascenti clinicians delivering upwards of 600,000 treatment sessions every year. Enabling people to make headway after illness and injury, step back in to work after accidents, or simply stay active and keep moving forward in their daily lives.

records.title: Brilliant
records.text: I have had chronic back problems for 18 months. NHS was no help whatsoever, just kept upping the pain killers, but no treatment.Went to see Sunilla in Nuneaton. (Self funded)Absolutely Brilliant !After 5 seasons, I’m on no painkillers, can climb the stairs, wash my car and even do some gardening. She’s truly given me my life back.Cannot recommend highly enough !!

records.title: Professional service
records.text: Used this clinic before and always got a high standard professional help.The therapists have good knowledge, are easy to work with and friendly. Can definitely recommend

records.title: Bhumi Patel i have a amazing experience…
records.text: Bhumi Patel i have a amazing experience with bhumi.She will understand what person needs and hope for. thank you so much

10/10. Started treatment for knee injury stopping me from running. 7 weeks later Im back on it and have recently ran a half marathon with no issues. Victor explained everything to me so I fully understood my treatment and gave advice on progressing which in time allowed me to start running again. Hoping it’s not needed again but if I do I would 100% go again. Thanks again to Victor

records.title: 5* experience with Ascenti and Emily Stott for physiotheropy
records.text: I rated my experience 5* when having physio with Ascenti, specifically with Emily Stott. Emily provided me with advice and exercises that helped me overcome a hip injury that had been bothering me for over a year. Emily was very knowledgeable and incredibly helpful. I would recommend Emily to anyone who needs a physiotherapist.

records.title: Excellent treatment
records.text: Excellent treatment from Joey Hext at Ascenti. Very thorough assessment, and created an exercise programme that got me back to running after a lower back injury. Very knowledgeable about the current state of research on sports injuries, and honest about where there is a lack of evidence or disagreement about the best treatment. Definitely recommended.

records.title: Knowledgeable and kind
records.text: Anum treated me with the utmost care, kindness and respect. Clearly very knowledgeable in her field, she was able to give me exercises adapted to my specific needs. Truly grateful to her that I am now totally pain free and would recommend in a heartbeat

records.title: 5* I attended physio due to a possible…
records.text: 5* I attended physio due to a possible slipped disk & sciatica. Shruti has been absolutely fantastic and very professional. She knew exactly what I needed to do. Throughout the 6 weeks of physio I had. She has been patient and made very clear instructions as to what I should be doing. From barely being able to stand and walk, within 6 weeks of stretching and light exercise I'm able to take part in physical exercise, Hiking, Running etc. Honestly I can't thank you enough. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Thanks Ascenti!
records.text: Great experience throughout the couple of months I attended sessions for my back. It now feels a million times better thanks to Shruti! She was always so lovely and welcoming and really understanding of what was wrong/guidance to help relieve my pain. Thanks again Shruti!

records.title: 10/10. Thank you Zain Mahmood.
records.text: Big thank you to Ascenti. In particular a huge thanks to Zain Mahmood. Zain has been brilliant. Since my accident I have been suffering severe neck and shoulder pains. Zain remained professional and  courteous. He provided me with great exercises to help me and was knowledgeable to answer all my questions efficiently and promptly. Not to mention zain was great to have a conversation with, extremely friendly and easy going. Thank you for all the assistance and your time!

records.title: Review for Vincent Chan @ Ascenti Cheadle
records.text: Review for Vincent Chan, MSK Physio in Cheadle…..Vincent has successfully helped me to recover from a rotator cuff injury. The exercises Vincent gave me have done the job. Vincent was good at demonstrating the exercises and helping me do them for the first time in our physiotherapy appointments. The Ascenti app has been good for the exercises program.

records.title: Specific exercises
records.text: The exercises and advice given were great to assist with my recovery.

records.title: Thanks to the guidance Rajesh gave me…
records.text: Thanks to the guidance Rajesh gave me the shoulder that was giving me pain is now back to normal.

records.title: Physio
records.text: I have been having physio with Rajesh for quite a while for a problem with my hip and knee.  He diagnosed the problem quickly and was very helpful in explaining the different ways to do the exercises that I was struggling to do.  My only criticism is the long wait to start treatment.

records.title: Possitivity
records.text: Just finished a block of physio appointments with Nimya Anand at Warrington. When I started I was really struggling with a lower back, hip & (eventually) a calf problem. On my final assessment yesterday, I reported that I was 90% better then when I started. I think with the ongoing exercises I will return to full fitness. Many thanks to Nimya, highly recommended.

records.title: Awesome physiotherapy
records.text: I have been blessed with my late sessions of a very talented and professional therapist Ms. F. Qamar at Croxley Business Park in Watford. She handled my case articulately. After more than two months I could see a big difference in my mobility, neck, shoulder and lower back pains. Almost 50%-60% reduction in general pain. I am very satisfied with her service, guidance and follow ups.

records.title: Good overall
records.text: Good overall, polite therapist ajay in loughborough still need to do some work to get the shoulder fully recovered but have been sent all the exercises to continue so no complaints.

records.title: Juan my physio was very helpful…
records.text: Juan my physio was very helpful throughout my journey. He was a pleasant and knowledgeable and did help me improve my problem area. Unfortunately, my issue was beyond physio treatment and requires more medical investigation, which Juan was able to identify and refer me. Couldn’t recommend him more!

records.title: I attended PT sections at Ascenti…
records.text: I attended PT sections at Ascenti through Vitality which was straight forward. I received a great service from Shruti Ketan Gandhi. Shruti was very attentive and have explained great deal about the issues that had my left lower leg. She certainly has a powerful touch when she mobilizing the right muscle and I felt the release of the muscle just right after first visit, incredible! Thank you Shruti. I’m ever so grateful!

records.title: Had treatment for bad knee pain
records.text: Had treatment for bad knee pain. It was well assessed and a good plan of treatment was devised , by my Physio - Mohammed Khalid.  Over a 6 month period the exercises provided a base to relieve stress in the knee by building strength and supporting muscles. I think there is pressure  on the state as the dates between being seen were quite long hence the 4 stars not five. However, mine was always going to be a long term fix as time was needed to develop strength - so that was a problem for me as I did my exercises  regularly whereas some may” fall off the wagon “ and need more regular reassurance. Overall a very good service.

records.title: Aveena at Preston is ace!
records.text: Aveena at Preston is ace!, her professionalism is a credit too her!she explains all exercises and seems genuinely concerned about my treatment

records.title: Physio for osteoarthritis
records.text: Three very useful sessions with Anushri Kharche, here in Kidderminster, to ease the discomfort of the osteoarthritis in my hip and knee. I've certainly felt the benefit from the suggested exercises that I have been doing over the past three months, although there's obviously no miracle cure.Disappointed that I've now been discharged without much hope of having surgery anytime soon. Sign of the times, sadly. I can't quite accept that my hill walking days are behind me. Snowdonia, I miss you.

records.title: Rotator cuff pain
records.text: The first physio I saw appeared good and gave me a series of exercises on the app. My shoulder pain seemed to improve slightly then my recovery plateaued. By chance I was swapped to Ishan who changed my exercises replacing the weight based exercises with resistance band ones. My shoulder pain has improved dramatically. Ishan has explained my condition, exercises and functionality of my shoulder joint excellently.

records.title: Nereida was personable and friendly and…
records.text: Nereida was personable and friendly and developed a useful range of stretches and exercises that made a real difference to my back and neck issues. Exercises were explained and demonstrated clearly. She was careful also to ensure an understanding of my overall health to give the best results.

records.title: Physiotherapy for shoulders
records.text: I attended my final session of 4 today.Easy access and  car parking.Location  at the Fort Parkway is clean and relaxing.I felt immediate relief after shoulder massages.Instructions for exercises was well explained and demonstrated both face to face by Victor,  and on the Ascenti  app. I would recommend this service.Useful having appointment details  confirmed by text messages

records.title: 6 months with Physiotherapist ISHA JOSHI…
records.text: I found my Physiotherapist ISHA JOSHI both knowledgeable and patient. Without her help over the last 6plus months. I don’t know where I’d be physically.The exercises and the way she demonstrated them were great. The work done and doing between our appointments has made movement possible.

records.title: Marib Ali is very nice kind hearted…
records.text: Marib Ali is very nice kind hearted physiotherapist . He treated me and my daughters . He gave us very nice exercise and provided very effective therapy session . I will suggest him to my friends because he maintain dignity and respect as required during our treatment sessions

records.title: Arm and shoulder problem
records.text: At first I was sent exercises for hip problems, though it was my shoulder that was giving me trouble. This was soon rectified after a phone call.  The following exercises I was sent worked well and my shoulder is now much improved.I was given regular visits to see a physio where I underwent a gentle massage and discussion on how things were going. My shoulder is now 90% better, my visits have stopped and I am continuing my exercises on a reduced level.

records.title: Good service
records.text: I had three physiotherapists at the Coventry clinic. All lovely. All gave exercises to do at home, which they reviewed each session and changed as symptoms eased. Only two did massage on me. The massage sessions were amazing. Latest physiotherapist is Zoye, she's been great.

records.title: My Physio was James Ascenti North East...
records.text: I was referred after a car accident with nerve and muscle issues. And have been receiving Physio for a few months now.My physio James was very informative, give me exercises and recovery instructions, which has helped with these issues.Hes friendly and professional.Made me feel comfortable and helped me gain full recovery.

records.title: Impossible to cancel appointment.
records.text: Hello, I have tried calling two days in a row, I have emailed and I have tried to complete the form on your website. I want to cancel my appointment but this seems like an impossible task with your organisation. Edit: what link? I don't know how to message you on this platform. Why does no one monitor your online forms or emails? How many methods of contact do I need to use? Ridiculous.Thanks Laura I eventually got through and managed to cancel the appointment.

records.title: Ascenti Physio Liverpool Ropewalks
records.text: You can see full of availability but things go different if you have a referral from your insurance. If you want to pay yourself and forget about your insurance because it is an emergency then you would still need to arrange a consultation and pay for it to decide what is gonna be your treatment for another day, even when you are telling them what it is the treatment you need and that it is an emergency. I already had a referral, it's so frustrating. They just care about the money. Update - I received a call from them and they explained that they need more time for insurance appointments and that's why they need specific slots. I am trying once again to see how it goes.

records.title: Assisting with stiffness in lower back
records.text: Treatment has aided somewhat with my stiff back over the 8 wks allocated. It did take until week 6 to identify that my hips also needed some manipulation/massage.  Also I wish that all the notes the physio has to make were done outside of my 30min appointment rather than during the short time we have to perform assisted exercises, this typing took up valuable hands on treatment time. I also feel that 1hr sessions for me would have been more beneficial and I would have hoped the physio could have organised two back to back 30 min sessions after the initial assessment.

records.title: Good for sedentary populations but not active or trained
records.text: I liked that getting appointments set up was an easy process. I liked being given several exercises to do and follow and being able to  access these online with video reference.I felt the exercises could have been progressed more effectively over the sessions, versus kept the exact same. Also some form of baseline measurement taken around this that I could use and understand and could be referred back to. As someone who trains a lot and whose body can handle a lot of load I think the level of the exercise would mostly create a de-training effect rather than a stimulus. So I loaded them myself which seemed to be effective.Also fewer questions and more engagement would be good. Meet me where I am at versus a series of generic questions. I found this frustrating. Like when you call your bank and they ask you repetitive questions which seems like you are simply repeating yourself again and again.

records.title: Had physio via vitality
records.text: Had physio via vitality, First visit was a 5min assessment where the therapist advised it was his last day but someone else would look after me, spent 5 mins asking some questions and that was it, no physical exam. Each follow up appointment was the same lasting no more than 5 mins each.No discussion of charges were made and given a £164 bill for essentially in total of 30mins of being to do stretches commonly known.Feels like a well constructed scam firm.Ascenti have reached out to me since writing this review and have conducted an investigation, they have made this right with myself and I appreciate a company who will do this and not carry out lip service for not delivering. Increased to 3 stars due to the customer services provided.

records.title: Still waiting to be called back
records.text: I booked an appointment through Vitality, which initially went smoothly. However, after my first appointment, I realized I hadn't received a confirmation email for my second one. Upon contacting them, I discovered no appointment had been scheduled in my name. Despite being informed I could either call to book another appointment or wait for a phone call, I opted for the latter due to work commitments. Unfortunately, when I did receive a call, the operator hung up after a few rings, and subsequent attempts to reach them were met with long wait times. Despite reassurances that I would be contacted, it's been three days with no follow-up. This has been frustrating, especially considering my limited availability to make phone calls during the day. In summary, two weeks have passed since my initial visit, and I'm still without a new appointment.

records.title: Cancelled my appointment at short notice
records.text: Cancelled my appointment at the Burton on Trent clinic with less than 2 hours notice. This is unacceptable when I have to make arrangements around work commitments etc.They claimed that the physio had called in sick, surely this was known with more than 2 hours notice?

records.title: Ascenti does not communicate well from…
records.text: Ascenti does not communicate well from the admin team to the patient. Example, I  was given an appointment in Chorley. This is some 15 miles from my home address. I  arrived in plenty of time for my appointment and paid to park my car. On reaching reception, I was told that no physiotherapist had turned up. Wasted journey at cost to myself. Could admin have telephoned me on the morning of my appointment?  I have had appointments made and then cancelled on more than one occassion, by Ascenti. I have a neck/spine problem. On my first appointment I  was amazed that the physiotherapist had not had sight of my x rays. I  gave my permission for my x rays to be made available,  however Ascenti did not request them from my GP. Overall, not a good experience.

records.title: I liked the exercises and the advise on…
records.text: I liked the exercises and the advise on equipment to buy to help with stretching. The sessions could have been more regular and there were a few gaps.

records.title: Could be much better!
records.text: Did not get more than 20 minutes treatment on each visit,which only consisted of discussing exercises.  Hardly any hands on ! On one visit tried to treat the wrong leg!

records.title: I thought the treatment  I received…
records.text: I thought the treatment  I received over the 6 sessions was very helpful to myself. I would strongly recommend the company to other people who I now for physio.

records.title: I could rate good and ignore it or I…
records.text: I could rate good and ignore it or I could be honest to improve the service. In my opinion I'm disappointed, from my first appointment that was by zoom called, wait many months to see someone face to face, I was giving appointment every 3 months, I had to see a private one a few times as the pain was unbearable. I was giving exercise to do by the app which it was good, I had one appointment that the physio looked in more detail to my low back as I have sciatica, having my door opened and another client outside waiting for her turn was very uncomfortable, I thought where is my privacy and dignity? And my last appointment lasted 5 minutes, I was just told that I was discharged, I didn't even bother as It hasn't been very helpful. That could have been told on the phone and save the the journey.

records.title: Web services are pitiful
records.text: Whilst Ascenti’s virtual and web based appointments leave a lot to be desired - systems never work, no video on calls, how can you diagnose an issue you can’t see is beyond me, and they have the cheek to still charge my provider for this serious substandard service which reduces my access to actual physio services, and has wasted  over 3 months of my time on this recovery journey is beyond me!!Despite al this, when I eventually got appointments with Sakina I have seen considerable improvement and she has been understanding and wonderful throughout our sessions and progress has been steady and meaningful. Just a shame ascenti’s poor service prior to her involvement has resulted in my overall rating as it would have been 5stars if only on Sakina’s service.

records.title: I was given exercises to do
records.text: I was given exercises to do, which I have done regularly and still doing, Yes, this has strengthened my muscles but I am still in very bad pain in my back. I do not feel this has improved the pain situation. These appointments started months ago, it has been drawn out for months with appointments being changed on several occasions by you.

records.title: I have to say that Kavita…
records.text: I have to say that Kavita Krishnamoorthy is an awesome therapist. She spotted the issue and her exercises & stretches are definitely helping. It was just unfortunate that I couldn't carry on with the rest of my treatment due to unfortunate circumstances. I was then booked with another therapist with Ascenti who cancelled on me twice at the last minute & then never followed up. I cannot help that I work til late on Fridays. Don't offer appointments on times that you cannot keep to!! That was the only thumbs down for me.

records.title: Useless app but Good Physio!
records.text: Just had a web based physio session with Ascenti.The on line face to face link refused to work so it was very, very disappointing.However the advice given by my physio Asad Hussain was very useful and informative.He's the only reason I gave 3 stars!Please get the app fixed or go face to face!

records.title: mixed review
records.text: Each physio I saw was fine but I would have preferred consistency instead of 3 changes of person. I don't think the info was recorded on your system correctly as they kept referring to my thoracic area but that was not the area that was affected. The app was frustrating as frequently lost my data or signed me out so I stopped using it. 3 stars because the exercises I was given were helpful.

records.title: My back pain is now manageable since I…
records.text: My back pain is now manageable since I was given the exercises. I feel the physiotherapist was professional, however not so welcoming, there was no good morning/afternoon, just "use the sanitizer please". I did not feel very comfortable at the door, I felt like I was intruding. Back pain much better now which is more important.

records.title: Nothing wrong with as far as it goes…
records.text: Nothing wrong with as far as it goes but I don't think on-line Physio works very well. My technology knowledge is limited and I am sure I am not alone yet it is assumed that everyone can use Apps etc. On two occasions the built in camera on my laptop failed for no known reason and therefore your man could not see me.

records.title: Face to face
records.text: It would far better if you can actually see the physios face to face.  No physio actually ever took place and I was signed off with the condition still existing.

records.title: They said 2 missed appts so won’t see me
records.text: After having suffered with injuries from a 4 car pile up I was happy to get physio appts with them. I have been very sick with various problems since this crash and on the first appt I couldn’t attend I had bad stomach problems and wasn’t able to leave the house they marked it as a missed appt. That was fair enough but on my very last appt I set out would have been there in plenty of time but the north circ had a bad accident I had to sit in traffic with a bad neck and shoulder pain and couldn’t make my appt. I spoke with the physiotherapist who called to see where I was when I told him I couldn’t get to him for reasons beyond my control he said fine marked me as a missed appt now Ascenti won’t see me at all and I am in pain, and have no physiotherapist at all!

records.title: Disappointed consultation
records.text: I went to tAscenti located in Guildford. My first appointment was rather disappointing. I was asked all the standard questions but not enough about my current health issue and no questions regarding my physical activities . I was not shown what exercises I should do but I was advised i should receive an email with videos of the exercises. Once I have reviewed 3 recommended exercises only two were suitable due to another health issue which I have mentioned to the consultant. The other 2 I have been doing for last 6 months so not sure if it wasn’t wasted time and money.

records.title: Useless experience
records.text: Just had a virtual physio appointment with a blank screen, bad sound quality, repetitive questions that I'd already completed, and then got referred to a face to face appointment. I could have skipped this whole step with Ascenti.

records.title: Decent physio but
records.text: Decent physio but hard to book and today cancelled an appointment with no communication other than an email.Just another corporate company taking away the personal feel of a health service.I’ve seen the reply and this is just not true I have received no phone call.

records.title: Care lacked consistency
records.text: Lots of different therapists meant inconsistent care apart from the last two. Sessions were generally rushed and exercises were rattled off. With the exception of the first session, I never felt I was properly assessed.

records.title: Customer service lacking
records.text: My therapist was great but the telephone service I received when I called for help was grudging at best. It was my first time using Ascenti and I needed help, as I couldn’t see my exercises on the site or on my app - despite the fact I was assured they’d be uploaded after my appointment. So I assumed it was user error and called for help. I also needed a receipt as I hadn’t received one. The telephone agent wasn’t keen to help and I was simply told my exercises will be there when the therapist uploads them and I should have received a receipt on email. It was only when I pressed her that I got some info on how to use the app and site and it turns out a receipt hadn’t been sent. I was made to feel I was wasting her time or she thought I was stupid. Had she simply listened and then looked into my issues it could have been a much simpler/more pleasant experience.

records.title: Unprofessional
records.text: I was directed to use thos company by AVIVA health for physio. Not a great experience..the physios they give you access to are quite amateur ...the lady I just had refused to touch my skin as male so gave me physio through a shirt and heavy jumper ...complete waste of time and money ...I already had to change once from the first physio they gave me

records.title: Dismissive therapists. Low effort, google-able exercises.
records.text: Honestly I am confused by all the positive reviews here. I was referred to Ascenti by Vitality but most (not all) times i’ve been the physios just sit starting at their computer screens with minimal eye contact while asking very basic questions and giving exercises which I could have Googled. Very little to no actually “therapy” was offered, and the physios seemed dismissive at best (one incident I recall the physio seemed to not believe I was experiencing significant pain)They also delayed proper treatment of my condition (by a medically trained consultant) by 6 weeks as they would not refer me onwards until I ”had completed their 6 week course of therapy” which I told them countless times was ineffective and would in fact increase the risk of greater injury to myself if the condition went untreated. I consider this negligent.Can’t say I’d recommend them based on this.

records.title: The first appointment I was asked what…
records.text: The first appointment I was asked what happened and where the pain is. He poked the tender areas and then gave me some excerises to do. The second meeting he gave me a massage to the effected areas. The 3 or 4 other meetings he just asked how I'm doing and how the pain is and that was it. A total waste of my time, as I'm self employed.  He could of phoned to ask me how I was doing.

records.title: Lack of Hands-On Support
records.text: During my appointments, the sessions mainly consisted of answering questions and receiving instructions for home exercises. I was hoping for more hands-on participation and assistance, leading me to use your services for fewer sessions than initially planned.Considering you are dealing with injured individuals, I believe it is crucial to have more hands-on sessions with supervised exercises to better assist and monitor patients.

description: Synergy is a leading Implants and Cosmetic, award-winning dental group in the north-west of England, boasting a plethora of bespoke cosmetic treatments. We use cutting-edge equipment and high-quality techniques, all of this while maintaining full transparency with costing and procedures. If you’re looking to straighten your teeth, replace or repair then you’re in luck. Free consultations for: Invisalign®, Dental Implants, Composite Bonding and Same Day Dental Implants. We are the highest provider of Straumann Dental Implant Solutions in the North-west of England, with over 4,000 dental implants placed in the last decade, with 100% success rate, when compared with other systems. Synergy is also a Diamond provider of Invisalign® Invisible Braces, with prices starting from £1,750 for 7 transparent Invisalign® aligners, teeth whitening and retainers. Covering most of the NW of England you’ll always find a dental clinic near you; Blackpool, Blackburn, Bolton, Bury, Chorley, Farnworth, Haslingden, Liverpool, Little Lever, Macclesfield, Oldham, Ormskirk, Preston, Birmingham, Burnley & Leyland.

records.title: Recently moved to synergy dentist and…
records.text: Recently moved to synergy dentist and had my first check up with Dr Asma and Alex and which was excellent. Dr Asma provided a full detailed overview of my teeth, which has never been done at my previous dentist. Very informative and professional.

records.title: New Year’s Eve Saviours
