records.text: Rang on New Year’s Eve after I had broken a rear tooth! An appointment was arranged to go in within two hours and was dealt with super efficiently. Can’t thank the staff enough, would have been an extremely painful few days otherwise!!Happy New Year Synergy X

records.title: Emergency appointment - Xmas/New Year
records.text: I needed an emergency appointment. The whole system worked great from the online booking to the service on the day. Swift, painless and appropriate treatment and advice for after care at the appointment itself.

records.title: Great service..had a dental emergency…
records.text: Great service..had a dental emergency on Christmas eve phoned at 9am was given a appointment that afternoon which was amazing then received a call asking if I would like to come earlier as they had a cancellation.. Meaning I start antibiotics..The staff were so helpful and happy..it's nice to see the reception area is having refurbishment as it has been looking tired can't wait to see it when it's finished.thankkyou synergy burscough

records.title: Highly Recommended
records.text: I'm really not a fan of going to the dentist but these guys are fantastic. Everyone is lovely, they're great at what they do and always make you feel at ease. I'm so lucky to have them.

records.title: Tooth Extraction
records.text: Everything went very smoothly from check in to tooth out. Having a  tooth extraction isn't a particularly nice experience but it was painless and relatively quick.

records.title: From the second I arrived I was greeted…
records.text: From the second I arrived I was greeted by a lovely polite young lady on reception who instantly made me feel welcome and at ease. She offered myself and the other patients a drink whilst we waited. I was not waiting long at all before the dentist came out and called me into the room. I explained how severe my anxiety is and explained what medication i take for it and both the dentist and dental nurse reassured me and put me at ease. The dentist discussed all of my options and gave me time to think and make my decision. I was visibly anxious but they both reassured me throughout the procedure. Asking me consistently if I was alright. It was a wonderful experience and i would highly recommend the practice to everybody.

records.title: Friendly service
records.text: Friendly service. Dentist Ismail was very good and his assistant Adela was very polite and caring. Definitely recommend great hygiene service

records.title: Was relax and can tell had my welfare…
records.text: Was relax and can tell had my welfare in mind while I had 2 wisdom teeth removed. just need to recover

records.title: Visited Synergy due to a recent dental referral …
records.text: Visited Synergy due to a recent referral for a tooth extraction. Nice calm & relaxing atmosphere. As I was very anxious about having this procedure done the dentist was very reassuring & made me feel as comfortable & reassured as possible. The whole procedure took 10 mins from start to finish. Job done & now pain free. They telephoned the following day with a courtesy call just to check everything was ok, which it was. Thank you so much for all you've done & making me feel as comfortable & calm as could be.

records.title: Very kind staff and informative.
records.text: Very kind staff and informative.Hard to rate having your mouth hacked but a good job done I think!!

records.title: Excellent Dentist
records.text: Friendly, professional experience with the young male dentist upstairs today (as usual). Only giving 4 stars though as since being part of Synergy other dentists at this practice haven't always given as good service so the jury's still out. (although not sure if these individuals are still at the practice). The "Synergy" experience is steadily improving.

records.title: Great dentist
records.text: I came to this dentist for an extraction and found them to be very professional, polite, caring. I changed dentist and I’m now an NHS patient here .I've  been agin since and found it to be the same . I’m not a nervous patient now .

records.title: Good care & advice
records.text: The reception is friendly & helpful. My dentist explained what treatment was required thoroughly, he brought pictures of my teeth up on the large tv and talked me through everything and answered my questions. The hygienist was helpful and offered advice. My overall experience of this dentist has been good.Sonia

records.title: Mahmud the dentist
records.text: Mahmud the dentist was friendly and made the effort to talk and explain things to me. He referred me after 2 other dentists telling me they already had.His assistant was also lovely .

records.title: Kashif Razvi is wonderful
records.text: I have had a few different Dentists since being with Synergy Dental Clinics. However my current Dentist Kashif Razvi is wonderful, I would give him five stars but the overall practice lower. He really helps me feel at ease since i have a huge fear of the dentist. Highly reccomend.

records.title: Blackpool synergy
records.text: Blackpool synergy Cant fault these guys, I'm still waiting the final fitting of my bottom veneers, but  more than happy with the work carried  out so far, the difference is amazing, my only regret is not having the work done years ago.

records.title: Had an awkward tooth extracted and an…
records.text: Had an awkward tooth extracted and an implant in its place over a series of months as a private patient.   I was a nervous patient and felt reassured and confident in the hands of my dentist. Procedure was handled professionally and the outcome successful.  Friendly staff greeted me on arrival, the dentist and dental nurse put me at ease.  I felt no pain at all during any of my procedures!! Good communication all round.  I have no problem recommending this practise in Bolton.

records.title: Really nervous at the dentist due to a…
records.text: Really nervous at the dentist due to a couple of bad experiences in the past but was in an out in less than 15 minutes for a wisdom tooth extraction. I'm sure this is a bit unusual but great for me. Would be 5 star but real painful bit comes when paying unfortunately.

records.title: Booked a check up  appointment on line…
records.text: Booked a check up  appointment on line very easy needed an unexpected extraction so had that done straight away  no fuss which  means no return trip happy day's 😀

records.title: Do not make nhs welcome
records.text: I cannot fault the friendliness of staff but I feel that synergy dental are only interested in private patients.  They try and get you to pay private for a scale when this can be covered under the nhs.  You aren’t given the option and just get a iPad shoved in front of you to sign.  Synergy need to be more customer focused as they used to be rather than sales pitching.

records.title: The proactiveness starting from the…
records.text: The proactiveness starting from the consultation date,  through the implants date  it being wonderful.  Their staff were amazing, my implants was done at Blackpool unfortunately it's not in their website location. It's still work in progress.  I would love to give five stars probably when we are done with the whole process.

records.title: I’ve always wanted my teeth whitened…amazing
records.text: I’ve always wanted my teeth whitened and corrected but always been too scared to have it done. I decided to brave it and made an appointment with synergie after seeing it so often on Facebook they have been amazing from the start put me at ease been patient with my fears. I’ve ended up with the smile I’ve always wished for I can honestly say I’ve never felt pain. A bit uncomfortable a few times but no pain i would recommend them to anybody

records.title: I am a really nervous patient and hate…
records.text: I am a really nervous patient and hate going yo the dentist.  I have been having trouble with a tooth and some sensitivity and the dentist was really kind. He explained to me what the problem was, what needed to be done and what I needed to do going forward. The surgery identified to was in Blackpool. Their address isn't in the options

records.title: Wisdom tooth extraction
records.text: I had my wisdom tooth taken out. I was very anxious and had bad experiences before with tooth extraction. The whole experience went well. The dentist made me feel comfortable and checking if I was OK.The procedure went smoothly.The staff were friendly.

records.title: The receptionist was brilliant and…
records.text: The receptionist was brilliant and friendly while being very busy and multi tasking so full marks for receptionist at Blackburn rd surgery ! Excellent tbh ! Didn't get her name but she was lovely! The young lady who took me upstairs to my appointment was friendly and welcoming so well done there too! The dentist who did my work was efficient, quick and friendly and professional! I was very nervous and he was nice and friendly.his customer care was good tbh .I had a full filling unexpected,a bit feels  rough behind my tooth so needs smoothing out tbh but I was happy with my treatment tbh but would like it smoothed out as got a sharp edge in mouth . dentist was excellent and would recommend this practice! He was kind and considerate as I was nervous.would really recommend this practice.

records.title: Was made to feel at ease as I'm very…
records.text: Was made to feel at ease as I'm very anxious when I need to visit the dentist as my teeth are shocking.  Was given my options on treatment and given an appt for ct scan within 48hrs.  I was paying for this so not sure if my appt was quick because of this reason but I was very happy

records.title: Fantastic dentist practice
records.text: Joined this dentist 8 weeks the staff our fantastic made me so welcome from day 1 great practice great prices overall surgery on my teeth was outstanding make you feel calm and relax answer all my questions the professional of This dentist is 10/10 excellent one of Best dentist practices I have been to

records.title: My appointment was on time
records.text: My appointment was on time, no waiting. I like them all at Synergy, always welcoming. £50 was a lot for a clean that lasted only a minute or two. My teeth were mostly free of plaque though, if they were in a worse state I'm sure I'd get my money's worth. I didn't mind the fee, afterwards my teeth felt nice. I always recommend Synergy

records.title: Dental therapist was so patient…
records.text: Dental therapist was so patient and caring. Being a very nervous patient the dentist is a very daunting place but she really took her time with me and reassured me all the way through my appointment

records.title: Very efficient
records.text: Very efficient, made a more pleasent experience  due to the wonderful receptionist Sylvia who is alway so kind.

records.title: Lovely dentist shame about the wait
records.text: The dentist was a lovely guy and very thorough. Unfortunately I was seen 35 mins later than my appointment time and despite telling him about a toothache I'd been suffering he focused only on the replacement crown.

records.title: Great place nice and fresh looking and…
records.text: Great place nice and fresh looking and knowledgable staff.  Unfortunatly the most expensive dentists I have found so far in Rossendale with a quote for my treatment £1200 more than the next nearest dentist in Haslingden.  I would suggest getting more than one quote across several dentists.  Quotes I got were all within 14 days for the same work.

records.title: Decent
records.text: The dentist accidentally cut the inside of my lip while they were polishing my teeth. I couldn’t brush my teeth later without the cut burning 😭 they answered all my questions and were helpful.The apprentice dental nurse was nice.

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: Let me start by saying the receptionists here are extremely helpful. The service here is not what user to be offered by NHS dentists. I have had my appts cancelled 3 times, also they used to offer a scale and polish as part of the NHS appt, now everything they offer is for private cleans, private everything. My dentist was extremely friendly and helpful. I would like to try the whitening but the cost needs to come way down (maybe qll are like this now?!). The building inside is quite damp and doesn't feel like a clinical clean place.

records.title: Post extraction agony
records.text: The staff were really nice & the actual surgery was painless aside of the agony of him hurting my jaw whilst trying to remove the tooth By early evening I was in excruciating pain and same the following day.Monday I had to return to my own dentist who had referred me to synergy, for treatment as the socket was green with infection. Despite my extreme care of the site, it was badly infected.My dentist cleaned and dressed it and prescribed antibiotics.However, it's now 9 days on, the pain is worse and I've had no sleep.The area of gum-jaw is extremely  swollen and hideously painful. So I'm having to go back via emergency appointment to get this looked at again as there pain is 10x worse than before the extraction.This is by far the worst hideous post extraction pain over ever had andn't before had infection like this and I've three last 12 months over had several removed by my own dentist,!!!I'm in unbearable pain.I returned again to my dentist this morning did to the pain and he ear fuming that Synergy did not do the exact surgery asked for which was to cut the gum, full away party of the bone to make the extraction easy. The reason it was requested was due to me having osteoporosis. So I've now got excessive trauma to the jaw because of them not doing what they were asked!!I'm seeking legal advice.

records.title: What was the uwaist of timese of going for a blood…
records.text: What was the use of going for a blood pressure test when they don't even have a date for the root to be taken out which I was told it won't be this month

records.title: Synergy blackpool
records.text: Synergy blackpool. Reception staff were so lovely and friendly. Very welcoming. Dentist seemed very short and a bit rude, not welcoming at all. Went in for one thing and came out with a huge bill for a lot more. It wasn’t really what I asked for and it was pushed a little on me to have more work done. If I was to go ahead I would definitely ask for someone new (dentist). Other than that, seemed very clean and tidy, just a little tight to take pram/car seat in especially with stairs too.

records.title: Good dentist but poor allocation of appointments
records.text: Blackpool Practice. The actual service received by the dental teams is as good as expected and staff are all polite and helpful but why book appointments at lunchtime and leave patients sat around for 25 minutes. We are all busy so this  needs improvement. It was clearly lunchtime as staff were leaving and coming back in etc.  My appointment was 12:50, I arrived at 12;45 and was seen at 13:23. I was subsequently late for my after appointments in the afternoon

records.title: Attended an appointment
records.text: Attended an appointment, the service given for the procedure was excellent (5*), however it was not clear why I had an appointment in the first place (1*)  so she had to improvise so that it was not a wasted journey, so law of averages the overall experience was 3*’s. Unable to specify location, the practice is Blackpool.

records.title: Always kept waiting at this place
records.text: Always kept waiting at this place. My teeth, as expected, were fine but it appears they need a clean where brushes can't reach otherwise I may get gum disease and my teeth going loose. Funnily that's exactly what they said to my partner! Either this is a case of "upselling" or we've lived together so long our teeth have developed the same characteristics!

records.title: My experience was good
records.text: My experience was good, lovely facilities and capable staff. Don’t judge a book by its cover so enter the doors before making assumptions. My first visit was on time but didn’t cover all the bases. A second visit was offered for free ( with a 30 minute wait) and cover the main root of the problem with a quote offered.I still feel that a thorough inspection of the assets (with pick n hand and vision in the mouth) would reveal hidden caves and falling rocks anyways - 🙏 I need to save £1800.00 for my future fix. Can’t find NHS vendor….

records.title: Went for check up
records.text: Went for check up at Blackpool branch, got up sold to £495 teeth whitening, when I rang to book I got transferred to a dead line, re rang and they took my money and booked me in, no email or text as receipt, ok service so far , waiting to get then whitened.

records.title: Brilliant service at a price
records.text: Cant fault the service and professional conduct and talent of aunkit java my dentist but having been used to nhs prices its a shock to the system. I had a palate made.... Still needs one or two slight adjustments... 2 teeth roots removed... A white filling... A silver filling and a clean. 800.00 pounds it cost me. Ive got my smile back and hes done a good job but it cost me!!!

records.title: Some good some not so good care
records.text: Some good some not so good care. I have had some good experiences where my dentist treated me well and have had some bad experiences where I have felt nervous, not at ease and charged for a filling that I shouldn't have been charged for. I had to argue my right to refund over quite a few weeks. I am now with a new dentist within Synergy and hope they will help me to feel less nervous and able to trust their judgement and work.

records.title: Previously the receptionist had a…
records.text: Previously the receptionist had a really bad attitude problem which has now been rectified due to a new one. Went for a tooth extraction due to an abscess to be told it wasnt an abcess but infected tooth. Then to find out the abcess is still their and im still on pain yet to be rectified.

records.title: NHS customer
records.text: Other than cost I look for 3 things in terms of service:How quickly the phone is answered - poor - the new Synergy recorded message goes on for an eternity just stating how brilliant they are. I would rather the phone was answered. Please could you reduce the recorded message significantlyHow quickly you can get an appointment - poor...Since Synergy took over delays are now 2/3 months.The quality of the dental service received - excellent....Carol is a brilliant dentist and her patients welfare is top of her agenda.The score provided reflects the overall position. Great treatment but poor in the two first mentioned areasGary

records.title: I had a young lady this time at my…
records.text: I had a young lady this time at my appointment,not Carole! I wasn’t told this so I was a bit unsure with a new dental nurse; she was ok but I rather have Carole who I have been with for a number of years and knows me .

records.title: COVID rules not followed!
records.text: I went for a routine check up and was happy with the service but I was disappointed that COVID rules were not being followed.  I was the only one in the waiting room wearing a mask including the receptionist and my appointment was delayed by 30 minutes.  The dental nurse also walked into the room during my appointment with her mask under her chin.  Working in a hospital myself and seeing how things should be done I was very unhappy with the lack of safety measures.  My elderly parents are also patients at the surgery and I would not be happy with them going in for an appointment given the experience I had.

records.title: Why aren’t the receptionists wearing masks
records.text: Carol the dentist is 5 star- reception seems very disorganised and despite signs all over the place asking us to wear masks it doesn’t seem to apply to the receptionists?Never did get a response in spite of what they said.

records.title: diagnosis was uncertain and the dentist…
records.text: diagnosis was uncertain and the dentist recommended further procedures which were invasivedidnt get the confidence that he was certain of what he is dealing withthe onus was on me to get to the diagnosis rather than the dentist patronizing consultationwouldnt go to this place again

records.title: Very disappointed with my last visit
records.text: Very disappointed with my last visit. I was due a routine check up and I was in the chair less than a minute. The dentist had a quick look in my mouth and I mean a quick look, he never tested my gums and said everything looked fine but considering he didn't examine my teeth correctly how can he say that.  Feel like I have wasted my money. To be quite honest I have been coming to this dentist for years well before Synergy took over and I have never felt so disappointed.

records.title: Went into their Liverpool surgery in…
records.text: Went into their Liverpool surgery in December 22 for a consultation and was given a price to undertake 2 fillings. Had these done in January 23. Paid for the treatment as per quote. One month later they are now claiming an extra£100 - reason being the fillings were larger than anticipated. There banding does not indicate this. So what is the point of having a consultation and X-rays if you are just going going to be charged extra ?  just to add the work done was great with great customer care at the time but for the fact they are not transparent on cost I’d not use or recommend them again.

records.title: I was a patient at this practice before…
records.text: I was a patient at this practice before Synergy took over and.I have.to say although the staff are lovely, the dentists themselves seem.to be.more interested in selling expensive treatments rather than the care of ones teeth, and quoted over £300 for NHS extraction when published rates state £70!.. Have.been lucky enough to find a.new practice with excellent ratings thank.goodness.

records.title: I started my treatment with Synergy…
records.text: I started my treatment with Synergy last year around July. At first I found everyone really helpful and I was excited to start my journey with them. However after paying my treatment upright I found the customer service especially by the dentist lacking. The receptionist team have been nothing but helpful, they have answered any of my queries and are really friendly. However on most of my visits to the dentist I feel like I haven’t been kept updated enough and I also feel like my appointments have been rushed. I have never had an appointment on time in the whole year I have been attending it’s always been delayed my minimum 20 minutes… On my last visit I was sent away with no indication of what comes next in my treatment, I was pretty much told I was done with it, however that wasn’t the case after speaking to one of the lovely receptionists. I’m really happy with my results however I’m really let down by some aspects of the customer service. I feel like I’ve been left in the dark a lot throughout the treatment.

records.title: Felt really uncomfortable
records.text: Felt really uncomfortable. Dentist basically said I’m fat and he wouldn’t do the work because of my weight.

records.title: Please read my review
records.text: I've been with this surgery for just over 2 years. It's the only surgery that was accepting nhs patients. I have quite a complicated dental history with bruxism which has resulted with me requiring a couple of implants and many cracked teeth. All very expensive to treat restore and prevent. Previously I've been with another surgery and I've recieved 2 sets of advice on a cracked tooth which had chipped away. Synergy dental had planned to extract remaining tooth and put in an implant. I was expecting  then and so didn't want to go through the lengthy procedure so I decided to leave it and asked if I can get something temporarily. He didn't offer anything at the time so I was left with a chipped sharp tooth that kept brushing into my tongue. Luckily I was in the area of my previous surgery which is 200 miles away. I made an appointment and they had a look and decided I would benefit from smoothing the tooth over with composite resin. 2 years on its still serving me well and has saved me from forking out thousands for a tooth implant while on maternity leave. The administrative services definitely needs work on. They've lost mouth guards that were made special for me and the appointments that they offer and confirm by text change on their system somehow by the day of your appointment. I'm now due work on my teeth again..seriously reconsidering parting with my money hereWhy 2 star and not 1? Because I feel once I was seen by dentists the checkups were ok and the reception staff are polite and apologetic when things haven't gone accordingly. Makes a huge difference.

records.title: Disgusting service
records.text: So I went to this dentist after getting a leaflet through the door saying they was taking NHS patient on. I already had dentures and had a couple of teeth needing removing, one basically hanging out! Went in November last year they said they only had private positions so went with it as I needed the teeth removing. Gave me an appointment 2 days before Christmas which by that time had already taken 1 of the teeth out myself. I was with a lovely dentist who was really nice but got told he wouldn't be staying so would have to see somebody else next time. I needed some new dentures so thought I would get these done. They did tell me I had gum disease and wanted to take all my teeth out but i didn't want to do that. So we went ahead with the dentures. I ask what options for dentures were and showed me 3 options which I thought go fo the dearest option as I was told they would be better quality and a better fit. So got about 4 appointments which I think out of 4, 3 got changed 🤔 when I eventually got the teeth they don't fit right on the bottom. Went back a couple of times to get them adjusted but after 3 month wasn't happy so told them and they wanted to take another impression but wanted my teeth as well for 2 days. My old teeth don't fit me no more so said I couldn't be without the teeth. So basically said there is nothing we can do. I paid £1700 and for the service I received and think is awful. I would of gone for basic dentures if I knew the fit was going to be like it was. Absolutely disgusting service from this practice 😒 😤 padiham surgery!

records.title: Difficulty booking appointments
records.text: Difficulty booking appointments, when I signed up for invisalign I wasn’t informed that the only day the invisalign specialist works is on a Tuesday 9-12 this makes it very difficult book appointments and navigate around work. When Appointments have been cancelled this leads to another 3 week or more wait time to be seen due to the limited availability and demand of the invisalign specialist. Staff are friendly and helpful at the clinic but if this practice is going to provide invisalign treatments there needs to be a greater presence from the invisalign specialist. Wether that’s having more than one specialist on sight or dedicating more time for the specialist to be on sight. Thankfully I haven’t had a problem with any of my retainers but if I did I’m very doubtful that I would be able to be seen at short notice. As I said before staff have been friendly and helpful at the clinic but feel the communication between synergy dental and invisalign is very poor, making it difficult for the staff and customers! This is a very expensive treatment and something that I thought long and hard about before getting. I can see the development and change with my teeth so far and very happy but feel the service provided could have been better organised.

records.title: £30 for a 2 minute check up.
records.text: £30 for a 2 minute check up.Not impressed by the level of care provided. The dentist did a cursory look at my teeth, not convinced it was a full check up and not worth £30z

description:
The 21D solution is our own fully digitally planned and guided process that enables us to provide you with your full jaw implants and your working prosthetic teeth in under one hour per jaw.
Your new teeth are produced in advance, entirely from the scans that we take of you at your free assessment. This means surgery time can be reduced from a full day to one hour.

records.title: Absolutely Trust this company
records.text: After lots of investigating and homework, i looked at travelling abroad but eventually stumbled across 21D. From the first contact to the final procedure, I just felt in safe hands and had found my dentist to complete my new smile. It’s not an easy decision as it’s a lot of money but it’s a decision that has changed my life and given me the confidence to smile again. Love my new look, just wish the check ups could be done closer to home, as my procedure took place in Twickenham but unfortunately they are no longer in this clinic and i’m having to travel to Luton.

records.title: Very happy.
records.text: The people at 21D have all been very kind, attentive and informative such that the whole journey has gone well and with much less trauma than I had anticipated. I now have lovely new teeth, can eat my food without pain and can smile with confidence once again. Thank you 21D.

records.title: Faultless
records.text: . Once the research was done the journey with 21D was faultless, from my review in Leicester in May to having my LTP’s just before Christmas. Had my surgery by the amazing team in Warrington 18/10, back to work the next day, although soreness and discomfort for 3-4 days there was nothing to worry about. Made sure I did as I was told with the meds and hygiene and had my LTP’s fitted 20/12. I could not be happier its so nice to not worry about smiling or eating Thank you so much to all the wonderful people at 21D for helping me along this journey

records.title: I can smile again
records.text: I hadnt been to the dentist in over 40 years after a very bad experience, then i found 21DIts been nearly a year since i started my journey, i can honestly say the whole experience has been very easy, from my 1st visit i left feeling very calm and relaxed and confident that 21D  knew what they were doing , They are very caring and supportive, will answer any questions , you have a nurse allocated to you as a point of contact should you need advice etc. The day of the operation I was a lot calmer than i thought possible, had the operation and was cared for and supported throughout. I have to say i had very little pain or swelling. I cant thank them enough for giving me the chance to smile again

records.title: Loving my new smile and confidence…
records.text: Loving my new smile and confidence after contacting 21D.  I had my assessment in March and my surgery in June by the lovely Izabela and her team who looked after me brilliantly explaining everything as I was a little nervous to say the least.  Great support again for my check ups after surgery and my LTP's fitting by Patryk. You also have your own dedicated WhatsApp nurse team for any questions prior to and after surgery.  Thank you again 21D

records.title: Professional and caring from start to…
records.text: Professional and caring from start to finish. Would totally recommend. In fact I already have family and friends who are thinking of having theirs done.

records.title: I can't recommend 21D more highly than…
records.text: I can't recommend 21D more highly than to say they are "miracle workers" from being unable to chew properly, I am now able to fully enjoy my food and I have a fabulous smile to boot! Thanks to all the team, you have done wonders for both my confidence and my enjoyment of a good Fillet Steak!🥩 😁

records.title: 21D gave me back my smile
records.text: My teeth were a total embarrassment and my confidence was rock bottom, I found myself isolating more and more, and desperately needed help. Having looked at several options over several months, I kept coming back to 21D's advert. I joined the patient group and read so many success stories. This gave me the courage to face my fears and contact 21D, and I honestly haven't looked backI cannot praise 21D enough , they have been excellent from the beginning of my journey to the end. From my initial telephone contact, the staff have been absolutely wonderful,  kind, understanding, non-judgemental and totally professional throughout. They have given me back my smile, my confidence is soaring, and I would have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending 21D. They are simply the best 👌

records.title: I would recommend 21D to everyone that…
records.text: I would recommend 21D to everyone that needs dental implants , like a lot of people was told I wasn’t suitable needing bone graft and sinus lift , went to 21D who are more advanced in technology and so professional , and it was a yes from start to finish it took no more than 3 month ,when going from temps to permanents , I had implants and teeth fitted 4 wks after first appointment, and permanents eight wk after , the procedure was painless as I had plenty sedation and medication, I was a little sore fore a couple of wks but that was it !! Lovely professional people 100 per cent company if your having failing teeth and gums go to 21D you it’ll be the best thing you ever do ❤️👍

records.title: I had lost my confidence to smile
records.text: I had lost my confidence to smile and I was unable to enjoy my food as I struggle to chew with the few remaining teeth I had left. After contacting 21D and first consultation I went ahead with both jaws implanted, I can honestly say that I now have my confidence back and love my new smile. Thank you for being so professional and caring from start to finish, I finally had my permanent teeth fitted today.

records.title: Excellent  treatment  and service …
records.text: Excellent  treatment  and service  throughout the experience,  Nothing too much trouble  Great  team , Thankyou

records.title: Took a long time to research and decide…
records.text: Took a long time to research and decide on my implants. 21D were really easy to deal with and made the process so straightforward. There was always someone on hand to deal with any questions I had and talk me through all the stages. Really pleased with my implants and glad I used 21D.

records.title: Extremely poor aftercare.
records.text: I had full set dentures, that is a fixed set of teeth, so one arch,  screwed into your jaw.  Top and bottom. You can't take them out.   The first set felt bulky.  But I was told that was normal and would get better when I got my permanent set. So I waited ( in discomfort). Anyway got permanent set and they felt awful,  they just didn't feel right. Too big and bulky.  Uncomfortable and painful.  So I told them. Went back several times for 'adjustments ' but they made no difference.  The aftercare was very, very poor.  I made my choice for this company due to the excellent reviews.  They have a Facebook patient page which is all great reviews.  I've now found out why. Any negative reviews are deleted.  My own post was deleted.  So the other lady is correct in what she said.  I am now left in pain and discomfort and I don't know where to go. I am devastated.  I paid them £18,000. And I'm very unhappy.  I am in touch with another patient who feels the same but she is too scared to do anything.  I would not recommend this company.

records.title: Mentioned a competitor on their…
records.text: Mentioned a competitor on their Facebook page to open a discussion about differences in cost and product provided and got blocked and banned. Potential customers are excluded when even considering another company.Pathetic.

records.title: I had a full mouth of implants from…
records.text: I had a full mouth of implants from this company paying 17k cash due for my first checkup as it’s been just a year and was told that they were guaranteed but now have been told I need to pay £250 for a yearly checkup PLEASE do not use this company go to turkey you’ll save a fortune!!!! I am fully expecting this poor review not to be published as I’m fully aware that bad reviews can be blocked from appearing by the company John Parker

records.title: How many data captures does one patient…
records.text: How many data captures does one patient need?I have surgery July 2023 and I’m still waiting on a set of finals that fit🤬I made an 8hr round trip to Warrington in May for a data capture only to be told that was a waste of time and now have another booked for 10th August!! I’ve also been blocked from the 21D patients page on Facebook as are many that leave negative posts! Only the patients that leave nice comments about the company remain so I will have to post my journey through here to make people aware of what can happen!! Don’t be fooled by all the positve comments as the negative ones have been removed🤬

records.title: How long will my journey be?
records.text: I had my surgery July 2024 and I’m still waiting for a set of finals that fit!! Surgery went well and my temps were lovely but my finals were horrendous!! My last scans were May 2024 and I’m still waiting on my finals and nobody seems able to tell me when I can expect them to be ready🤬 I paid a lot of money for this procedure and certainly didn’t get what I paid for!!

records.title: Untrustworthy
records.text: This company changes treatment offered at last minute.  Before we paid we had addressed all of our concerns and got replies that satisfied us to the point of paying £34000 6 weeks before the surgery was due to take place. They insist on full payment to book the treatment!3 days before the surgery was due to take place they changed the goal posts and then blamed me for being upset and made blanket refusal to treat!! Never even spoke to my husband just cancelled his too. Their whole attitude changes and to be quite frank they become rude and patronising. Loads of miscommunication and a severe lack of ownership in their mistakes. No duty of candour. Even when a formal complaint was put in and a reply requesting explanations you just get a standard “we acted appropriately“.So glad now we went with an alternative company that outshone them in communication, professionalism and far better services offered.

records.title: Scammers
records.text: Scam artis they wanted me to send 5000 pounds and agreed I could pay the balance a few months later verbally but refused to give me and form I’ve documtents stating that then they said they couldn’t Go ahead because I questioned themStay away for your own good

records.title: my 1star review is not fake
records.text: Despite other review stating my 1star review is FAKE I can state that my review is not fake it was a true reflection of my experience and would appreciate her comment being taken down

description: Smile White is taking the dental industry by storm, offering dentist-led clear aligner treatments, teeth whitening and daily care products that really work, at incredible prices. 💰 And best of all? With a network of 400+ approved dentists across the UK, your new and improved smile is closer than you think. ☺️

records.title: Best experience I could’ve asked for!
records.text: I kept seeing adverts on social media for smile white, and had been thinking about getting my teeth straightened for my wedding later this year but was worried about having braces as an adult. I did a consultation with George Denson at smilewhite after being drawn in by their market leading clear aligners and couldn’t have been happier. George was great at explaining the process and getting it all started. It was a really positive and personal way to start the journey! I’ve had my aligners fitted at my great smilewhite appointed dentist and couldn’t be more impressed with the process so far. George even called to check in and give me some tips. The aligners are comfortable and robust, and barely noticeable. Can’t wait to see the end result!

records.title: Professional company and my treatment is working well
records.text: I haven't finished my treatment yet but the aligners are working and I am progressing as expected. All my contact with Smile White directly has been great, friendly and professional. I am also very impressed with the partner dentist I have seen.

records.title: I collected my trays from the dentist 3…
records.text: I collected my trays from the dentist 3 days ago. It has been a really seamless process for me. They gave me all 24 of my aligners, my retainer and the whittening products! The aligners are really discret and very comfortable to wear - it's only been 3 days and I feel more comfortable with them in than out now! My dentist is great too, very professional and informative. I've had regular calls from Smile White and receive regular emails too which is really appreciated. If you are looking for an afforable alternative, I'd definitely choose Smile White. George Denson checked in with me following my fitting and was a pleasure to speak with, he was very genuinely helpful!

records.title: I reached out to Declan Prentice at SmileWhite…
records.text: I reached out to Declan Prentice at Smile White on New Year’s Eve in a bit of a panic after realising I was paying too much interest on my plan. From the very start, Declan was incredibly reassuring and kind. No matter how often I asked for clarification (and there were quite a few!), he remained clear, patient, and understanding.Declan not only got me onto a much better treatment plan but also managed to secure a full refund for the overpaid interest. He thoroughly explained the next steps and made what initially felt like a stressful situation so much easier to navigate.I truly appreciated his support and professionalism throughout the process. Declan is an absolute credit to Smile White. Highly recommend his services to anyone needing assistance!Thank you, Declan, for your kindness and help, it really made a difference!

records.title: Smile White has been very helpful…
records.text: Smile White has been very helpful throughout my journey from the start to the end. When I have my first consultation they have explained everything in details. Once I had started my treatment it was very easy as I was given all my trays and I didn’t have any issues throughout my treatment. The aligners are very comfortable to wear and you can’t feel any pain when your teeth are moving which was very good. I also had a call from Harry, who rang to talk about how my treatment was going and mentioned that I can contact after my treatment has ended if I need anything. Overall I believe Smile White is a good company to go to as they have good staff who take care of you through out your treatment and provide you a good service.

records.title: Client Focus Care
records.text: Having tried another big, more expensive brand, I can confidently say that Smile White stands out in the best way. The support team and everyone I’ve interacted with have been so much more helpful, flexible, and approachable. The entire process feels smoother and more client-focused, like they genuinely care about making you happy rather than just seeing you as a source of profit. It’s been such a refreshing experience!

records.title: Great experience with Smile White
records.text: Great experience with Smile White. Support and information given right from the get go and a smooth and efficient process. Great support from George Denson also, calling to check how things are going. Would definitely recommend

records.title: Great
records.text: Really helpful customer service and much more affordable than Invisalign. Finished my course in 24 weeks and now have straight teeth again!Helped by Harry and Joe

records.title: Fantastic
records.text: The whole process from start to finish has been great. Customer service from Harry Lane has been fantastic, the dentist has been fantastic and now I have straight teeth. I would highly recommend Smile White 😊

records.title: Couldn't recommend enough…
records.text: Amazing customer service and friendly staff, haven't had any issues with any of the treatment. I have finished 15 weeks of aligners and want my teeth a little bit straighter so I have been given more aligners at no extra cost so I'm 100% happy. All the staff at smile white are easy to contact via email or phone and are always on hand for any questions you have.

records.title: Fantastic dentist, just started plan
records.text: Some teething problems in the beginning (pardon the pun) but eventually got my sons aligners sorted and fitted, Dentist was amazing and so far we’re in week 2 of his 30 week plan and no issues. Smile White technicians always friendly and happy to help hoping the rest of the treatment runs smoothly 🤞🏻

records.title: Good service
records.text: Great customer service from George and the team with detail of stages and processes.Dentist punctual.Only issue I have experienced is the aligner box is too small for the set plus the blue hook. This needs tweaking in my opinion to secure optimal hygiene.

records.title: Half way and very happy
records.text: I’m half way through and my teeth are really starting to look great. The ones that needed to be straightened most are all done. Really easy to use, and comfortable. Got a dentist appointment in 2 weeks but so far really happy.

records.title: After service blip but all good
records.text: So far just had my consultation was great. First after service call to allocate aligners lady was quite honestly a little short and not the most helpful. Saying the sales team don’t speak to the after service, and they didn’t know sales person so note yours down. I signed up based on being seen at a specific dentist she didn’t have a clue. Then sounded pissed off when she had to check as this is the premsis of my purchase then being told my first appointment won’t be until Feb but have to make payment monthly from sign up. Financing strategy is questionable from a FCA point of view. Dentist just called I got appointment tomorrow so hopefully onwards and upwards- defo redeemed.Update dentist was great so hopefully I get my aligners and all the rest is good  it must have been a blip the aftercare lady I got. Just make sure you put in writing anything negotiated outside standard.

records.title: Smile white Aligners
records.text: I am 3 weeks in on my aligner journey. I have a mild case with my teeth- meaning I only have 3 teeth that need straightening. Smile White has been clear and consistent in providing information, telling me anything I need to know, asking me questions and answering any questions I put forward. They’ve been in close contact with me making sure my journey is smooth sailing. The dentist that I’ve been signed to have also been helpful and informative and taking care of my teeth. I still have another 17 weeks to go, but so far so good.

records.title: Great staff
records.text: Got recommended to Smile White by a friend, my journey so far has been great. Everyone I have spoke to so far has been super friendly, especially Ella and Rachel who have been amazing. Can’t wait to start my journey😊🦷🪥

records.title: Great service from Harry
records.text: Having done a lot of research about Clear Aligners I chose to go with Smile White. I had a rocky start with regards to the dentist I was given however this was quickly resolved. The dentist has been amazing with all my visits and I am almost at the end of my journey and I am so pleased with my teeth so far, I have just a couple of refinements. Today I have had a call from Harry who could not have been more helpful. He talked me through the final stages and answered any questions or concerns I had. I cannot wait to see the final results!

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Good experience! Happy with results.Initially was advised I could have just the top retainer - then when speaking with the dentist was advised this would be a bad idea. So advice initially wasn’t great.At the end of treatment Nathaniel Maddison was very friendly on the phone today catching up with me about my treatment and helpful. Alongside other colleagues who checked in during the process and advised where needed.

records.title: My SmileWhite aligner journey!
records.text: I have recently started my SmileWhite aligner journey and I’m currently on week 3 out of 20. The only thing that slightly concerned me about this experience was the initial waiting for my aligners to be made, it was around 8 weeks until my aligners were ready.  However since I received them they have been fantastic. Rachel from SmileWhite contacted me to see how I was getting on and gave me advice about my aligners, really helpful and friendly! I would definitely recommend SmileWhite to my friends and family and I can’t wait to see the final result :)

records.title: First Class Customer Service
records.text: I had some problems with the dentists cancelling my fitting appointment without first speaking to me as my aligners had not arrived. I contacted Smile White who confirmed that my aligners were due to arrive with the dentist before 12 midday on the date if my fitting appointment and so it could go ahead as planned but by this time the dentist had given away my appointment time. George at SW went above and beyond to liaise with them on my behalf to get the appointment reinstated. Absolutely first class from Smile White - I'm now on week 2 and looking forward to my new smile in due course.

records.title: The real deal not an online service
records.text: I have had a really positive experience with Smile White to date. The staff have always been extremely friendly & knowledgeable. They have made me confident in them as a company but also in a successful treatment. The only negative is the delay in between the consultation & the fitting I expected this to be much quicker based on what I’d been told previously. That said once the fitting came it was a very easy appointment & my dentist was fantastic. I’m really looking forward to seeing the end result and have every confidence in a successful outcome within the team agreed.

records.title: Great Teamwork and Customer Service
records.text: My experience started from the first day I had my online consultation, was impressed with how Brody took time to explain and answer my questions.Thereafter, I was booked in for my first appointment at my local dentist which was quite easy to locate. Mr. SC AN was really nice he made sure I understood the process and what to expect. He took my dental x-ray after I got my cavities filled at a discounted rate.Also, RORY has tried to keep in touch after my first appointment and further explained the process and next step to me on the phone.I’m looking forward to get my treatment plan after the 3D scan on my next appointment and can’t wait to begin my journey to a straight and white smile

records.title: Great Customer Service, Easy & Smooth Process
records.text: Lovely staff at SmileWhite, whenever I call. So easy to get in touch with them and the process is so easy and simple. If I ever have any questions or concerns, they help me out straight away. I didn’t have the best experience at my local SmileWhite approved dentist, SmileWhite got in touch to see how it went (always checking up on me). I let them know it wasn’t what I expected and they did everything to rectify, they have now assigned me to another practice which has won loads of awards! I’m so excited for my aligners to arrive.

records.title: So far I’ve been treated well by smile…
records.text: So far I’ve been treated well by smile white and dentist that they referred me to. I’ve been honest with me and have also provided you have a lot of information about the procedure and everything that’s gonna be going on. I want to give a big shout out to Ross Ford he is one of the customer service advisor at Smile White excellent job with the way he conducted himself with me

records.title: Positive experience
records.text: I had a positive experience with the Smile white company. The aftercare specialist Rory O’Toole was knowledgeable about the product, took the time to explain everything clearly, and helped you through the process smoothly. His friendliness and professionalism is very much appreciated. I am now feeling very excited to see my end result!

records.title: Retainers in comparison to previous providers
records.text: The retainers are a very good fit. I started originally with smile direct whom have gone out of business leaving me without future pairs of retainers. If you have previously used smile direct retainers, you may be aware that they become loose quite quickly. These retainers from smile white are a good fit, I have been wearing them for over a month so far and I am very happy with them. I asked them how long the retainers would last and they will last for roughly 18 months or longer depending on how you treat them. Smile Wite are quite hard to get hold of via email, but if you call them, you get a response much quicker and the call staff seem pretty good at getting the ball moving. I will use smile white again as the retainers are a nice fit.

records.title: Really positive experience so far
records.text: Really positive experience so far. The staff are all very helpful and can answer any question you have. On reflection I do feel like I was a bit rushed into my decision but am told I can change my decision after my consultation if needed which has put me at ease. It’s great to see that the dentists get valited and reviewed often too. My dentist has been great so far!

records.title: Smile white have been brilliant from…
records.text: Smile white have been brilliant from the start. From my initial consultation with Joe, who explained everything in every detail, to my aligner fitting. Always kept in contact to make sure everything is going well and answered any questions I have. Definitely would recommend.

records.title: There was a few teething problems…
records.text: There was a few teething problems in the beginning with appointments not being within the time scales advertised, but everything was put right. I’m really happy with my dentist, she was thorough & explained the process from start to finish. She explained everything she was doing & made sure I was happy with what was happening before proceeding to the next stage. I’ve been wearing my aligners for 3 weeks & I’m finding the routine with changing the aligners straight forward. I’m happy with the movement of my teeth & I’m happy with the simplicity of the whole process of straightening & closing the gaps in my teeth.

records.title: Good experience with Smile White
records.text: I am nearly at the end of my journey, although I believe I will need a new set to push the teeth together after they have been straightened. So far my experience has been good, the aligners are doing they are meant to do. Smile white have checked in a few times with emails and calls, which is good. I can contact the dentist any time which is helpful, currently I am waiting for them to book an appointment to attach the worn off attachments, but the dentist is waiting for the attachment delivery. I can't say anything on the teeth whitening part just yet as I haven't got that far yet. I would like to edit my review once i have completed my journey to give a 100% feedback.

records.title: Not so bad some hiccups inn the…
records.text: Not so bad some hiccups inn the beginning then smooth throughout the strStraightforward process. Now that I have completely done I’m waiting for my last tray. I still have received it. My teeth are starting to tear my last tray as the dentist has removed the attachments and they are struggling to stay in the correct place. Wouldn’t be surprised if they don’t fit in my last permanent tray which I am still waiting for….

records.title: Poor service
records.text: They chase you and chase you to sign up and are quick to take your deposit but then the poor service and communcation begins. I've asked for a refund as the dentist explained the treatment wasn't possible in my case and haven't heard anything.

records.title: All around good in terms of the staff…
records.text: All around good in terms of the staff that work for smile white. All ways on hand to help. The down side is when it gets transferred to fhe dentist. It took 2 weeks to get my first appointment and then about 3 weeks for aligners to be made. Its then going to take another 4 weeks to have my fitting as the dentist is away on holiday. So all in all over 2 months fron first dentist visit to actually have them fitted.  I think had I realised the lenght of time it would take I would have gone directly to a dentist for them doing.

records.title: SmileWhite is good but the dentist not so much
records.text: I'm still in the eleventh week of my treatment, Smile White themselves have been nice and supporting but the dentist is another story. In my first appointment the dentist was in so much rush he just scanned my teeth without even checking up or getting me x-rays to make sure they are in good shape. This contradicts what SmileWhite said should happen during the first appointment, then during my second appointment the dentist wanted to just cut through more of my teeth without even looking at the progress, when I asked him if he should look at the progress he said its a computer plan like its fault proof. I know for a fact a computer program can never be bug free and anyone who says otherwise is just wrong.Anyway SmileWhite isn't bad but should choose partners better, maybe even ensure the dentist knows/does exactly what they should doing during an appointment. If you want to get a treatment I suggest you avoid BlueDental.

records.title: Its been 2 weeks since my first dental…
records.text: Its been 2 weeks since my first dental appointment & i am still yet to receive my patient plan that i have to confirm in order for the company to even make my trays. Im yet to receive it as the company have been contacting the wrong dentist for my scans. Every phone call i get is someone asking me questions that i then get days later in an email as nobody updates the system. Followed by an email asking for a ‘review’.Its now going to be two weeks till i even receive my aligners. For a ‘quick and easy’ solution as advertised it really hasn't been & considering i paid the money in full i really dont think i have been given a service to match the price as of yet. I hope the actual teeth straightening part of the journey goes better.

records.title: Check what you’re sold!
records.text: So far the experience isn’t as excellent as they say. During the initial consultation on teams, I was sold a moderate package, with a discount and the finance price within my budget. My first mistake was not checking the confirmation email…I later found out they they’d put it through as mild. I visited the dentist allocated to me, no complaints there, he was lovely and I felt he actually cared and wasn’t just in this to make some money. The dentist sent the scans off and I received the plan - just an image of my teeth before and after - and they looked good. A few days later I get a phone call informing me that this is a moderate plan and it will cost me over £200 extra, but I can pay that over 2 years interest free! I asked if they recorded the teams calls so they could check what the salesman (very good one I might add) sold me. They do but they're deleted after 2 weeks because of ‘storage’. I hope the rest of the experience improves, it’s not put me off having them done but I can’t give them a 5* review, it might change to 4. We’ll see.

records.title: Satisfied customer eventually
records.text: It took a while to get my retainers but we got there in the end. The impression kit came with no instructions which was frustrating. Customer services were slow to respond but once someone was on the case, everything was resolved to my satisfaction. Many thanks.

records.title: Update
records.text: *Edit this issue has now been resolved but due to the amount of time it took to be resolved I can’t review higher than 3*, the product itself however worked very well*It’s been 2 months, i have chased up the team several times on the phone and through email and i still haven’t received all my products. They also asked me to give 5* feedback before I received the product to get 2 extra whiting tubes for free which i also never received

records.title: My first initial contact with smile…
records.text: My first initial contact with smile white was brilliant, the gentleman I spoke to was absolutely lovely and answered all questions I had. I had to have some dental work to begin with before I could get my aligners. The dentist I went to was amazing, couldn’t fault him and he put me at such ease when in with him.Only negatives I’ve found so far is not one person has contacted me since having my aligners, I see people leaving reviews stating that they are always getting checked on etc but I’ve not heard a peep. Now I’m not saying I need my hand holding and to be checked on all the time like a needy child but would have been nice to have been asked how I’m getting on (even by email). Another concern I had, was the fact I actually got sent an email trail between smile white and another customer, so I have her dental plan, her costs, email address etc, I did reply to the email but obviously I got ignored due to someone making a huge mistake here. I just hope my details haven’t been mistakenly passed around as well. I’m nearly at the end of my treatment and I am beyond happy with the results so far.

records.title: I could see a difference on my teeth…
records.text: I could see a difference on my teeth they did get slightly whiter but I was expecting better results, I feel like the 1 month course was not enough to fully whiten my teeth.

records.title: 3 months and still awaiting on SmileWhite to deliver!
records.text: Although communication between SmileWhite, the dentist and myself, was initially not always as timely and smooth as expected, I was very impressed by the company's swift and professional resolution of my issue.  Andy J (Kent)

records.title: Promising Start with Room for Improvement
records.text: My journey with Smile White began on a positive note. The team was incredibly responsive and courteous, which set a great first impression. However, as I progressed through my aligners treatment, I noticed a lack of follow-up from the team. I hadn't received any calls or messages to check on my progress, and I also found myself uninformed about the potential sensitivity of my teeth during the treatment process.While these aspects were disappointing, I remain optimistic about the final results of the treatment. I'm genuinely looking forward to seeing the transformation in my smile and believe that Smile White has the potential to deliver excellent results.In light of my experience, I would like to highlight the need for improved post-treatment support and more comprehensive information for clients regarding the potential side effects of the treatment. Addressing these areas would undoubtedly enhance the overall customer experience.In summary, while there are areas for improvement, I am hopeful about the outcome of my treatment and would still recommend Smile White to others. With some enhancements in customer support and communication, Smile White has the opportunity to create an even more positive impact on its customers.Overall rating: 3.5/5

records.title: I'm only on day two but... Now on day 10, updated review
records.text: 22.04.2024- I'm only on day two but...Firstly, it took a week short of 3 months from the initial consultation (payment made the same day) to having the aligners fitted. Each time I was promised a call/appointment/update from the dentist or Smile White, I had to chase them up myself, only to find that the timeline that I was initially sold, was far from the reality.Had the aligners fitted by a dentist who didn't talk me through the process, so when he was doing things to my teeth, I didn't have a clue what was going on. Water and air being blown in my mouth is a bit unsettling when you're not told what to expect. Also, the 'chewies' are missing from the box- I found out when I got home so I called the dentist and they said 'they were missing from the box when we received it. Get in touch with Smile White and they'll have some sent to you'- will probably have to wait another few weeks to receive anything! Surely the dentist should have highlighted this to Smile White and git it sorted before my appointment?! There's another 'slot' in the box which looks like something's missing from it- hopefully it's not something I need! The dentist (Langlands in Sedgley) has also told me that he won't need to see me throughout the 15 week process, which I find a bit odd! What if something's not going to plan- I wouldn't necessarily know as I'm not a dentist. Where is the follow up aftercare? I appreciate that people are saying that Smile White make contact to see how you're getting on, but they're not dentists either! Having read the negative reviews, I feel a bit twitchy so am trying to concentrate on the higher number of positive reviews. I guess in reality, only time will tell!Update: 01/05/2024- Still no chewies received so, I bought my own. No response either, to the email I sent asking why I have been told by the Orthodontist that they won't be doing any check ups. have resorted to calling them and, to be fair, they answered the call straight away and advised they will send the chewies and send me an email to confirm that they've actioned it. They also stated that, unless I am struggling to get the next set of aligners in the program onto my teeth, I won't need check ups- some dentists offer them and some don't- as this will mean that it's all going to plan.Overall, I still rate their communication as extremely poor once you have paid them. I was told at the beginning  that the number I was given, to send texts to, would be answered all the time and I could contact them daily if I needed to. Hmmm!

records.title: Hardly see any difference
records.text: I can hardly tell if my teeth has gone whiter. Customer service is very very slow.

records.title: Told me to leave a 5 star review but it…
records.text: Told me to leave a 5 star review but it just does not reflect this company. The process of straightening my teeth was flawless. How ever they’re so careless. Spelt my name and surname wrong from start to finish but who cares. Took years to get me started initially, okay what ever. On my last week of having my aligners they were supposed to prep my last permanent aligner and get it posted. For over 2 weeks I had my attachments off and no aligners. I was wearing my last aligner but unfortunately they were getting damaged as my teeth were going back to normal and were ripping them. I called them to express frustration. The whitening didn’t work? Maybe because I didn’t get the “magic” toothpaste that is supposed to be a part of my package. And to top it off with a cherry… *drum roll* … they send my last aligner in the post (yayyy) but guess what, it’s the alignment of my teeth PRIOR to starting the treatment. They sent aligners of my wonky teeth. Soo all of that to reverse it. Nice. Save the extra money and go with Invisalign. Because I’m tired of dealing with this nonsense. At the rate my teeth aren’t straight and I’ll probably have to go elsewhere. To avoid this, keep nagging them and basically be annoying. It’s now Christmas. I probably won’t get any aligners until mid to late January.

records.title: So far, NOT SO GOOD !
records.text: Ok, So far - not good, but I am willing to change my review moving forward if things improve. Also please don't say we can't find an order in this name? knowing we use different email and user ID's on Trustpilot - who I appreciate for giving us this guidance platform.. I paid for what I was told was a mild case aligner, given a treatment plan for moderate (which I didn't know what is was) and then afterwards, asked to pay more as it wasn't mild. I absolutely hate this sales tastic for getting more money out of people and will never accept it. I told them I'm not accepting that - considering they supposedly had already spoken to an onsite dentist to assess if it was going to be mild or moderare.After refusing to move forward with this tactic, they came back and said ok - I could have it changed to a moderate for free????  On top of this the girl was really flippant..... she was all sales no customer service.Then said"Can we produce the aligners??" - I told them "no that the dentist (who so far is really helpful) is contacting them to tweek the treatment" Because on the treatment plan it had my teeth moving more forward for 7 weeks? before moving back - hence the result looks almost the same from where I started. I'm concerned but as I say I will amend this if they take notice of the tweeks and the concerns. Because they certainly took notice in the video conversation and of my payment details. Order #20235I will review the dentist I'm using seperately on Trustpilot. but so far they have been great.

records.title: I was promised that if I changed my…
records.text: I was promised that if I changed my mind I could get a refund. I felt incredibly pressured to purchase this and was rushed into setting up an Klarna account. the first time I tried to cancel I felt guilt tripped into waiting out the process till I saw the dentist. Unfortunately I had a sudden illness meaning a lot of time past and I realised I can’t be spending £2000 on my teeth. £445.21 has already been taken out of my account and all I have had so far is the initial phone call consultation. I asked Rory if he could refund me on the 19th and went to follow it up today however it said my email could not be sent as it’s not longer a valid email address. I appreciate if this is a mistake however I want a full refund and do not want to be spending £2000 on nothing which is what I appear to be doing now. Please can someone help me sort out the refund.

records.title: Not a smooth journey

I did receive an email saying where my dentist was but it was totally different and much further (3 hours away from where i live) from what was been said to me during the first call. They keep reassuring me they will get it corrected but nope, no updates. I only have sorted when I called them again, which makes me wonder if i hadnt called them then i wouldnt be getting any updates. However, the customer service caller, Rachel, was kind enough to sort it out for me and I’m really grateful for that. She assured me that I will be getting my aligners sorted in 4 weeks after my appointment, which I am looking forward to.Will update again on my treatment journey.

records.title: Took longer than expected
records.text: Took longer than I expected for them to ship out my first set of aligners. Wore aligners for 21 weeks which my teeth wasn’t fully straight afterwards. Had more impressions took and 4 weeks later ring customer service for an update for them to tell me they have only just started to make my aligners. I went with smile white cause I was told it would be a fast process but it don’t seem that way.

records.title: Bombarded my inbox regarding the…
records.text: Bombarded my inbox regarding the consultation time and date - emailed be 3 times on the day of the consultation to "remind me"I turned up 3 minuets before my slot, to be sat there for a further 10 minuets to nobody from SmileWhite attending. Next time just cancel and don't waste my time. Just like your T&C's my next appointment slot is £40 since you didn't turn up.

records.title: Extremely pushy sales team, and very difficult to cancel. AVOID
records.text: Extremely pushy sales team, who ghost you as soon as you agree to make payment. Incorrect information was given regarding my eligablity for the aligners, and how much the cancellation fee would be. Having had my 1st dental apt the dentist advised my issue was too complex for smile white, despite the saleman saying otherwise. (The dental surgery were great, and no issues with them) I've been trying to cancel for 2 days now, being told different information each time. The cancellation team desperately try and get you to reconsider in a forceful and unpleasant way. I was promised an email to confirm cancellation, and have even made a follow up call, and still no email to confirm cancellation has been processed. Please do yourself a favour and just pay the extra £1000 for invisalign.

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: I spoke to Troy for my consultation and he was very informative and had good energy and kept reinforcing that I have his mobile number now so anything I need to can contact him straight away. He only responded to my text when it came to agreeing on a payment plan and has been ignoring me since. I have to call the customer service line and then Paige Tolson will contact Troy. He only called me back once and has been ignoring all my calls and texts since collecting the deposit.

records.title: Reviews must be fake I bought bit this hype
records.text: Reviews must be fake, I don’t know? my experience is somewhere in between. Yes the initial phone call appointment and promises went well….. they want your money!!!….. to then finally get to see a dentist….. with the “services” advertised …… another few months. Initially saw a dentist within 4 weeks, didn’t do 3D scan as advertised etc, didn’t even do a health check, examination of my mouth etc !!! I complained to smile white. All the usual bull shit of this isn’t their car etc….. so, I got sent to another dentist who WAS fantastic. I got a 3D scan and x-rays etc. so be careful with What you’re being sold to then get offered !!! I had to complain to smile white as their advertising is misleading, only for I complained, I got What I was paying for …. But it ended there. Since seeing the 2nd dentist…. All has been well, but smile white haven’t ever given me a weekly, bi weekly or even monthly follow up call to see how I am. The dentist is great but this company want your money and bye bye. I’ve been wearing retainers for 4 months….. I was in the middle “tier” for treatment, costs etc, I don’t see great results…… yes my teeth move….. but the minute I take my retainers out for a cup of tea or a few hours….. they have moved back….. I’m 4 months in with 8 weeks to go. Not hopeful at all…. Can see why people butcher their mouths and go to turkey…. I don’t know if this is normal or not because I don’t get any follow up/check in calls from smile white , I see absolutely no improvement when I take my retainers out and check 2 hours later, my teeth go back to square one (after 4 months) but the dentist thinks all is good 🤷‍♀️ absolutely confused , not feeling confident. With 8 weeks to go for me for those final “results” … I see no improvment to my smile, just £2,500 worse off…… not sure about all this. Quite disappointed really as took me a while to take a plunge…… so do your reaserch guys. Maybe I was unlucky or this is just a load of crap to take our cash.

records.title: Genix the business versus the Dental staff
records.text: You need to separate Genix the business from the Dental Staff and the front of house support staff.The Dental staff are everything you might expect from a private dental practice, professional and with access to modern dental equipment.  5 starThe front of house staff are professional and courteous and do the job within the limitations of the tools, procedures and protocols they are given. 5 starGenix and management have clearly lost all contact with the fact that they are a service industry and serve their customers. The customers do not solely exist to provide profit to the business.  For example; Genix tell you, the private customers, when your appointments are and then send you reminders for appointments you did not make or accept.  Genix instruct you to complete online paperwork to check details they already hold, no questions about changes just fill in everything again,  When you challenge sufficiently you are told the booking team cannot amend the record you can get it done at the Practice.  At the Practice you are handed an electronic form which negates the online completion you are instructed to complete to save you time - no it just wastes it.  The final cannot be bothered from Genix is that they ask about prescribed medicine and dose and when you see the electronic version they do not record the doses you take, yet another waste of client time but they cannot be bothered.  To round it off the electronic version has been in my Practice for more than six months so how many client hours have been wasted because Genix don’t care about wasting client time.The bottom line is that Lancaster is the centre of a dental wasteland where you can waste even your private patients time and it doesn’t matter - where else can the customes go? 2 Stars
