records.text: On arrival had to pay for treatment,had paid a deposit in February now October,and the cost had risen by 25 per cent,disgusting. We are pensioners on fixed income and cannot get NHS so have to pay private. Husband had to have a clean,the price was for 20 mins it took less than 10 mins,so getting money for nothing,no decrease in cost tho.Therefore I will not book next appointment for 6 or 8 months but 12 months and will booka lot nearer to time as you are making interest on my deposit.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great staff , can't fault my treatment so far. My 3 stars is based on dentists, Marske Genix included not accepting nhs patients and pushing me and many others into more debt by having to go private!!!!!!!

records.title: Aggrieved client
records.text: The care is good and the staff are friendly.  However, I am currently a private patient at Genix in Gloucester.  I only chose to be a private patient because Genix were not accepting NHS patients.  At a recent visit I found out that Genix were  now accepting NHS patients.  I asked if I could change from being a private patient to NHS.  I was told that because I was a private patient I could not change.  I am annoyed with this as being a private patient was not a choice, but a necessity.

records.title: If there was a world record for speed…
records.text: If there was a world record for speed of examination they would win hands down,Work colleague had the same experience

records.title: Impossible to get appointments for my Invisilign treatment-frustrating and unprofessional
records.text: I have had some private treatment at Garforth -Leeds for Invisilign with DR Risha. Whilst she is a lovely lady and I was pleased with her treatment in general the end of my treatment was a big flop. Throughout the service it was nigh on impossible to get to to speak with the staff dealing with my treatment, various phone numbers and texts but it was a problem on multiple occasions to make appointments or discuss problems when needed. At the end of the treatment when my permanent retainers arrived they were NOT MY TEETH, infact I have never seen anything so bad. Despite having told them they did not fit and then photos and videos to prove so it took 11 days of nothing till i finally got my retainers. I have struggled with these even having to trim the plastic as it gouged into my lower and upper pallet. I have been trying to contact for an appointment to discuss this and I am unsure if my teeth are a correctly completed so would like to speak with someone-again not a chance of getting in touch with anyone. I am on hold again now at 46mins-working full time means i cannot do this. Have left messages etc not a thing. I think the service has failed for being unprofessional, quick to do open days, start treatment but cant complete or get help when needed. Sadly ruined the treatment that could of been better

records.title: Regular check up…
records.text: Attended the dentist yesterday for a 9.15am appointment, at 9.46 I asked the receptionist if I've been forgotten, as people who's appointments were clearly after mine had been in and out. The receptionist said I was down for surgery, which didn't make sense as I was there for a routine check up. When I eventually saw the dentist, I did not receive a proper check up (as in previous visits with the lady dentist) and was in and out within 2 minutes. A disappointing visit.

records.title: Business first, dentist second
records.text: Nice dentist but plans are misleading. Business first, dentist second unfortunately. Appointment went okay and dentist was nice but we were left disappointed on check out. We signed up for plan 2 and my expectation was to get my teeth cleaned by the hygienist that dat or at least soon after. However, we were told it would be £55 as we haven't been a patient for 6 months!Unfortunately, this was not communicated by anybody at all during the signing up process. It's not clear online, the call centre people are very good and persistent at getting your details and making you feel warm and fuzzy. But honestly we are disappointed and feel misled. I think they should make it clear online, during calls and clear in writing going forward about what to expect in terms of the plan. Ironically the day after saying we are disappointed the call centre rang again to see if we wanted finance options for treatment they are recommending. Again, dentist was nice enough but it's clear this is a business that wants to maximise profits.

records.title: No communication skills…
records.text: Had a consultation for private dental work. Paid for a scan and a X-ray. The results of which shocked me a little bit and I couldn’t decide how to move forward, so I decided to show my nhs dentist my scan and X-ray results. I have requested the results to be sent to me and was told I needed to go into the Genix Gloucester branch and fill in a form, which I did. Three times now I have contacted them in the past few months and still nothing! No communication skills. I would definitely never go there to have anything done again! So disappointing, quick enough to take £100s of pounds off of me, but not able to give me what I paid for……shocking!

records.title: All for profit
records.text: The whole appointment just felt like a sales pitch. Going from the regular appointment 6 months earlier having been told “just keep doing whatever you’re doing, everything looks great” to this time being “you need x, y and z done” which came to a total nearing £1800. If the dentistry doesn’t work out then looking good for a career selling double glazing.

records.title: I liked the reception
records.text: I liked the reception, they were informative and helpful with knowledge before you had your appointment.This was an emergancy nhs appointment three weeks wait , has  I was referred by 111 due to toothache previouse to date.The tooth ache was coming fron right side upper mouth , from a root filling done few years when I did have a nhs dentist before the practice went private. I was glad they got myself in for appointment, but I was let down when handed to the dental nurses care.First they ask me my issues which good, but only check part of the mouth of issue, has when I've  been dentist in the past they checked all of the mouth. Also I've had a polished , included I didnt I was just told dead nerve in the right tooth removed and water was offered but much later due to the two nurses , discussing previouse nurse getting the wrong instrument out on another appointment. Then when they had finished, they said the tooth would need a filling.I was told you'll have to find a private to do this due to no nhs spaces but I felt, it more about money, then customer care. I am a person  with a minumue wage job,  I just felt it's about money to these , no care or compassion and no customer care skills.The help offered was finance option and told you have to register.To be honest I dont want to register due to the fact I told you the issue but I felt you didn't even want to check my oral care, as I am use to at my other practice they check whole of your mouth  just incase not one part. My gums are bleeding so I know there a issue, with no tooth polished offered AND THE MATTER OF FACT ATTITUDE, I well not be coming back here , even if I had a loan to pay for my dental care as feel your just a money cow to this practice there no care in there work. And talking about previouse collaeges in front of a customer is bad taste .I am now put off due to experience.This palace would not recommend to any friends or family.

records.title: impolite and careless communication
records.text: impolite and careless communication

records.title: First time at Genix healthcare
records.text: First time at Genix healthcare, found the the staff friendly and helpful .I got seen pretty much at my appointment time ,the dentist gave me some advice but also listened to me .So was really happy with the service I received

records.title: Waited 50 minutes past my appointment…
records.text: Waited 50 minutes past my appointment time!!! Was in the room 6 minutes £75 for what? The lady was rude I told her I had an abcess and please be careful as it was hurting she then proceeded to poke at it several times! What a con! Then proceeds to tell me she can refer me to a nhs dentist what will take a year or she could sort the abcess for £250 all a money making scam robbed of £75!!!

records.title: Absolute con. They pocket your deposits
records.text: They take a 50% fee when booking work, which they pocket for themselves. What they don't tell you is they will keep this fee if you need to rearrange the appointment. They don't explain the  cancellation process or the fact they keep this fee at the point of booking. I made the appointment on a Saturday, in person, for the following Monday afternoon.I called on the Sunday to reschedule due to a change in work shift. But they were closed.I called first thing Monday morning at 9:30am at which point they told me they will pocket the 50% and charge me another 50% for the new date. This was not explained to me at any stage during the booking process.Absolutely con.

records.title: Contradictive
records.text: Puzzled. Covid Screens on reception but 9 clients were squashed into a tiny waiting room with one of the assistants leaning over a reception desk (elbows on it) with her leggings clad butt facing us all for 10 mins!! Finally got into see the dentist 25 mins late I was given a lecture on smoking only to have X-rays  etc and absolutely nothing wrong with my teeth or gums, 5+ years in a row !! I’m 55 years old by the way. Not good.

description: Curate Health offers prescription medication through their registered internet pharmacy for the treatment of weight loss. The service is fully regulated and genuine medication is dispensed from London based pharmacy.

records.title: Curate has been the most professional…
records.text: Curate has been the most professional and ethical company that truly looks after its clients. They have consistently given code for a reduced price and there is no hidden costs. They are prompt and honest.

records.title: Amazing!
records.text: Amazing service, fast delivery! I’ve been with curate for 7 months now for my weight loss journey and I couldn’t be happier! Professional and prompt!

records.title: Very helpful
records.text: Very helpful, fast and easy. Quick delivery even over a bank holiday! Definitely recommend

records.title: Helpful providers of a life changing product
records.text: It’s no exaggeration to say starting my Mounjaro journey has changed my life. 2 months in, 2 stone down, and feeling healthier and better already. Ordering from Curate has been a breeze! There are so many places out there offering these products so picking one over the other can seem pretty daunting, but the initial assessment and ease of ordering has really been a bonus for me, as well as the great pricing compared to some other vendors.

Once I had done that, my prescription was reviewed and I received my weight loss medication within a couple of days. It was well packaged and sent in a cool packet. Impressed once I got over the initial hurdle and seeing results within a week. If you’re a little nervous if using this service because if the negative reviews, I was too! However, I took the plunge on a whim but so glad I did. Onwards abs upwards for me.

records.title: I am fully confident with Curate as 8…

records.title: Great service.

Responses including updates for delivery, etc are always sent in good time and the product works really well. Using mounjaro as a tool has enabled me to focus on getting the right nutrition and my sleep has improved. I am really happy with losing 7/8 of a stone in two months and will continue to repeat order until I reach my goal .

records.title: Curate are fab

I somehow manage to order my mounjaro before a sale, order then takes longer to deliver. I like to be in the house when it's delivered as its expensive and I dont like it to be left at my door so it messes about with my work schedule a bit when it's not going to be delivered when expected. records.title: Disappointed with the lack of…

records.title: Ordering easy but delivery Not Great

records.title: First time ordering was great ordered…
records.text: First time ordering was great ordered approved and delivered in 3 days. Second order was still pending 3 days later after being ordered emailed and got a response next day. By the time I get order will be 5 days past injection day.

records.title: The order was easy to make but…

records.title: Due to curate being the second company…
records.text: Due to curate being the second company I decided to purchase weight loss medication from, I obviously needed to be approved by supplying photos of previous prescriptions from another company. This I understand and find very conscientious ....but the bit I find dissatisfactory is you have to pay for the product upfront before you are told you are approved or rejected... Also, I only found out that I was still being held in the approval part of the transaction by contacting them myself to ask what the delay was. I think it would be much smoother if you were given the approval first then charged for the product to save any other customers worrying where their money had gone without any reassurance of where's they address in the process.

records.title: the overall communication is not ideal…
records.text: the overall communication is not ideal the only way of contact is through emails, i get the service maybe busy but please dont operate next day deliver when it can take over a week to be posted out

records.title: Encountered delays in dispatch

Exposing the pen. I believe the item sat waiting, un refrigerated from the time the order complete email arrived - despite their statement within the email that it will remain chilled until courier collects. Fingers crossed all OK with it when first dose taken. They did set expectations on delays, credit for that.

records.title: Absolutely terrible service.
records.text: Absolutely terrible service.My first order was without any problems at all and I was happy with the service received. However the second experience has been appalling. Without a telephone number available to discuss problems with a person, the ping pong email of 20 messages has resulted in nothing but a frustrating and timely experience that I can do without. Goods not sent. Payment not refunded. Emails ignored. I have had to contact the bank to escalate funds. Dreadful customer service. Very poor experience.

records.title: Not sure I'd recommend

Received an email saying there may be delays due to a warehouse move - would have been good to know this prior to ordering but it came in time so no worries there either. My only concern really is that my medication arrived in a bag with a completely thawed, warm "cold" pack and the box seal was broken (through being squashed I think). Other providers package more effectively and I've never received one warm or squashed until today.

records.title: Second order with Curate for Mounjaro
records.text: Second order with Curate for Mounjaro. I must say, they were not as quick the second time around and definitely not next day. I would advise to order a couple of weeks before you need it to prevent any missed doses. Still the cheapest around though.

Then received a generic email stating all orders will be sent out 28th December due to them not wanting to put a strain on Delivery services. records.title: Customer service is horrific

records.title: I placed my order with plenty of time…
records.text: I placed my order with plenty of time for my product to arrive before I went away. Curate needed some more info that i supplied straight away. Then there was silence! Im sorry but the business is making money you should staff up to meet demand. Will not be ordering from here again!

They really want a satisfied customer and do what it takes to get one. I wouldn't want to go anywhere else.

records.title: What a fantastic dentist!!
records.text: What a fantastic dentist!!! I am always extremely nervous when going to the dentist, but DCT looked after me from start to finish. They will pick up and take you back to your hotel every appointment. Staff are great! Especially a lovely lady called Su, who made my time here so much easier. My dentist Dt Barman has done an amazing job on my poor teeth. I feel like a new man!!

records.title: Thank you dental care for a magical…
records.text: Thank you dental care for a magical experience. Jade you were fantastic from start to finish. You are not just professional but super friendly and made the experience effortless. I hope to see you again one day! Thank you. Claudia and Lynette :) xxxx

records.title: From start to finish I had an excellent…
records.text: From start to finish I had an excellent experience. My consultation was very thorough and she explained everything in detail and also really helped to calm me when I got nervous even providing blankets 😁 and a lot of laughs along the way.

records.title: This is a well run clinic, from the reception staff to the dentists & surgeon. I heard about the clinic from a friend's whose father had implants 15 years ago and to this day everything is perfect.
records.text: My treatment went well and i had no side effects. I had a sinus lift and a bone graft. I felt no pain and was given antibiotics, and vitamins.To help the healing process. My surgeon was excellent. He gave me good advise for my after care.

records.title: Love the teeth I got but expect a lot…
records.text: Love the teeth I got but expect a lot of sensitivity near the base of the crowns, they have held up really well with no issues apart from the sensitive.Got provided a gum shield that lasted 2mins so it’s ok till you can get a more suitable one if your a tooth grinder.Service the whole time was amazing and they don’t mess about when it comes to sorting out your dental plan and appointments.What I got for the price was amazing they could have been more upfront about getting sensitivity issues but using the right toothpaste and flossing helps a lot with this.

records.title: Couldn’t fault the staff
records.text: Couldn’t fault the staff, and the service that you get there is second to none it’s fantastic. My only problem is at the back of one of my Teeth where my tooth doesn’t quite meet my gum I have a hole that food can get into so my gum is always very sore around it. But Hopefully this is going to be Rectified with no further cost to myself.

records.title: I have just returned after my 1st…DCT Fethiye
records.text: I have just returned after my 1st visit. I would like to thank Richard and the rest if the team that saw me through this visit.I had to have a dbl sinus lift and a double bone graft, and 8 teeth removed. Through years of bad experiences in the UK, I was terrified, it has taken me years of preparing for this, however it did not take the fear away. After The team giving me a diazipine I was relaxed enough to get into the chair, the team worked quickly to get me numb, I can honestly say the most painful part were the injections, wow they did hurt. Once numb I can say there was no discomfort or pain. After returning to my hotel and taking pain meds I slept for a few hours, when I awoke I was in no pain and by the 2nd say post op I stopped taking the pain meds. I was so surprised that approx 12 people from the hotel I booked independently were also going back for 2nd or 3rd visit. They too could not speak highly enough. I'm back in October for 10 implants. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend DCT Fethiye

records.title: Anxious  patient
records.text: Obviously was nervous about going to another country for dental work especially as I’m very anxious and don’t like dentists, but it turned out to be not that bad. Firstly the good pointsStarted with an X-ray then a thorough consultation where they weren’t at all pushy.3D X-ray machine far superior to the nhs in the U.K. Also all areas of centre very hygienic and clean.My dentist was lovely she was kind patient and sang while she worked ( which put me at ease) Surgery for 2 implants wasn’t that bad think the injections to numb me were the worse bit.Prices a lot cheaper than the U.K. Appointments were at night so I could eat before.They have a lab over the road that makes crowns etc within a couple of daysOh and they have a cute little drinks place next door which is free. They offer you a drink as soon as you book in. Fabulous service Now points I would like to changeFound it a bit uncomfortable as whilst working they were constantly chatting and laughing and phones kept pinging or ringing. That was a bit off putting.I would have rather heard them reassure me.Going back for part 2 in October and not dreading it.

records.title: wonderful clinic
records.text: wonderful clinic! Thanks to Mr. Shukr for the excellent work. The gum healed as you said, within 3 days

records.title: Implants
records.text: The care I experienced was excellent l look forward to returning to having my implants fitted

records.title: This dentist was great
records.text: This dentist was great. The staff were very helpful, kind, professional and compassionate. The only thing is that I thought I would more of an input over how my teeth would look and was disappointed that even after many complaints that the teeth appeared too long was told "well you have a long face". Now that it's all settled they don't appear as long as I first felt, but I still worry that they look unrealistic because of the length. Saying that, I have way more confidence than I had before and so overall happy ☺️

records.title: Don’t be pushed into their choice
records.text: It was very good service... however I felt the dentist shaped my teeth to what he thought looked good and kept it natural as possible.. even though I said I wanted to look like I had my teeth done.I feel they should try and make it to how the customer wants I didn’t want to look natural like my original teeth as I had good teeth in the first place

records.title: Amazing service!
records.text: Great service! Only thing being when we arrived they said they did not have my partner booked to have his treatment which caused panic within myself as I had message to prove booking of both my partner and I however they then quickly sorted it and my partner was able to have treatment as well.

records.title: Love the teeth but need to have the option of having professional photos during treatment
records.text: Absolutely love my new teeth and the service is great. 5 stars for that. The reason for 4 stars is that I was expecting a better Instagram experience as it would have been nice to have some pictures done of the treatment but that was not the case. They only do the before and after pics.

records.title: A very professional and epic experience...
records.text: A very professional and epic experience!I visited Dental Centre Turkey for the fitting of 8 Veneers on top jaw and teeth whitening of bottom jaw.You firstly attend consultation discussing what you like and are then recommended the best course of treatment followed by a presentation.You then attend a couple of sessions for the treatment to take place.A final checkup is done and you are done!I did not rate at 5 stars as there are periods whereby you may be waiting a couple of hours in Reception but you are treated to some delicious Milkshakes and you get free WiFi!

records.title: Amazing experience and new teeth
records.text: My consultation went well, everything was clear my choice of colour and everything else plus my doctor was amazing. Thank you Dental Centre Turkey 😊👍🏽

records.title: Great end result
records.text: I had 12 dental crowns done in Antalya in February. The end result is beautiful. My experience of the Turkish dental centre was very good. Good communication before i went, efficient pick up/drop off service whilst there, English speaking interpreter so I fully understood the proposal from the Turkish dentist, excellent customer service from the reception staff & waiter in their coffee bar, state of the art technology. If there was one thing which I would give constructive criticism is I felt the service lacked compassion. I’m not sure if it’s a cultural thing but travelling alone as an older woman It felt very business like. I really would of appreciated someone genuinely saying “Are you ok?”  They do obviously ask you if your happy with there work and if you weren’t I’m sure they would accommodate you until you were but the only way to describe the experience was it lacked compassion. I would however recommend TDC to my family & friends

records.title: The work was done properly.
records.text: The work was done properly is just I got gum infection afterwards. I need to review the dentist to make sure that I am not going to get things worse in the future.

records.title: Be warned of long waits
records.text: Just had Root canal and a crown in Fethiye. The dental work was fabulous and would defo recommend. The only reason I don’t give the full 5 stars is I found the communication was very slow there were a few emails before I flew out that were missed and was questions I kind of needed answers to. Also you have a appointment time and are sometimes left hours before going into your appointment and when you are on holiday time is precious. Overall I would recommend but just be warned if you are planning on having work done maybe allow a couple extra days on top of your holiday as you will lose big chunks of your day for appointments. One of which took 15 mins once I was in the chair but was waiting almost two hours in the waiting room.. being a nervous person when it comes to dental treatment I didn’t appreciate this anxious wait, with no communication.

records.title: very good service and professional…
records.text: very good service and professional staff. i was quite satisfied with the whole experience.

records.title: If your reading this review go for it!
records.text: I went to dental centre Turkey in august 2020, 4 months since having my teeth done and I’m in love with the results. I feel like a new person and have gained so much confidence. I would recommend dental centre turkey to anyone and plan on going back with my sister for her to get a full set of crowns. Advice to anyone considering going here. Take someone with you. After the initial consultation they start work almost immediately. I didn’t expect this and was on my own. As much as the co-ordinators are good the dentist himself and the dental assistant didn’t speak great English so I was really overwhelmed when they started drilling the teeth down and you cannot communicate (this was painless your full mouth is numb). I needed 3 route treatments done and wished I had had this done in Scotland before I went to dental centre as I ended up with an extremely painful abscess due to having the route treatment and disrupting the infection that was already in my mouth. I contacted the clinic as soon as the numbness wore off and I felt the pain and they sent a driver to pick me up the very next morning to see the dentist. The dentist could only give me more pain relief which was enough to get me on my flight home and then I went to a private dentist in the uk to have the abscess drained.  Despite having this problem which really was unforeseeable I would go back in a heart beat. Clinic is spotless. The results are amazing!. It was worth the pain and the best money I have spent. Thank you dental centre turkey

records.title: Good and fast service
records.text: Date of experience: 23 September 2021

records.title: I’m glad I got my teeth done
records.text: I’m glad I got my teeth done, it’s bright & clean but it’s they could have done a better job, considering the travel & cost. My bottom teeth protrude out too far. Moreso than I had previously with my other veneers, I never had this problem before. They said it’s just the way it is. My top tooth is discoloured underneath my veneer, something I had previously. The last time I had veneers they used some white material to cover my tooth and then placed the veneer over it so my tooth appears white. They didn’t do that here so it’s a little discoloured, they mustn’t have the expertise for this. If a tooth isn’t under warranty, the quality & care isn’t there.

records.title: The service was impeccable
records.text: The service was impeccable. Could not be faulted at all however, the actual quality of the laser teeth whitening wasn't the greatest. I listened to the advice given by my dentist and abstained from all coloured foods. In spite of this my teeth went back to the same shade within a month.

records.title: Well when I was there I was called back…
records.text: Well when I was there I was called back to the dentist for another appointment I wasn’t told on the phone the when I got there it was to have tooth changed that had just been done, there was a gap showing on the X-ray they wasn’t happy with. Since I’ve been back 5 months there is another 1 with a gap food gets stuck in also have a 1 tooth very odd shape and size compared to the same tooth in the other side of my mouth. I also have a couple of back ones grinding down when I sleep. I was charged for moulds but only received a top mould. It’s very disappointing when you spend all that money and you can just pop down the road to get it sorted! Overall they look ok but really they still get me down.

records.title: I'm a genuine customer of dct
records.text: I'm a genuine customer of dct, just last week. I visited this clinic before it went VIP, and it was incredible, from drivers to dentist, rexeption staff, I felt relaxed ( I hate going dentist) and not anxious at all, I felt  no pain at any point. So returned feeling confident  and not scared at all(I had 2 dental implants) . First visit, 18th May,    they opened up my gums and stitched them back to stay open. The dentist never left the numbing fluid on ling enough so I felt all the injections,  and he stabbed my lip when talking to someone ! 2nd visit  was to take moulds etc and put caps on I think  .., dentist never really explained, was rushing and very rough, impersonal and hurt me I feel unnecessarily, never gave  me mouthwash at the end, I returned hotel in great pain all night feeling bruised and battered 3rd visit, I told reception staff how I was feeling and why, they were great I was having my teeth fitted and aligned   ,  i waited two half hours. ..nit happy at this at all   the reception guy came in fir first half hour then left,     I felt  the rushing from dentist and the blatant  disregard for the pain he was causing,  by squeezing my jaw closed over the xray  plastic bit,    it was gruelling,  so much so, that another hour later I just burst into tears  , at this point, he just threw his hands up, sat in a chair and never really said much to console me, then once I stopped he threw fluid over cotton pad and literally roughly wiped it round my stitched gum  which hurt and got it in my lips  n said I inject you, I said no..just keep on with it . The nurse had left room, never returned, but a other nurse came in, the pressure  on my jaw, neck head was tremendous, I was in sitting position and have back problems    so wasn't good, then reception man came in, said something and dentist laid me back  thankgod   finally work got finished and I was soooo relived  I grant u it was fiddly for him as implants on bottom left side  and I have small mouth, however I just felt like a piece of meat if I'm honest. I feel bad for saying this but have to be truthful, .I feel they are seeing too many patients and the quality of dentist care  has gone down  big time, and I feel dentists are under pressure too, which doesn't help   . I spoke to lots patients,  most of whom felt  their injections,  but obviously did not know any better  as I did  from my first visit  and met a couple whom like me were amazed in 2019, but sorely dissapointed this time, and the guy only had a scrape n polish and said it was sooo rough, he was in pain and in pain all night  .On a positive note, the building, the staff, the drivers, the refreshments,  the finished product is excellent,  but the dentist process, treatment left me feeling in pain, upset and anxious  so much so that if I could have stopped I would have, but couldn't as I was half way through What I'm saying in this review is what I told reception staff and what I put in their feedback forms  .

records.title: Waste of time and money
records.text: I was emailing this clinic back and forth for nearly a year, spent a long time (I wanted this done for over four years and saved every spare penny) researched my aftercare and the pros and cons of what I wanted and after finally saving the required amount agreed upon, then the added expense of travel and accommodation, I ended up walking out at the first consultation. They completely ignored what we'd agreed previously as they clearly had their own agenda and only wanted me to pay for more expensive and longer treatments which required me returning to Turkey. I spent over £1000 for a wasted journey. I'm actually very upset with the whole situation and disgusted with the way I was duped into believing they'd help me. * I explained that I was in constant pain and eating was difficult. My teeth were very yellow and discoloured and they were misaligned, my breath was always bad. I agree that what I wanted was drastic but I'm not a young person, I'm nearly 50. I wasn't doing this for cosmetic reasons, I'm sick of repeated absesses and expensive visits to UK dentists. I thought removing the teeth would solve all my problems both physically and mentally. I never smile and get very embarrassed speaking with people. Regarding the 3D imaging, the clinic gave me recommendations to get this done prior but expected me to travel from Glasgow to England, which I wasn't going to do. I came for your help and you refused.I DID send photos before I booked. We are clearly not going to agree.

records.title: Extremely over long wait time for your…
records.text: Extremely over long wait time for your first appointment/consultation left a very bad taste in my mouth...I made my appointment two months prior to arriving in Turkey.  I arrived at the clinic and was told to wait in reception.  After about 45mins I went for my 3D xray and then was told it would be another 2 hours before I could have my consultation appointment and to go out to get some lunch. I was a little surprised by this long wait but agreed and went out for some lunch then came back and after two hours asked when my appointment would be to be told it would be another 2 hours. I was completely shocked by this but as I had come all the way to Turkey to get my teeth done I waited, but was very upset by this totally unacceptable experience. After nearly 5 hours I went for my consultation to be told to wait another half an hour to see the dentist. Another two hours later I was called in by the dentist and I got back to my hotel after spending 10 hours at the clinic. It was one of the worst days of my life. So miserable and upsetting.

records.title: Disappointing experience (inconsistent quality of care).
records.text: I visited DCT Antalya on 18/12/2023. I chose  this clinic because of the high ratings. Unfortunately, the process was not as smooth and pleasant as I expected. Booking & Organisation: 5/5Excellent communication from DCT before my arrival. They were very thorough, helpful and responded quickly to my inquiries. The appointments were organised well and the drivers were always on time.Initial Consultation (with patient coordinator): 3/5 This felt very scripted and lacked individualised care. I asked them to prioritise the health of my teeth and I wanted options to make them look better. The initial suggestion was 8-10 crowns on my top and 8-10 on my bottom teeth, which I found very strange as my bottom teeth are perfectly healthy. I had to ask for less invasive options, which should have been initially discussed. Not everyone wants a ‘Hollywood Smile’.  Also, there was no enthusiasm from the staff. However, I was happy with the final plan as it was more reasonable. The coordinator answered my questions to a satisfactory degree.Root Canal Treatment: 2/5The initial consultation was followed by my root canal treatment (same day). The root canal procedure was terrible. I will be clear and say that I was not in pain during or after the procedure. However, it was extremely uncomfortable and overwhelming. 1) The dentist did not warn me that he will inject anaesthetics - this surprised me and I couldn’t do anything as the needle was already in my gum.  2) He was very rough in his approach - I know this is an invasive procedure, but at least TRY to be gentle and empathetic when handling my mouth. He did not show any care. I actually developed a small rash which I am certain is from the equipment that he was using as it was rubbing on to the side of my mouth causing a lot of friction (I sent them a photo of this). 3) I was not asked once if I was okay, my neck and jaw were very uncomfortable. The dentist did not speak English well so communicating was difficult, and communication is the most important thing in any treatment. Teeth Preparation: 5/5 This was so much better. It was with a different dentist who was reassuring, explained what he was going to do and communicated very well. The procedure was smooth. I asked him a few questions and he was very helpful. Crown fitting & Overall result: 5/5This was with the same dentist that prepared my teeth. He made some aesthetic adjustments to the crowns. Although the crowns do not completely match my natural teeth, I was expecting this as I have some discolouration in my natural teeth. It definitely looks a lot better than before the treatment which I am happy about. Final thoughts:I am not the only one to make a complaint of this nature. It is clear that they are seeing so many patients which makes the process feel scripted and lack enthusiasm, personalised care and empathy. Customer satisfaction involves the process and results. The results are good, but in my case, DCT neglected the process - which was terrible. There are inconsistencies in their overall care so I would not recommend this clinic.Edit: DCT initially attempted to remove this review and they flagged it as ‘Fake’ even though I had a full discussion about my experience with the operations manager prior to posting this. I have now verified my experience with trust pilot so it was posted. Due to the dishonesty, I’ve reduced the rating from 3 to 2 stars.

records.title: So many red flags
records.text: I will give two stars instead of one because my teeth do LOOK good. However, these doctors/dentists are not trained correctly and only seem to care about the look of your teeth versus practicality. They also have horrible communication in office. I went in to get 12-14 teeth total.. during my consultation we discussed 8 top/8 bottom. The oral surgeon seemed great, explained I had a minor crossbite to fix and I said okay. I then went to another room to begin the preparation process and it was an entirely different oral surgeon and somebody I’ve never seen before, which was weird. They shaved my teeth down and put on temps. Only when I got back later that day did I realize they shaved down ALL of my teeth. Literally 25 of them. So without telling me they did 12 top/13 bottom? They changed the price on my final receipt to reflect the same total price I had agreed to but changed the price per tooth from 425 to 325 or something like that. So I essentially got a bunch of teeth for free which is great but still seemed super sketchy and odd? I reached out to them about this and didn’t get a clear answer. They said something about fixing my crossbite and it requiring more teeth. Fine but maybe tell me first? Also when we did the prep work and I was numbed, they hit a nerve that you should be trained to not hit. It’s not a huge deal because in most cases it goes away when the anesthesia wears off but it also sometimes take days/weeks and just simply shouldn’t happen if a dentist knows what they are doing. The entire side of my left face was 100% paralyzed for 12 hrs, even though I was numbed evenly. This is just a small example of not being trained well/correctly. Anyways, it’s been 3.5 weeks now since I got my teeth done. I have emailed DCT a few times regarding my discomfort and pain and know it hasn’t been long but the pain is now excruciating, unbearable and increasing everyday. I’ve seen 3 dentists/specialists here in the US and they have all told me the same thing. “My teeth look good but were not done correctly”. Essentially the way they changed my bite gave me TMJ (a super painful jaw issue) and my jaw/joints are not adjusting. I’ve been taking 6-10 ibuprofen a day just to function. I was super patient, hoping it was just gonna go away and have a high pain tolerance but it’s truly horrible. DCT has been responsive but my only option now is to fly back to turkey and spend thousands more on travel to have them HOPEFULLY* do it right this time. Which I’m not very confident in. I’ve been told it’s not an easy bite adjustment but would require completely redoing a section, if not all of my teeth by two professionals here. Not only am I in pain but very depressed and anxious about the whole ordeal. I don’t trust DCT anymore but also cant pay 50k+ here to try to fix them and can’t live with this level of pain much longer.. so not a great situation. Also frustrating that when I have redo them or fix them, there’s 24 to fix versus the 12-14 I asked for. Much bigger expense and simply not what I wanted or asked for

records.title: Left feeling really disappointed once…
records.text: Left feeling really disappointed once home after having 8 crowns fitted on my top row of teeth. Initially it all went well, had them done in February 2020, wore my gum shield at night religiously..... looked after them well. They have in the meantime moved considerably, I’m left in pain and not happy with the wonky new teeth. After contacting them they did offer to rectify them free of charge, however I am unable to travel until mid August and just cannot wait that long, due to the pain. So having to now pay thousands to become pain free in this country. Really disappointed 😔

records.title: Dentist and assistant were chatting non…
records.text: Dentist and assistant were chatting non stop in Turkish, laughing and joking and I had no clue what about, not what you want when having such a big transformation, also felt very rushed like I was a inconvenience!

records.title: Rip off
records.text: Booked for my treatment only to have the price increased by £2000+After 4 jours Eventually Met with the manager who is just a figurehead - absolutely appalling company and now subject to ‘regulatory attention’On speaking to existing clients this apparently the way this company works - everyone needs ‘root canals’ I wouldn't touch this company with a barge poleIf you don't sign their terms and conditions they wont treat you but send you information relating to other clients

records.title: VERY UNPROFESSIONAL Dental centre Turkey was another which…
records.text: Dental centre Turkey was another which boasted good reviews So on my recent visit I decided to get a “consolation” here too.I didn’t even bother staying the duration My appointment was @ 18:00 arrived ten minutes early to be given a questionnaire to fill in which I did.  No update was given to how long I would need to wait.  I was then called in at 18:45 for an X-ray and was then told to wait in the seating area.  Around 7:15 I went to the front desk and asked how long it would be as my appointment was for 18:00 - I was only then told it will be another 60-90 minutes!!I gave them a piece of my mind and decided to leave. Again yet another shambolic place only interested in getting people through the doors.  Yes I understand it’s a business you need to run but be a little professional dealing with peoples time - having read other reviews online it seems they are also guilty of unnecessary treatments - I think I dodged a bullet !

records.title: I would like to share my experience…
records.text: I would like to share my experience with DC Antalya. I got my teeth done 2 months ago here I had composite bonding done 6 upper 6 lower. My experience didn’t go as smoothly as I wanted it to. My stay got extended longer than I wanted it to as they had to fix my teeth as it didn’t look good. I experienced a lot of faf after being 80% happy leaving I’m now experiencing more problems with my composite bonding. Iv already had two teeth that have chipped making my smile look ugly to the point I don’t even want to go out, after explaining the problem to them they think I can just jump on the next flight and come ? Iv had enough of the back and forth I wouldn’t recommend this dentist and I won’t be coming back ever again.Melda Guclu.

records.title: Not worth it
records.text: I had my teeth done last year. And at to go back this year for permanent has I had 2 bridges and I am so disappointed with the final result my temporary teeth were better then the final ones now. The dentist who did the temporary ones last year was so good he made sure all was straight and all aligned. He did say he may not be here when I come back so when I had a lady finish off he’s work she did a bad job my teeth are not aligned they are many errors and was quite rough I did ask the coordinator to ask if she could be more gentle when given the injections on the whole it’s not worth the money I wished I had paid more and had them done in London. I have made the dental centre aware off this woman’s work and they have e mailed and said there part but all in all this woman was not on the ball and did the complete opposite to the first dentist I see. So do think before booking…

records.title: Great investment for your smile
records.text: This is the third time I order from the site, the product is original and identical to the ones I used to buy in the USA. I am very satisfied and recommend the product. records.title: I purchased this product after my…
records.text: I purchased this product after my friends recommendation (and oh my lord her teeth look so perfectly white ) though since I have sensitive teeth I ordered the sensitive range and it has had no affect at all! I have written to crest and had no response..

records.title: WHAT FELT LIKE A NEAR DEATH EXPERIENCE
records.text: WHAT FELT LIKE A NEAR DEATH EXPERIENCE Absolutely do not recommend! If I can offer anyone advice, it’s to stay far away from this place.I should have paid attention to the other negative reviews, but the discounted offer swayed me into booking. It was the worst decision I’ve ever made. If I could rate them zero stars, I would. They’re happy to take your money and then completely disregard you afterward.I had the ALURION BALLOON procedure, and initially, the staff seemed nice. However, once I arrived for my procedure, everything changed. The nurse was rushed and unprofessional, which made me feel anxious. I asked for my sister to be present during the procedure for support, but Dr. Sharif was dismissive and patronising, making no effort to calm me down.The level of medical negligence I experienced was shocking and needs to be reported to the CQC. After the balloon insertion, I received no in clinic care despite facing severe issues. I experienced extreme vomiting and nausea for three days, far worse than the "mild side effects" I had been warned about. Despite their promise of a 24/7 on-call nurse, I couldn’t get hold of anyone. The medication that was recommended caused me to vomit, yet Dr. Sharif made no effort to adjust or change it. Eventually the vomiting had stopped but the discomfort was very much there. After one month, my condition worsened, and I was rushed to A&E with agonising stomach cramps.The hospital surgeons had no choice but to removing the balloon due to the pain I was in. Days after my discharge, I finally received a message from the nurse, who was more concerned about how I got her number than about my condition. There was no compassion, she completely disregarded my well-being.I was never warned about this particular complication during the consultation or in the consent forms. When I asked for a refund due to the serious health issues I faced, they ignored me for months, only to later inform me that I wouldn’t be getting my money back. This establishment is a disgrace and should be shut down. I will be taking legal action.

description:
Pharmadoctor services for patients
Pharmadoctor is a leading UK provider of private clinical services for patients through its nationwide network of 8,000 partner pharmacies and clinics. 
Patients can conveniently access over 60 clinical services and 200+ prescription-only treatments without the wait for a GP appointment. 



Services provided include
Private Covid Vaccination
Travel Vaccinations
Weight Management
Chickenpox vaccination
Private Flu Vaccination
Ear Infection
Strep A Test 'n Treat
Full Vaccination Services
Pharmadoctor has the UK's largest network of travel clinics and its thousands of partner pharmacies also offer a variety of clinical services.  Services include the full range of vaccinations such as chickenpox vaccines and private Covid vaccines, as well as weight management clinics. All services provided are private so are not limited by NHS restrictions. With Pharmadoctor you can book a private Covid vaccination appointment for your entire family even if they are not eligible for a Covid jab on the NHS. Pharmadoctor partner pharmacies and clinics can also offer services on a walk-in basis, perfect for those looking for last minute travel vaccines and treatments as well as comprehensive travel health advice.  All patients have access to their full consultation history within their Pharmadoctor account and can see records of any vaccinations given, as well as summaries of travel advice provided during consultations. The weight management service consists of face-to-face consultations where thorough assessments can be carried out, complete with goal setting, progress reviews and, if clinically appropriate, access to all the latest weight loss medication including weight loss jabs; all designed to help ensure healthier and sustainable weight loss.



How it works? 
Visit www.pharmadoctor.co.uk/patient, select the clinic / service you are interested in, search for your nearest Pharmadoctor partner pharmacy offering the service, then simply book an appointment online. 

You can even complete a pre-consultation online before your appointment to speed up the process. Alternatively, just walk into one of our participating pharmacies and see a trusted local pharmacist who can provide you with a consultation and treatment if appropriate. 



Why Pharmadoctor?
Our multi-award-winning pharmacy services have helped over 1 million patients, blending the best of digital health with local bricks and mortar pharmacies.
Unlike digital-only clinical services, Pharmadoctor connects patients directly with a real healthcare professional (your trusted local pharmacist) at every consultation. The result is a convenient, accessible and affordable private healthcare service when you need it most.
If you are travelling abroad and need vaccinations or you are looking for help with weight management, your local GP service may not be able to provide a convenient and timely solution. Pharmadoctor has identified the key areas where patients are struggling to find the service and treatments they require, at a time that suits them, and is stepping in to help.



Pharmadoctor services for pharmacies
Pharmadoctor has been working hard since 2009 to be the leading provider of clinical services to the UK pharmacy sector. With over 12,000 community pharmacists having used our services from small independent pharmacies to nationwide pharmacy chains we are proud to be delivering valued clinical services that are putting community pharmacy back where it belongs.
Our consultation guidance system, the Pharmadoctor eTool, provides pharmacists with all the support they need to offer a comprehensive service, including up-to-date relevant clinical advice specific to the patient in attendance.

records.text: Booking process straight forward but you don't know cost until you turn up at pharmacy.

records.title: Late appointment - no apology
records.text: my appointment was late despite me turning up 5 mins early, as requested. No apology offered, which would have been just manners.There is a reason customers book a time, its because they have other things to do before and after that time. All the slots before my time and after my time were free so no excuse there. Customer service is everything, next year I go somewhere else, simple, learn some simple manners

records.title: All personel were very helpful but excessive charge
records.text: All personel were very helpful in helping me set up an appointment for a RSV vaccination and the pharmacist who administered the jab was friendly and caefully explained the process.  He arranged for a small private side room for the jab ensuring privacy  and gave me the jab without too much discomfort.  So setting up the jab and administering it was handled well.  However what was less satisfcory was the price.  I had looked up the guidelines on charges on the NHS website ,gov.uk and was informed that private companies should charge between £180 and £200 for the RSV jab.  I was therfore extremely surprised to be charged £300! I had thought £200 was high enough but £300 seemed to be quite excessive.  I would be interested to hear the justification for making such an ecessive charge particularly in the face of government guidelines.

records.title: We wanted malaria tabs.
records.text: We wanted malaria tabs.Tabs were expensive towards other places.Pharmacist was nice, but we did have to wait a long while to pay, as the till was not working.That is why we gave three stars.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: The staff were very friendly, but the cost of the vaccination I went for turned out to be more than the parameters mentioned on your website. I was also concerned that nobody advised me to sit for 5 minutes afterwards to ensure I hadn’t had an adverse reaction to the jab - the first time I’ve come across an experience where they failed to do that.

records.title: I live in Ashington but wanted to…
records.text: I live in Ashington but wanted to utilise the pharmacy at the glebe surgery in storrington west Sussex. I couldn't find it on your system, so telephoned the surgery and made my own arrangements. Your system wanted me to go to henfield. My doctors are the glebe. I think your system needs the new pharmacy added. Thank you.

records.title: It said on your website that the jab…
records.text: It said on your website that the jab was free for over 50s. The pharmacist admitted that the website hadn't been updated. At this point I'd taken half an hours flexi time from work and was sat there having travelled across town to get there with my sleeve rolled up. Perhaps this should have been honoured. Poor really.

records.title: Booked a covid vax to pay for privately. Pharmacy was very bus Staff unable to navigate system on pc
records.text: Booked a COVID Vax to pay for privately. Pharmacy was very busy on my arrival. Waited for some time. Staff unable to navigate IT system to even find my appointment. Staff then arguing. Eventually received my jab, but not a very nice experience, unsure that anyone knew what they were doing and at a cost of £89.95. I really would not recommend and will not be using again.

records.title: Website difficult to use
records.text: Website difficult to use. Address search for GP poor. Drop down to book appointments poor, not clear on which slots were available. Also no confirmation of appointments being booked.

records.title: No one informed me about Pharmadoctor
records.text: The main thing that was wrong was that no one at the Health Check Clinic mentioned Pharmadoctor or that I would be registered for it. This should have been mentioned in the booking email or in the pre-screen session. My initial assumption what that the email was pfishing or SPAM.Otherwise the experience was OK.

records.title: Doesn't work
records.text: The appointment I first booked wasn't available at the pharmacy that day, yet I only found out by calling direct. The second booking I made was also never confirmed and the pharmacy didn't have it. Fortunately they had availability just after and made it work for me, but no thanks to anything from thus website.

records.title: Had to wait a long time to be seen
records.text: Had to wait a long time to be seenThe pharmacist was having trouble with his computer so more waitingJust took so long, I dont think I would visit that pharmacy again for a vaccine, staff were  nice though

records.title: Pharmacist had no record of appointments
records.text: Used the website to book Covid vaccinations for myself and my family. They showed nothing in our area, despite the fact that we live in a good sized city. Booked appointments in another city 20 miles away instead. I completed the process, got confirmations, but could only fill out the optional pre-consultation section for one of us. The larger challenge was that the pharmacist had no record of out appointments. Fortunately, she was able to take us as walk-ins.

records.title: Although I had and paid for 3 travel…
records.text: Although I had and paid for 3 travel vaccinations only 2 were displayed on my record until I notified the company. I was also told these should be available free on NHS but had to pay £133. I also have to notify my own GP to get these vaccinations added to my NHS records.

description:
RT Aesthetics specialises in the very latest non-surgical treatments that provide long lasting superior results. All of our treatments are FDA approved and are carried out by highly trained qualified practitioners. Within RT Aesthetics we have a qualified nurse practitioner who is on hand to answer any medical questions that you may have. Our goal is simple, to deliver superb results safely and effectively while providing you with a holistic, personal centred approach. We aim to enhance your body confidence and quality of life in a relaxing environment, offering an alternative – affordable solution to surgery.

Not all of us are blessed with body we want, however with RT Aesthetics we can help you achieve the body confidence you’ve always wanted using scientifically proven products and treatments, without going under the knife. We are passionate about helping our clients to achieve their goals, therefore we promise to provide you with a holistic, personal centred approach, aiming to enhance your body confidence and quality of life.

With a friendly and relaxing atmosphere you can be reassured that you will receive a down to earth, open and honest service where you will not be judged or pushed into anything you don’t want to do or pressured into unnecessary purchases. We believe you should have the opportunity to discuss your treatment needs and obtain expert advice prior to committing to a treatment, which is why RT Aesthetics offer a free no-obligation consultation.

We have an extensive selection of services to choose from so you can get exactly what you need.

records.title: Exilis helped with loose skin
records.text: After losing weight, I had some loose skin around my stomach that really bothered me. Exilis made it look tighter and smoother after just a few sessions. It’s not a miracle, but it’s made a huge difference in how I feel about myself.

records.title: Exilis made a huge difference
records.text: I’ve been self-conscious about the loose skin on my stomach for years, but Exilis helped so much. The sessions were quick, and I didn’t feel any discomfort. Now my skin feels tighter, and I feel way more confident.

records.title: Wonderful Experience!
records.text: What a wonderful experience at RT Aesthetics! The whole team are warm, friendly and knowledgeable putting you at your ease every step of the way. I wouldn't go anywhere else!

records.title: Emsella helped me feel normal again
records.text: I used to avoid laughing too hard because I was scared of leaks, but now I don’t even think about it. The sessions are quick, and I started noticing a difference pretty fast. It’s been such a relief to feel like myself again.

records.title: Saw results after a few sessions
records.text: Honestly, I wasn’t expecting much because I’ve tried so many other things. But by the third session, my thighs looked slimmer and smoother. It’s such a relief to find something that actually works.

records.title: Hifu really tightened my skin
records.text: I noticed my jawline and cheeks looked a lot firmer after the HIFU sessions. It wasn’t instant, but after a few weeks, the difference was super obvious.

records.title: The consultation was so detailed
records.text: They didn’t rush me or try to sell me random treatments. Instead, they gave me advice that actually made sense for my skin.

records.title: Hifu gave me noticeable results
records.text: I can’t believe how much tighter my skin looks, especially around my jawline. It’s such a confidence booster when I look in the mirror now.

records.title: EMSculpt gave me definition
records.text: I’ve been hitting the gym for years, but EMSculpt really took it to the next level. My muscles feel firmer, and I can see more shape in my arms and abs. It’s wild how much it’s helped in such a short time.

records.title: EMSculpt has me hooked
records.text: I’ve only done a few sessions, but I can already see a difference in my arms and abs. It’s like it’s doing the work for you, and the results are amazing. I can’t wait to keep going and see what happens.

records.title: Fabulous staff
records.text: Fabulous staff.  Unfortunately my treatment has not worked as I wanted it too for me.  I'm 56 and wanted my skin tightened on my stomach which hasn't actually changed at all.  I know it keeps working down the line for 3 months but I cannot see it changing to be honest.  I think the only way that will help is surgery.Nothing against the company as I know everyone is different  and might work for others.

records.title: I had the 360 fat freezing and it's worth doing
records.text: I had the 360 fat freezing and this was my second appointment.  I would definitely recommend it as I have noticed a difference on the sides of my stomach in particular, after my first session.  I think the front stomach fat is more stubborn hence the second session.  I do body brushing twice a day as stipulated and it certainly helps.  It's worth trying if, like me, you don't like the fat in your stomach.  It can be a bit uncomfortable during the treatment but stick with it, as it is worth it.

records.title: Staff friendly enough but unfortunately…
records.text: Staff friendly enough but unfortunately paid a lot for treatments and had literally no results despite giving it time which is a real shame.

records.title: Bad experience
records.text: A staff member changed their terms and conditions online mid text conversation with me after realising the policy they were trying to impose on me when I tried to reschedule a treatment (single treatments validity is 6 months) didn’t actually exist. After confronting them with screenshots of before and after, I was called by them several times and they apologised for it, insisting it was an external company who deals with their bookings and offered discounted treatments and free skincare which I was reluctant to do but I did initially agree to. Also as I had seen zero results from coolsculpting although I did only have 1 treatment, I was expecting at least some difference and then I read up about serious side effects of it which I didn’t realise so I chose emsculpt neo at a discounted rate as agreed until nearer the appointment time, I decided I’d rather actually not attend a dishonest salon. The other staff members were nice when I attended the clinic the one time but due to my experience after this with the dishonesty of who I liaised with via phone, I’d rather go to a more trusted place for my treatments even though it meant losing my £100 deposit.

records.title: Had a treatment here months ago
records.text: Had a treatment here months ago, very expensive and didn't see any results, I did mention this to the owner of the company, he said wait longer, no results at all.Very disappointed.

records.title: Not impressed with attitude of a member…
records.text: Not impressed with attitude of a member of staff.  Very unpleasant experience.  Female member of staff was very helpful though.
