description:
Did you know most people don’t replace their toothbrush heads for 9 months, on average?

We want to solve this habitual headache (and bad habit!). That’s why we started Ordo - to offer convenience in an area of everyday necessity. No gimmicks, simply great oral hygiene that's both convenient and cost effective. That’s it.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Excellent customer service! I contacted Ordo about a lost order which was destined to be a Christmas present. It was as over a week since the order date & the courier service appeared to have stalled! Ordo’s response was prompt & proactive. A new order was placed, the item despatched the same day & within 2 days I’d received the parcel! I can’t fault that level of service, well done Ordo. In addition I love the toothbrushes, they’re the best!!

records.title: Best toothbrush ever
records.text: Best toothbrush ever ! I got 2 for my children and then ordered another 2 for me and my husband. Very happy with the quality, the look and the finish after brushing. Highly recommended

records.title: Absolutely amazing
records.text: Absolutely amazing . Not only is  my flosser the best thing. I’ve had the best customer care / response. I couldn’t recommend anything else . 👍🏼

records.title: Great colours
records.text: Great value and much better than the Oral b brush I was previously using.

records.title: Nice for a gift, pretty colours
records.text: The order arrived quite promptly even tho Christmas time. It was for my daughter, she loved it

records.title: Great
records.text: Sonic toothbrush is great, it really makes a difference and can feel retry a lot cleaner without having to brush hard or for longer time

records.title: A great product and a fantastic company to deal with !
records.text: I recently had a problem with an Ordo product I purchased earlier this year and I contacted customer services. I received a response and the issue was dealt with swiftly and efficiently to my satisfaction. I would wholeheartedly recommend Ordo products based on this response.The actual sonic toothbrush is superb at keeping my teeth clean and my gums healthy. Thank you everyone at Ordo.

records.title: Fantastic toothbrush
records.text: Fantastic toothbrush, I love the  overall aesthetic and ease of the the travel case. Great battery life, and it's so much easier being able to charge with a type C cable as opposed to the traditional cables you charge an electric toothbrush with. My teeth have never felt cleaner!

records.title: Great kids toothbrush and my daughter…
records.text: Great kids toothbrush and my daughter loves the squashimallow theme. Definitely worth the cost, well made and great quality. Her teeth look cleaner and whiter. Perfect transition toothbrush from young children to tween.

records.title: Practically perfect
records.text: Extremely fast delivery, product is perfect and good value for money.    Can’t ask for anything more

records.title: REDUCES PLASTIC BOTTLES
records.text: I like Ordo mouthwash because it reduces plastic waste and is also as good as supermarket ones.  Good service. I ordered 2 bottles of concentrate but only one was sent. However as soon as I told them they sent the second bottle promptly

records.title: Item arrived quickly and is just what I…
records.text: Item arrived quickly and is just what I wanted, colour is absolutely gorgeous.My only niggle is I think the brush heads are a bit too soft for me but will persevere and see how I get on.

records.title: I have placed an order for two…
records.text: After not receiving the two brushes I ordered I did receive the other toothbrush and someone came back to me via email with a £5 refund. It’s just a little frustrating not having a contact number.

records.title: Good, but a few niggles.
records.text: I bought an Ordo Lite toothbrush direct from Ordo. It arrived fairly quickly; no problems the toothbrush works well but three niggles....Miserly to supply only one brush. Too easy to turn on and off accidentally in use. And no travel lock to prevent accidental turning on during travel.

records.title: Good Customer service
records.text: UPDATE - Ordo have very quickly dealt with my concerns and refunded my purchase. If I may offer some constructive feedback that a lightweight travel case is considered for the Sonic Lite. Otherwise it’s a great product. Thank you …….A couple of months ago I ordered the Sonic lite “travel friendly” toothbrush. I gave it an excellent review because it cleans very well and is lightweight -ideal for travelling. However the first time I packed the brush to go away I discovered a flaw in its design….. it switches itself on in the my suitcase or bag as there is nothing to protect the on/off button. So recently, I ordered the travel case for the travel toothbrush…. However only on delivery I found this travel case doesn’t fit the Sonic Lite brush. The travel case only fits the Sonic +. On closer checking of the description it does state only suitable for Sonic+. I knew the brush I had order 2 months earlier was Sonic but didn’t know its full name. My mistake I guess, but Ordo wouldn’t allow a return on the travel case, only offering a slight discount off a new Sonic+ brush to fit the case??  I don’t need 2 - Disappointing! So I now have a travel case that doesn’t fit the “Travel Friendly” lightweight brush which to reiterate isn’t designed well for travel.

records.title: Fast Delivery
records.text: Haven't tried toothbrushes yet (got one for present and one for a spare) disappointed to see the free brush heads I was meant to receive along with the two brushes were not in the package

records.title: Good toothbrush, but...
records.text: Been using Ordo toothbrush for a couple of years and very happy with it. Battery lasts a couple of weeks or more. I do find the replacement brushes to be expensive though, and probably don't replace them as often as I should. There was an offer on recently and I took that up.

records.title: Custom Service Ignore You
records.text: We have multiple Ordo devices in our house. Unfortunately, one stopped working whilst under warranty. Support initially replied quickly, however it's now been a week of radio silence despite 3 chaser emails whilst I'm left with a broken product. A shame because we were quite bought into the brand. update: after working with customer service, managed to get this resolved quickly. Just a shame I had to post here first.

records.title: So pleased with my ordo brush and my…
records.text: So pleased with my ordo brush and my dentist could see great results in tartar buildup too. It gives a great clean with the different settings. I would've given a 5 star if it wasn't for the severe rise in replacement head costs lately as they have risen from £10 to £20 for a pack of four, though saying that they do last 3 months so about £20 a year is worth it for a brush that really does clean.

records.title: A good buy
records.text: When looking to replace my electric tooth brush recently, came across Ordo and was drawn by the design,colours and price. It feels nice to handle, has some good features e.g 2 modes for different kinds of brushing and a reminder to change position of the brush. However, I'm still in the process of getting used to the sonic vibration, but overall very pleased with the purchase.

records.title: Amazing toothbrush
records.text: The toothbrush is very effective, looks good and is easy and light to hold. Battery life seems much better than a well-known brand that I previously used! Only reason I didn’t give 5* is nothing to do with the excellent product-it arrived not that well packaged and outer box was badly damaged but luckily contents were ok 👍🏻

records.title: Good product but not quite Phillips
records.text: Good product but not quite Phillips! Given the price though,very good value compared to Philips. Think the brush is a little on the soft side. Service is very quick but did not get tooth paste with my first order but did get one with second order. Packaging is very nice and love the ability to charge brush in the case and view when finish charging.all in all 4 out of 5.

records.title: Had an issue with a sonic toothbrush.
records.text: Had an issue with a sonic toothbrush not lasting more than four days. Contacted the company, posted mine back and replacement sent, no argument. My only criticism would be the timescale for their response to my emails.

records.title: Delivery was very fast, product is great.
records.text: Delivery was very fast—especially considering it was an overseas delivery. I ordered it when I was traveling in England, and because I could t find an estimated delivery time, I had it sent home. My neighbors let me know when it had arrived, and if I’d known it was going to be that fast, I would have sent it to an address in England. But I love the water flosser and especially the travel case and the thoughtful design for traveling. I’ve used up two other flossers of another brand, and I hope—and it sounds as if—this one will work better. Thank you for choosing an usb cord for the charger. It also makes traveling easier.

records.title: Bought toothbrush
records.text: Bought toothbrush. Perfect for travel as it uses USB to charge. Sadly the model I bought doesn't fit the Ordo travelling case. The other downside is that whilst Ordo dispatched it quickly, the delivery company they use was inefficient.

records.title: I would never go back to an ordinary electric toothbrush.
records.text: Good toothbrush and a sore area in my gums have cleared up since I have used it.   Is it because I have slanted the toothbrush as pictured in the user leaflet?  The brush is looking a little used after one month.   I am happier with this sonic brush than the Phillips which I used for many years.   I would never go back to an ordinary electric toothbrush.

records.title: Should keep promises
records.text: Like the toothbrush. I ordered some replacement heads and was really pleased when Ordo said I would get some free toothpaste. However, there was no toothpaste sent with my order.

records.title: Great colour
records.text: I bought the toothbrush in May because it came in a colour that a certain someone preferred. The device is fine, the battery lasts for weeks. The brush head is not as good as the leading brand that begings with P. I find the bristles aren’t as aligned with Ordo. The brush cap is not really fit for purpose when traveling, because it squashes the bristles. I have ordered another set, but I would love to see more caps to be made available. Also, the now offered children’s brushes have no details about whether they fit the adult (normal size) base. It was easy to place an order and the delivery came quickly, in a paper box, where every packaging is truly recyclable. I like that and I hope Ordo is going to be around for a long time!

records.title: Ordo Water Flosser
records.text: The Ordo water flosser does a great job at cleaning between my teeth and is easy to use.  I ordered white and it came with a lilac tank, but the company sent out a replacement straight away after I brought it to their attention.

records.title: I ordered over £100 worth of items…
records.text: *update*Ordo have sent a goodwill gesture and have resent the items I ordered. I ordered over £100 worth of items which were sent via evri but never arrived. I can’t escalate with evri as I’m not the seller and Ordo haven’t responded to my messages. There’s no way to telephone anyone to speak to them.

records.title: Having ordered a set of brush heads in…
records.text: Having ordered a set of brush heads in the Black Friday offer, they didn’t turn up when expected. Tracking showed a problem, so I emailed Ordo. It took slightly longer than the estimated time for a reply, so I contacted them via dm on Instagram. Shortly afterwards I received the response telling me that the items were lost, and I was offered a refund or asked to wait until they were back in stock. Not being confident that the transaction would go smoothly, I took the refund, but I will have to pay full price when I try and re-order. All in all, a bit of a wasted time.

records.title: Toothbrush needed replacing
records.text: Only 3 stars because I needed to return my toothbrush for a replacement. This process was done very quickly although I did have to pay the postage to send back the broken one.

records.title: My son loves the toothbrush
records.text: My son loves the toothbrush, but He didn't receive the free toothbrush heads for some reasons.

records.title: Bit of a saga but ends well.
records.text: Flosser failed after a monthReturned at my own expense for replacement which never arrived!After lots of emails back and forth I asked for a refunded. The refund was made and a complimentary replacement sent. Offered a refund of the cost of postage but I declined to complimentary Flosser. This arrived safely.Three weeks and it still works and is extremely effective, blasting debris from between my teeth.

records.title: More marketing!!!!
records.text: Toothbrush works well but when I went online to fill out the additional 1 year warranty I had to agree to accept marketing!WHY?Who wants more marketing? Such a cheat!So, no additional warranty for me. May even send the brush back now.

records.title: Coating has come off after a few weeks.
records.text: I really like the toothbrush and find it great to travel with however in only a few weeks the coating has come off and has left a sticky residue which I cannot get off. I contacted support and they offered to send me a new one if I send back the original one but I would have to cover the cost of this. Having only had the toothbrush for a few weeks I am not too happy to be out of pocket for a product which didn't last that long. Update: customer services did send out a replacement brush without me having to pay to send the faulty on back.

records.title: I received the bottle but no…
records.text: I received the bottle but no concentrate s was which then took another few days to arrive so a bit frustrating. The mouthwash is very very blue, not keen on that and it tastes like it has artificial sweeteners in it. Love the concept but not the actual product!

records.title: Long bad experience! Which is got  better!!
records.text: Flosser failed after three weeks. Finally well after the promised 24 hours and 4 emails from me someone  emailed saying they are sending a replacement. I had to pay the proof of purchase £8 to send the faulty Flosser back. The replacement Flosser never arrived and although I was promised someone would look into its non arrival and get back to me I have heard nothing! Most upsetting, disappointing, annoying and a thoroughly unpleasant experience. Encouraging update: ORDO have told me they will refund me and offered to pay my proof of posting. They require my bank details which I am reluctant to give out over the internet. The best news is that they are sending a replacement flosser as well! That’s a vast improvement on my initial experience. Now let’s see if the refund lands in my bank and a working flosser actually arrives!!Final update. After lots and lots of emails a very helpful man, Elliot, refunded me and recently a replacement FoC flosser arrived. I believe he was let down badly by ERVi who still have the original replacement being processed!🤞that’s the end of the saga

records.title: Works well, delivery time could be better
records.text: Update September '24.After my review I received two toothbrushes by mistake. If you're from Holland; you have to pay customs fee. I did twice. I've received a lot of compliments and people ask if I used teeth whitening. Very happy with my toothbrush. Feedback: my old electric toothbrush paused too after 30 seconds, but when the 2 minutes passed the toothbrush kept on. I prefer that, 'cause sometimes you want to deep clean. Ordered the Purple Violet electric toothbrush on February 18th. Asked them in March how come I didn't receive anything yet. There were some troubles with delivery. I'm still waiting, it's April now. They don't give you update proactively, you have to ask. No refund, no discount, and no updates...

records.title: The toothbrush is great
records.text: The toothbrush is great. Easy to use, multi functional, nice colour, stays charged for months.I thought it was quite expensive but I haven't regretted buying the brush itself. The introductory package was not cheap to get and I would have liked to have more options for the care packages. I cannot use the toothpaste but have to buy that as well as the replacement brush heads.

records.title: I ordered a toothbrush and case on the…
records.text: I ordered a toothbrush and case. Took a while to arrive customer service just kept repeating it was out of stock. About a month after purchase they evenyually came back with a 20% refund and sent the item. Otherwise, i am pleased with the toothbrush.

records.title: Love these Ordo tooth brushes
records.text: Love these Ordo tooth brushes , the only downside is the durability of the toothbrush heads which barely last 2 weeks in my experience they really should last longer than this !!

records.title: I bought on a whim from my dentist
records.text: I bought on a whim from my dentist as I'd been using a similar  toothbrush for a few years. It stays in the cupboard as I've got used to a smaller toothbrush head  which Ordo don't offer

records.title: Great shopping experience (packaging
records.text: Great shopping experience (packaging, etc..) but not that sure about the end product, ie the toothbrush itself. I think it may be a bit too soft and too gentle? I don't have this feeling of my teeth being cleaned. The head of the toothbrush is quite small for a long toothbrush as a whole. I will persist but I am not 100% convinced I must admit.

records.title: Good, not great
records.text: The toothbrush is average to good – nothing special. The brush heads are extremely expensive though and no better than a Philips so I think I will be switching back.

records.title: After  one month I’m not sure this is for me...
records.text: After  one month I’m not sure this is for me . The dental flossing brushes are flimsy and bend too easily. The mouthwash & toothpaste seem ok... but I think I prefer my usual.  I love the actual toothbrush itself , just not sure about the rest of it!

records.title: Excitement turned frustration
records.text: Not sure if it's Lockdown syndrome but I was really excited about my new toothbrush. I'm also all for an easy life, so new heads, mouth wash and toothpaste being delivered regularly was a great sell for me.Sadly following my order being placed on the 27th November. I received nothing and heard nothing. Up until a few days ago when I made contact via Twitter (no real contact details on the website). Of which I was informed they were waiting on mouthwash, but how they didn't want me to wait any longer, so they could send it out separately. I replied unhappy but accepting. Why couldn't they have told me this originally!!Then nothing....Until today I emailed them, and guess what....the exact same response....simple copy and paste. No checks on correspondence, no mention of previous correspondence.Ive asked for a delivery time, within 48 hours or a refund....I won't hold my breath for either to be honest in the timescale.Ordo your lack of transparency, and lack of communication does not complement your product. Should anyone be willing to wait, and have no idea when or if you will receive your product, by all means order. However if you like to know if your order is eventually going to turn up....I'd go somewhere else!Update***19th DecemberIt seems that following this review Customer Services decided to pull out all the stops and had the tooth brush delivery sorted the same day. It arrived a few days later.The product is exceptional, and it even came with the Mouthwash, of which wasn't available! Nevertheless the product has delivered and I'm very happy with it.Overall 3 out of 5. Customer contact and delivery delay lets the whole approach down, but the end result is what's important I suppose.

records.title: Great customer service but they never…
records.text: Great customer service but they never have anything in stock which delays your order

records.title: Ordered 2 weeks Ago, still not arrived.
records.text: Ordered the starter kit around 2 weeks ago now and was told on the email delivery is around 2-3 days. Granted I ordered on a Bank Holiday weekend so I wasn't expecting it to dispatch for a couple of days. I decided to chase it up a few days after the bank holiday, I work within a manufacturing company so I understand how busy it can be so was respectful of this. I was told there was stock availability issues... First of all, upon initially ordering this starter kit I was not informed of any stock issues. If you have no stock you should be informing people immediately that there will be a delay in dispatch. I should not have to chase this and then be told. Secondly I find it crazy how you can take someones money and not inform of them of the above point. I emailed again towards the end of this week and was told my order had dispatched. Although I found that response very odd because still I have not received a dispatch confirmation email. I decided to check my account on their website to find that my order is still classed as "Unfulfilled". This is a huge disappointment. Now they are either having really bad stock issues and still struggling with back ordered stock, or their stock issues are fixed but they are having system issues? In all fairness I wont blame the customer service member who I have been emailing. He responds quickly and is extremely apologetic. So thank you to Elliot on this matter. Reading other reviews I can see my points being a major issue. I'll be leaving it a few more days and if I don't receive any dispatch confirmation I will be requesting a refund and cancelling my order and going with an alternative company.Edited with one more star due to receiving a dispatch confirmation today. But won’t be receiving any more stars from me.

records.title: Good product but buy from Amazon
records.text: A genuinely brilliant toothbrush but do not order from the official website, order from Amazon. Ordered nearly a month ago, just replacement heads and head covers. They sent me an empty box, told me they’d resend and then no contact OR replies from customer service just to be given a refund for something that was clearly out of stock from the very beginning and they went the most backwards about it.

records.title: I ordered some water flosser heads…
records.text: I ordered some water flosser heads including a periodontal head.  The periodontal head had a split in it and cannot be used.  I have emailed them with photos asking them to resolve the issue however I am still awaiting a response

records.title: Toothbrush's are amazing but not the costumer service
records.text: Toothbrush's are amazing, but unfortunately my order came incomplete and no one replies to help solve the problem.This was a child's Christmas Present that hasn't arrived.

records.title: Not at all impressed with this thing.
records.text: I’m fed up with ‘disruptors’ who enter an established marketplace with a newly thought through product and manage to make it worse. Ordo is, IMHO, one such. The toothbrush I purchased has a number of fairly serious faults. Firstly, the brush head (and the so-called travel protector cap has the same problem) doesn’t stay on the body of the brush. You have to sort of jam it on and hope that a squishy bit of plastic will compress enough to provide tension that holds the two parts together. It doesn’t. So the brush head keeps coming off in my mouth while brushing. Secondly, and TBF you get what you pay for but this thing does not clean my teeth as well as a Sonicare. Thirdly, there is no case and not travel lock so the thing has already managed to go off in my hand baggage and with a lithium ion battery, imagine what’s going to happen if it switches itself on in some hold baggage.Multiple fail, regret the purchase. Move on.

records.title: Well emailed you about a certain…
records.text: Well emailed you about a certain product which was responded by Elliot where he  was good as he offered the product at the original price because it was out of stock when I ordered the mega bundle & didn’t want to pay P&P & it had gone up by the time it came back in.He said I could have it at the same price it was £14.99 but when coming to pay the  invoice it wouldn’t let me as said it couldn’t be shipped to my address & wouldn’t take the payment,so emailed a couple times again but still no luck.So had to order it through your website as I wanted it for a Christmas present & had no issue then with the shipping address & had to pay full price.😡

records.title: Ordered 4 toothbrushes which weren’t…
records.text: Ordered 4 toothbrushes which weren’t cheap - dispatched fine and then lost by Evri. Customer service is slow to get back to you, no number to phone. Don’t hold out much hope if they need any sort of warranty issue raised. Seems it’s not the first problem with Evri and this company - they’re more than likely being stolen. Why not use a different courier and it would prevent the inconvenience for people. Also not impressed that the day after I asked if there was any discount codes and being told no… they put out a Halloween code 🤷🏼‍♀️

records.title: Poor refund experience
records.text: Returned toothbrushes under their 60 day guarantee.  Initially good service but now trying to get my money back is a joke.  Gave them bank details and had email to say being processed, nothing so chased and again told being done, nothing.   Chased again and now saying there is a query and can I reconfirm bank details.  Let’s see how long it takes now.

records.title: Ordo experience unsatisfactory
records.text: I bought water flosser & toothbrush on 11 October 2024 from a large department store in Sydney.  Yesterday I unpacked the toothbrush (it was really a flosser I needed) and no "travel case" in the pack.  Not that the travel case for the flosser is in any way protective and the pick is very hard to remove.  And there is only one toothbrush head supplied.  There's no contact telephone number that I can find.  I'm likely to go back to Phillips products.

records.title: Still waiting for my parcel to be…
records.text: Still waiting for my parcel to be delivered.  This is down to poor service from Evri.

records.title: Style over substance.
records.text: 3rd flosser I have had, find they all last a year. So far, I'm not overly impressed with Ordo. Main reason is small water reservoir, who want to fill it twice, especially if you use it in the shower? 2nd significant reason is water reservoir can't be easily detached after each use to thoroughly let it dry out. My last one could and I much prefer that. Leaving reservoir with small amount of water in which doesn't pour out makes them go mouldy and then you need to deep clean and steep in sterilising fluid. Serious design faults.

records.title: Responses are quick and consultations…

description:
For people living with a stoma, bowel or bladder needs, our home delivery service is the reliable, convenient, and tailored service that ensures nothing stops you living your life, your way.
SecuriCare is the family owned, UK based provider of specialist care and products for ostomy and continence care. For over 30 years thousands of people across the UK experience our independent home delivery service every day.
Backed by one of the largest specialist nursing teams alongside dedicated customer support, we’re committed to making sure our customers continue to live their lives as fully as they want.
 Join SecuriCare

records.title: Securicare is second to none

records.title: The staff are great 😊

records.title: Always pleasant  & helpful when phoning…

records.title: Goods delivered on time

records.title: I have had my stona goods from…

records.title: Reliable service from Securicare and the team

records.title: Delivery hiccough
records.text: I always found securicor staff friendly and helpful. My only concerns were on two occasions when I had requested my normal supply of stomach pouches and only got sent one by mistake.   The only other time was this last Friday when I had stayed in and I found a note through the door saying they were unable to deliver. I had been in the lounge the whole time and have quite a loud doorbell but the TV was on. They can’t have tried very hard.   Thank you. I AM grateful for Securicor supplies.

records.title: Stoma bags…
records.text: Quickly arranged delivery of stoma bags when prescription was held up at GP surgery.

records.title: The service is really good
records.text: The service is really good, I phone in and list my requirements and then wait for delivery. However we used to receive a text message telling us when we can expect the delivery but over recent months that has stopped. If we were told when to expect delivery I’d have given 5 stars

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: Always a delight to communicate with the excellent staff. I am contacted on a monthly basis so that I can order my urostomy supplies, and they arrive promptly.The only downside is that they have discontinued the pharmacy and I do not feel that the replacement pharmacy is as good, or has the same personal touch.

records.title: The people i speak to are usually…
records.text: The people i speak to are usually helpful and polite. I like the courtesy call before delivery as i like to be here for delivery. I can choose complimentary items then too rather than items not required being added.

records.title: Tried and tested
records.text: Really good service, Securicare get the prescription you need after ordering it from the account you make with them. It's very simple to do and once you are set up you can easily reorder whenever you need to. My only gripe is that when you have ordered something unlike others they don't let you know if they have received the prescription from your doctor, it just arrives. I have never had a problem with them so would highly recommend, four star rating 5 star service.

records.title: Found it useful
records.text: Found it useful to begin with, but they asked the same questions every day.

records.title: Not useful website, but great customer service!
records.text: The website isn't operating fully. If I type specific products, or their reference code,  sometimes there are no results. It means I then have to email the customer service team, and query things with them, even discovering products that otherwise I wouldn't have found out, if placing my order online. Luckily, with SecuriCare,  the staff are polite and helpful. I've experienced other suppliers who don't want to deal with me, only going through a community stoma nurse, even though I'm the user and don't speak with stoma nurses, so they don't k ow what is best for me. Thank you, and please emphasise that the patient is the one going through this, so ensure to listen and approach people with friendliness,  kindness and support - which is what you're doing, so please keep it up! 💜💫

records.title: The people that raise our orders for…
records.text: The people that raise our orders for delivery are really helpful generally and very understanding. The only not so good experience I’ve had recently is after chasing an order and finding out that only one box of pouches had been signed off, the person on my call suggested that Doctor’s seem to think that wearing a pouch for two to three days is what is expected. I’m afraid, like having a shower every day and changing my underwear I also change my pouch, this will never not be the case. I also on occasion have to change my pouch twice as it sometimes leaks or the skin around the stoma becomes sore.  I am just getting used to these life changing ways and have to figure out what works best for me as everyone is different, I went to Choc with a sore stomach in April and came out of hospital ten days later after life saving surgery. All anyone needs is a bit of encouragement, unless you have a stoma you can’t know how that person is feeling in themselves. . .

records.title: Thank you for my recent order
records.text: Thank you for my recent order. I assume the use of a plastic bag for delivery is cheaper than a more protective cardboard box, which often leads to the contents being damaged. The staff on the phone are always very polite and helpful, thank you all. From a very grateful customer, ROGER SCOTT.

records.title: SeririCare Sevice.
records.text: I have found SecuriCare to be efficient and helpful.  Even to the point of phoning to remind me that I may need to place an order.  However, If I need anything out of time, or need to top-load in consideration of Christmas, then there are invariably delays and uncertainty.

records.title: Because of an issue with a repeat…
records.text: Because of an issue with a repeat prescription I got mini flange extenders instead of the bigger ones which I prefer when I go on holiday as I explained at the time. I went on holiday on Wednesday November 6 in the morning. The extenders I wanted were delivered later that day by day and( left in a safe place) when I go away I switch off my phone until I return (yesterday 20th) I had not looked at my phone but when I did saw that dpd had sent a message ent pic. The package was left in my paper bin. When I go away my neighbour puts out appropriate bin and unfortunately the bin with package was put out and emptied while I was away so i didn’t get the extenders. I had discussed the timeline with you at the time but I suppose these things happen

records.title: Supportive of new stoma user
records.text: Good availability of times to place orders and staff are always friendly. They are happy to answer queries about products or getting a RADAR key for example. Supplies are sent as quickly as prescription requirements allow and are packaged well. The stoma nurses are exceptionally supportive, and go the extra mile to support even arranging meet ups to match my work schedule. The online resources are really good and informative - it is a strange and often frightening experience particularly if like me was an emergency job and I have found it so much easier due to securicare's support.

records.title: Good Service
records.text: Very easy to order my stoma supplies each month. If I have any queries an e mail is responded to quickly and if I need to call I’m treated with respect and helpfulness.

records.title: You CAN speak to a human contact!
records.text: I always prefer to telephone my order and very often I receive a call in anticipation of my own contact. I can ask any questions at that point. However, I know contact can be made in other ways, eg email.

records.title: Package arrived on time
records.text: Package arrived on time. Always get word when package is coming so can make arrangements for delivery. When I have phoned securicare . Staff were very helpful and informative.

records.title: Most of the time I get an excellent…
records.text: Most of the time I get an excellent service , before time and with great customer service.Occasionally my order is wrong which means I have to constantly check what I receive vs what I ordered and make amendments next time

records.title: Greatful
records.text: My husband and I have used SecuriCare for 15 years and 13 years respectively.  We have found them to be very efficient, helpful and a person to talk to at the other end of the line. The service is very good and if you have a problem someone is always there to chat too.  Keep the good work up.

records.title: Helpful and courteous
records.text: Whoever I contact is helpful and courteous.  If any problems occur, they are always sorted.  I have been with Securicare for a long time and don't intend to change supplier any time soon.

records.title: The Staff at the other end of the phone…
records.text: The Staff at the other end of the phone are always extremely polite and friendly and helpful.

records.title: Slipping halo
records.text: There was some sort of mix up with my last order with only 10% being initially delivered  Happily I contacted Giles who was first class in sorting it out. I have to say,  however, that over the past few months I have detected a decline in the excellent service I have had from Securicare during 40 years. I adjusted to it but perhaps you should look to your laurels.

records.title: Service was prompt and delivery quick
records.text: Service was prompt and delivery quick. However, your delivery service DPD! We receicrd ETA message. NOONE knocked and package just left by bins! Found later that day. NOT adequate especially if disabled/mobility problems (I wouldn't have been able to get the parcel myself and lucky someone else was unusually home)

records.title: Supplies
records.text: Spoke to a lady earlier this week and tried to place an order so was unsure about my requests, eventually I thought I had ordered  my supplies to be rang by another employee to confirm what was being sent only to find the first had requested items I did not need and left items off that I had asked for. Thank goodness for the second call other wise I would have been without supplies over the festive holidays

records.title: Not quite perfect
records.text: I like the fact that I can order by email, but the holes which are cut for me in my product are inconsistently sized, and I never know when my order will arrive.

records.title: didnt call back
records.text: I phoned and ordered products and it was great the a couple of hours later phoned and wanted to add an item lady didn't know about product and said she would get someone to call me bacck no call came.  I call and the lady new straight away and added to the order

records.title: Yoo sent me the wrong colour and wrong…
records.text: Yoo sent me the wrong colour and wrong size again im having to empty my stomo bag two times through the nighr i need to sleep for work i need a large not a small last moñth i was sent bags for wee   .

records.title: No problem with Securicare although…
records.text: No problem with Securicare although order took nearly 2 weeks to arrive. My issue is with the delivery company you use which ignores delivery instructions. Twice my order has been left on doorstep, not in shed as requested.

records.title: This is because of the way the bags…
records.text: This is because of the way the bags were cut jaggedly and not tidy, so whoever cut them may have the same issues as my a essential tremor in their prominent hand.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Mostly I have had good service from Securicare, but recently there have been a couple of hiccups. 2 months ago I was very late receiving my order, due to a computer problem.  This happens,  but some communication would have been nice. I had to chase it up. And the first person I spoke to didn't explain the problem,  but made out it was the surgery's fault, which it wasn't. 2 wks ago, samples were asked for as having bag problems.  They never arrived.  Again I resolved this but had to go elsewhere and do it myself. My surgery made an error of sending one of my medications to securicare instead of the pharmacy.  Instead of contacting me or the surgery, they just put the item on the NHS spine. When I realised it was missing from my pack of medications,  once again I had to follow this up and sort it out.I am perfectly capable of sorting out problems,  but not everyone is able. Communication is key and needs to improve.

records.title: You seem to have problems getting a…
records.text: You seem to have problems getting a persons order correct,this has been happening a lot recently,my last 3orders have had the wrong stuff in and stuff missing

records.title: Order came on time
records.text: Order came on time, only problem being they sent the big extensions and not the mini which I requested, will now have to cut them into smaller ones.

records.title: Not kept informed of problems with bag production
records.text: I wasn’t informed that you had trouble with production of the Welland bags until I chased my order, and wasn’t offered an alternative product. An email just to explain the problem would have been good so I could have made other plans. To place an order start of May and have to wait until a week into June for the order of essential items we can’t do without I personally found unacceptable, there wasn’t even an apology about delay until I had emailed twice asking where my order was. I have now switched to Coloplast Charter who at least keep me informed if there is a problem. Disappointed.

records.title: Delivery  service is great on time and…
records.text: Delivery  service is great on time and very politeTo many emails and queries  if I have a change or a problem I will let you know

records.title: Night drainage bagd
records.text: I have been waiting for overnight drainage bags since the beginning of April as they are in short supply. I keep being promised a date when they are available but now nearly 2 montjs down the line still havent recieved them.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: I was waiting for my delivery of stoma bags and I rang to chase and was told they were out of stock. This is an essential medical appliance so I should have been informed before now and offered a suitable replacement . I have had to accept  different model for now and waiting for that to be delivered urgently and only now have one bag left and I’m panicking that they won’t get here in time.

records.title: Could do better!
records.text: You did not have all my items in but sent others to try. This time all went ok though still waiting for my parcel.But in the past it has taken longer than it should to receive items, and dry wipes have been forgotten.Sometimes good service but sometimes not.

records.title: Cos here's constants mistakes
records.text: Cos there's constants mistakes.  Causing delays or without dry wipes this month ect

records.title: My order was not complete
records.text: My order was not complete Out of stock I only found out after I chased  my order by telephoneThey should of notified me If I hadn’t decided to check why I had not received my goods I would still be waiting They did send me part of the order that was in stock after my telephone conversationStill waiting for the pouches which was out of stockThis really is to long to wait for the goods

records.title: My order for stoma products seem to be…
records.text: My order for stoma products seem to be taking a long time to come through (just lately)

records.title: Lack of phone calls from company
records.text: Lack of phone calls from company, gave to phone in to place order

records.title: Sweet staff, lousy system
records.text: Keep having to wait for products that are out of stock. Got a huge amount of products backed up because you can only order what you need when you order something else which doesn’t make sense when they use up at different stores times. The staff are always friendly and sweet but there’s nothing they can do to help and have little understanding of the trauma of not having the correct kit when living with a stoma, and you need to chase up products that were out of stock from the last order. The delivery times are quickish and flexible and they will leave in your safe place which is helpful.

records.title: Lack of complimentary products
records.text: Unfortunately I have not received any complimentary items this time and only 2 packs of dry wipes wet wipes and bags on previous orders. I have bought nappy sacks and baby wipes now myself however with a high output stoma 2 packs of dry wipes are nowhere near enough. I did speak to someone a while ago about the limit and was told that it had been determined that only 2 wipes per bag change were needed. This decision has obviously been made by someone who does not have a stoma let alone a high output one! It is impossible to use cotton wool pads because it leaves fluff everywhere and bags do not stick as well.Something needs to change and the rules surrounding the amount’s urgency reviewed.

records.title: I have had considerable problems during…
records.text: I have had considerable problems during the last few months in obtaining my stoma pouch supplies . Since  they are always out of stock, I am constantly on the phone to them !!

records.title: Ask to change my delivery address…
records.text: Ask to change my delivery address 3months ago still send parcel to wrong address and the people who live there are not very nice

records.title: Long wait for accessories
records.text: I have been waiting for a water bag for about 2 weeks now when I ordered one urgently after my old one broke. The wrong thing was delivered and will be collected. I have had a large amount of water on the floor every day

records.title: was not informed that my pouches was…
records.text: was not informed that my pouches was being discontinued that I used for 20+ years until one month before and was only told such because I had to make an order otherwise I would of not known

records.title: Let me down
records.text: Didn't deliver as promised and no notification to say on back order.

records.title: Stopped using certain products we use…
records.text: Stopped using certain products we use between them and doctors taking to long to send supplies no longer send complimentary products maybe need to find a new supplier

records.title: Constantly getting order wrong
records.text: Constantly getting order wrong. Have had notes put on the account but has made No difference

records.title: Not what I expected as new Stoma Patient
records.text: Held onto an order for weeks in spite of knowing I had no supplies. Zero customer service and would avoid entirely.

description:
View Our Scooters




View Our Chairs




ProFold SuperLite




Cotswold Recliner



    Forget everything you know about "mobility"


    Here at Muick Sandy, we believe in
    the power of creating
    a world with fewer obstacles and limits, where people have the freedom to build a better life and
    pursue their dreams.


    Forward Thinking


    We are a mobility specialist on a mission to bring the best user experience to
    our customers through our innovation, service and technology. Our customers
    are at the heart of everything we do and we don't settle for anything less
    than excellence.


    At the heart of our operation lies a deep understanding of the crucial role
    that personal comfort plays in maintaining an independent and fulfilling
    lifestyle. And over the years, we’ve dedicated ourselves to finding
    solutions that significantly elevate your quality of life.


    Market-Leading Innovation


    We're leading the way in the mobility industry by continuously offering
    fresh and innovative solutions. Our product range, featuring the
    ProFold SuperLite™
    - the UK's lightest folding mobility scooter - is just the beginning. We
    also boast a luxurious
    range of luxurious rise and recline chairs, each designed with the utmost comfort and style in mind.


    Our commitment to innovation doesn't stop there; we're constantly exploring
    new ideas and technologies to enhance mobility and comfort for our
    customers. We take enormous pride in our ability to blend cutting-edge
    technology with practical, user-friendly designs, ensuring that each product
    we offer is not just a tool, but a life-enhancing solution. This dedication
    to excellence and innovation is what sets our product range apart, and why
    we're immensely proud of the impact our products have on the daily lives of
    our customers.


    Delivery and Installation Included


    Every Muick Sandy purchase includes a free white-glove delivery from our
    installation experts. They’ll ensure your products are fully set up in your
    home and only leave when you’re completely happy.


    Our dedication to handling everything in-house sets us apart. Unlike our
    competitors, we do not rely on third parties, ensuring that the people who
    deliver and set up your furniture are as invested in its quality and your
    comfort as we are. This approach allows us to maintain the highest standards
    of care and attention to detail, providing you with a seamless, worry-free
    experience from our door to yours.

records.title: Muick Sandy
records.text: All contacts of Muick Sandy were very professional, helpful and courteous. They kept us informed of the progress of our order. They took time to explain things if it was difficult to understand. The delivery drivers were polite and friendly, offering any help required. It was a pleasure to deal with Muick Sandy and we would not hesitate to recommend them.

records.title: 10/10 My experience with MuickSandy was…
records.text: My experience with MuickSandy was brilliant the first gentleman came and explained how every worked even made sure it was able to fit in the back of my car successfully.And on the delivery day the two gentlemen again went through all the things to have a successful time with my new scooter.And they even took away my old scooter which was brilliant.Thanks very much MuickSandy.

records.title: Company was very helpful
records.text: Company was very helpful . Was delighted with the service . Couldn’t fault them . Scooter was delivered when they said it would be . Unfortunately couldn’t fit in boot of car . That’s the only downside .

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Extremely helpful and demonstration easy to understand . Kept us informed of their arrival time . Excellent ,friendly service .

records.title: Best in Service
records.text: It was so professional. He carried on the chair in sections , put it together and I was able to try it out. I placed an order and asked if I could have a loaner chair while I waited 6 weeks for mine and they said yes and delivered the temporary recliner and set it up

records.title: decided to purchase my F2 scooter with…
records.text: decided to purchase my F2 scooter with Muick Sandy following a demonstration from their salesman even though they were based in summer set they had a sales office in Wimbledon which covered London. The sales team I spoke to were nice and accommodating, they delivered it before Christmas i. less than the agree 3 weeks delivery. The delivery driver was friendly and showed me how to use everything again. very happy.

records.title: The perfect scooter!
records.text: I was interested to hear all about Muick Sandy and the two gentlemen who called explained in some detail about the scooter.  It seemed to me that this scooter was exactly what I needed.  It was light enough for me to lift into the car and out again on my own.  This was the most important thing for me.

records.title: Good old fashioned service.
records.text: From start to finish it has been a pleasure dealing with this company. A very pleasant lady on the telephone told us that a representative (Simon) would come to demonstrate the scooter on the following Monday. There was no pressure to buy, but nevertheless we decided there and then to purchase. The scooter arrived far quicker than anticipated and was just as promised. We were given a further demonstration of the scooter by (Bruce) and all the paperwork that goes with it.

records.title: Clear and concise description and…
records.text: Clear and concise description and explanation of the product. Useful demonstration and opportunity to test the product.

records.title: I would definitely recommend this riser recliner
records.text: I would definitely recommend this company. The service is excellent and the product is amazing. Just what I needed. From start to finish, all the staff were polite, helpful and professional. Thank you

records.title: Give me time
records.text: The sales person was excellent and the chair is made well, sturdy and looks good.  It just amazes me that I’m asked for a review the day after taking delivery😮 how can I form a honest review the next day, simple answer I cannot.  Ask me in a month’s time and I will have a reliable answer.

records.title: All's well that ends well.
records.text: I came upon Muick Sandy by chance, browsing the internet and phoned up and a very friendly, chatty lady answered my questions and made an appointment for Nick to come and show off a chair to me.  Everything went so smoothly.  Nick seemed to have all the time to talk, answered all my questions and spoke with enthusiasm about the whole history of the company.  I was impressed and ordered a chair, complete with heat and massage, that had to be specially made to my own measurements.Unfortunately, there was a mistake and having waited several weeks a very different basic chair was delivered without the heat and massage and arm protectors.  The office were full of apologies and promised they would fast-track another before Christmas, which they did and I am now very happy with the quality and ease of operation of my new recliner, complete with heat and massage. So all's well that ends well.

records.title: Good Service
records.text: The man who brought and put the chair together was polite and very helpful. He took our old chair away even though he had not been told that was part of the agreement. He explained clearly how the chair worked. We were impressed by him. I do not find the chair very comfortable but may do as I get used to it. The service from Munich Sandy has been excellent throughout since we decided to purchase the chair. I found the sales pitch rather intense.

records.title: Pretty good experience buying my first…
records.text: Pretty good experience buying my first scooter. The rep was friendly but just ever so slightly pushy. Tried to secure sale too soon, before I had chance to talk it over with my husband. Then office rang to check everything was correct but with no delivery date saying two to three weeks when rep had led us to believe it would be within days. My advice is office rings only when it has delivery date. Delivery crew were excellent.

records.title: Very helpful just a small problem was…
records.text: Very helpful just a small problem was quickly rectifieda great experience

records.title: Delivering a mobility scooter to a…
records.text: Delivering a mobility scooter to a disabled person at 8am is not on as takes me ages to get out of bed but apart from that everything ok

records.title: understanding people
records.text: had a few problems with the person who put the scooter together . i have a hearing problem .. and he spoke to me with his head down not looking at me ,,, at a very fast diction , i had to stop him  to request  repeatedly not to do this ....i have to lip read ..and talking at  a rapid speed makes understanding too much .....he did slow down in the end , Simon  is coming next week to go over it all  very kindly  thank you ..

records.title: Rapid response to an enquiry
records.text: Rapid response to an enquiry; immediate help on the phone and the rep was available for a home visit the next day.

records.title: Mark was very patient and helpful but…
records.text: Mark was very patient and helpful but it did take longer than he said it should. He told us 4-6 weeks and it was 8. My mother was suffering from a fracture to a vertebra and this was what triggered our investigation into a chair and it so was quite urgent.

records.title: Excellent customer care
records.text: Lost a star because disappointed that it doesn’t fold flat with the additional empty seat bag in position, meaning it’s a lot of hassle having to put it on & off as required, I’ve therefore left it off. Also additional battery charger ordered & paid for wasn’t delivered with the scooter. However, excellent customer service when informed of the omission has immediately sent it. Also must say what excellent service I received from Muick Sandy, having my scooter delivered the day before my birthday, they also sent flowers!

records.title: Good service and efficient delivery
records.text: Kirsty the rep.  helpful and well informed. Delivery efficient and on time. Demonstrated well and different functions explained. Old chair collected as promised. Cushion feels a little firm but will probably relax when used a bit. On the whole very pleased with purchase and service

records.title: My heated recliner chair mpany for the…
records.text: I would recommend this company for the excellent customer service. Everyone i have spoken to have been warm and friendly, can't do enough for you. I am happy with my chair and would highly recommend this purchase.

records.title: Good delivery of chairs and information…
records.text: Good delivery of chairs and information on using electrics. Very disapointed at the two chairs not being the same height they don’t look right next to each other. We weren’t told this would happen by the sales person.  The small chair is a lot smaller on size and they cost the same !

records.title: prompt delivery
records.text: prompt delivery. 4 stars.    A star was deducted  for ignored email to customer services.  ultra light folding scooter purchased for low weight and eas of lifting into car boot.  needs large boot. Should be labelled semi folding, just seat and tiller fold down, still resulting if quite large assembly. Turning circle and range less than some.

records.title: Good delivery
records.text: Good delivery - though a bit late for a ‘morning’ delivery and the delivery man’s phone failed or could not get a signal. Good explanation and help with assembly, etc.

records.title: Recliner chairs
records.text: Pleasant delivery drivers. Efficient and organised. Recliner chairs assembled safely and with care. Controls demonstrated and explained patiently. No one pointed out that, according to the information booklet, the controls are not to be plugged into an extension lead! Yet both the initial sales rep and the delivery drivers knew our chairs would need an extension lead and plugged the controls into one!!This is not good enough and we are left very confused and concerned.

records.title: Delivery as expected no problems
records.text: Delivery as expected no problems. Mike the delivery man went over everything in a calm experienced manner he made sure we were happy with the new scooter.  He took the old scooter out of the boot of the car assembled it and then took it away. Only criticism the scooter was ordered with arms which will not be received for another 10 days which means we can not use the scooter without the arms and this is disappointing.

records.title: Great end to end service
records.text: The whole process was  pleasant from the salesman who first came to see me to the delivery guys who delivered my chair. A minor issue with the castors being damaged, but they will be replaced soon. The chair is well made so should last for years and will give me so much support when rising from sitting  position moving forward. Glad I chose this company.

records.title: With some hiccups, a good experience.
records.text: (This part submitted by Jenny who made contact on behalf of Dawn, a friend with MS)Within a couple of hours of an on-line request for a brochure MuickSandy rang me and we arranged an appointment. Efficient!I was with Dawn for the visit by Gavin. He was 2 hours late, but we had been forewarned of this by telephone because he had a puncture in his van  -  evidence of company care for potential clients.Gavin was patient, personable, knowledgeable and experienced. After 2 1/2 hours a deal was negotiated, and delivery time organised. All follow-up calls and emails were efficient and pleasant. (For this part of the process I would have given 5 stars, especially as the whole experience from initial request to delivery was just 11 days)I was not present at the 'white glove delivery' - Dawn asked me to write:-a) Josh was 1 hour lateb) Brought wrong colour machine with missing back cushionc) Found the right colour in his vand) Can tell he is in a rush to goe) cover demonstrated by Gavin was padded, this one is thin plastic.f) My 1 month insurance says blue scooter - mine is red.

records.title: My new means of transport is great
records.text: My new means of transport is great, very comfortable and easy to drive with far more features than the old one I has. That in itself is a bit of a problem, the manual is not very easy to understand and when it was delivered I did not feel enough time was given to help me to understand everything. Scooter 5*, delivery 2*

records.title: We purchase an ex-display model
records.text: We purchase an ex-display model and was shown a photo of the scooter with a few scratches which we didn't mind but the one we have got today 2nd Jan 2025 had more scratches on the front than the one in the photo.

records.title: A bit of a let down
records.text: I specifically asked that depth be adjusted nso that my feet did not overhang. This request ignored " need to avoid any pressure on heels". I also requested an antimacassar.Missing on delivery. Delivery was requested for afternoon as wife out in the morning. So, delivery was just after 12 noon. My wife not pleased as carpet rucked up and hef foot support pouffe not put back.I emailed next day, no reply.The foot situation was relieved with a cushion and I have had to order an antimacassar from Amazon.The chair itself was fine. I estimated cost about half of what was charged.

records.title: Not happy with pricing
records.text: Very quick to respond to request for brochure and visit home with selection of scooters but was surprised at the prices. Was assured that the one I chose was far superior to the cheaper ones. Decided to purchase but had to wait over three weeks for delivery. Since I purchased, paying almost £2500 I have seen identical scooters for as little as £599 advertised by CareCo. Sorry, can’t give you more than 3 stars. I feel that compared with other companies, you are very expensive.

records.title: Taking time to adjust
records.text: It is taking me time to adjust to my lovely chair. When I first sat in my chair and put it in recline position, I was upset that it stopped at my ankles which I found very uncomfortable and made my feet feel cold.  When I rang to complain I was told very politely that it was supposed to be like that. I have found I can overcome the problem by putting a cushion under my ankles and a rug over my feet.  I wish I could remember if this was explained to me when I had the home demonstration .

records.title: 3 piece suite
records.text: My husband and I took delivery 2 days ago of 2 rise and recline chairs and matching sofa to replace an old 3 piece suite.  We never had the opportunity to actually see or try the chairs previously and simply chose from a catalogue with the help of one of your representatives.  The rise and recline chairs were measured for my husband who has arthritis and a replacement knee. I am of a similar height to him and I personally have found all the items  uncomfortable.  The sofa in particular has a high narrow seat.  My daughter, myself  and her friend cannot comfortably put our feet on the floor.  The seat is narrow and the back is high and straight leaving no room for comfort.   The chairs are similar but can at least be tilted to give some degree of comfort.  Whilst the chairs due their job for anyone with mobility problems I would not recommend a whole suite for a group of people of differing shapes or sizes and feel there should always be an opportunity to try before you buy!

records.title: Delivery problems
records.text: I was happy with the home demonstration and information about the scooter. However there was communication problems over the delivery. A message was left on my phone on Monday asking if the scooter could be delivered on the Wednesday. I rang back to say I would be out all that day. I was told someone would ring back with a new date. This did not happen. I did happen to be at home on the Wednesday lunch time ( one of my appointments had been cancelled)  As I was having lunch the scooter arrived, I had not been informed and it was not a convenient time. I felt rushed and was not prepared for asking questions. The gentleman who delivered the scooter told me they had been trying to contact me as he was in the area. I had not received any phone calls or messages from the company.

records.title: The man that deliverd the scooter gave…
records.text: The man that deliverd the scooter gave a full explanation of all the controls. Took his time to exp what each one did very good. The only thing missing is there is no manual. Why?. It would have been handy to ref what dose what as a reminder. That is why you have only 3 stars.

records.title: Better customer Services this time.

records.title: Made mistakes but are willing to improve
records.text: I phoned to request a brochure on 30th September and to be honest left the phone call quite annoyed.  During the call,  the lady was friendly but made comment about me sounding young to be asking for motability equipment. I was asked if the question had offended me. It had, but I wanted to move on from this. Sometimes people can be insensitive without malice and I acknowledge that she realised what she had said. I wanted some prices and was told this was only possible with someone to the house. At times the call felt very much like a sales call and I did get spoken over a times. I did address this with the lady on the phone and said I didn't appreciate being spoken over. The call did not end well and I did feel quite insulted and annoyed at the time, so I added a review. I genuinely did not want anyone else to experience this.Having become disabled only recently, it has been a difficult journey to navigate and I have seen at times how differently I am treated compared to before. Even by those who mean well.  I have since received 2 phone calls from the company. One the same day and one more recently. Both times I have received an apology and it gave an opportunity to pass on some valuable information in how to deal with/manage/support people who may be requiring the equipment that this company sells. I was asked to provide some feedback as the company wanted to know where they could improve. I don't feel led to remove this review as I truly believe a company with all 5* reviews is a highly suspicious one. I would like to say that I don't feel these 2 calls were all about getting me to remove this difficult review at all. The company seemed genuinely interested in my experience at having to navigate dealing with a disability especially an unexpected one at an unexpected age. I do believe this company have listened to my suggestion about providing empathy to those requiring their equipment. Choosing this sort of equipment is a personal one and for some a difficult thing to do.Consider this an honest review of a company who have made mistakes, but have taken time and effort to consider feedback and make changes, something they didn't need to do. After all I am one person amongst, I imagine, so many others. I can't comment on the equipment however, I believe the people who run this company do care. On the second call I mentioned a family member was seriously ill and I have since received a very kind apology and well wishes for my family member. Something they didn't need to do, which I appreciate. When I do resume my search for my equipment I will give this company another chance. If the offer of a fantastic deal in exchange for me becoming an advocate for a younger demographic and review of the equipment is still there, I may just do this. No one is perfect. This company isn't. However, I appreciate a company that is willing to learn from their mistakes and listen to their customer base, especially one in an arena of this very important and sensitive nature.

records.title: Poor customer service, damaged scooter
records.text: I am replying to MuickSand’s response. I have given an honest truthful review on my personal experience with this company. I did find the salesmen pleasant. The paperwork issues were really unacceptable, these were not changed from a previous customer, again took three attempts to do so and was corrected in the end. I was constantly chasing for the paperwork that we didn’t receive, and an approximate time for delivery, including terms and conditions which apparently state a collection fee. To waive a fee that I was not even aware of having not received the paperwork. I also didn’t receive a telephone call as told apart from to collect the damaged scooter. The scooter had two marks on, which I wouldn’t expect for a brand new scooter. Whilst I appreciate the apology and the phone call to ask if I would change my review etc. my intention is not to give a company a bad name, being a small business ourselves. I gave an honest review to my own experience and the service I received. Just to confirm I have purchased another scooter exactly the same and cheaper, not provided from MuickSandy. Unfortunately myself and some other reviewers also didn’t get the service this company normally provides. Firstly, they would not provide a scooter without a salesman visiting my home beforehand. Even though, I knew what I needed and the specifications. Pleasant salesmen. Unfortunately this was the only positive. The company got my address and mobile number wrong three times, even after emailing it and repeating over the telephone. Did not receive the paperwork we should have done. Apparently these were sent twice? Still not received anything. Response from customer service after full payment made was terrible. There were some issues to rectify as well as incorrect address. Only when I stated I would cancel my order, did I get a reply. The scooter arrived damaged which was the final straw. We then had to wait another week for it to be collected and they were going to charge £200 to collect their damaged scooter!  Though if we would have had a replacement then it could have been delivered the next day. Which we found rather strange. They were obviously not happy we cancelled their damaged scooter, with no paperwork and incorrect information. Waited three days for the refund. I would not recommend. The scooter is the same as a Pride scooter (the actual manufacturer) have now purchased at £500 cheaper

Essential Aids has been a UK top provider of disability aids, mobility aids and daily living aids since 2004.

records.title: They sent me a trolley that I couldn't…
records.text: They sent me a trolley that I couldn't put together by myself or with my friend. The plastic clips were too tight to be able to assemble. When I told the customer services that I couldn't assemble it, she said I should get a big, strong man to help me!. Wow! I couldn't believe how sexist this was in this day and age. Also, if you're sending out products that need a another person to help put together then this is completely wrong. I can't use my hands very well. The trolley should have been assembled in the box ready to use and not have very stiff parts that had to be taken apart first. I'm very disappointed with both the products and the service that I received on the phone. I truly believe that the woman on the phone needs some training in inclusivity and diversity.

records.title: The picture on your website shows the…
records.text: The picture on your website shows the time I bought with a stand.   I only realised after it arrived that this has to be purchased separately

records.title: There are no fixings for it and it’s…
records.text: There are no fixings for it and it’s also too big for our shoes cubicle.

records.title: We placed an order 11th of December
records.text: We placed an order 11th of December, called 17th on the day of our supposed building standards visit/final inspection. Apparently they will dispatch that day. Our business is in jeopardy because they don't despatch same day as promised on the website. Won't recommend anyone, bought the same from screwfix for next day collection.

records.title: Unserious people
records.text: I had a terrible experience with them, on the website it says 3-5 working days to be DELIVERED and today 19/12/2024 it’s exactly a week since I made I purchase and still nothing item. I ordered a crutch because I had an accident and I’ve been struggling a lot to walk. I called them three times and every time I got the item was still at the warehouse. Unserious people!
