description:
We want to ensure that your experience with CareCo is trouble free. 

However, if you do have an issue with a product, delivery or warranty, please contact our dedicated customer services team who are ready to help resolve your problems.

records.title: A company worth dealing with!
records.text: Firstly your facilities within Hilliers Garden Centre Eastbourne are quite amazing. It’s a large open space where, as customers, we can browse to our hearts content but it’s your staff that make the difference, they offer a splendid service by being attentive, pleasant and professional. I shall have no hesitation in recommending Eastbourne CareCo. Thank you

records.title: Customer service 😀
records.text: I had trouble trying to order on my pad, yesterday but gave up, this morning a very nice lady called Skye phoned me from care Co and sorted it out for me, order on the way now. Great customer service, many thanks xx

records.title: Very impressive customer service
records.text: I bought a power chair for my parents and opted for home assembly.  The service in the store and the product was excellent but the home assembly was not as advertised. Following a complaint to customer services and having left a three star review on here I was contacted by the owner on New Years Day. He addressed my main issue.This company is obviously very good but I was particularly impressed with how it is run from the very top. It is not everyday that you will deal with a company whose most senior staff are on the spot.

records.title: CARECO IS THE PLACE YO GO
records.text: We were greeted as soon as we arrived at the Warrington shop. The store was well lit and very clean. Sales member Natalie  Farrell was amazing, I explained what it was I required, she was very knowledgeable and gave me  advise on a couple of All Terrain wheelchairs which she encouraged me to try out. We were able to take our time no pressure or hard sell.Natalie was very patient and answered all our questions and concerns. I decided to make a purchase. I would highly recommend Careco Warrington for your disability products.

records.title: Follow the signs and you'll find it !
records.text: Luckily the showroom is well signposted being located a bit off the beaten track - but well worth finding ! A large selection of mobility scooters available all ready for a "test drive". Gary established my needs and scooters matching were identified - a really great choice and each one tested. Guided by this knowledgeable expert a suitable model was selected , public liability insurance arranged and the job done . Well done CareCo team , very satisfied customer.

records.title: Leicester CareCo - place to go
records.text: Leicester CareCoAble to try out the wheelchairs on the shortlist we had worked out. Store clean and well stocked with versions to try out. No hard sell, just practical advice and ended up buying a different model than the one we would have, if we had just bought on-line. Very happy with service. Unfortunately chosen one not in stock but 3-5 working day, free home delivery, so can’t complain about that.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: The lady that served me today was so polite, professional and helpful. I called this morning regarding a rollator and she was able to advise me on the product she even remembered the over the bed table I was asking about in the morning when I collected the rollator.

records.title: Very good experience
records.text: As soon as I walked into the showroom there was someone there to greet me and ask if I needed any help with anything I'm particular. They weren't pushy just friendly Once I'd told them I was looking for a scooter, they told me all about the range that was available and asked what I would be using it for. Chloe was very knowledgeable about the scooter. I had a go inside and outside the shop. I would definitely recommend the Sheffield showroom.Thank you Chloe

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: I spoke to Moses over the phone who was very helpful and gave me all the details needed about the chairs I was purchasing.  He was very efficient and I immediately received confirmation of my order by email.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Able to try many different products for size/ see them ‘in the flesh’ in store. Good advice in store, fair pricing, no hard sell and excellent delivery.

records.title: magnifying floor lamp…
records.text: I ordered a magnifying floor lamp which unfortunately was not suitable for my elderly mother as too high and didn’t really magnify. When I raised a complaint, Careco were very good in resolving the issue and offering me a full refund. Whilst the product wasn’t great, the service was excellent.

records.title: The store salesman  was extremely…
records.text: The store salesman  was extremely friendly and helpful. The large screen with the wb page was helpful in deciding on which product to purchase. Only downside was limited stock and the nearest chair to try out was over 200 miles away in Newcastle.

records.title: Looking for a riser recliner chair for…
records.text: Looking for a riser recliner chair for father, very helpful staff and pleased with the end choice. Point knocked off for money off voucher to be used on another purchase.

records.title: Reading lamp watch out for the returns policy!
records.text: I purchased a standing lamp for my mother for Christmas in November, as I was trying to spread the cost of Christmas. The lamp arrived in a small box, obviously in smaller pieces. On Christmas day my mother opened the box to see the thread to the base was cracked and the lamp could not be assembled. When I contacted Careco, I was told I needed to send a photo when the item arrived and that I only had 14 days to return it. Nowhere on my order confirmation does it say this. There was only a link at the bottom of the page.  Anyone buying something from Careco should be aware of this and that they need to check the product on receipt. However, I have since received a telephone call from Careco who are trying to resolve the issue and hopefully, we will soon have the lamp for my mother that I was hoping for.

records.title: I have recently bought a small buggy…
records.text: I have recently bought a small buggy from your store in simpering very helpfull thought of you when I had to have bandages on my legs

records.title: Extremely poor returns policy
records.text: **Extremely poor returns policy. I bought a gift for an elderly relative and was unable to return due to falling outside of return period- a miserly 14 days. They were intransigent when I explained the situation. No other offer was made. I will not purchase from them again due to poor customer service. ** NB I am updating this review to say that I was contacted by the company and the matter has been satisfactorily resolved. I was also informed that the returns policy is changing to 30 days in Jan25 which is more in line with customer expectations.

records.title: Really pleased with the service.
records.text: Really pleased with the service we received at Care Co Preston. They were helpful and informative. Delivery was within 2 days.  However we were not happy with the delivery driver who refused to unbox the chairs even though we were promised that they would otherwise we would have given 5 stars.

records.title: I have said it before
records.text: I have said it before, I cannot understand why showrooms do not stock small items for purchase. I really do object to having to pay postage when there is a half empty showroom a few miles from my home. I have heard the excuses but do not accept them as reasonable

records.title: Emma was friendly
records.text: Emma was friendly, professional and knowledgable. Thank you

records.title: I was a little surprised that the…
records.text: I was a little surprised that the initial price was 29 pounds and at the end it was 39 pounds .The web site is not very clear ,giving the impression that you have to disabled to get the original asking price.Ian Ckarke

records.title: Good service
records.text: The sales person was patient and explained the range of recliners available. We decided to get one made to our specifications. We were pleased that the recliner was to be delivered sooner than we expected. The men delivering it rang us an hour before they arrived and were extremely careful and explained how it worked etc. A very good service. Everyone was helpful. Would certainly recommend this Company.

records.title: Went to view a mobilty scooter
records.text: Went to view a mobilty scooter, The salesmen bought it up for me to try, but the battery was flat, thought they would have check their demo stock is working. Had to fit a larger battery which had to be balanced on the platform, so just had a little drive around the showroom. I did order a new Scooter.

records.title: I am disappointed that the18v gator…
records.text: I am disappointed that the18v gator hand held vacumn is not available  from Vax any more.

records.title: Happy to recommend
records.text: My only gripe was that the website intimated that demonstration was available in store and they were in stock but on visiting neither was so. However the staff were friendly and helpful and my order arrived at home four days later which included a weekend. Great service.

records.title: service plan/warranty
records.text: Just bought a service plan and warranty, it is good to have peace of mind for the next 3years. However I think careco need to offer a pay monthly option. Many people will not be able to afford the full amount, and the ridiculous 29.9%APR offered by the associate finance company is awful

records.title: Showroom person Reece was very good…

records.title: Riser/recliner chair purchase & delivery
records.text: Good online buying experience of both riser/recliner chair, assembly and removal of old item. Had to chase up to get delivery date but once established Glen & Justin made an excellent job of installation and instruction on functions.

records.title: The Staff have always been Helpful,
records.text: The Staff have always been Helpful,& able to give advice also they have been polite & courtious..

records.title: Immediate service, item ordered, all good
records.text: We had immediate attention, item was in stock to try, just what we required so order placed.  Notification that item had been dispatched within a couple of hours.Well done.

records.title: Things to know
records.text: I bought the triglide cruiser and it's less than a year old since day 1 I've had several problems between poor assembly of machine, bits falling off ,switches not working and wheel problems. Now I have battery problems which after speaking with the engineer seems to have been an ongoing problem since day 1 and has worsened to the point my scooter cuts out and they want £350 for replacement plus charging me for the engineer plus charge for pick up. I would highly recommend using any company. Customer service will go by the book but after dealing with Mr Matthew Parker it does restore a bit of faith in getting proper help, he was a great pleasure to deal with to get things sorted.  Thank you   Matthew

records.title: Ordered a perching stool faulty product…
records.text: Ordered a perching stool faulty product clips not secure back rest very loose and scratched

records.title: Customer Service somewhat lacking
records.text: My wife went into the shop in Southampton to order some leg risers for our sofa to assist with her arthritis.  She gave the shop assistant the sofa leg dimensions and the woman ordered a set that are far too small. Customer Service wanted to charge us to return them, even though it was their error. However, William saw my poor review and has stepped in to offer a full refund.Thank you William for stepping in and for some common sense at last.

records.title: CareCo need a better delivery company!
records.text: Most people need supplies from CareCo because they have mobility issues. Fireside chair for my dad ordered on Thursday 19/12 at Patchway branch in Bristol. Advised DPD would send me a text on day of delivery. Told likely would be Monday 23 or Tuesday 24 December for delivery. Chair arrived at my dad’s with no message to me to say today would be the delivery date! My dad is 89, has chronic arthritis and the parcel was initially left in his doorway blocking exit or entrance. Driver said he wasn’t allowed to go inside. Box was very bashed around, bolts were not easy to install. Rather disappointed! Update I need to obtain the order number from my father before I can email CareCo. I will see him later and send to the email address included. They are taking the review offline by asking me to email them. I have been in to the store where the purchase was made. Perhaps you can speak with them as they indicated it’s not the first time they’ve had issues with DPD!

records.title: The instructions for putting together…
records.text: The instructions for putting together the rollator were hard to find ( they were inside shopping bag). Two parcels arrived separately but I was not informed beforehand that that was the case. The items were good and exactly as described.

records.title: Not great
records.text: Good - delivery timeNot so good - the wheat warmers stank on arrival, are damp, moldy and came without any instructions about how long to heat them

records.title: Very stressful experience but then happy resolution
records.text: Up until my most recent experience I have been very happy with the help and service I have received from the Norwich showroom . However on this occasion a mistake was made in ordering the wrong item for me. Initially I did not see that this was not too much of a problem as mistakes happens . However resolving it turned out to be so. My contact with the showroom and then customer services I found appalling and created a high level of unnecessary stress at a very stressful time for me . However on escalating my complaint as to the unsatisfactory handling of my case I had the good fortune to encounter Matt who did exactly what I would have expected from my initial contact with customer services. He resolved the problem and organised the replacement of the right product quickly and efficiently. He was both professional and friendly and made me feel valued and I thank him for that. He has renewed in me a level of confidence in purchasing  from CareCo again which I’m glad about. On this occasion although I would give 1 star for my initial service from CareCo and contact with customer services in resolving the problem  , because of Matts imput who I would certainly give 5 stars to for his customer service , I felt 3 was fair for this time.

records.title: Possible improvements to Breeze 8 11..
records.text: After delays in supplying my initial order when I changed model to a Breeze8 11 it was delivered as promised.There are some design details I would take issue with.1)The front wheels should be lockable straight to assist folding.(a simple pin locator would suffice)2)The brake cables do not need to wrap around the front frame but with a simple design change a much shorter cable could run inside the rear struts making it more pleasing to the eye & cheaper to produce

records.title: Had a £100 voucher off CareCo and I…
records.text: Had a £100 voucher off CareCo and I drove over 100 miles round trip to Exeter and I spent over £800 and when my mother chose what she wanted they said for some reason the computer wouldn’t except it. So paid for the products and haven’t been back since. Don’t know if it was genuine or she wanted it for herself or a friend. Who knows, wouldn’t rush back.

records.title: The commode
records.text: The commode, after being assembled, was well within it’s expected function, and the client was very satisfied with it, however, the assembly of the legs was a real struggle because the plastic protective bungs in the leg entry holes were stuck fast in the tubes, which needed to be removed to get the adjustable legs into the tubes. I had to practically chew them to pieces with a pair pliers just to get them out, before I could put the legs in.

records.title: Great shop but a little pointless when…
records.text: Great shop but a little pointless when you can’t buy and and take away a tri stroller

records.title: No it was 27 Connaught Gardens Weymouth Dorset DT4 9PD
records.text: It was the address which you posted, 54 Norman Road, Sutton, Surrey SM1 2TA. We left there on the 5th July 2024 and moved to a detached bungalow at 27 Connaught Gardens, Weymouth, Dorset DT4 9PD. Please don't send to Sutton but send to Weymouth. Thank you!

records.title: Delivery shambles
records.text: Delivery for my elderly mother was absolutely shocking. I had asked to knock loudly and bring into the hallway . That didn't happen.  He knocked and left it on the door step. If it hadn't been for a neighbour it could have been taken. So disappointed as CareCo has always been so good

records.title: very helpful staff.
records.text: Very Helpful staff so we bought a small ticket item in the Maidstone store. The item was faulty but the store refused to process a return. We had to ring customer services to return it by post which was long winded, however they were very helpful and have since processed us a refund and sent us a voucher. Thank you.

records.title: CareCo Hayes 26/10/24   A Bad Start!!
records.text: A bad Start. Visited Hayes to look at the options for a riser recliner.  Greeted by a young man (the only male assistant in the Unit)   Explained our requirements and you do have a wide range  and we had no knowledge it took a few minutes.  The young man was reluctant to answer some queries in particular how the 5 year warranty worked.  He then said "I will be back in a minute"  some 10 minutes later he was still chatting at the desk and drinking coffee!!  He eventually returned and I think he thought we were "tyre kickers" I said I was unhappy with his attitude and could I please see the manager. He realised I was serious and tried to recover the situation and I told him it was too late.  Michelle appeared and her attitude was as one would expect.  she dealt with all of our queries and as you can see we purchased.  Nothing was to much for Michelle I would employ her at the drop of a hat.  I suppose there always has to be a bad apple in the barrel.  OR2107120

records.title: 12" suction grab handles…
records.text: I ordered two 12" suction grab handles but I could not get them to stay attached to the wall. I tried different positions on the tiles in my bathroom and also tried them both vertically and horizontally. Nothing worked although one did stay up for 24 hours before falling off. Having said that, the ordering and delivery was easy and efficient and the returns process looks as if it will be the same. It's just a pity the product itself wasn't as good.

records.title: Very courteous and helpful
records.text: Very courteous and helpful. I found raising and lowering seat very complicated and unnecessarily difficult. Initially staff did not want to do it.  But it was imperative that I find out if the seat height made a difference to my comfort. When it arrived my husband found the bolt for raising the seat was unnecessarily tight!  After all the bolt went completely through the stem! We were also told instore that it would arrive fully charged.  All instructions said it wouldn’t.  It needed a full charge before we could test it.

records.title: Not the service expected
records.text: I purchased a new wheel chair & another disability aid & was extremely pleased with the wheelchair which I will review seperately.After a few days I received a telephone call from the company telling about their pain remedies, Gummies & CBD Cream. I had been looking at it so paid for a trial month, which is quite costly. However when my parcel arrived it only had the gummies & not the cream, so my exciting thought of reduced pain levels or no pain, went away. I weasnt happy at being sold something you didnt have & then very annoyed to find one couldnt get through on the telephone after making 5 attempts & one of which was over half an hour. So here I am over a week later with part of a product, only. Very unsatisfactorty. Not good communicators.

records.title: The chairs were 8 weeks old service…
records.text: The chairs were 8 weeks old service engineer said it was a mana factory fault as both chairs were so noisy .The customer service was very unhelpful we asked for a full refund but we couldn’t have that as we had them past their return policy.Very unhappy with the way this has been handled. We have reselected chairs that I don’t even like as we want cream leather very little choice only 2 chairs come in cream leather.

records.title: It apppears there is something missing…
records.text: It was a relief  to have a prompt phone call from a human being to discuss my previous review - all now sorted.  Well done Careco for addressing your Boundary Management so promptly and so smoothly.Good to know that AI has not taken over completely.Noblesse oblige...AMB ( previously before retirement Assessor for UK/European Management Awards  ...)

records.title: The company forwards your details to…
records.text: The company health advisors contacted me and their 'health advisors tried to recommend CBD oil based products for my elderly father without taking any details of medical history or assessment of his needs. After strong complaints from me, they have agreed to offer further training to the "health advisor" and review their practices. The matter was eventually resolved.

records.title: Left in neighbouring shop.
records.text: My order was despatched promptly, however my door code was missing from my address label. It was included in the email order confirmation and notes to the DPD driver. However parcel was left in a neighbouring shop for some reason.

records.title: YCould do better
records.text: You did not ring me to say you were delivering my chairs so I now have to wait 2 days with a living room full of furniture until my 3 seater setee can be removed and the chairs made up,

records.title: Not the best value
records.text: Not the best value. Checkout with discount code is a fiasco, I went throught the loop 3 times and non of the codes worked so I gave up & went to checkout. Disappointed to find dely charge is hidden until I was committed to the purchase. Slow free delivery would have been fine. I would have gone elsewhere but item matched 2 others. BTW it's poor that the shops don't hold any stock.

records.title: Had to return cost me six pounds didn’t…
records.text: Had to return cost me six pounds didn’t realise it wasn’t free returns won’t shop here again

records.title: Poor customer service experience
records.text: Recently ordered my elderly mum the comet stroller. When it arrived and I opened the box the stroller had scratches and chips on the paint/finish.Emailed the customer service dept with photos and an explanation. Stating I wish to return the product.After 24 hours I had had no reply to my concern.  So contacted them by phone.  The lady was nice and stated that they had not received my original email, although I had a confirmation email from them that they had received it.  I was asked to resend the email again to another email address which I did.Today, nearly 48 hours later still no reply or return number received from them.I therefore sent the original email and stated that this was terrible customer service.  At the same time I gave them a call.Another lady said that no they had not received any emails from me and could I please send again whilst on the phone, so I did.After a while she said yes she had received the email and how rude I was for putting terrible customer service.  Three emails, two telephone calls and all she could focus on was the fact that I had written terrible customer service.  I eventually got to ask how long it would take to receive a reply and was told another 24 hours.I’m sure I will be calling them again over the next few days to get this sortedUpdate 29/11/24Spoke with Matt and he was very understanding and listened to my concerns.  Matt arranged a collection for today, however, no courier company came to pick parcel up.Not blaming CareCo for this as well all know what courier companies are like

records.title: Updated -Customer Service-
records.text: The chair was repaired by a technician from the Emmeria group. It was fortunate that he had a part in his vehicleas the part sent out for him to use was the incorrect oneHowever, since writing the review l have been contacted numerous times by William Harrison, the founder of CareCo wanting me to delete or edit the review. Think l have counted 6 emails, even when another family member had been hospitalised asking me to amend/delete it. I fully stand by the original reviewand only increased it to two stars as it has been repaired.The facts are:Very difficult to contact their customer service,Waited nearly two months for a repair to be completed,Incorrect part sent out and only repaired as the technician happened to have a spare part.They did refund the £80 excess fee, increased the warranty period by two months, sent a cheque for £100 as compensation.My 80 year old mum was left without her rise and recline chair after shoddy treatment from both Careco and Emmeria Group.First called Careco on 20 September to carry out a repair on a ‘sitting pretty’ electric rise and recline chair. They contacted Emmeria Group to carry out a repair, bearing in mind a service agreement was in place. After a technicians initial visit and waiting for a part, the repair is being scheduled for tomorrow, 18th November.Very shoddy service to repair an essential item for an 80 year old lady. I would therefore avoid purchasing anything from Careco and repairs from Emmeria. Both companies customer service is appalling. I would avoid at all costs.

records.title: customer care were unempathetic and…
records.text: customer care were unempathetic and uncaring.  I wanted to change an order that I had already emailed a request about.  It was made very clear to me that, if they could not find my texted instructions, they would not change the order and I would be liable for the whole cost.  Not what you want to hear when you are 80 and living on a pension! despite all your caring 'advertising'.  You do not come up to expectations

records.title: Rude and aggressive
records.text: I'm writing this on behalf of my elderly parents who have just had one of the worst customer service experiences they have ever had at CareCo Bristol (Patchway). Whilst trying to explain a potential fault with a folding scooter (that lead to my father falling off the seat whilst at the Mall) they were met with rude and aggressive behavior from one male member of staff. Whilst I wasn't there to see this for myself, my mother who has worked in retail for many years said that she had never witnessed such bad customer service in all her years.

records.title: It was an excellent service
records.text: It was an excellent service. The price was great & the pills arrived within days & I was notified by my chemist to collect them.

records.title: Always very speedy delivery
records.text: Always very speedy delivery. I would like to see a better points system as I have loads but find it difficult to use them.

records.title: Contact process
records.text: The meds I order arrived, though a bit delayed.The only thing I could suggest to improve customer service would be to improve the contact procedure. I filled out there online process to be met with the phrase "we can't prove your not a robot" or similar. No way could I get passed this.

records.title: They are a very reliable company and…
records.text: They are a very reliable company and they have a very good customer service department. The medication I used did exactly what I was expecting it to although if you want to lose weight you have to stick to a diet and not just rely on pills!

records.title: Arrived on time and at a great price
records.text: Arrived on time and at a great price. will definitely use agin

records.title: Saved my marriage
records.text: Saved my marriage

records.title: Stomach Bloat gone
records.text: I'm just coming to the end of a 2 month cycle and as a periporsal (can't spell it but defo going through it) female the weight gain and stomach bloat in a short time is mood altering. I'm not to sure that I've been following the rules properly but would say 3, through the day is better than all together. My stomach is less bloated and I plan to get some more for the 3rd month and hope that this will have me back to my usual size.

records.title: Delivery timing and everything else was…
records.text: Delivery timing and everything else was spot on.The service was efficient, and my order arrived exactly when expected, which I really appreciated. The packaging was discreet, and the whole process felt smooth and professional. The only minor downside for me is the pricing—it’s a bit on the higher side. However, considering the reliable service and quality, it's understandable. Overall, I’m happy with the experience and would still recommend them despite the slightly higher cost.

records.title: Quick solution
records.text: Important questions asked before product granted ,and speedy response with delivery also product was very good at what was required,will use again

records.title: GOOD
records.text: These oral capsules are easy to take.  I haven't lost as much weight as I'd hoped but know they are working due to the fat content dispersed whilst going to the toilet.  Hoping the second month will bring much more weight loss.

records.title: Drugs correct, wrapping delayed them.
records.text: The drugs were correct and came in good time. If they had been simply wrapped, I’d have got them very quickly. They would have come through the front door letter box. Unfortunately, they were put in and oversize box and then a big plastic envelope. So they couldn’t get through the door, were taken away and I had to go and collect them from a nearby village, a day later. Pity.

records.title: Very easy to find what you want and…
records.text: Very easy to find what you want and quick delivery

records.title: Prompt service but a substitute product…
records.text: Prompt service but a substitute product sent. I know you prewarn that this might happen but I would have preferred what I ordered.  Please is there any way I can ensure you only send the brand I ordered ?

records.title: Excellent and professional service
records.text: The service received was excellent. It was lovely that a check was carried out of my health first before I could place my order. Items were delivered fast and I will surely use them again and recommend to family and friends.

records.title: Wasn't expecting it to work truthfully
records.text: Wasn't expecting it to work truthfully. But it definitely gives you that extra lift. I had a bit of hanky panky and then a bit more hanky panky. Then a cuddle with my missus. When she went to sleep I spent the next hour with palmer and her 5 sisters. Definitely ordering again

records.title: Lost some weight
records.text: Lost some weight, not a lot.But I may have done better if I had changed my diet a little more.

records.title: Late delivery
records.text: The first dose arrived almost 3 weeks late,however I feel that the postal service was partly to blame when I was assured that this was a speedy service.

records.title: Messing around with discount codes…
records.text: The process of ordering online is quick, efficient and simple. However, there is one particular niggle I have with this organisation. They keep sending me the temptation of a discount code, without any obvious preconditions, but when I attempt to use it, I discover that the code has expired or there is some other reason why I am unable to use it. It may only be a small thing but it does remove at least one star from the review.

records.title: Sildenafil
records.text: Service great, delivery great, discretion great, product not so. Sildenafil 25% did not work for me. Tried 50% still nothing. Seems like I will need to try 100% next time otherwise it will have to be a trip to the doctors for the real V.

records.title: They worked, but made me ill.
records.text: I last nearly half a stone, using Alli, but after 3 weeks developed a severely bloated stomach and stomach cramp, so have stopped taking the tablets. It’s not an uncommon side effect - but not one I experience when using them a few years ago. I wouldn’t take them on days when I was leaving the house, for the risk of being ‘caught short’.

records.title: Easy ordering but not seeing the benefits 😕
records.text: Very easy with ordering and actually recieving my order! Iv taken the medication which it to help with jet lag but it is having no effect on me what's so ever! Iv has a less dosage from the GP before and that worked perfectly, but these one from pharmica are not doing anything

records.title: Back to the drawing board
records.text: Liked the layout of the site, easy to fill in questionnaire. The tailored advice was very good....BUT!! I think the pills are expensive.  ED is an embarrassing  condition to have, all I want to do is feel like a man with my gorgeous wife,  this feels like just cashing in on my decimating problem. The pills I got did not work, maybe it's just me...anyways this is an honest review.

records.title: Only person can order at an address…
records.text: Only one person can order at an address without any hassle. My medicine wasn't delivered and Royal mail asked for more money. I received my refund through PayPal.

records.title: It works but after a month I haven’t…
records.text: It works but after a month I haven’t seen any very obvious results so looking forward to trying it for another month to see. It was very effective in the first two weeks but then didn’t seem so

records.title: It is good service but silly things…
records.text: It is good service but silly things annoy me, like the discount you can have but loose the free delivery or visa versa

records.title: I got charged for nxt day delivery and…

records.title: postal service

records.title: Very easy
records.text: It was all very straight forward no issues and delivered quicker than thought also

records.title: Cut out gimmicks
records.text: Have been buying tablets for over 2 years - have not qualified for a free postage yet - don't bother

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order. Regular emails to keep me posted re delivery. However, I chose the next day delivery and my order was about 2 days late.

records.title: It is what it is...
records.text: It is what it is. Where the are gaps and loopholes in legislation. There will be people happy to exploit those gaps and loopholes for money.This is not a doctor. This whole thing is about getting as much money for as little cost as possible.

records.title: Hydrochloride -v- Dihydrochloride
records.text: I ordered Cetirizine Dihydrochloride tablets but received Cetirizine hydrochloride tablets. I'm not sure what the difference is but I know that the ones with the 'Di' work for me. Nothing flagged up at the time of placing the order that I would receive anything different to what I had requested and there was no explanation enclosed with the order. It has therefore left a little concerned that what I requested is not what I received - and with no explanation as to the reason or the efficacy of the received product over the requested product .

records.title: Service great
records.text: Service great. Medication didn’t really work as well as hoped but will try again. Service like I said was helpful and prompt

records.title: Paid for guaranteed next day delivery…
records.text: Paid for guaranteed next day delivery but didn't receive my medicines until after the weekend. No response to email questioning this.

records.title: Not satisfied
records.text: Its not working properly as they described.

records.title: Service of Pharmica
records.text: After correspondence with Pharmica and seeing how they do their due diligence I find their services more than satisfactory

records.title: Didn't get what I ordered
records.text: Didn't get what I ordered.  Was emailed 3 times to question me about what I wanted, but when I asked for a call back after the delivery I had no response.  Wont use again.Update: After several emails back and forth I was able to resolve the problem.  The reason I didn't get my items was due to a dispensing error; which I find worrying.  They gave me assurances that my missing item would be sent via special delivery and that they would endeavour to make sure something like this doesn't happen again.

records.title: Accepted out of stock order
records.text: They accepted an order from me with 2 to 3 day expedited delivery time.After no delivery in 4 days I contacted them to ask why, only to be told it was out of stock. This wasted me 4 days without treatment.  How long would it have taken them to tell me I had not asked? This is unacceptable.

records.title: I recently bought Mylan 1% Clotrimazole…
records.text: I recently bought Mylan 1% Clotrimazole from Pharmica on line. I gave specific instructions that I did not want any substitute. I received a product by Care +. When I contacted Pharmica about this error, they offered a refund for the product but not the postage. As the postage is nearly as much as the product I find this situation totally unacceptable! It was after all their mistake!

records.title: They asked the right question when I…
records.text: I wrote a very good review beforehand on my previous orders,but on my last order which I have paid for but still haven't got ,as the items were under review. I answered the questions that was asked but nothing has changed. Still haven't got back to me. Please have the common courtesy to get back to me.

records.title: Very hit and miss
records.text: Very hit and miss, if they don't deliver your order on time, refused delivery refund and told to just wait for it.Used a few times bit the customer service us always a hassle and atrocious to speak to (had a very pleasant woman who was extremely helpful last time so I'm comparing the experience to my previous one)Will unfortunately be using other retailers from now on due to a couple of constant issues.

records.title: Very disappointed with this company.
records.text: This the 2nd time I have ordered OTC medication from this company and the 2nd time they have sent me something I didn’t order and didn’t want. I ordered esomeprozole because I can’t take omeprozole, so they sent me the latter which I would never have wanted and can't use. The pharmacy state they sent me an invoice telling me what I had ordered but, stupidly, I did not check this, so it's my fault.It would have made no difference anyway the medication is on its way by that time.  I will point out that 2 other pharmacies I tried to order from, substituded esomeprozole, which I had on screen and put in my basket, for omeprozole when I came to check out. So this company is not alone but on those occasions I noticed the exchange before I paid, so no order was made. Other people may have had amazing experience with Pharmica Pharmacy but I'm afraid I didn't.

records.title: I ordered a tablet and it wasn't…
records.text: I ordered a tablet and it wasn't delivered. I asked for a refund but they said they will resend it. Fine - but I had an infection and couldn't wait for a tablet for a week so I got one from a local pharmacy. I explained it to Pharmica and still got a response that they will resend it. Useless but oh well.

records.title: Placed an order should have been next…
records.text: Placed an order should have been next day delivery, instead I had to wait a week for you to tell me it was finally going to be dispatched!

records.title: Delivery, quality and size
records.text: Super fast delivery. Quality is great. Sizing-wise, I would say it’s a bit smaller so I ordered more of one size up and they fitted my daughter better especially when applying ointment.

records.title: Good purchase

records.title: Using the site was easy, but I bought the wrong gloves, because you ate flooded with too many options.
records.text: Using the site was easy, but unfortunately I chose the wrong gloves made of the wrong material, I chose Vinyl gloves instead of nitrile.The vinyl gloves gape at the wrists, so unlike nitrile, it’s not practical the wash your gloved hands while wearing them.Nitrile gloves have a higher wrist that fits snugly, so you can wash your gloved hands if required

description: Palm Safe is a Scottish-based business on a mission to make the best possible hand sanitiser.  Our sanitisers use premium isopropyl alcohol (70% by volume), which isn't so harsh on your skin as the ethanol found in most shop bought sanitisers. We then add aloe vera to moisturise your skin and leave your hands feeling soft. With over 30 different scents available, your hands will be left smelling and feeling amazing. Palm Safe dries quickly and won't leave your hands sticky.

records.title: Another fantastic order arrived was…
records.text: Another fantastic order arrived was ordered on Friday arrived today Sunday.  Great product.  Smell great not like the cheap stuff alcohol smell at 1st but goes away with a few seconds  then all you smell is the is the scented  ie candy cane Order a few product all arrived well packed.  Please don't take in the negative reviews. I've ordered for years now and never had any problems.  This a family run business who during covid did a lot for the local people/ young people as well . I would rather spend a bit more money for a better product that's supports local business than buying from a big company that uses cheaper chemicals. Buy online at the store or amazon has their product as well . Thanks palmsafe team

records.title: Great and on time.
records.text: Great as always. No complaints just wish there was a store in aberdeen city centre to save paying a delivery fee.

records.title: Recommended by a friend absolutely love…
records.text: Recommended by a friend absolutely love it will order more especially the hand wash the apple and cinnamon is lovely x

records.title: My favourite hand sanitiser gels
records.text: My favourite hand sanitiser gels, used throughout the global pandemic and still like to have one in my handbag. I have a pump dispenser on my desk at work. Excellent quality and come in a variety of scents. This is my first time trying the liquid soap. Two items were missing from my order but the problem was addressed and resolved quickly.

records.title: Our saviour.......
records.text: During COVID my autistic son's hands became very raw, he stressed a lot and his mental health really suffered,he washed his hands a lot. I searched for a hand sanitizer that wouldn't hurt his already suffering hands and Palm Safe has been it.  Great smells and colours and most importantly beautifully sanitary without drying out your hands, super product.

records.title: Called up to ask about the products and…
records.text: Called up to ask about the products and the female staff could not be any more helpful, she talked me through everything and made my purchases so much easier.  The service was fantastic and after picking what I wanted the delivery was very quick, the product are definitely a 10 out of 10 and I would definitely be buying more. The products are hand made in Scotland and they smell so good.

records.title: Best experience!!
records.text: Everything about these hand sanitisers are great, they have their own sweet unique smell to them almost as if you're wearing perfume but obvs less stronger. I really recommend, better than any other hand sanitisers I've used..

records.title: Covid Pandemic hit Palmsafe
records.text: When the Covid Pandemic hit Palmsafe were one of the first local companies to produce a hand gel without that terrible strong smell of alcohol. Palsafe produced hand gels with rather a lot of lovely smells that lingered on tour hands. That is the reason that we awarded them 5*

records.title: Brilliant hand sanitiser
records.text: Brilliant hand sanitiser. Initial smell is a little strong and then the perfume takes over. Doesn't dry your hands. Feel much safer using it when I'm out and about. Colours are fab too. Use different ones according to what colour handbag I'm carrying.

records.title: Best Hand Sanitizer
records.text: Quality hand sanitizer in lots of different fragrances. Quick and efficient customer service and delivery. We have used this hand sanitizer since The Pandemic and still use it. Always have a handbag size with me at all times and a pump one in the car. Highly recommend 10/10

records.text: These are fantastic sanitisers. They smell lovely and are very handy in the pocket sized ones.

records.title: The products are first class
records.text: The products are first class. Worthy of the price. I will happily recommend. The missing star is because the delivery by EVRI failed not once but twice! UPS delivered with no problem. Just unfortunate it took three attempts to deliver my order successfully.

records.title: I would have given 5 stars as I love…
records.text: I would have given 5 stars as I love the products and the company itself and the customer service is great but I just wish they would stop using Evri as a courier.I’ve ordered directly from palm safe twice, the first time Evri lost the package and it had to be refunded. The second time Evri lost my own and a number of other which had to be re-sent from palm safe, which resulted in a delay.

records.title: Love the product, bottle lids need to be stronger.
records.text: Love the product, feels and smells amazing. Initially it smells quite strong, which tells me it's doing it's job, but then blends away to smell like the bottle says and is lovely. I bought this specifically to keep on my car keys as it's handy for being out and about to have on hand. Unfortunately the lid no longer seals down and it leaks meaning it cant be used for what I need it for. I'd definitely recommend the actual product but until the bottle has a sturdier lid it doesn't cover what I need it to do.

records.title: I will buy more
records.text: I do find the products to be on the pricey side but I do enjoy the scents of the hand sanitisers. I have bought the clip on sanitiser bottles so that I can clip them onto my lanyard at work. The sanitisers never leave my hands sticky which I enjoy. The scent, after the alcohol evaporates, is not very strong and I have to sniff at my hands to get a slight whiff. I do find the skin around my nails becomes extremely dry after a week of using palm safe but I feel confident that this product is working to kill germs.

description:
iDLOGIC supply pet microchips to trained microchip implanters including animal breeders and veterinarians. Our microchips include free DEFRA approved database registration. We offer next day delivery to most of the UK.

iDLOGIC pet microchips are manufactured to EU standards, with biocompatible glass which is coated in an anti-migration treatment that will help prevent movement of the microchip once it's been implanted in the animal.

Our 8mm pet microchips and 10mm pet microchips are incredibly small but still offer an excellent read range when scanned. This makes microchip implanting a much easier and more comfortable procedure for both the implanter and especially smaller animals.
