records.text: Fairly quick response, although I cannot help thinking that delivery time(s) could be improved, if Royal Mail were to be used.

records.title: Had results quickly
records.text: The results came back quickly, would have been nice to have a follow up email to say my sample had been received and you were going to start testing as your just left waiting..

records.title: Order easy
records.text: Order easy , arrived in time , Some of the boxes where crushed as packaging was inadequate Arrived in polythene packageThe company got back to me about crushed boxes and very kindly sent me some more , but they still need to change the packaging they send them in as it’s not adequate

records.title: No results and haven’t responded to any…
records.text: No results and haven’t responded to any emails …. Looking at the other reviews I should have taken note instead of paying for a food intolerance test. Clearly it’s a huge scamUpdate I received my results today. The company just needs to improve on keeping the customer informed and respond to e-mails and messages much quicker then I think people would be a little more understanding

records.title: Disappointed delivery
records.text: The boxes were all crushed when I opened the package.

records.title: Covid Lateral Flow Tests: poor use by date
records.text: I ordered 30 Covid Lateral Flow Tests. They arrived promptly but the use by date was very disappointing at 6 October 2023. I’ve never had LFTs before with use by dates less than a year. I would have ordered fewer if I’d known and am very unlikely to be able to use them all by October. There should be some kind of ‘use by’ alert on the details when ordering if it’s going to be so short. The packaging is also disappointing. Very wasteful and eco-unfriendly. Instead of a package containing a number of tests, each one is individually boxed.

records.title: Stock received almost out of date.
records.text: Stock received almost out of date.Only 3 weeks left on COVID tests.Is the internet a way of getting rid of old stock.Similar items in local pharmacy have at least 9 months before out of date.

records.title: Slow service
records.text: You're asking me to review when I haven't even had the results back yet!! I can't say good or bad, although I will say it has been a slow process.

records.title: Quick delivery but lancet not powerful enough
records.text: Test arrived very quickly and delivered safely to front door.  Test was good - simple and easy to do, but the lancet was not very good - unfortunately, for these types of test you need a good old, slightly painful, puncture!  This one was simply not strong enough and the blood flow was therefore minimal.  Fortunately, I had a couple of lancets from another purchase of another product, so was able to use these.  If the lancet worked better to give a useful puncture, I would have given the test five stars.  I would suggest you have another lancet or two on standby, otherwise your whole test will be wasted.  The hydrophilic method of filling the pipette works well if you have a good blood flow.

records.title: Test arrived quickly however there was…
records.text: Test arrived quickly however there was a note inside advising not to do it until after the 10th due to the bank holidays meaning I have to wait another 7 days before I can do it. If I had known there would be a delay with processing I would have looked into alternative options as the reason I ordered this was to get results ASAP. Hopefully when I am able to send it they do a quick turnaround.

records.title: Short expiry date on item
records.text: Ordering process was straightforward and despatch and delivery was fast and efficient. My only disappointment with the order was the expiry date of the LFTs I'd ordered. I ordered 30 to keep cost down (need them to visit father in care home). Expiry date was Oct 2023 meaning they will realistically be out of date before all used (I visit twice a week).

records.title: The product arrived in good time
records.text: The product arrived in good time, but it only had a six month shelf life. Delivery 12th April with use by date of October 2023. It would be useful if a use by date was included on the product description when ordering.

records.title: Delivery
records.text: I have used DAM Health before, but this time I have been let down on delivery. I have had a message from DPD to advise they are expecting the package and will be in touch with a delivery date. However, I haven’t heard from them since this first contact. I expected to receive the package yesterday, but nothing so far.It's now over a week, still no delivery. DPD tracking shows that they have not collected from DAM Health, so they are not at fault. Customer services have made contact asking for the order ref. I have given this and heard no more.

records.title: Expensive "next day" delivery
records.text: You have to pay £4.99 for next day delivery yet it takes 3 days. You shouldn't have to pay that much if its not going to come the next day. I needed these tests Monday and they are arriving today (wednesday). The fact that it doesn't give you any other delivery/ pickup options is annoying.

records.title: A little disappointed that the ‘use by’…
records.text: A little disappointed that the ‘use by’ date on the 30 covid tests purchased were only valid for 6 months. Looks like disposing of old stock.

#26604 l have edited this review but l stand by what l said about the delay with the order especially when it's a covid test and delivery is £4.99 it was pointless My email was ignored l only got a response when leaving a negative review. Royal mail was not used so l don't understand the delay if you are selling these tests you have to understand that fast shipping is important and the price for delivery should easily cover this. I thought l was getting one test but l got a pack of 5 which l read it wrong so the price was definitely reasonable so l have changed my review but this does not change the fact that it was money wasted because they came to late.

records.title: Instructions weren't super clear
records.text: The instructions on how to send back the test weren't super clear as they were referencing an email with instructions that I never received.  I am changing my rating (from 1 to 3) as I misunderstood the instructions. However the customer support still tool a week to contact me back, after which I didn't need the test anymore.

records.title: Not next day delivery
records.text: Tests ordered on 21st April and delivered evening of 25th.  Expensive delivery service, not next day even taking in to account the weekend.

records.title: Uncoordinated
records.text: Disliked that our appointment was changed by DAM twice: once from Edinburgh to Glasgow, another was a time change. Each time I received 11 emails which was confusing. Disliked that even though I contacted customer service and received email confirmation that my appointment was confirmed, when I arrived on the day I was told I was not on the system and had no appointment. Staff were friendly and got me the test but contained several errors on the certificate including important areas such as date of birth and passport number. I liked that the customer service hotline was available and after three calls it was sorted. A bit of a nerve wracking experience.

records.title: Usually excellent service but this time…
records.text: Usually excellent service but this time a few issues occurred. The first order never arrived and was in fact returned to depot . Following an enquiry via email the second delivery arrived a couple of days later without any tracking information (was given a tracking number but it wasn’t recognised) , fortunately I was in. No problem with the product or customer service, just a ‘blip’ I guess.

records.title: The 3 stars is more about the delivery
records.text: The 3 stars is more about the delivery, we expected and received an email advising they would be delivered in next day, in fact we waited 3 days, which actually meant we had get someone to go and get the tests elsewhere.

records.title: Quick but watch dates!
records.text: Very easy to order and fast delivery. However, the shelf life is is less than 5 months, that’s very disappointing.

records.title: Not next day delivery as stated.
records.text: Paid for next day delivery but was not received until two days later.Also the expiry date is quite short which is a pity. Did like the fact that I was sent 5 separate boxes.

records.title: Essential that you have access to a…
records.text: Essential that you have access to a smart phone because everything to do with this test is managed via an app. Hadn't realised that DAM Health is a partner of Muhdo and as such I need to arrange and pay for postage.

records.title: Expiry date was for only 6 months
records.text: Expiry date was for only 6 months I’m a pensioner and had bought 2 boxes. I would never have used them in that time, Original expiry date on box was for 2 years. I’m returning them for a refund

records.title: Order not fulfilled
records.text: I ordered a pack of 10 lateral flow tests plus one fit-to-fly test. I received 1 lateral flow test and two fit-to-fly tests. The order arrived promptly and was well packaged. I have tried to contact DAM 3 times asking them to correct the order and offering to return the extra fit-to-fly test. After nearly a week of trying DAM has not even acknowledged my emails, let alone sorted the problem. DO NOT USE for anything time-sensitive.

records.title: Intolerance test inconsistent
records.text: The test results did not correspond to my food consumption and symptoms!

records.title: Feedback, feedback but no product!
records.text: Well the first request for feedback ("Tell us how well we have done") was received before anything was delivered. I could slightly forgive that as it was a bank holiday weekend. So the kit was delivered, used and sent back. And the next two requests for feedback arrived. Call me petty but I'd rather you deliver the results, which after all are what I've paid for, before asking for feedback. Till then, maybe dial back on the speed and frequency of requests and focus instead on actually delivering the product.

records.title: Test took two working days to arrive…
records.text: Test took two working days to arrive when they said it would be one. It is ridiculously complicated to send back... instead of just sending a pre paid envelope you have to register and print your own label. Just made it really difficult.

records.title: Don’t use for Asia
records.text: Service was great and the result time even better however my certificate was not valid for the country to which I was travelling and when I tried to get in contact it was impossible. Do not use this service to go to Japan or Asia in general because the certificate is not filled with all the necessary information

records.title: Instructions unclear and vague
records.text: Instructions unclear and vague. Cannot track returned package despite being told there is that option. The provided link does not work, you have to manually type into the browser. Box is needlessly big (could fit 15 tests in there) and can’t fit into post box unless squashed.

records.title: How can anyone trust the company
records.text: On Friday afternoon I had a call to tell me the the Huddersfield DAM clinic was closing down. I was due to have a test on Saturday afternoon. I was then offered Leeds at midday. You had already closed Sheffield Rotherham and Doncaster. What a shambles leaving such a late time to close a place down. Fortunately I was able to go to Leeds but what if I couldn't. I was flying to South America in two days and needed a COVID test. The only positive was the the nurse was very organised and the result negative. How can anyone trust the company?

records.title: Russian Roulette
records.text: Not enough information, too many hidden clauses don’t know what I will do if I don’t get my pcr before I’m due to fly tomorrow!! I don’t know how I’ll get my results, or how to register the kit. Still waiting for replies 😢 Hi I submitted my details

description: DocHQ is a Health Tech company on a mission help users connect efficiently to health support and advice whether you are at home, work or travelling.

records.title: Good service  I…
records.text: My package came much quicker than I thought. Good prices too.

records.title: The products are very good
records.text: The products are very good, always work!

records.title: pre-cruise covid testing
records.text: The practitioner knew we had connected to the call but we weren’t aware, as there was technical issues.  They called us to go through other options which resolved the issue. The lady was very patient and reassuring and guided us through the test experience. Wouldn’t definitely use your company again if needed. Thank you

records.title: Well recommended
records.text: Recommended by my long time faithful travel adviser Nicky from Dial A Flight! Excellent choice and a very good service! Our Video Consultant was Alex who was very good, patient and very supportive! Alex really made the experience calming for us as we had trouble loading the access to the website and the app! Will is DocHQ again and will strongly recommend it to others!

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service. Quick and efficient. Result within 15 minutes using my own lateral flow test kit. They even rang back to double check that I had received my certificate as I had cut off the video call prematurely. I used the service because I had COVID and needed to prove it to cancel a holiday. Also on the Government approved list which is where I found them.

records.title: Fantastic service at home
records.text: Fantastic service at home . Bought our own kits for £2 each and did video consultation at home . Went on about 5 mins before appointment time and lady there right away . Great service did tests observed and certificates issued right away . Great price and very easy to use . Would recommend

records.title: I was a bit worried about how this… but excellent service, couldn't fault it!
records.text: I was a bit worried about how this would go, but it was so easy, I was sent reminders so I didn't forget. The lady conducting the test was brilliant arrived on screen on time, had patience when my husband could get the passport on to the screen to show her.  We did the test as instructed and she asked us to carry on with our day for 15 minutes, she came back to 2 negative tests and sent though the certificates straight away by email. So simple would highly recommend

records.title: Great service from Alex
records.text: My wife and I had to take a lateral flow test before travelling to the USA to catch a cruise ship in Seattle. Tried to connect to the link provided which informed me that my device was not compatible so missed the start of my appointment. Alex rescued the day by phoning to contact me and then providing an alternative link which worked. All smooth thereafter and a big thanks to Alex.

records.title: Great easy experience.
records.text: Great easy experience.Good access link, clear video and easy to follow instructions.Even when our Internet cut out the link took us back straight to our appointment.And the certificate was emailed whilst still in the appointment.Would recommend and use again.

records.title: Easy, fast, professional service
records.text: Easy to use service. They have their own video calling system so you are connected to them by clicking a link on the email. There is no need to download any software so absolutely no I.T. skills required. I got reminders at 24hrs before hand and one hour before hand, each having the video link. The tester was very patient and extremely professional giving clear instructions for each step. I received my certificate while I was still 9n the call.Overall an excellent service and I will be using it again. Highly recommended.

records.title: Efficient and quick
records.text: Date of experience: 13 March 2023

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, the only thing was that the video call kept cutting off, it happened at least six times, and that obviously made me very nervous as I thought I was going to miss my appointment, but I tried calling again and it reconnected. Apart from that technical issue, which I hope is sorted, I recommend this company.

records.title: Problems with times
records.text: We had a problem with the times as our online test was booked for 820 am and we received an email and phone call saying it had been cancelled. I eventually managed to get hold of someone by phone as we were then panicking who then said it's fine log on at 815 it was the time difference making it 720 their time which was extremely stressful but the  actual test etc was good

records.title: Ease of Use
records.text: Ease of use and quick test along with result arriving instantly. Only reason not 5 stars the call volume was very quiet and difficult to hear

records.title: Difficult to get connected
records.text: Difficult to get connected, kept refusing to work on iPhone. Had to set up the laptop to get it to work. But once connected it was very straightforward.

records.title: Pre cruise testing
records.text: Easy process and results immediately after test. Slight issue connecting at the time but a quick call sorted it out with no delay

records.title: on the whole the experience was quite…
records.text: on the whole the experience was quite good although once we had done the test (and had to wait for for the result to appear the person on the other end disappeared for approx. 15 mins

records.title: Worked well but I'm not sure about the…
records.text: Worked well but I'm not sure about the wisdom of ringing off for 15 minutes as we could have substituted tests done earlier.

records.title: Was very helpful,guidance  all the…
records.text: Was very helpful,guidance  all the way,would  highly  recommend, and definitely  use again, many thanks.

records.title: Was good - ensure you plan for longer than your booking time
records.text: Once someone attended the appointment it was great and all instructions were clear and easy to follow. However, our appointment started 20 minutes after our booking time should have began and due to the wait time on tests meant it was then an hour to complete. Make sure you factor in that these may not start on time.

records.title: Would recommend
records.text: Very easy to use, great price,and very quick at emailing you the results, my only downside would be that the volume wasn't loud enough and struggled a bit to hear the lady on the other end and kept asking her to repeat.Would recommend anyone use DocHQ.

records.title: We had an issue with the link.
records.text: We had an issue with the link that it wouldn't connect d3spite trying 3 different devices. They cancelled our appointment as a no show after 5 minutes. I booked and paid for another appointment straight away and e mailed to complain that 5 minutes was not long enough to sort conn3ction issues out. They called me straight away, refunded the 2nd appointment and arranged to do the supervised tests straight away. Well rescued.

records.title: Pretty pleased with the service
records.text: Pretty pleased with the service. Appointment started a few minutes late but procedure was easy. Bit worried when the health practitioner didn't return for 20 minutes to verify our results but all was well in the end. Would definitely use again and would recommend to others.

records.title: My DocHQ Experience
records.text: The test process, live explanation and overseeing was all very helpful for all four family members.The pre-purchase clarifications and replies to questions were amazingly speedy, clear and supportive

records.title: Easy, friendly and fast.
records.text: Very convenient and simple.

records.title: Worked smoothly
records.text: I booked a fit-to-fly antigen test for travel to the USA.The test arrived in the post, and I booked a video appointment for my test to be observed for the day before my flight. The video appointment worked for me and the medical practitioner joined the call on time, and gave clear instructions about how to complete the test. After the test I was issued with a certificate.

records.title: Useful, reliable service
records.text: Great service, easy to use. The physician at the appointment was very helpful and changed details for us last minute. Only reason for 4 stars is that when I had to call the company at one point, the options to get through to someone were very unclear and I was on hold for quite a long time. Once through, the lady on the phone was very helpful but it was quite tricky getting through in the first place.

records.title: Highly recommend.
records.text: Highly recommend.Some how my video consultant test was booked in the UK in Amercan timezone which was a scare on the day I was to fly.  My 8.20 am appointment came up as 4.20 pm on the day.Once I contacted the company they dealt with it very quickly and couldn't have been nicer.  Within the hour I had my test completed.

records.title: Quick and easy.
records.text: Booked about a month in advance and wondered if it was real but got a reminder text the day before the appointment. On the day we activated the link and there was a Dr on screen. The Dr told us what to do and verified what we did. The Dr verified the test cassette and sent us our certificates. The Dr then stayed on line until we confirmed receipt of the Certs. Very easy just nerve racking waiting for the swab result.

records.title: Browser issues
records.text: Anita, our medical practitioner was brilliant, very patient especially as we had problems with the technology. Our phones couldn't support the browser. It would have been useful to have been told to check this before the appointment rather than when we checked in 5 minutes before the appointment. This left us panicked trying to set  up the laptop. Anita was very understanding, thank you.

records.title: I have increased my previous rating
records.text: I have increased my previous rating to 3 because after some time I was able to rebook my appointment at no extra cost. There is a problem with the internal system that tells the doctor that you have not connected to your video call even when you have clicked on the link sent to you.

records.title: Process to take rapid test was…brilliant
records.text: Process to take rapid test was brilliant. However on completion I had a small query and sent an e-mail, left a voice message and did not receive any response whatsoever. Phoning just gave me 3 options and in each case I was diverted to a voicemail box. Poor after sales spoilt what would have been a great experience

records.title: Email link didn't work at first - use a PC
records.text: Test kits arrived quickly and email reminders were good.However, when we tried to use the link in the email on an iPad using Edge or a phone using Edge, there was a message saying that this browser was not supported, only Edge, Chrome etc were supported. Even when we used a pc the link didn't work at first. A different link was sent by email then it worked fine,Overall a reasonable service but stressful when the link didn't work on 3 different types of device.

records.title: Not a secure process
records.text: The process was easy to book, except that their system made me book and pay separately for my wife. At the test, their system kept dropping out, even though I have excellent wifi and ultrafast fibre. After the 10–minute pause, they had to call me to ask me to restart my browser and then we had a couple of further dropouts. How did the doctor know that the negative test I showed him was the same one that I took out of the box? He didn’t record its serial number. They’re just doing lip-service with this test.

records.title: We paid for boxed set of 5 tests at…
records.text: We paid for boxed set of 5 tests at about £25...once had them I saw the same set for £9.80 in Boots! RIP off price for our tests. We then paid separately for a video Covid test 24 hours before our flight, again paid and was stressful waiting but had our appt on time, lady who did it was polite and efficient....but this is he US wasting our money, airlines just do a quick random check of our email result...

records.title: Booked and paid for a test to New York…
records.text: Booked and paid for a test to New York USA . The usa stopped the need for a test to enter the day before the appointment. No mention of a refund or to cancel the consultation ???? Plus we where placed on hold screen blank so we could have swaped the test or falsified the result but the doctor or health advisor was polite and to the point.

records.title: The system was glitchy and service basic
records.text: The call connected but then kept disconnecting at first, which is disconcerting taking into account the importance of the call. I Would not have used this service if I didn’t have to. Simple as that.  No high scores required. Definitely Money for old rope. No reason I couldn’t have used my own test kit from NHS (with its own official barcode to check validity) and been observed rather than have to buy one from them and pay again to be witnessed.

records.title: Confusing scheduling process
records.text: The appointment itself went very well although we did have some technical troubles. The practitioner was helpful, efficient, and friendly.Scheduling the appointment was very difficult--the fields that require input were sometimes confusing for a non-British English speaker. It's also frustrating to have to purchase the appointment time before you see availability; I ran into an issue originally where I paid for a test time but there were no time slots available.

records.title: Using the service
records.text: Using the service, the confirmation emails were never  received. I also checked my SPAM folder and did not find the emails in that location either.  Please can you try to improve your email process so that emails are sent with higher confidence?  Or offer a method to send the confirmation by text message (SMS)

records.title: Ordered my order on line for 4 tests…
records.text: Ordered my order on line for 4 tests and the video call and paid about £88.Unfortunately my test never came they got sent somewhere else but when I enquired about them to your customer service line to ask about it and asked you to check you had my right details I got told that it was fine and the Royal Mail had them so didn’t find you very helpful with that and that we didn’t receive my tests and had to go out and buy another set of tests for my family.

records.title: Process was very slick but only after I…
records.text: Process was very slick but only after I opened my browser on my laptop as Safari was not supported via the link.  They say you don’t need to download any software for the video call but it would be helpful to advise what software is supported as this would have saved some panic on my part and a false start for the medical professional on the other side.

records.title: The video came on quickly and we were…
records.text: The video came on quickly and we were greeted by one of your male colleague’s who I have to say for the entirety of the video consultation was not very friendly. The video went off a couple of times abs we definitely weren’t logged in with any other device. The gentleman just seemed to have an unfortunate manner which is a shame as I has heard good things about some of your colleagues. I found the process to be extremely stressful and having more of an understanding person on your end would have helped

records.title: Get your passport ready too.
records.text: Found it difficult to understand the lady who had a bad cough and was coughing without her hand over her mouth.  Also I had to get my granddaughter to help me as I had to find my passport which it didn’t say on the form and as packing for my trip tomorrow to Canada really stressed me out.  Did not feel relaxed at all as found it all quite stressful.

records.title: Good and not so good
records.text: Four antigen tests Arrived in plenty of time. Did as they said and did not open until our video call started and one test package had no liquid which was distressing so was told to use one of ours if we had one! luckily we did!! Makes a mockery of not opening the package as would null and void the test!! Otherwise all went smoothly and fast results

records.title: Incorrect booking appts given - corrected quickly
records.text: The booking system books your appointment for today and not the selected day! Now the tests have been rejected. Try to call them on 0333 014 3760 and all the options will cut out or tell you mailbox is full. To be fair to DocHQ Team, they have been able to get this resolved and send an new appt notice, it is Easter Sunday aswell. Look forward to having the appt.

records.title: From USA service was rubbish lost my money on wasted appt
records.text: Very good service very impressed and gentleman talked us through procedure, did have tech problem but he phoned back and sent new link great, unfortunately in USA trying to book one over there different sorry could not get any advice mailbox full text help was no good or not answered made an appointment for 930 am and they video called me 430am and missed call again could not get in contact

records.title: The lady was absolutely charming and…
records.text: The lady was absolutely charming and helpful, however when I opened the kit the solution was missing. Fortunately I had some spare NHS kits so was able to use the solution from there. Easily sorted although if I didn’t have any spare kits it would have been a problem. Excellent service otherwise. Thank you to the lady for all her help, really appreciated.

records.title: Online test
records.text: We booked two online test. 1st one no problem at all getting the test done but we were told within 30min we would get an email with the results. After 6 hours we send an email, 7 hours we received it. 2nd time we waited an hour in a queue for them to answer. The test is very easy. The practitioner was very helpful trying to get our email through while he was online to us but couldn’t. We received it a few hours after the call.

records.title: The test was no problem  the medical…
records.text: The test was no problem  the medical staff were excellent.  But.  We were told to expect the E mail within 20 minutes. it did not arrive until 9 am the next day  4 hours before our flight which caused a lot of stress.  We were unable to contact you by phone as it was always busy.  The QR code was not recognized by Verifly and we could not manually enter the details as the test was taken the day before.

records.title: Relatively easy, but practitioner wasn't very engaged and it didn't feel very rigorous
records.text: The actual receiving and taking of the test was easy, but the practitioner wasn't particularly engaged and didn't seem to take too much notice of the test as it was taken. Being put on hold for 10 minutes was concerning, as the person taking the test could do anything this time (e.g. swapping out the test for another one), and overall the process didn't feel very robust or thorough.

records.title: Missing test results
records.text: I didn’t get my covid results so made for a really stressful experience. I emailed as there was no other way to contact. Phone number didn’t work internationally and web chat was down. After around 12 hours I had my reply and got the vouchers just in time.

records.title: Ordered two lateral flow tests to…
records.text: Ordered two lateral flow tests to travel to USA which arrived but there was only one test. Tried to contact without success. Emailed and was given a reference number (auto ) but never got a reply. Then USA dropped the requirement for the test. Wrote to the company for whether i could return the test and get a refund. No reply. So we decided to take the test on the assigned date and time. The medical professional supervising the test was good. Mentioned to her that there was only one test kit we received. She suggested we could use any NHS test kit we had. She said she will make a note of it and nothing has happened

records.title: Nice little earner for Boris’ mates
records.text: Very efficient BUT you pay first and only then see appt times which for us were all really limited. Horribly over-priced service capitalising on the current regs and opportunities. Supervised by a doctor? Not convinced. She was lovely though. Camera off for 10 minutes during appt ( while results emerged) when we could have switched results with ‘one done earlier’. Oh well, more money for Boris’ mates.

records.title: I paid for 4 tests with two video calls…
records.text: I paid for 4 tests with two video calls on two different days. The first video call fo me and my Husband was great, the lady was fantastic and my review would have been 5 stars. After paying for the second two tests and video call there were no video times on the day we needed even though it was over a week away. I tried to get a time on the required day but couldn’t so had to ask for a refund. This was done but I did not receive a full refund as I was charged a £5 admin fee. I think this is bad as I only cancelled because you couldn’t provide the service I paid for.

records.title: Ok to book on line
records.text: Ok to book on line, but wanted to change my appointment time only for the system to cancel it. Only wanted to see if l could amend then it cost me £15 to rebook. Far to easy to cancel. Needs to be additional confirmation if you really want to cancel. Shame as rest of service excellent 😏

records.title: Late and a little rude.
records.text: My practitioner was 10 minutes late to the appointment and was quite disinterested and rude when I asked questions. There also seems to be a lack of consistency as the rest of my family were just asked to provide passport numbers and I was asked to prove my identity with mine.

records.title: Delayed results!
records.text: Test were ordered and conducted timely, however the person conducting test seemed disinterested and didn’t really check what we were doing.  We were told results would be emailed within 15 mins but didn’t receive results for about 12 hours and couldn’t get hold of anyone via phone or email so had to arrange alternative tests. We were lucky we managed to do this 1 day before our flight. We wrote an email to complain and tests were refunded as requested.

records.title: Could be better...
records.text: Actual test was fine but very disappointed to find afterwards that not directly compatible with Verifly App. Attempted to call for support (don't bother, there is no one there apart from an answer phone). No reply by email. Eventually worked out that needed to attach PDF by blind determination and luck. Really not a positive experience and made the whole procedure much more stressful than it needed to be.

records.title: Poor contact upon incomplete certificates
records.text: Testing process was good as were comms leading up to the test.However, in a party of 4 only 3 certificates were originally received, unable to contact via phone, chat, email etc, causing an massive amount of stress.Thankfully was resolved in a few hours (as certificate turned up), but was due to fly out the next day and was in the process of booking another test elsewhere.

records.title: “Medical Professional” was late, unenthusiastic and unthorough”
records.text: Our appointment was at 11.20 so we joined at 11.15 and waited. A disheveled-looking young woman finally turned up at 11.35 with no apology. She said we weren’t on the call when she checked at 11.20. She looked like she may have just woken up. She asked for our passport numbers and date of birth, then we did the test and she watched us swab our nostrils. She then disappeared for 20 more minutes, during which time she emailed our certificates before she even asked to see the test results. We could have been anyone and we could have easily cheated the test in so many ways.
