records.title: A really great place
records.text: I’ve visited Bedford three times, first for an early viability scan, then a dating scan and finally a gender scan + NIPT test. The staff are super professional and lovely to speak to, and every single visit has been so much fun. I am very grateful!

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service, staff very friendly and helpful.

records.title: The best sonographer!
records.text: This was my second visit in three years and it was worth every penny. Neither appointment was pregnancy related (one was a soft tissue lump and the other was pelvic) but how I wish I had known about this place and the wonderful sonographer when I was pregnant! She is incredibly knowledgeable and patient, she took time to show me what she saw and explained in detail, answering every question -  genuinely trying to help me. I’ve had ultrasounds at Harley Street and private hospitals (charging a fortune) but no one took the time or had the patience to listen and then explain their findings. I am so grateful, it was a very stressful time and I was anxious but the professional, calm and caring approach made a huge difference. The NHS waiting times are months and I was able to make a booking for the following day! I will definitely go back, if I need to. The whole place is a little gem, also the lady at reception was lovely. I also love the fact there are no hidden costs, you know what you pay for. That cannot be said about private hospitals. Thank you. I cannot recommend enough.

records.title: Excellent service, fair price, efficient
records.text: I visited the Ultrasound Direct branch near Mansion House tube station, London today for an "abdominal ultrasound" scan. Overall, I received excellent service - very easy booking process, fair price (I paid £145), and good treatment during the scan. It took about 15 mins, and the sonographer explained what she was looking at during the scans etc. 5 minutes after leaving the clinic, I received an SMS with a link which had about 25+ photos of my scans and a report on the findings. I will now forward these to my GP. Very happy and impressed with the company.

records.title: Portsmouth clinic review
records.text: Me and my partner have been to ultrasound direct for 5 private scans so far, they’ve seen us through uncertain times at 5 weeks to reassurance scans up until 12 weeks till today our gender scan at 16 weeks, every sonographer we have had has made us feel welcome and comfortable from the reception room to the ultrasound room! Every staff member makes you feel at ease and safe when there! I couldn’t recommend ultrasound direct enough! They’ve made my journey being pregnant a lot more reassured and special! The only private ultrasound clinic I will ever go to! They are just amazing!

records.title: I had a great experience at ultrasound…
records.text: I had a great experience at ultrasound direct in Manchester. My ultrasound technician was Neelam. She did a wonderful job at explaining everything to me. I definitely recommend her! Thank you!

records.title: 4D Bonding Scan
records.text: I recently had a 4D bonding scan at Dundee Ultrasound Direct, and it was an amazing experience! The sonographer was incredibly lovely and patient, making sure to get a perfect view of my baby boy. Her persistence paid off, and we were able to see him clearly. It was such a special moment that I'll cherish forever. Highly recommend Dundee Ultrasound Direct for their exceptional service and care!

records.title: Always amazing
records.text: Had a reassurance early scan and also a gender scan here, Gill and Vicky were amazing always make the experience so special. We asked them to wrap up a pink or blue teddy bear for us to reveal our baby’s gender at home and she wrapped up so well so the surprise was so special. Always so excited at the front desk. Been here for all my previous pregnancy scans too, wouldn’t go anywhere else :)

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Went for an early viability scan in Hammersmith and the staff were friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Clean and modern waiting and appointment room. Lots of pictures and videos from the scan available afterwards. The only downside was no measure of fetal heart rate was given - this is done for early scans at the hospital so was hoping to get this information too.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Such a lovely visit here after a scare during pregnancy. Both staff members were so welcoming and friendly. Didn’t feel rushed at all and everything was spoken through in detail. Will be returning for another scan soon.

records.title: Lovely experience
records.text: Had an early 6 weeks ultrasound scan at the Swindon branch. The scan was carried out by a lovely lady called Jane. She was very kind and answered any questions we had. The sitting room and clinical areas were very clean and it was friendly relaxed environment. Also the receptionist was very friendly and explained everything that was going to happen on our visit. You get given some free photos which is great but only downside is they do a video of the heart flutter but you have to log in to an account and they make you pay for the video if you want it. I just feel like after you've paid £70 for a scan (which only takes about 10minutes) it's cheeky to then try get you to pay for video.

records.title: Friendly atmosphere
records.text: I have been to this place numerous times and it has always been a good experience. The sonographer was informative, welcoming and friendly. I'm giving 4 stars only because my appointment was postponed last minute, 30 mins before the planned appointment, and that had an impact on my plans that day.

records.title: Staff were really lovely and a nice…
records.text: Staff were really lovely and a nice environment. However, felt slightly disappointed that no one told us that we would have to pay further costs for the photos after spending £75 already.

records.title: No fault!
records.text: The waiting room had refreshments and suitable for other young kids. I loved the fact I can bring upto 5people. Baby was not in a great position for 4D scan and we were offered a chance for another scan / partial refund.

records.title: New location not ready
records.text: The girls doing the scan were so nice and very accommodating when i arrived very late. It was so diffulicult to find the building as signage has not been displayed on the new shop and the email and message I received had old eircodes. Phone numbers were referring me to belfast which was not helpful as they were also unsure of where to find the building

records.title: Reassuring but not very private
records.text: It was reassuring to be able to get a scan at 9 weeks and the lady doing the scanning gave us a good amount of time to see the baby's heartbeat and it moving around which was lovely - great to have the printed scan photos too. The place itself is in a building with lots of other organisations and not very private - you eave the scan room straight into the building reception - so I'm not convinced the experience would be very nice if it wasn't good news.

records.title: Staff were lovely and made me feel…
records.text: Staff were lovely and made me feel comfortable. The scan was very thorough and sonographer explained everything I was seeing. The location was extremely difficult to find.

records.title: Good experience at early viability scan
records.text: My husband and I had an early viability scan with ultrasound direct. The scan was shorter than we expected (we paid for 20 mins but were only in there for 10), but it was lovely to see our little baby’s heartbeat, we just wish we could have stayed longer.

records.title: Overall very good and efficient.
records.text: While the environment is basic, it was clean. The receptionist and the sonographer were both friendly and the scan was thorough and well explained, with almost instant printed results. Blood test results the next day. I would go there again if I have the need. The only slightly negative thing was both the receptionist, and on one occasion the sonographer (though not during the scan) answering their mobile phones in the middle of my talking to them, which I felt was not ideal.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, friendly staff.  Only downside I would say is if not a local difficult to find, building not very well advertised.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service. Really listened to what we wanted and were super kind and reassuring. Disappointed we didn't get a follow up discount code to use in future.

records.title: Excellent professional and friendly…
records.text: Excellent professional and friendly service at Ultrasound Direct, Canterbury. Visited several times this month for fertility scans during IVF. Cannot recommended the team highly enough. Would give five starts but giving four as the price as it is a little steep compared to competitors. However, it is worth it for how the staff make you comfortable and offer their care and expertise.

records.title: Quick appointment availability
records.text: Quick appointment availability. Very thorough scan carried out by sonographer. Result provided on the day. Full set of photographs cost an extra £10

records.title: They were friendly,dedicated, respectfu and they also keep to time.l
records.text: They are dedicated and they keep to time. It was indeed a nice experience.

records.title: The experience was amazing.
records.text: The experience was amazing. The lady behind the desk when you enter was incredibly lovely, and also very informative. The lady doing the scan was lovely also, explaining everything she was looking at in the scan. The whole experience was lovely. The only thing that could be improved, is you get sent a link afterwards with all your scan photos on, but nobody says anything about you having to pay extra to see these photos.

records.title: I love the personal experience they…
records.text: I love the personal experience they give you to have your children come in with you. The room is lovely and the TV to watch is a perfect touch.The only negative thing is paying for the images separately which seems a little excessive for the price paid.

records.title: We’ve had a great experience with…
records.text: We’ve had a great experience with ultrasound direct and I’d really recommend them!The only thing to mention is that they offer the 4D ultra sound up to 34 weeks and we went at 33 and we couldn’t see our baby clearly cause it’s squashed in there!  They offered us a rescan which was great but it couldn’t be at our local one and it had to be during the week which wasn’t possible for us due to work.

records.title: Their service was amazing,i appreciate…
records.text: Their service was amazing,i appreciate all their friendly service.Thank you

records.title: Not a great experience.
records.text: The three stars is for the customer service on the phone, the woman sorted my appointment and explained everything perfect couldn’t fault the service. However when I actually went for the blood test, a service I had to pay for getting a ruptured vein where the nurse went in and out the other side wasn’t the best. Had a tracking bruise all up my arm for over a week couldn’t train or anything! I’m a youngish male who uses the gym frequently wasn’t hard to find the vein the nurse even said that herself. Had numerous blood tests and never reacted or experienced the pain and damage that I did during this one.

records.title: The clinic and staff were lovely and we…
records.text: The clinic and staff were lovely and we had an excellent experience whilst there. The deduction of two stars was that we had to pay an extra £10 for our digital images, which was the only way of accessing the video of our baby's heartbeat. Seeing as we paid £75 for the appointment, I had expected that the images would be included in that price.

records.title: Weekend staff and service not as nice
records.text: This is our second appointment and it was on a weekend. Compared to the 5 star review I gave last week, the difference in service is significant. The receptionist was not welcoming, charged me for the full price without checking first that I have already paid the deposit, and was very distracted whilst dealing with me during check in. The sonographer only saw us for 5 mins and minimal effort was made in comparison to our first appointment, understandably and possibly as she was only doing overtime that day.This definitely made up my mind about booking slots over the weekend, I will still come back but will inquire if the better staff Corrine and Sarah and ensure I only book when they are there.

records.title: A scan with an Attitude
records.text: I recently went for a scan at Ultrasound direct Prestwich, Manchester. I was greeted by a very nice receptionist but the lady that performed the Ultrasound was very rude and abrupt with no bedside manner whatsoever. when I tried to ask a question it was always answered with an attitude, if I moved slightly or was asked to move it was always with a stern tone. I am glad I had the scan and it answered some questions but when stating my concerns to the lady that performed the Ultrasound it was answered with, "well I'm not a Doctor am I so you will have to go and speak to them." Thank you for performing the scan I am very grateful, but please learn some bedside manners it goes a long way.

records.title: A scan with an Attitude.
records.text: All I can say is that I'm glad I had the scan as it answered some questions. As for the staff it was a tale of 2 stories. The receptionist was very pleasant but the lady that performed the ultrasound was very rude and abrupt. All I can say is she needs to learn some bedside manners, it goes a long way.

records.title: Place was nice and clean and staff were…
records.text: Place was nice and clean and staff were polite and friendly. Scan helped us to date the pregnancy and reassured the quality of scan and photos were not the best so we wouldn't return for that reason. Because pregnancy was only 8 weeks it wasn't very clear to see on an abdominal scan. We would've maybe been able to see things more detailed if we were given transvaginal but we weren't offered this. Appointment felt a little rushed because I think we were the last appointment of the day, again maybe why we werent offered transvaginal. Disappointing because we had such lovely memories of our two visits to the bedlington clinic with our last pregnancy atleast we could see we had a heartbeat today i suppose!

records.title: Excellent service, but fees are now unreasonable
records.text: Absolutely brilliant service from Corrine at the Poole clinic as usual, this was our 10th visit across 3 pregnancies. However, we aren’t fans of the continuous price increases. Not only have the costs of scans gone up across the board (which we think is fair given the costs of everything going up) you also now have to pay £10 to access your digital images too. Previously this was included in your scan fee.

records.title: Went for gender scan which the website…
records.text: Went for gender scan which the website states will last 15 mins however we where in and out in 3-4minutes... fair enough we seen the bits right away but we felt very rushed compared to the 2 previous visits where the girls took there time. I also brought my 9 yr old and was more disappointed for her cos it was so quick and rushed for her. Had been at 8 wks and 12 wks and was pleased with the service but this time was bit disappointing

records.title: Wouldn’t wait 5 mins for my husband to…
records.text: Wouldn’t wait 5 mins for my husband to arrive as he was stuck in traffic due to an accident so he missed the scan. Was happy for the next people to go ahead as they was there waiting but they said no

records.title: The staff arrived at 11:15
records.text: The staff arrived at 11:15, there was myself and another man waiting for 11am appointments. They made no apology to either of us.

records.title: Sadly not the great review I’d hoped to…
records.text: Sadly not the great review I’d hoped to give. I was very much looking forward to this appointment but was left quite disappointed by the environment the clinic was set in and also how rushed my appointment was. We were there less than 10 minutes and I just felt it wasn’t the experience I expected given how much I’d paid (£75).

records.title: The actual scan was amazing
records.text: The actual scan was amazing, sonographer was incredible. However, the new location is not something I love. Before it was on an off street, very discreet. Now it’s in the town centre, you have to knock on the door outside and wait to be let in. I don’t think this is an ideal location for anyone wanting to keep the pregnancy low key.

records.title: Waiting
records.text: When we arrived we were advised that the sonographer was running 15 minutes late so we went for a walk. Upon arriving back the receptionist was then upstairs chaperoning for an additional 10 minutes which meant the door was locked and we were unable to enter. This left us outside in the hot sun with no shade, no where to sit down and a very full bladder fit to burst in preparation for a scan.

records.title: Privacy and confidentiality could be…
records.text: Privacy and confidentiality could be improved - I could see names of other people coming in for later scans while I was laying on the bed.I had to shut the door myself prior to the discussion about the scan results.I wasn't given privacy as I got unchanged, aside from sonographer turning her head.The toilets had no lock on the door.

records.title: Felt rushed for the price point and…
records.text: Felt rushed for the price point and then had to pay £10 extra to get the pictures in digital felt it was not worth the money and staff didn't seem to care thought there would be more enthusiasm as we were seeing our baby for the first time. I know it doesn't matter for them but does to us

records.title: Should have given report in writing
records.text: With pictures should have given report in writing

records.title: Predatory business practices
records.text: We’ve had 2 scans from ultrasound direct and the end of our second scan left a bad taste. The clinical staff were excellent, friendly and knowledgeable worthy a 5 star review.In between our two scans the company changed policy so rather than digital imaging and reports being available for free, they are instead charging £9.99 for them. This change was something staff were apologetic about, clearly embarrassed. This change was hidden in the fine print with pages still clearly mentioning digital media without mentioning it costs extra. The changes towards a more predatory business model isn’t something I can endorse.

records.title: Very professional but too quick!
records.text: Everything was handled very professionally and the sonographer was very friendly and got some great pics of baby. However we weren’t even in the building for 10 minutes so felt rushed out and I felt I didn’t have enough time with baby. The appointment slot states it is a 15 minute appointment which I definitely didn’t get for £95.

records.title: Booked for a twin scan
records.text: Booked for a twin scan, didn’t even know because they didn’t check so feel like we was giving the right amount of time. Only got a few pictures unlike the other branch we used and on top of paying the amount we did it said we had to pay more for having the photos on our phones where as the other branches are free

records.title: Wasn't as good as last experience with…
records.text: Wasn't as good as last experience with themParking has completely put me off going back

records.title: Incorrect gender reveal pack
records.text: the sonographer and assistant were both lovely and made us feel comfortable and assured. We booked the 16 week gender reveal package and we were told at the scan we were having a baby girl however the scratch card as part of the package said we were having a boy which was very confusing for us and our family when our confetti cannon was pink for a girl.

records.title: Barrow Location
records.text: Not a very nice facility. The initial experience was not great, waiting room chairs filthy with animal hair, wanted to take a note of all my bank card details but I did a bank transfer instead.I would have rated it one star but it felt unfair to the sonographer who was nice and we saw what we wanted to see.But I won’t be back and we’ve since booked with Bay Ultrasound. My advice is, if you want a nice experience from start to finish on what should be a special occasion - avoid.Reply: completely cannot believe that you regularly clean. The seats weren’t just lightly covered in hair and dirt from general use. Also, if you are equipped to handle transactions in a normal retail manner, you shouldn’t need to take a note of my long card number, expiry and CVC.Please avoid this place. It’s awful.

records.title: So this was difficult but employees good
records.text: So this was difficult.  The company were excellent in booking a scan really quickly when NHS failed so I would rate 5.  The employees were fantastic- would rate 5.  But I asked for results to be emailed to my doctor and was not told that they would need to pay and how difficult it would be for doctor.  This resulted in delays and even more stress.  Had I been  better informed I could have sorted it myself

records.title: Gender revealed :(
records.text: I booked a gender reveal scan so I was not suppose to find out the gender during the scan. The sonographer turned the screen off while she identified the gender which was as expected. When she turned it back on to have a look at the baby, the sex was displayed on the screen. She also went on to say ‘These are HER hands’ which also gave away the gender of the baby. This completely ruined the surprise element that we had planned for our gender reveal party and what should’ve been a really exciting moment was spoilt.

records.title: We have used ultrasound direct before…
records.text: We have used ultrasound direct before in a previous pregnancy so was expecting it to be as special as it was the previous time but unfortunately not so much. This is my 3rd and final pregnancy and I decided to book a private scan and invite my family to come something that I haven’t done before. On entering the receptionist was ok a little blunt but I brushed it off. We was 10 mins early and they invited us up straight away. We went up for our scan and the sonograph lady was just so blunt and low key rude the whole time. And the scan was so rushed. I left feeling very disappointed in the whole experience and sad. I will definitely not be returning or recommending this place.

records.title: I've had 2 scans here
records.text: I've had 2 scans here - 2 years apart - paid private out of desperation.  Both times it was difficult to get an electronic copy of my results.  The first time I didn't get any results at the time and had to chase the company to get my results sent to me.  The second time I got a paper copy of my results and was told I would get a link to download an electronic copy (for £9.99!).  I still haven't had the link.  The thing that annoys me the most is that the clinic that does the scans has no phone number or email so you have to ring Ultrasound Direct - but there is no phone number on their website! It's an awful service considering the cost and the stress caused by waiting for information.

records.title: Very disappointed
records.text: Very disappointed, used this service (aberdeen) for my son 2 years ago and loved the experience! So booked for my current pregnancy. Felt very rushed, 5minutes in and out and one look at gender. No little video like with my son, imagines weren't great at all. Sonographer pushing extremely hard on stomach also to the point I was tender the next day! Overall disappointed and wouldn't recommend

records.title: The nurse thought it was the wrong…
records.text: The nurse thought it was the wrong scan, wrote in-correct notes and told us wrong information about future scans. Didn’t leave us with much confidence. The reception team have been lovely however the nurse (who we had on two occasions) didn’t fill us with much confidence unfortunately.

records.title: Felt unprofessional
records.text: Waiting area tiny, could hear other scans taking placeScanner not in scrubs felt unprofessional.Screen in room tiny. Would feel uncomfortably small with more than one other person present Reception staff wearing north face outside coat.Having been to other clinics as part of this chain it felt like here was the poor relative Will not use again

records.title: A disappointing experience from me this time
records.text: My most recent experience at Ultrasound Direct was unfortunately not positive. I have been here previously and received a much better experience hence my return. However on this occasion, I was attending for reassurance of a viable pregnancy after having two miscarriages previously. First of all, the sonographer did not take any time to try and ask/listen/understand my reasoning for being there. I found the appointment very underwhelming even though we found out great news. As someone who was really anxious leading up to the appointment, I was met with comments such as “well things look ok for now being as early as you are” (9 weeks pregnant) but also a comment of “your uterus is a very odd shape so I’m trying my best”. Again as someone who has experienced multiple miscarriages and was after reassurance, I’m not entirely sure that I got that, even though I was able to see a heartbeat and a viable pregnancy. This is such a shame as I will also be wanting to have an early gender scan, should all continue well with this pregnancy. I do have a daughter and have had a gender scan here before but based on my most recent experience, I will be looking elsewhere for the gender scan. This is a shame as I have also recommended this place to several people in the past but I won’t be doing that again. The two stars are because the facility itself is great and you go get several pictures so it deserves some stars for that. However certainly lost the other three stars based on the way I have been left feeling afterwards. Also very disappointed that you now have to pay £10 extra to see your digital photos. This was not the case previously.

description: ExpressTest by Cignpost Diagnostics is a COVID-19 testing service providing fast, accurate and reliable PCR screening across the UK. It is a programme that is run by the direct to consumer division of Cignpost Diagnostics Limited.

records.title: Amanda (blond lady) Carina test lab…
records.text: Amanda (blond lady) at the Birmingham AirPort was amazing! She took me and my disabled mum out of the line and helpend us with the Corona test when Nobody  else did. Such a Nice and patiënt lady, Thank you So muchMarlene Roodbol from Holland

records.title: Quick and easy
records.text: Very easy to book, convenient location at the airport T3. We arrived there was no queue, just needed to present QR code and passport. Actual test took less than a minute, the lady was very calming, professional and gentle! I booked the same day test and had the results super quick in a few hours. Highly recommend Express Test

records.title: Best testing company
records.text: As testing now seems to be winding down I'd just like to say ExpressTest has been the best testing company for me by far, for Value for moneyQuick and efficent resultsFriendly and professional staffResolving all issues promptly and fairly

records.title: Staff was very helpful
records.text: Staff was very helpful. five star ratings fr that at heathrow airport.my family frinds were flying back home and their card was not wrking for unknown resons for payments. so hve to go at airport and did the card payment as they dont accept cash which is a drwaback for people stranded at airpot from other countries but afterr that their efficiency was world class

records.title: how comfortable the test was made
records.text: i was a bit apprehensive before i went in having seen some u tube test being done and worring about having a thing stuck up my nose near it reach my brain.but it was done i was Delight tingly surprised how comfortable it was done  .

records.title: Quick and painless!
records.text: No issues at all with my fit to fly covid test which I had booked online for testing at Terminal 4, Heathrow. On arrival I found there was no queue so I was tested straightaway, and I then went off for a coffee while I waited for the result, due to be sent by email. Fortunately it was negative and I was therefore ‘Fit to Fly’ - and off I went, up, up, and away! Thank you Express Test.

records.title: Very helpful staff
records.text: The gentleman was really helpful with the information I needed.  He also advised me that I was booking my test too early because the hour of the test matters.

records.title: We have done our PCR test in last…
records.text: We have done our PCR test in last minutes after finding out that PCR test was required on the flight. We went to this place and staff guided us all the way. Staff was knowledgeable,friendly and helpful,(i wish i couldrememberher name).  We had to book it online and made payment online. They done the test straight away, We were told that the result will be delivered in 4h but we received email with results in 2h and 15 minutes. Good service and highly recommended.  5 starts

records.title: Brilliant
records.text: I arrived at heathrow terminal 4 at 4 hours before departure, my vaccination status was not accepted by the Qatar airways, i rushed to the express testing center within the terminal. I had no prior booking. The staff assisted me with booking whike the other prepared the test realising that i did notbhave enough time and i might actually miss my flight. My COVID was done within 2 hours which was excellent and i caught my flight.Superb experience.Thank you

records.title: Very friendly and obliging, all staff…
records.text: Very friendly and obliging all staff members at LHR 5. What I would’ve also liked to get was a PCR result which showed the numerical value of the CT score. That assists in knowing whether one is on the margin or whether trace detectable. It helps better understand false positives and false negatives.  I think the PCR test should actually have the numerical value on it and advice as to what the cut off threshold is thought or deemed to be.  Thank you.

records.title: Good
records.text: I have used them a few times, prompt delivery.

records.title: 4 stars for speedy test results
records.text: Only reason for providing 4 stars was, we received the test results before the anticipated time of 4 hours.But, from user experience perspective, the process has to be simplified. I was asked to create the profile at the last moment by providing the details, which took me more time.

records.title: Team great but too expensive
records.text: The team got us through very quickly and efficiently, when we didn’t have much time to get our flight.  Very pleased with the service we received from the staff.However for the company in general the tests are completely overpriced and unsure why the wait is 25 minutes when all other Rapid Antigens are usually 15 minutes to read the result.

records.title: Lower Price
records.text: Staff is nice, professional and helpful, quickly for whole  test, it is a good experience, next time will also book your company

records.title: Overall fantastic service
records.text: Everything to do with the Staff, test centre and process was excellent. Only dropped 1x star because of the difficulty of changing from one Heathrow test centre to another Heathrow test centre more than 24 hours out on the website ( have to cancel and rebook at a higher price) - which meant I didn't do it even though changing would have suited my changed requirements.

records.title: Apart from getting to a mezzanine floor…
records.text: Apart from getting to a mezzanine floor where the test unit was, experience was smooth.

records.title: The assistant was helpful and acted…
records.text: The assistant was helpful and acted promptly.The limited time available on the registration web page should be extended.

records.title: Smooth Express Testing The staff we met on the day were…
records.text: The staff we met on the day were friendly, helpful & efficient. The whole experience went really smoothly.

records.title: Fast but may be too fast
records.text: It was quick and easily done. The results arrived as promised within 40 minutes. I did not feel the swab was used in a very accurate way. And I did not see the result with my eyes.

records.title: Very easy to make an appointment no…
records.text: Very easy to make an appointment no waiting straight in had test done and straight out waiting for your results very nerve racking even though had been testing myself all week before I arrived for my test what really got me was paying £45 for a simple LFT which I was doing for 7 days and it did not cost me a penny

records.title: Quick and easy response time
records.text: Quick and easy response time. Received my results within the expected time period before my plane departure. The main issues I had were with the limited test centres available of which some already closed down , limiting me to come to the London area. Good services offered and recommended.

records.title: fast management of the test
records.text: fast management of the tesr

records.title: The service worked quite well
records.text: The service worked quite well:  pretty fast and efficient.  Only quibble was that it was a bit hard to find the testing facility since it had been moved at Heathrow Terminal 3, and it’s new location was not well indicated.

records.title: Efficient Covid test centre
records.text: Let down by another well known pharmacy we were in a position where we needed a fit to fly lateral flow test the evening before a morning flight. We searched Google and found Express test at the airport that my son was flying out of. Completed the online application the evening before and it literally took 5minutes at the airport to do the actual test. Within 30m I received the email confirming the result including the certificate. It was all very efficient and while it cost more than other places, it was done at the airport so no extra travelling involved. I knocked off a star because the person administering the test was quite rough and my 14 year old child said it hurt, which of course a nasal swab test should not. Would I use them again? Most definitely, yes.

records.title: Service good; directions bad
records.text: Service was very good but the signposting was bad. It took me ages to find.

records.title: Taking the test was perfectly efficient…
records.text: Taking the test was perfectly efficient but bearing in mind how few tests are needed now and I saw nobody else waiting for a test in the centre it was disappointing to have to wait 28 hours for the result.

records.title: Easy to book
records.text: Easy to book. Found place easy as I used Birmingham airport they offer reduction for parking. The place is in the building opposite the airport departure terminal. Quick covid test on Sunday morning at 10:30am arrived 10 mins early was seen straight away and received results next day at 10:30 am assuming they were not busy. Remember to take passport with you.

records.title: Expensive but quick and reliable service
records.text: I took my test in clinic at 2.45pm, it took a couple of minutes and I had the results and fit to fly certificate within 24 hrs. The certificate was accepted in my country of travel so all good. Just a shame it’s so expensive. I wish I’d booked the day before as left it and it went up another £10 if you booked on the day.

records.title: The result was not approved by Japanese…
records.text: The result was not approved by Japanese government soon. It was necessary to show the result to staff of airline and immigration office.

records.title: Very expensive but they were good and…
records.text: Very expensive but they were good and fast.

records.title: The shops are top end designer- alas the restaurants aren’t.
records.text: The shops are top end designer. However the restaurants are bog standard. This is a mismatch. Why appeal to big spenders in shops then serve them bland tasteless food. You need another Gordon Ramsey Plane Food at terminal 3 too.

records.title: Very bad online payment experience
records.text: I opted for this test for my son and when I tried to make online payment, payment failed for the first 5-6 times with the message saying that "Too many people trying to book online/due to heavy load unable to process your request". It was working for others at the same time and when I tried with new payment card it worked so the message was wrong and wasted my time because I have given the test before my flight departure. Make sure your app shows a proper error message if the transaction failed due to card/payment related issues instead of irrelevant messages.

records.title: Appointment registration process too…
records.text: Appointment registration process too complex. The worst, the impossibility of obtaining an appointment in any other way than digital. it should be noted that not all people manage smartphone.

records.title: Horrible customer service at every level
records.text: I agree 100% with the terrible customer service and lack of empathy by ExpressTest. Do not use them as they have no empathy or understanding.Follow up review.Having received a response on Trustpilot to email them via their website, it has now been a week and yet no response. Surprise surprise!!!!Follow up review #2I have already submitted my complaint AGAIN via the website like I mentioned in the first follow up review, as can be seen above. Please READ before suggesting the typical copy/paste response.Follow up review #3A response of "Hi".... I guess that says it all. SHOCKING!!!!! I guess it is clear to all who read this review the level of customer service you offer!!! I don't think I need to add any more.Follow up review #4Weeks gone by and yet no response to emails sent via the "Contact us" on website. I guess ExpressTest really is going out of its way to showcase their terrible customer service.Follow up review #5Having followed the instructions as per your previous replies I have 3 reference numbers, 686512, 686908 and 687989. I look forward to hearing back from you.Follow up and final review #6Having been following up on this matter for almost a month I have finally gotten a positive resolution. For the sake of transparency and fairness, I am glad to say that ExpressTest finally sought to see reason and resolve the matter. The only thing remaining to say is that if it could have been handled professionally, amicably and sensibly, keeping customer satisfaction at the forefront, this whole episode could have been avoided and saved a whole lot of time and effort for both parties.Nonetheless, a sincere thank you Express Test for the favourable and fair resolution.

records.title: The place is empty and they have staff
records.text: The place is empty and they have staffbut you cannot walk inyou have to connect online and fill some formsthen they do an autotestthe only good point it is fast and practical if you are stuck at the airportbut this test is a joke, and it is ridicoulous to book online when the place is emptythe staff looks under or not very qualified

records.title: I didn't receive the emails with test…
records.text: I didn't receive the emails with test results until after we boarded our flight

records.title: A quick service but should be informed of travel requirements to avoid unnecessary and expensive spending
records.text: A quick service. However staff should be aware and informed of the travel requirements at least to avoid customers spending unnecessarily. This was my experience when travelling to Spain last week. I spent £55 on a test that was not even asked for on arrival at my destination.  This was wasteful considering the current times where money should be spent mindfully.

records.title: Need to improve service
records.text: Very disappointed a part a lady  who tried once the rest of the team were not very helpful they are not cooperative at all we are not all british n we come to your room in emergency to do a quick test n catch our flight if we don t have assistance we could miss our flight Thank you

records.title: Why wont you listen
records.text: I have only given 3 stars, as i feel express test should have given me the difference between the cost of my test at Gatwick and where it was actually taken in Bluewater. I followed all the correct procedures and contacted to ask for assistance. I got none.On the up side the test was done and I got the result in time

records.title: Very helpful staff. Terminal 3 walk in centre.
records.text: My 4HR PCR test result took 5hrs 15 minutes to come endangering me catching my connecting flight.Although not overly happy with the turnaround service, the staff were very helpful in contacting the lab and the admin staff to find out what the hold up was and to get the result of the test emailed to me asap. Thanks to those involved if you’re reading this. I made my flight to Shanghai. 👍🏻

records.title: We booked 2 appointment s at terminal 5…
records.text: We booked 2 appointment s at terminal 5 about 2 mths in advice 2 days before we were due to go we received an emai stating we had to  alter our appointment due to the fact your company had changed the opening times of t5 test centre it was very stressful changing the appointment s as we had t cance the  original then re bookwait for a vouncher  then book at an inflated cost  terrible customer service why the original could not have just been moved over to the new one  thus avoid the stress

records.title: A decent service
records.text: The website for booking was quite misleading. On entry there is a date and time combo, but when selecting the date the time combo disappears. If the time field is not needed why is it on the page in the first place.On the plus side my support emails were replied to quite quickly. And the process at the test centre itself was very smooth.Although the certificate itself says "Oropharyngeal and nasopharyngeal Swab" but at the centre only a nasal swab was taken. I'm not too bothered about this but it is misleading/incorrect

records.title: No way to phone when things went wrong
records.text: The staff at the centre were really nice and very helpful. But if anything goes wrong there is no phone number to contact anyone and I ended up trying to email back and forth, and waiting for replies whilst waiting to board my plane. The only way I eventually got an answer was to walk back from my terminal to the centre.

records.title: Rip off codt for test  No problem with the service the actual…
records.text: No problem with the service the actual test or getting the results However £40 for lateral fliw test is a complete rip off.You can but the test for £1 We had no option due to our teavel plans and the limited options available

records.title: Disappointment
records.text: I am only giving 3 stars would give 5 just for the for  one lady who was very helpful with the booking wish I knew her name to say thank you. The rest of the experience what a headache even the lady who did the swab rude as hell. Extreme prices haven't companies made enough money already off people. Terminal 4 only opens at 10am what's the point in that. Rules change daily with different pcr requirements  it's not a new thing for the last two years, should be able to have a walk in not book an appointment. Hopefully I don't have to use this facility again terminal 3 with the grumpy old bag behind the desk.

records.title: The test process was quick and…
records.text: The test process was quick and efficient but we were the only people there as tests are not needed for many countries now. I have used Express Test before but was disappointed this time that their charges are not made clear online. So the earlier you book the cheaper it is but it doesn’t indicate at all when you need to book by to get the price displayed which is very annoying.

records.title: Disappointed to get a positive after…
records.text: Disappointed to get a positive after arriving in the UK with a negative PCR 3 weeks earlier. As no symptoms I wonder how many cycles this PCR was run with to produce this test result. Also, could a minor cold the previous week or hay fever have been contributing factors?

records.title: Good admin, dodgy testing
records.text: The booking process was very efficient, and the results were sent quickly too. For the testing, the people who swabbed us put the swab just a few millimetres up the nostril, where they briefly tickled the nasal hair - I can't believe anyone ever tests positive with that method! Of course we didn't want to, but it would have been good to be confident we were negative.

records.title: Feel sick several times
records.text: I am afraid I felt sick several times during the PCR test at London Victoria Station centre. Of course, PCR test by oropharyngeal swab is always uncomfortable, but I was so nervous because I had to be standing during the test there. If I could sit on the chair during the test, I would have been a bit more comfortable.

records.title: 2 bad, 1 good point.
records.text: I wanted to book the 59 pounds test but the Express website would only allow me to purchase a more expensive one. I tried different devices and times but the situation was always the same, so definitely not good. No doubt it was a 'system error', and not designed to earn more income for Express... (I live in Japan and PCR test are free here.)The counter staff seemed relatively disinterested (no smile) but the nurse who administered the test was quite friendly.The test results came through earlier than I had expected, which was good.

records.title: We were unable to hear…
records.text: We were unable to hear receptionist/collector through plexiglass as microphone was not working. I had not booked online as I was unsure where test station at airport was and found it a bit ridiculous that I couldn’t just pay to have a test done there and then.

records.title: Poor webmail
records.text: Poor webmail, password should be made visible on request. Overcomplicated and slow. Expensive. Saving grace was excellent help from young staff member to help me.

records.title: One test was not read properly and had…
records.text: One test was not read properly and had to pay for a retest

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Used them previously (3 months ago) - that result came through late (just over 4 hrs) causing me to almost miss my flight. Only way to chase this up was via ‘contact’ email tab on their website which was not answered at all. This time around I asked for a mobile number when I registered with them, in case of similar problems. Staff were very evasive, again saying I had to use the website - not interested when I raised previous problems. Although the result was through this time within 2hrs and the test facility is convenient for LHR T5 departures, the overall level of service is not good (and meanwhile in the last couple of months the cost of a 4hr PCR has increased from £119 to £129 - an outrageous amount for a simple PCR!) Avoid if you can.

records.title: Staff helpful, but misled and almost missed flight
records.text: The only reason that it does not get 1 star is that the staff were very approachable and very helpful.I should not have been allowed to book my 4-hour PCR test at 8pm if there was new policy which did not allow me to take the test at that time.I arrived at Heathrow terminal 5 on time and then was told that I could no longer take my test, and that I would have to wait until 6am the following day at a different terminal. My flight was leaving at 12:30 pm so everything suddenly became very time sensitive.It turned out I could only get my test at 7am, which I was not told on my first try. This meant that I would be receiving my result after I had checked in and passed through security. If security had been asking for evidence, I would have missed my flight.As I said even though I was given a lot of different information and misled a few times, the staff were very accommodating and did answer my questions with the best intentions. It seemed from an outside perspective that different branches do not share information very well and if there is a change of policy then the website should have been updated immediately. If I had known I could have made arrangements beforehand and saved myself the most stressful journey I've ever experienced.

records.title: Unhappy experience
records.text: Unhappy experience. The test was fine. But the online booking was too complicated. It took me a hour to complicate the book. I saw some customers struggle as well. A staff tried to help but she could not solve the problem neither. An Asian staff was very rude.It was at Heathrow airport terminal 4.

records.title: took too long
records.text: online form kept refreshing so took longer to complete, and the results took too long so we missed our flight and had to buy a new ticket. the lady who took our swabs was nice thou.

records.title: A de-Customerize Service
records.text: The service is not value for £129 that not echo the customer's minor request for a hard copy of the test result. And I asked the staff in the reception at 12:35pm, the male staff rejected me immediately even I expressed the reason of my need. And I saw a printer found in the reception, so that your company must equip your front desk staff of their  flexibilty.

records.title: Go somewhere else when there is a choice
records.text: The registration system is badly designed and the time allowed for filling in the information is ridiculously short. The time extension functions did not work at all and I had to race against the clock and entered the credit card numbers for 5 times before I could proceed. Most of the staff at Heathrow T5 were unfriendly as if I am already infected with COVID whenever I raised a question.

records.title: I booked my test and gave all of my…
records.text: I booked my test and gave all of my flight details. In my panic to get the test done, I missed one important detail. The test is only valid for 24 hours. I booked mine 48 hours before. I true proffessional would have crossed reference my flight details and pointed it out to me.

description:
Eurofins. World Leader in Testing for Life.
55 000 employees. 900 laboratories. 50 countries.







Eurofins Scientific is an international Group of life sciences companies that provide a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. 




The Group believes it is the global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.




With 55,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 50 countries generally specialised by end client markets and operating 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as develop and carry out innovative clinical diagnostic testing services. 




As one of the most innovative and quality-oriented international companies in its industry, Eurofins is ideally positioned to support its clients’ increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the increasing demands of regulatory authorities and healthcare practitioners around the world.

records.title: Warrington test
records.text: Ok we were able to use the Warrington drive thru for our pcr tests and believe it is closing down soon. We had excellent help from staff and despite their having to stand in the pouring rain supported us non techno individuals! Results came back promptly just a shame we couldn't fly as there was one positive test. 😪

records.title: Great PCR test service
records.text: Plenty of available slots for drive through PCR day-2 tests at Warrington test centre. Re-scheduled the appointment under my request to the same day (called leaving the airport at arrival from abroad) and the attention by phone was great. Easy procedure at test centre, all clearly explained, results were available in less than 24 hours (were approx 12 hours after tested). And the best part is the cost, easily 50% less than most options, and just slightly more than at home tests. Great to deal with, will use in the future if needed.

records.title: Best postal PCR test experience so far
records.text: I got to South Africa a lot and have to do a PCR test before I leave, and don’t live near a big city to do a drive through one. Has always been really stressful with other test providers with results not coming back in time. Eurofins was super quick. Instructions about registration were a bit confusing but other than that, very pleased. Will use again

records.title: Great team work...
records.text: Quick, hassle free and fast results

records.title: Testing Testing 1 2 3
records.text: Finding the drive through testing centre was not easy even using satnav - maybe some extra signposting to get there would help.Once there, the staff member who dealt with us was patient, helpful and guided us through the process.Covid safety was observed throughout.All in all a very easy operation.🙂

records.title: Great Customer Service
records.text: Have used Eurofins before and always found them very efficient all results arrived as promised.Today had a problem with day 2 lateral in uploading the results as I could not download the App (old phone). Sent email re my problem received a reply quickly, I replied explaining my phones problem.Later received a call from Bill and explained in more detail, sent in the required information and later received a call saying problem was fixed and so it was. Can’t thank Bill enough for sorting it, that is what you call customer service.

records.title: Super affordable and reliable
records.text: I’ve used Eurofins twice for PCR testing. Once in a drive thru site and the other a self swab test sent to my home. On both occasions the process was simple, quick and easy - and the results were emailed to me less than 24 hours later. I find their prices reasonable but I’ll always use them going forward because they’re reliable.

records.title: Eurofins  excellent company
records.text: I had to be tested prior going to France, due to no slot available and though the test was done 21 hres prior departure and being told the result may not arrive in time prior myself flying however I was very impressed that the result was emailed to me at 6 am The prompt service allowed me to fly home.I did 2 tests Pre and post coming back,the eurofins's staffs were very professional and received an excellent service from them.Thank you

records.title: Excellent.
records.text: Highly recommended. The staff were extremely helpful and patient, in the pouring rain, helping me through the problems I was having accessing the booking details on the App. The results came through promptly and as advised, and I will be using their services again.My only suggestion would be the availability of a good wi-fi signal, which would be very helpful, otherwise a great service, at a great price.

records.title: Very helpful !!
records.text: We had problems with our CV docs at the ferry port Portsmouth - a nightmare!  Had to get re-tested for travel to France as our PCR test was a few hours out on the bureaucratic rules of the French.Ozzie Pete and Jenny in Portsmouth were very helpful and saved the day.  Many thanks to you for your kindness, cheerfulness and for being willing to help.P&P from Devon xx

records.title: Eurofins tried to double charge me but we got this resolved
records.text: I had to have a test done by Eurofins in November last year and paid for it promptly. However, a couple of days ago they sent me another invoice requesting that I cover it again. There is clearly an issue on their end as I find it hard to believe I just randomly got an invoice for something that was performed and paid for almost a year ago.I do hope this is a misunderstanding but the whole situation is concerning to say the least.Update: they admitted their mistake and it has been resolved

records.title: Taking the test was very easy to…
records.text: Taking the test was very easy to administer. Instructions were clear and simple. However we experienced great difficulty logging on and our password needed to be changed three times before we could access our account. We also needed to change our passport numbers as we acquired new passports subsequent to booking our tests. This too was problematic requiring direct support from Eurofins, needing four telephone calls to resolve.

records.title: Experience was good.
records.text: First time using them and the experience was good. I have booked two 'fit to fly pcr' tests through sampling site in Cardiff Asda car park for my parents on Sunday morning around 10:30 and the results arrived just before midnight on the same day. You need to register and login to trustone website or download the trustone app to see your results and download the 'fit to fly' certificate. Hopefully this will be the case again if I have to use them again the future.Although I would say I was hesitant booking with them after reading some worrying reviews over here.

records.title: Friendly
records.text: Friendly, helpful staff and quick result. 4/5 as had some issues with original booking that took some explaining to try and resolve via email  - but this was sorted quickly once spoke with someone on the phone.

records.title: Support system and staff very helpful…
records.text: Support system and staff very helpful in what was a smooth operation. ( We used the Day 2 test at home system after a long haul holiday) The only issue was lack of clarity over part of the test kit registration process - the instructions referred to a bar code on the tube but there was no bar code. I tried the QR code on the cassette and only half of the code could be read - the customer service element was very helpful and solved it quickly but the technology issues are a frequent cause of time wasted  and frustration across pretty well all suppliers - but the certificate came back very quickly. Overall not bad

records.title: My only reluctance to give the full 5…
records.text: My only reluctance to give the full 5 star score was the computer glitch that arose with my wife's test results which did not arraive until after we had pursued.

records.title: Quick and easy process
records.text: Very quick and easy process, overall very happy and would definitely recommend Eurofins Heathrow to others.Would just say that as an international traveller it would have been good to warn us that we needed to register online once at the site as we had no internet capabilities and it cost us an extra ten pounds to call the helpdesk to arrange

records.title: Good service but got charged for 3…
records.text: Good service but got charged for 3 tests when we only booked 2 tests and having great trouble trying to get the overcharge refunded otherwise good service

records.title: Service good and used before
records.text: Service good and used before. On this occasion the app was down, causing a backlog / queue and we had to wait for a very long time for someone to come to us

records.title: It can be quite a stressful process but…
records.text: It can be quite a stressful process but we got our results quickly which was a big help

records.title: My wife dealt with all of the necessary…
records.text: My wife dealt with all of the necessary stuff. It took a long time but once she knew what she was doing it was fine.

records.title: Time to get the results is too long
records.text: It was quick and easy but the results arrived late, it that could be improved

records.title: Bit disappointed with the quality of…
records.text: Bit disappointed with the quality of the hut at Asda Cheltenham.

records.title: I booked a 2 day pcr fit to fly with…
records.text: I booked a 2 day pcr fit to fly with you but had to cancel, after many phone calls and emails sent to you, I still haven’t had my refund back for me our my husband! However I have just received my refund, I have used eurofin on many occasions and haven’t had any problems with these, they have been reliable and very helpful when we have had our test done, there seemed to be a missed email for my refund but has been corrected now.

records.title: Easy and quick
records.text: Easy and quick. Exactly what you want! Very simple to book. We were given a QR code but the team were using an old-school pen and paper so took a little longer than scanning the QR code. We were then given the test kits and instructions on how to use them. We conducted the swaps and deposited the samples into the collection bin and we were on our way. Results came within 12-24 hours as promised.

records.title: Helpful staff but VIP service not fulfilled
records.text: The staff at the drive through were extremely helpful and friendly.Unfortunately, even though I paid for the VIP service (return within 8 hours) it did not come back in time for me to go out in the evening. After 9.5 hours I decided to call and chase them up. I was told that the result had been processed, but had not yet been uploaded to the database. This was done immediately after I came off the phone.

records.title: A need for more drop boxes- in the…
records.text: A need for more drop boxes- in the south of England, I had to drive an hour to get to a dropbox. I didn't want to rely on Royal Mail. And couldn't  - due to a time constraint of needing a 48hr PCR. Customer service was excellent over the phone however, I called three times. Even the RM priority boxes only had two pick up times one in the morning and one in the evening. My advice is check your location and make sure you have a dropbox closeby.

records.title: Everything went really smoothly
records.text: Everything went really smoothly. Friendly and helpful staff at the travel agent, who help my mum with the test. Received the results in 12 hours.The reason for only given 4 stars it’s absolutely impossible to get any help from customer service, phoned numerous time and was just kept in a phone queue for hours, I also wrote several email and received no reply!!!

records.title: Great service but no full refund
records.text: Great, affordable and efficient (used for day 2 test previous time). However the refund policy isn't great. Called days before appointment was due only to find results won't arrive in time for flight (no test available on weekends), but was not given a full refund.(To reiterate, I would happily go back to them, but be extra extra careful about timing!)

records.title: Certificate knowledge for staff.
records.text: The test was easy to carry out and the staff were very friendly and helpful. I arrived at the time of my appointment and they were ready for me with my details etc. The only reason this was not a 5 star review is due to the fact that nobody there could inform me of what the test results would look like. I wanted to ensure that the test certificate would be acceptable for Kuwait, however the staff were unaware of what would be printed on the certificate.

records.title: Eurofins offers a user-friendly service…
records.text: Eurofins offers a user-friendly service with quick and efficient results, but there are some drawbacks. While the staff are friendly, locating the testing site is challenging due to the lack of signage. Some customers have experienced issues with test results not integrating smoothly with official sites, and there have been reports of certain tests not being recognized by airlines, causing inconvenience and extra costs. Additionally, the demeanor of some staff leaves room for improvement. Overall, a mixed experience with areas needing attention.

records.title: We only received 1 of our antigen tests…
records.text: We only received 1 of our antigen tests in time for the flight therefore we had to pay for a drive through one the day before flying. Eurofins did refund the money for the missing test though which I appreciated.

records.title: Failed delivery
records.text: The test kit did not arrive and after more than a week of waiting,  I decided to cancel the order. The guy on the phone sounded like he was asleep/drunk and was not interested in my call. I wrote an email and sent a message through the Eurofins website. Received quick response and my money was refunded in no time.

records.title: Still waiting for a refund
records.text: I was extremely impressed and grateful when receiving the prompt email after the travel rules had changed at the beginning of January, offering a refund when exchanging the day 2 PCR for Antigen. However, I didn't then receive the refund at all, it has been 20 days now and still waiting.

records.title: Testig unit was no open when we…
records.text: Testig unit was no open when we arrived. The analyst arrived over 30 minutes late. Everything else relating to his service was good. Test straight forward and results recieved promptly.

records.title: why is there no toilet
records.text: I think it is unacceptable that a place that provides a profitable, very profitable, public health service, does not have sanitary facilities that can be used by its customers.  I think that the profit of your business would easily cover that investment.

records.title: Disappointed that we didn't get the PCR result quicker
records.text: Disappointed that we didn't get the PCR test back until 23:15hrs the night before the morning we were due to travel so couldn't get to sleep until we knew the result as would have changed our travel arrangements if positive.

records.title: Can I get services like testing sleep…
records.text: Can I get services like testing sleep supplement to verify both the content and precise quantities of each ingredient.

records.title: Straightforward delivery only for one
records.text: Straightforward delivery only for one test.Had to chase second test arrived days later.Trust one app ok till we arrived home and could not facilitate forwarding test result.App apparently had ‘ difficulties’Five stars go to Mohammed who helped with problems…efficient friendly knowledgeable understanding.  However probably not use Eurofins in the future if we need tests.

records.title: The location was not fit for purpose!..
records.text: Unfortunately the location was not really fit for purpose. Even with an appointment, we waited over 40mins, sitting in pouring rain  in a small car park, where car were coming in & out with no control & eventually, by chance, we were tested. We felt very sorry for the over worked, soaked staff who could do no more than they were. It was badly managed, putting unnecessary stress on the lovely staff.

records.title: Booking was easy; but Sign-Posting at Ashford is non-existent!
records.text: Booking was easy;Online delivery of test result worked well;signposting of test site at Ashford is NON-EXISTENT!!!It took me an HOUR to find it - even security guards at the roundabout did not know where it was and sent me completely into the wrong direction;Staff members have escalated this several times already to management, but have been ignored so far.That's really bad!!!

records.title: You need a smartphone to use this service for lateral flow.
records.text: I thought this would be a fully attended service. It appeared that way from the website. So I was disappointed that I was expected to take my own sample and photograph the results.Unfortunately I do not possess a smart phone so I couldn't use the service. Very embarrassing all round.It should be made clear that a smartphone is necessary at the drive-in locations

records.title: Fine on way out
records.text: Fine on way out. For our return we both requested 2day postal antigen tests. My husband received this but I received a 2day postal PCR kit. We both had problems registering the tests as 2day postal was not an option on drop down menu. My husband took a photo of result whereas I had to post the sample. A bit disorganised overall but Sonia on phone very helpful. Very short notice about closure of drive through site at Livingston.

records.title: On arriving on site it was not obvious…
records.text: On arriving on site it was not obvious anyone was there.Once someone did arrive they said they didn’t have the equipment to establish/verify who we were,  and our booking!However we were given test kits and proceeded to use these in the car. The Eurofins ‘ post box’ was ….just there on the site.All done, thank goodness, and the result arrived within 15 hours.

records.title: Chaotic visit / results in 12 hours
records.text: Chaotic visit to the text centre - drive thru Heathrow- not open for appointment time, dark no lights, actions at the site did not reflect in any way what the prior documentation had instructed, none of the stated paperwork or passport were checked. However, once test was obtained it was easily carried out and the results obtained within about 12 hours.

records.title: Did the job but results might be unreliable
records.text: Great to be able to test at a “drive-through”. Not as organised or official as the one at ExpressTest at Edinburgh Airport but I guess it did the job and we got our results quick enough and within the time expected. The test is meant to be UKAS accredited which the analysis bit probably is but I very much doubt the sample collection would ever pass inspection (if assessors saw what really happens) which puts into questions the reliability of results.

records.title: Receiving result of test
records.text: Eurofins does not email the test result to one's email address as one would accept but expects someone to download a third party app to receive the result. As a result, I never received the result. The app is an invasion of privacy and also is very difficult to download. As a result, I will be using another test provider next time.

records.title: The procedure was good until we…
records.text: The procedure was good until we received an email saying results in and then no data Available, we were flying the next day , we rang the number provided and the recorded message stated closed until Monday . We then got through by choosing an option not relevant to us , the team were helpful You had technical issues so no data could be shown , you must update your system , the results were ready and the team got them downloaded for us . A very Stressful situation

records.title: Simple
records.text: Had fit to fly test for me and family. Straightfoward process, staff lacked charm, but did the job (and a dull job it must be so dont blame them) efficiently. Results back overnight, which was great. Would have been 4 stars, but no signposting in car park and sign had blown down,  so did acouple of laps before we found it (its at the furthest point from the shop).

records.title: Test results got mixed up
records.text: Overall good experience with the day 2 testing at the walk-in in Wheatley. Three of us got tested in the afternoon and received the three test results next morning. Unfortunately the tests got mixed up and two tests are listed in the same name. This shouldn't be possible and would concern me if we would need the tests for flying! Therefore the low score.

records.title: Not responding to emails and results…
records.text: Not responding to emails and results were very late and not reflected to the price at all.

records.title: the instructions are inadequate it is…
records.text: the instructions are inadequate it is not made clear that you should not register your kit until the moment you do your kit and send it off, as this is used to determine when you have done your test. This meant I had to buy another test wasting the test kit and £45. A simple change in the guidance would stop this happening to no doubt thousands of customers.

records.title: Test not delivered in stated timeframe
records.text: My wife and I ordered the home test kit for our pre-departure Covid test. We sampled 72 hours before our flight and put the test kits in a priority mail box. Although the test kit was labelled as next day delivery, the parcel was not in the system by the day before our flight.We contacted the eurofins call center but were advised that even if it arrived that day, the lab would take at least 24 hours to process the kit. We ended up paying almost triple the amount to have an express test at Heathrow. All in all, the Eurofins Test was a really stressful experience and not something I would recommend to other passengers.

records.title: Not helpful deductions made when apply…
records.text: Not helpful deductions made when apply for refund

records.title: Billed us twice for test,then we had to…
records.text: Billed us twice for test,then we had to chase them for results ,got them at midnight ,travelling that morning ,stressfull and can not contact a person about billing issue ,

records.title: Not helpful hidden deductions when i…
records.text: Not helpful hidden deductions when i apply for refund

records.title: I booked for a test kit to be sent to…
records.text: I booked for a test kit to be sent to my home but it was not sent. I followed up with a call and a kit was then sent out but that arrived too late to be of use. At least the call operator was helpful in sorting our the error.

records.title: unimpressed
records.text: Test kits arrived as ordered. However, it is proving impossible to register the tests and an email enquiry as to how to do so has just led me round in circles on the automated phone lines ... unimpressed

records.title: Day 2 home test never arrived
records.text: The Day 2 home test I ordered never arrived. I called them and first they said it had been sent but then another operator said it hadn't (it had been 10 days since I ordered at this point). They sent me a new one, which arrived, but there wasn't much point then, I was at about Day 14 of being home. Never replied when I asked for my money back. £50 for nothing.

records.title: We paid for VIP Service
records.text: We paid for VIP Service. We had a test at 11.17am email response at 4pm saying no data available. Went back to test centre feeling very worried and stressed. Young man very helpfully at drive through test centre phoned up  eurofin and did his best but no luck so gave us the phone number for us to keep trying. After many phone calls at our expense we were told server problems. That’s all we were told . Wouldn’t tell us if we were positive or negative so still panicking. Finally at 2am just 7 hours before our flight we got our results, then still had to do check in for flight. This is not acceptable and ruined the start of our holiday. We were so stressed we were on the verge of going home. We then heard on the flight we didn’t need a PCR test just an antigen test.. why on earth did eurofin not tell us this. We could have done that instead and would not of cost us £180. We feel a refund is the least eurofin should do for all the stress and cost of phone calls we endured.

description:
Qured is changing the way people receive healthcare.

We believe that accessing healthcare should be convenient and easy. That's why we created Qured. At the touch of a button, you can receive high-touch, quality healthcare, powered by technology.

records.title: Amazing service!
records.text: Amazing communication, easy to take the blood test and weirdly pain free!!! Received the results via phone call week after the test. They've explained the health concerns, very thoroughly and sent me all in an attachment for GP later on. I'm still in shock how great this experience was! Thank you!

records.title: Great experience
records.text: The service was very well-organized, and the process was seamless when I received my test kit. I was provided with a step-by-step guide along with support from an online advisor. The test kit was easy to use thanks to the clear instructions and guidance. My results came back incredibly quickly, and afterward, I spoke with an online doctor who explained everything thoroughly. I would highly recommend Qured to anyone!

records.title: Very simple
records.text: Very simple. Very professional. The online video chats were extremely helpful and friendly. I would highly recommend.

records.title: Tests were carried out in a…
records.text: Tests were carried out in a professional manner with the results talked through with you by a GP

records.title: 2 tests for insurance purposes
records.text: We ordered 2 tests for insurance purposes to prove we were positive and could not travel . Tests arrived as promised next day , it’s easy to take the tests and to upload the picture of the results via the Qured WebsiteBe aware you only get 10mins to upload your test so be ready as soon as you get the result.  We received confirmation back almost immediately. Staff were efficient sending medical  docs through immediately when asked.

records.title: £9 For peace of mind to transit airport,  quick results!
records.text: Was a little confusing without many instructions before we actually started to take the test.  However All went well and the verified results came through in 10 minutes.  However,  there was only random checks at the Spanish airport that we only had to verbally say we had proof,  seemed a waste of time,  effort and stress when the Spanish authorities didn't seem to be interested. £9 For peace of mind though. Worth it in the end.

records.title: Great Experience !
records.text: I found the entire process of my first two tests extremely easy and informative.  The consultants took me through each step and made me feel at ease throughout.  The consultation after each test was very thorough and wasn't rushed.  I felt very comfortable chatting about the results and asking questions.  What a great experience !

records.title: Rapid antigen for entry to Spain
records.text: Ordered the antigen rapid tests for entry into Spain.  Had to select 3-5 working days as being delivered to Northern Ireland. Tests came within 3 days. Once uploaded-cerificates came back within 15 minutes. Brillant service-highly recommend! Once we arrived at Spain they asked for a QR code which this certificate doesn’t have. It’s no problem, they read the certificate and accept you through.

records.title: Easy to apply online. Good value.
records.text: Easy to apply online and good value, compared to some sites. The tests arrived the next day. I was nervous about getting it right, as the Spanish health information was very strict, but the tests were like ones we were used to, just had to write date and time on test strip, and upload results, next to passport picture page, by taking a photo. Took a couple of hours but got certificates back and then health form was complete, so received QR code.

records.title: Very good service.
