records.text: Very good service.Used before trip to Ibiza.Noticed a few negative comments but if you follow the instructions correctly to a T you shouldn’t have any issues! Some people are just incompetent lol. Got my cert within 45 mins of uploading my results. Thank you

records.title: Simple and easy test to use.
records.text: Performed my test effectively and was easy to do.

records.title: A good service  but not available 24/7
records.text: A good service and economical.But do not believe everything on their website. They are not available 24/7 and certainly do not deal with tests uploaded on Sunday as advertised.Follow up: After complaining about lack of service yesterday, Qured offered 50% refund which was acceptable. Have therefore raised rating to 4 stars. Good customer service.

records.title: Very easy process  extreamly helpful…
records.text: Very easy process  extreamly helpful staff to speak to on the help centre and the adviser that supervised us. The app is clunky as it wouldn't let me sign in then linked itself to my emails after uninstalling and reinstalling a few times it worked again. Would definitely use this company again.

records.title: Smooth and efficient
records.text: Ordering, delivery, test information, submitting tests and getting results all went smoothly. Happy with service.Two points for future customer satisfaction.1. I visited the site a couple of times to do comparisons etc. Even after submitting our tests I was still getting reminders that I had tests in my basket to complete orders.2. Perhaps you could make more clear the actual test times to be submitted  i.e. time test taken or time test submitted.

records.title: I did receive my test result within 2…
records.text: I did receive my test result within 2 hours.I did not receive next day delivery service as promised and extra paid for(£6), very close call for travel time needs.

records.title: Absolutely fantastic communication and…
records.text: Absolutely fantastic communication and customer support from start to finish. Had to call last week and chase up my tests and the lady I spoke to was very helpful and dealt with my query straight away.

records.title: On the whole ok but I found procedure…
records.text: On the whole ok but I found procedure online a little clunky. Staff very helpful to remedy my experience. I chose Qured because of Facebook recommendations.

records.title: Changed labs after submitting first…
records.text: Changed labs after submitting first test -so had to redo -was worried I would not get results on time but thankfully I did. Support from team was very good.

records.title: Would recommend
records.text: Very easy service to use  with speedy response. Much easier and cheaper than a certain high street chemist chain.

records.title: Test arrived in plenty of time ready…
records.text: Test arrived in plenty of time ready for my trip , but I then found out I no longer needed it where I was travelling

records.title: its great and helpful team but how do…
records.text: its great and helpful team but how do you add to apple wallet which is a requiremnt for travel?

records.title: Service is good but I think…
records.text: Service is good but I think instructions could be better written. My first test and I was nervous.

records.title: A simple system to use
records.text: A simple system to use, but not for everyone! Unaccustomed to these things I did my best but, through my own fault, things went a little bit wrong and were stressful. BUT, Qured helped a lot and I got there in the end. Contact was great. Responses were prompt. They did all in their power to help and I wasn't alone.

records.title: Simple and easy to use.
records.text: Nervous about which company to order from. However Qured was on the list of approved and had good reviews. Ordered test and was here within 2 days. Straight forward easy instructions. Results came back within the hour ( fit to fly antigen) certification to fly. Simple and easy to use.

records.title: Stressful travelling made easier
records.text: Stressful travelling made easier. I was fairly anxious about all the procedures needed to travel to US. the antigen test arrived in time - i was able to book my appointment - the person took me through my test pretty quickly and was friendly yet professional. the waiting area situation on video consultation was a little confusing and i felt like i shouldnt have to wait during my appointment - it added to the anxiety and was hard not to open the packet.

records.title: Downloading  certificate
records.text: Downloading negative certificate not easy to do but testing was ok.

records.title: All worked well
records.text: The process to get a certificated antigen test worked well. One improvement on the instructions I would have appreciated would have been to provide more detail on the results upload process before you actually do it. I found a much more explanatory leaflet from qured available on the web which wasn't included (or even mentioned) in the emailed instructions and not referenced by the otherwise very helpful and responsive help desk.

records.title: Reasonable process with minor hiccups
records.text: Ordered kits which came promptly as promised, though the initial statement from shipper was misleading in that it said the kits would come later than advertised.The relevance of location should be better presented on website, as it was not clear that the time of appointment was linked to the time zone of the location.We didn't actually follow through with test due to change in airline rules, but it appeared that the process would be straightforward.

records.title: We booked Antigen tests for the USA…
records.text: We booked Antigen tests for the USA before the requirement was dropped, so we took them anyway as we were unable to get a refund. The video connection was a bit unstable but the observers were very pleasant, helpful and clear about what we had to do. We both tested negative and we got our certificates within half an hour.

records.title: Good support staff
records.text: The video consultation was explained clearly although the connection with the agent dropped at the start, but she restablished connection quickly. I did have to chase for my medical certificate as I hadn't received it within the 2 hours as stated on the website. I placed a call and the support agent dealt with it efficiently and escalated it, I then received it 10 minutes later

records.title: Straightforward but load too quick
records.text: Straightforward enough, but uploading result within 10 minutes was frantic for me. I am not a teenager and not so used to using my tablet for this sort of thing. Please give us a bit more time ..and explain that when I press upload test result button that I will be able to take a picture directly - I had taken a picture and uploaded through a different way - anyway with all the pop ups I needed more than 10 minutes.

records.title: The service is not user friendly
records.text: Date of experience: 24 November 2022

records.title: Website registration is awful, but otherwise a good system
records.text: Price was better than other tests for video certificates.  Website was convoluted, and required way too many details.  Messed up one of the test registrations.  Video reviewer was Amazing and deserves a raise, as she fixed the issues!

records.title: Long wait at time of appointment
records.text: Kit arrived quickly, in good condition. Had a bit of difficulty on the website while booking appointment - website was “hung” multiple times. Logged into the link punctually for my appointment then had to wait for 40 minutes for the representative to show up. When everything was done, the confirmation email was very quick.

records.title: Got there eventually.
records.text: Test appointment ran to time. Found it a bit odd that it just relied on me uploading a photo of the result, no one checked in on it. And I know it did say it could take up to 2 hours to complete, which it did, but meant a very nerve wracking time waiting. Then the certificate had to be manually uploaded to VeriFLY- all felt hard work but job done.

records.title: Tests worked but response is not prompt.
records.text: Tests worked according to plan, but after arranging our trip schedule to be on time for our monitoring appt. and signing in early as requested, we had to wait online for 50 minutes past the appt. time to meet the monitor and start the test, then we were not notified of our results for hours so we didn't know if we could fly home until we arose early in the morning to catch our flight.

records.title: Fit to Fly in UK?? Needed to be EU
records.text: Was very quick and received the fit to fly certificate very soon after logging the test. But my only issue was that it actually said fit to fly into the UK, which is pointless as you dont require any certificate to fly into UK and i was using it to fly out to Spain!!

records.title: I almost missed my flight
records.text: I almost missed my flight. The promise of 2 hours was not met by them and it was between 3 and 4 hours before I got my result. Be warned if you use this company to not rely on this 2 hour guarantee on their website. Do it at least 8 hours before, if you do not wish to be disappointed.Otherwise, the certificate passes as valid when you are at the airport and delivery was smooth, so will give that to them. Cheaper than the other nonsense tests they make you do.

records.title: Received the kit in plenty of time and…
records.text: Received the kit in plenty of time and I booked the appointment easily. I had to change the date a couple of time due to flight cancellations. The appointment was a little delayed but it went well. The result took about 4 hours to come through but that was because of how busy it was. The paperwork side was easy to add to the verify app.

records.title: Be prepared to wait
records.text: Tests arrived quickly after paying for express delivery. I booked 3 supervised tests at different times on one day for different family members. All of us waited for 20-30 minutes before being connected to the Qured staff on the video calls. They were pleasant enough while on the call, but no apologies for lateness. We received our certificates 2-3 hours later.  It was an ok experience, but my experience with other companies has been better.

records.title: Exactly as needed, just a bit late
records.text: We had 2 appointments via video for a recent trip to the USA. We had the video calls and got all the paperwork which was great, and in that aspect Qured were fabulous. However, I had a booked time slot at 10.50 which didn’t go ahead until 11, and then another slot at 11 which didn’t go ahead until 11.40, so I was waiting on a video call for much longer than needed.

records.title: It got the job done but. . .
records.text: It got the job done but. . . 25 minutes wait time on website to begin video test. Representive spoke very fast and was obviously rushed. Guaranteed 2 hour test results during regular business hours arrived in 2 hours 30 minutes. The bottom line is the service worked but getting a test at a local provider would likely have been less stressful and this was not nearly as easy competitor eMed although in fairness the wait time for a representative was similar for both services.

records.title: iphone video setting adjustments!
records.text: Since this testing is critical to ability to fly in and out of countries, I would strongly suggest 1) Detailed instructions on how to adjust phone settings to include video when using the link to get to the appointment.  My iphone video didn't work.  Had to find another device/ laptop to make it work while dr waited. Stressful experience.   2) Remind user to have their qured user name and pw  nearby for upload of photo of test results. Links didn't work for that.  Glad dr was very patient with us !

records.title: Unclear time zone causes needless concern
records.text: They provide a code and time to write on the cartridge. Call ends and you have 30 minutes to upload your pic after the timer goes off. But the time they gave you is UK time and you’re in Central Europe. So is it already expired? Then you panic and incur roaming charges to call them in England. Seems like something could be improved to avoid the needless concern in an already stressful situation.

records.title: No QR code on the certificate
records.text: We have used Qured before with no problems but this time flying to the USA where the test has to be less than 24 hours before the flight we had a major issue as the Qured certificate  does not have a QR code for uploading to VeriFLY. We had to submit it for manual review after it initially being rejected and with only a few hours until we flew it was nerve racking. It was accepted after a couple of hours but still ruined our evening as I suffer with travel anxiety anyway

records.title: Long queue/hold times
records.text: Logged in 10 minutes before appointment time. Was waiting over 30 minutes to have my call answered. Good thing my cell phone didn't drop the call in the over 45 minutes it took to get through the process! Also, results were not available 2 hrs after submitting the test as promised- it was over 3 hours.

records.title: Did what we needed but with two avoidable glitches
records.text: Pretty good service with two glitches. First, the tests we received in the mail did not look like pictures of the tests we ordered. I had to check with customer service, who asked for a picture of the items I received. In the end they were the correct tests, but this could have been avoided. Also when it came time for my appointment, I was kept waiting for around 35 minutes. If Qured requires clients to make and respect appointments, then they should do the same.

records.title: Mixed satisfaction
records.text: When it all finally worked, it was a relief, and the representatives on the video were helpful. But the symbol I was told to look for to upload the finished photo did not appear at all, which caused some anxiety, and I had to really search through the website to find it. And my daughter was kept waiting more than 40 minutes past her appointment time, causing us to have to rearrange our plans for our final day in London.

records.title: Many unclear steps and stressful
records.text: The steps to procure, schedule, test, and await results were many, not always explicit, hard to contact someone to coach us through it, the process and awaiting the results were stressful. Two out of three online staff were hard to understand. My camera had a glitch. I could see my observer, but she couldn't see me. I had to desperately hunt for another device to be able to complete my observed procedures. However, I must say she was patient. I had to go offline, but she assured me that when I could return she'd pick me up quickly and she did.

records.title: OK, but be aware of issues with incomplete instructions
records.text: Delivery of the kits was quick. However, the instructions provided were somewhat confusing and lacking in key bits of information - for example the certificates arrived, but they came as 'pop-ups' which I had disabled on my computer. It took several attempts to get these into a form that I could use. The website did not tell me that I needed to accept pop-ups, and the instructions refer to 'downloads' which is not what they are.

records.title: So disappointed with this service!
records.text: So disappointed with this service!! Been lied to twice by Lawrence okho !! First he told me my tests had been delivered but when speaking to another colleague she told me that they had not even attempted to deliver my tests then he said he would send new tests out which I will receive buy 1pm the next day and guess what they did not arrive !! I’m going on holiday in 5 days and have been waiting over two weeks now for these tests to arrive, definitely would not recommend this company!!

records.title: One of our tests did not come back…
records.text: One of our tests did not come back within the 2hr period, not even within a 12 hour period which caused significant stress the morning of travel. It ruined our morning and our first ever family flight, and only was resolved following my calling and demanded it be pushed through. After that, and generally good service but the initial error was unacceptable.

records.title: Late Delivery
records.text: Late DeliveryThe test kit I have ordered for travel was late in delivery, I have to pay extra for another lab as a contingency.When I asked a refund from Qured, they only provide partial refund and I have to pay for the postage.I should have choose another lab, it costed me more than it should be

records.title: It was not at all clear
records.text: It was not at all clear what to do with the test after using and so my results were invalid, causing me to miss my travel and first 2 days of holiday. Why not write what I have to do on the instructions????Very disappointed.

records.title: mixed service
records.text: We had booked 3 travel to US tests as a family; two of the tests were fine with video call on time.  The other test video call took place some 3 hours later and only after calling their support staff 3 times.  The first of calls made service was after waiting 1 hour from the appointment time and we were promised that it start soon, but nothing happened and need to call again and again.  Imagine how stressful that was on friday evening with the flight from Heathrow at 8.30am !

records.title: Photo ID not mentioned but required.
records.text: Nothing in the information provided tells you that you need to accompany your submission with photo ID such as driving license or passport. This caused a major headache as the passport had already been handed over to the travel arranger. Although they turned the approval round quickly, we were concerned that it would be delayed because we then had to retrieve the passport. Qured need to review their instructions, make sure that every aspect of the process is fully defined, and take on board comments such as this.

records.title: Supposed technical difficulties?!
records.text: Supposed technical difficulties?!?  Signed in to Qured as instructed, even 10 minutes before my “appointment”.  It was over 45 minutes of a message basically saying we’ll be with you shortly.  My traveling companion was waiting for a person to start her video test for over an hour.  If you have plans to enjoy the last day of your trip, make arrangements for Covid testing other than with Qured.  I’ll be contacting my airline as well.

records.title: Wait times were long.
records.text: Wait times were long, The system is not integrated with the airline. Delivered a PDF but the check-in Verfly service needed an image file. when reservation made the time in the time zone was not clear. We make the reservation for 7:30 AM thinking it was local time where were were going and it was time where the reservation was made not the  time where the were on the trip. Had to wait 5 hours We were in a car to do the the test.

records.title: Customer Service was found lacking
records.text: The Qured support team were difficult to get hold of and slow to respond once I did. Poor follow up and slow response times contributed to an increasing sense of anxiety as my flight approached. Suggest that Qured invest in application development that allows real-time, in-app interaction, as well as better and clear status reporting and TTR (Time To Resolve).

records.title: Supposed to get results in 2 hours took 5 and 2 calls
records.text: Supposed to get results in 2 hours. Called after 4 to ask where they were. Told they would be done at some point….Asked for results to be expedited. Told they would be. I’d have them in 20-30 mins. Called back one hour later because I still didn’t have them. Asked to speak to a supervisor, and got told “oh they are ready”

description:
Concepto is one of the most popular and trusted clinic to provide travel tests. We are Government approved private Coronavirus testing company that has over 15 clinics in England. DHSC (Department of Health and Social Care) has approved Concepto Clinic to provide COVID-19 Travel tests including Test to Release, Day 2 & Day 8 tests . We also provide Fit To Fly RT-PCR test and travel certificate.

- GOVT APPROVED PCR TEST(24HRS RESULTS GUARANTEED)
- URGENT TRAVEL TEST - GUARANTEED SAME DAY RESULTS.
- DAY 2 AND DAY 8 TESTING FOR INTERNATIONAL ARRIVALS.
- GOVT APPROVED TEST TO RELEASE TEST.
- CORONAVIRUS ANTIBODY BLOOD TEST.
- ANTIGEN TEST.

records.title: NIPT test
records.text: NIPT test - We had the advanced NIPT blood test via our local window to the womb branch in the north-east of England. We were impressed to receive tracking information throughout the whole process. We had the blood test on Monday. Blood results arrived at lab for processing on Tuesday evening and we received the results on Saturday morning - which was well within the 5 working days.Although not as fast as other online - who report results in 2-3 days - but were pleased that lab works and sends out results on a Saturday which we didn’t expect.It was a little annoying that they don’t have a phone number to contact but they do have a dedicated email address for NIPT support.We also liked how gender and genetic testing results were in 2 separate attachments and you couldn’t automatically open the gender results as you needed to use password provided in the email.

records.title: Excellent Covid fit to fly service on a Sunday…
records.text: Covid fit to fly tested on a Sunday morning around 11am before an early Monday morning flight to Japan. The Ealing clinic was clean and in good, easy to find location. The staff were quick and very professional. Nisha, who took the sample, was helpful, calm and efficient.  The result certificate was emailed back between 9-10pm. Excellent service. Highly recommended.

records.title: NIPT test
records.text: We did a NIPT test right before Coronation weekend and the result came out very swiftly and really helped reduce the stress! (well within the given time frame)/ Then we had a quick follow up question on fragment, which was handled both timely and professionally. Overall we are very happy with the service and our experience and we would like to recommend Concepto Clinic. Thank you!

records.title: Pleased with the service
records.text: Requested the three hour result option. Flight was at 7pm from heathrow, went to the clinic near the airport at 1/30pm, in and out in 5 minutes max. The worker was friendly. Results were emailed less than two hours later. Uploaded them to the visitjapan site and accepted a few minutes later. Id never been to heathrow before so was a bit hard to find but was probably google maps fault for taking me down the wrong road, its in the hotel building. Would recommend.

records.title: Very pleasant service at the brentwood…
records.text: Very pleasant service at the brentwood essex branch , nice lady who took my blood sample , she was very patient and caring , she  kept asking if i was ok. My results were faster than expected 48hrs instead of the 72 plus we found its the gender we wanted , we can start shopping early .Thank you blue or pink

records.title: I had another positive experience!
records.text: I had another positive experience with Blue or Pink! I sent the test on Monday and received my result today, Wednesday. I didn't want to risk using the lancet because I actually hate them so I took the test to my GP. I had blood tests booked on Monday. The nurse took some extra blood and poured it into the tube. This made my life so much easier! I'm also very happy with my result!

records.title: Amazing!!!
records.text: Amazing, i was so nervous for my NIPT test result but got results way quicker than expected had the blood test appointment Thursday and result by Saturday afternoon. Thank you so much!!!!!Don't hesitate to use Concepto clinic nothing but good things to say!!!

records.title: Very good service
records.text: It is clearly ludicrous that a COVID test is required to enter Japan if you’re not jabbed (given that natural immunity has been proven to be as effective, if not more effective than the “vaccine”) That said, this issue is clearly not the fault of Concepto clinic and they handled their task well. The nurse was kind, friendly and helpful. I would recommend this Clinic to anyone else forced to have a test (however, unnecessary the test itself may be.)

records.title: Quick, friendly and a negative result - soon to become obsolete
records.text: Compared to the peak of the pandemic, prices are reasonable; we were in and out within 5 minutes and the service was great. 2 days after our PCR, China announced that they will no longer be required to travel, so I suspect this location won’t survive long!

records.title: Excellency in action.
records.text: The whole process from booking to the actual procedure, was smooth and easy.The lady I found at the clinic was very friendly and welcoming.I arrived a few minutes earlier and she did not ask me to wait but attended to me immediately.I got my results as expected.Thank you for excellent service.

records.title: Their service was very smooth and…
records.text: Their service was very smooth and comfortable. When I asked them to send me another certificate of PCR test result, they were willing to send me back with pdf, soon after I received the result. I appreciate that. I hope the test fee will be reduced in the future..

records.title: Parking tricky and hard to find Clinic…
records.text: Parking tricky and hard to find Clinic as signs pointed to locked entrance. In the end had to go through hotel lobby after asking at their reception. Otherwise fine and results came through on time.

records.title: Happy with the service
records.text: Happy with the service, only found out need to apply online after a phone call. Could make it more clear in the website.

records.title: Works as it should, albeit a bit expensive
records.text: Works as it should, albeit a bit expensive. For the Heathriow location clearer signage and entry would be useful, thus why a 4 instead of a 5.

records.title: friendly staff
records.text: Very friendly staff member working on the day of my test. Results were delivered on time as promised via e-mail.

records.title: Arranging an appointment at the…
records.text: Arranging an appointment at the Brentwood branch was easy online. The only issue was no direct contact details to phone the venue as we were running late. The lady that served and provided test was brilliant and very professional.

records.title: Cambridge Branch
records.text: Place easy to find on main high street. Staff very friendly and helpful - even suggested what information would be recommended to be placed on certificate. PCR procedure quick, but would have ideally liked instructions about what would happen before the swab was taken to allay some anxiety.Overall, very good.

records.title: Nothing to complain about their service
records.text: All fine as I received my results by midnight of the same day.4 stars instead of 5 because it could have been more quick as I made the test at 9.30 am and I received the test results at 11.40 pm, after I send them an email to remind them to send it. Some other Covid test providers are faster to provide a result and although they say they send it by midnight of the same day, they send it after few hours.

records.title: Recommend
records.text: Worth the price (Antigen). The staff on the phone had clearly no interest in my questions but it did not particularly affect my experience as the branch staff were perfectly friendly and corporative. They were happy to reschedule my appointment when I mixed up the dates and refunded me the original money. Unfortunately, the result was confirmed, by email after 7 hours, not within 2

records.title: Overall very good value and…
records.text: Overall very good value and straightforward process, only minor issue was that the emailed results were out of alignment and unreadable which could have been an issue with border control but was quickly sorted

records.title: I did a PCR test before travelling and…
records.text: I did a PCR test before travelling and visiting some vulnerable people. All was easy and smooth (booking, payment, etc.) and the result arrived on the same day.

records.title: The lady was welcoming and friendly
records.text: The lady was welcoming and friendly. She explained beforehand what should happen. The result waiting time was reasonable. The clinic was clean and tidy that made my visit comfortable. Thanks

records.title: My experience at the clinic was quite…
records.text: My experience at the clinic was quite okay, fast and straightforward. But it was difficult locating the clinic. Map took me to the opposite direction, hence reason for 4 star.I'll advise you put a signage at the central showing direction and shop number.

records.title: Speedy
records.text: Speedy, not too expensive, got my results quickly. The only problem is it's difficult to get hold of them if you have queries/ want to change your appointment. I had no response.

records.title: Good human service
records.text: Good human service,  Nurse made procedutr relaxed .I was uncomfortable with the procedure  nurse ,reassured is nothing to worry about ,and be calm,it worked. Smooth procedure .

records.title: On time
records.text: On time. Efficient nurse management. Pleasant surroundings Only negative, I had to phone for results, was told already sent??????Difficult to understand telephone operative.

records.title: Thank you
records.text: In need of a covid test to travel, your welcome and diligence were magnificent.Unbeatable value for money and timing.A big thank you to the lady who welcomed my wife and I.

records.title: The experience was great
records.text: The experience was great, they entertained my query and the test was great.

records.title: Friendly and efficient at the Croydon centre
records.text: The lady that handled my tests Croydon was friendly and efficient.I think I paid extra for a guaranteed before the end of the day result.  It was almost double the standard fee which is the only downside.

records.title: Experience was excellent till taking…
records.text: Experience was excellent till taking the test. Lost 1 Star due to the results not arriving before midnight as promised. Had to chase for it the next day.

records.title: Overpriced given length of turnaround
records.text: I wasn't very impressed by the service given the price of the (NIPT) test. They sat on my blood sample for 6 days, only processing it when I sent a chasing email to all 3 of the email addresses listed on their website (no phone number available to call). Even the NHS can provide results quicker than that and they're not charging £200.

records.title: Test easy, booking nightmare
records.text: The actual test is very easy and simple - got there two hours early and they were happy to do it then for me. Nice and friendly. Only part which has been a nightmare was booking the test.Had our tests cancelled three times by them and we are still waiting on part of the last refund. Hope this doesn’t happen to others.

records.title: Expensive
records.text: Good: booking process; location; helpful to change appointment time; friendly staff. Bad: the cost is totally outrageous; the tiers are set to make even more money (same day vs 3 hours).  The price increased by 50% from November to December without any justification (£40 to £60).

records.title: Can be better but does the job
records.text: the Welcome experience was poor. With the staff not caring about the customers. The nurse has been professional. Results were communicated quite late on the next day. But the document was good and validated by airport.

records.title: Poor experience even it did the job
records.text: Booking online out of date and not synchronized (booked for 0915 while the lab only opened at 1000). Swab made at the edge of the nostril : could not possibly catch any germ… so what is the point?

records.title: Parking can be difficult and ensure people have correct address as moved clinic 1st Jan check your paperwork ?
records.text: When we finally found correct place the young lady was great couldn’t park and offered to sort one person test first namely the driver which was helpful

records.title: The girl who served was not that nice
records.text: The girl who served was not that nice.  I don't know if she likes being in customer service.  the report and the test was fast, that was very good.

records.title: No restroom available
records.text: I strongly believe that a restroom should be available for customers, mainly for hygiene reasons. I couldn’t wash my hands while I was there.

records.title: I thought the person responsible for my…
records.text: I thought the person responsible for my examination was cold attitude.But, she answered the question clearly. Thanks.

records.title: A genda but corrected swiftly
records.text: Although my Glenda was mistook in the certificate was not accepted the flight company, however as soon as I made a call a correction was made swiftly. Appreciate.

records.title: PCR test
records.text: I went through a PCR test (result expected by the mid-night of the same day). The sampling was very smooth and nice performed at morning of Sunday. However, I did not get the result until 5 am of the morning next day after I sent them few emails explaining that I needed it for my flight. They sent me the result then, and explained that I should have received it before mid-night. But, it was not correct. I never received email from them in time promised! Good service, but  stressful since I had a limited time.

records.title: Quiet and calm.
records.text: Quiet and calm.The service was good, but the location was a bit complicated. I needed to be guided by a staff.I liked the quiet and calm environment inside of the room.

records.title: Silly error or would have been 5*
records.text: 5* for the test itself.  Lady at Milton Keynes just lovely.  However, my test result didn’t arrive although hubbys did.   When I called the 24 number the young man had misspelt my email address (despite me receiving confirmation and reminder at correct email address).But we got there in the end.  But these tests are stressful enough when needed for travelling without silly errors.Without this I would have given 5*

records.title: Not easy to find
records.text: The place of the clinic is difficult to find. There should be some clear signs outside the hotel to lead people to the clinic.

records.title: My appointment was in the morning of…
records.text: My appointment was in the morning of 26th Mar 2023. The gentleman was very nice. I give him 5-star. But, the lady wasn't, only 2-star. Sorry.

records.title: appointment and payment problems
records.text: System cancelled appointment due to system delay in collecting proper online payment . This led to initial confusion at clinicFailed to email the result of the test automatically and had to call to chase

records.title: Delivery of results was offered in 12…
records.text: Delivery of results was offered in 12 hours.  the result was received 20 hours later

records.title: Make it easy to find
records.text: Location was not very easy to find by satnav. But the staff member was very kind and agreeable.

records.title: Because we found out we didn't need the…
records.text: Because we found out we didn't need the test after all and nobody put us right!

records.title: The pace was good to get the test done…
records.text: The pace was good to get the test done and results gotten on time but the fast track 3 hours process is too expensive.

records.title: NIPT testing
records.text: Attended for NIPT testing at 10 weeks pregnant. Was told results would be 5 working days max. On the 5th day I contacted them to ask what the latest time I would hear back was. Was told I should have already received the result and I needed to check my inbox.When I pushed back and said I hadn't received the results and was confident they hadn't been sent, they checked and said the results would be released later that day.I did get the result and am relieved everything was fine, but I can see that they received the sample the day it was taken, so it was actually 6 working days. They only actually processed it because I checked as they've entered the time the sample was run. Had I not checked I would not have received my result today.I received no apology and no explanation for why they told me the result had already been sent.In future I'd go somewhere with more sensitivity and professionalism at what is a really stressful time for people.

records.title: My partner booked my early gender test
records.text: My partner booked my early gender test, once I went there at Concepto Heathrow, had to wait in the same room with a fairly poorly woman who was doing her Covid pcr, also there were another 2 men for pcr waiting. The clinician took me to a exact same room where he tests all Covid cases.. I am sorry but you shouldn’t be putting at risk myself and my baby, especially when I can’t take medication! Giving additional star for the clinician who was very caring and understood where my worries coming from.

records.title: Technician was late by 15 min
records.text: Technician was late by 15 min. Which is a lot considering that each time slot has at least 2 customers and is scheduled in 5 min increments. Tension was rising as people waited by the door and each one had a flight to catch . The earliest appointment is 10 am . It would make it easier if there time slots 8-9 am , after all it located near busiest airport in UK .

records.title: PCR testing
records.text: The address as stated on the website is not helpful as it states a unit number which is not on the shop. I called customer service for guidance and was told to ask some in the center. I asked for the name of a shop near to them and was advised he could not tell me. A cleaner was approaching and she pointed me in the right direction. It was only on reaching to shop and explaining to the person doing my test, my frustration at trying to find you that I found out your CSA are based in India. It would be useful if you could at least give them knowledge of the location of your premises. The lady who performed the test was wonderful, polite and very apologetic however, due to your CSA lack of knowledge I would not recommend you to anyone.

records.title: Prompt test, slow results
records.text: Results were not delivered anywhere near the 3 hour turnaround promised.  This is an issue for fitness to fly PCR testing.

records.title: i had to call as the 3 hour service did…
records.text: i had to call as the 3 hour service did not happen its a good job i was not flying the same day as you would have caused me to miss my flight

records.title: I did not see it is a good experience
records.text: I did not see it is a good experience. Have to wait for clinic to contact to admin. However. It is very hard to contact the admin. Not recommended.

records.title: I asked to have a receipt or invoice…
records.text: I asked to have a receipt or invoice but never receive it after 1 week.

records.title: After-service is bad
records.text: Operation was speedy and precise. But After-service is not good.

records.title: Not easy to find
records.text: Not easy to find the clinic because of wrong located sign boards.service is good .

description:
At Window to the Womb, we our proud to offer our families an outstanding level of care throughout your pregnancy journey. Our family and child-friendly clinics offer a range of private ultrasound scans from 6-42 weeks gestation, and are conducted by fully qualified, medical Sonographers. Our goal is to ensure you feel safe during your baby scan experience, which is why our staff undergo extensive training. Our clinic teams strive to offer you a first-class experience, and are always on-hand to answer any of your pregnancy questions.
Our baby scan packages always include a diagnostic check of baby, so whether you need peace of mind in the early stages of pregnancy, want to see boy or girl, meet baby in 4D or just see how baby is developing, you will leave our clinics feeling reassured.  Our clinics also work closely with local NHS hospitals, to ensure you have on-going care if required.

records.title: This is a very lovely service
records.text: This is a very lovely service and couldnt reccomend enough. As anxious first time parents everything was made very easy and the whole process was very reassuring. We've had both the 8 week scan as well as the gender reveal scan which both services could not fault. The photo package also is something we will always cherish as they provide such lovely images of our baby. Already recommended it to fellow parents to be and will continue to do so :)

records.title: Welcoming and enjoyable experience
records.text: All staff were very welcoming and made us feel very comfortable, the radiographer was absolutely amazing and the member of staff in the room along side us. They offer an amazing gender reveal in the room with colour changing lights, this made our experience 10x better. After the scan we then had a chance to look though the scans and choose the favourite to get printed aswell as add ons to our package were reasonably priced. The add ons were keyrings and magnets and our baby’s heartbeat in a teddy bear they are very good quality. Any images we didn’t want printing all got emailed to me. I 100% recommend was definitely an experience to remember!

records.title: Would recommend
records.text: Staff were so friendly made us feel so relaxed. Sonographer Anna was amazing.The scan was slightly more affordable than other clinics near us. 100% worth the money, would recommend!

records.title: We had a wonderful experience at Window…
records.text: We had a wonderful experience at Window To The Womb in Hamilton. Every member of staff from the receptionist to the sonographers were so welcoming and kind and we were made to feel so comfortable! The scan itself was amazing with multiple screens around the room so we could always see clearly and the lovely pink lights when we found out she was a girl! We can’t thank them enough for such a special experience

records.title: Really nice experience,if you have any…
records.text: Really nice experience,if you have any questions the staff is very helpful with all that you need.The best clinic to have a safety scan to see your baby how is  growing up.Really recommended

records.title: I went in for a private reassurance…
records.text: I went in for a private reassurance scan, staff inside were incredibly welcoming and friendly. The lady who scanned me was very reassuring and explained everything in great detail to us

records.title: 110% recommended
records.text: staff was amazing, the lady doing the scan talked about what will happen and was amazing, the assistant in the room would point out areas during the scan made it clear.very helpful will be going again and would highly recommend.

records.title: The experience was excellent the scan…
records.text: The experience was excellent the scan was amazing and displayed in large screens inside the room. Lots of extras including a teddy that carries your babies heartbeat. Would highly recommend

records.title: The best experience!
records.text: We went for our gender scan yesterday at window to the womb.The sonographer was soo friendly and he explained every little detail to us & our little boy. It was just the most perfect experience for us!We chose to do the cannon in WTTW which was just so personalised, the staff were absolutely outstanding & joined in on our reveal. So so good with our 4 year old boy!Wouldn't have chosen anywhere else🥰10/10 from us💕🫶 xx

records.title: We had 3 visits at Worthing Windows to…
records.text: We had 3 visits at Worthing Windows to the Womb. And those 3 visits are always a lovely, warm and welcoming experience. All the staff are so welcoming and so lovely. Highly recommended!

records.title: 4D scan
records.text: Staff very polite. Very clean. Always find the sonographers appear to be quite fed up. Unfortunately, baby wasn’t cooperating so been offered a free return next week which is appreciated. Shame there’s no free parking on site. Was delayed going into appointment.

records.title: Window to The womb is brilliant I…
records.text: Window to The womb is brilliant I highly recommend

records.title: A lovely experience for expectant parents
records.text: My partner and I had a lovely experience with Window To The Womb. We booked a gender reveal scan at 17 weeks because we were so eager to find out for ourselves; we also came away reassured that everything looked as it should as the scan included a general welfare check for baby ahead of our 20 week scan, which was most important to us ! We were offered a lovely keepsake in the form of a heartbeat bear when we arrived which we accepted in the excitement of it all ☺️ however it may be helpful to remind at the start that they do come at an additional price. A very small note from an otherwise happy day! Thank you to all the staff for making a happy experience for us 🩵

records.title: Great service
records.text: I’ve been to WTTW since my first born and now I’ve expecting my second. I love going there to see my babies, the staff are lovely and explain things very well, take their time with you. However the cons is I wish the image quality could be better as sometimes the sonographer screenshot the images some of them is not clear and sometimes I can’t pick my free images to be printed. Other than that, amazing experience.

records.title: Great team, but slightly odd location
records.text: The team are very friendly, and the scan was done very professionally, but the new location is a little bit industrial / doesn't put you fully at ease.

records.title: Magical
records.text: I had a lovely experience and would deffinatly return found out I was having a beautiful little girl using there colour changing lights it was super magical

records.title: Amazing experience window to the womb…
records.text: Amazing experience window to the womb are so helpful and understanding through the whole process! Only lost 1 star as the quality of the scan photos weren’t great and I don’t know why, maybe I didn’t drink enough water before? Or maybe they just weren’t good pics this time! But overall would recommend

records.title: Late appointment slot
records.text: I had a late appointment booking for 7:30. I was initially abit worried as I noticed store closing time was 5:30pm . The phone line was not answering, so we sent an email and got  a very prompt response that store is still open for scans only which was reassuring. So I assume that the timings is to do with accepting new bookings vs actual appointments. Very lovely staff at the clinic! Service with a smile. The  sonographer Dr Iqbal wanted to make sure we got good imaging so sent us out for a walk but  baby was playing hide and seek still so we managed to get a rescan date which was kindly arranged for me. Recieved this as a gift and would  defo consider gifting to a first time mama.

records.title: Middlesbrough
records.text: All of the staff we had interactions with were lovely (receptionist, sonographer & assistant). They checked I didn’t want to upgrade to a more expensive package to get free prints etc but this didn’t feel too “sales-y”, it seemed like they genuinely wanted to double check that I knew what I’d booked! The only downside was the waiting room was very busy despite a note on the window politely requesting people to come in only 5 minutes before their appointment, which meant it was quite loud and busy in a small space. I found this a bit stressful but it wasn’t anything to do with the staff, just a general point if you feel a bit anxious before scans.

records.title: Have been on to window to the womb for…
records.text: Have been on to window to the womb for all my none nhs pregnancy scans and they have all been really well . Such a good experience to watch my little man grow from a pea sized to human size

records.title: Good service!
records.text: Good service!

records.title: Very friendly staff
records.text: Very friendly staff, lovely experience.

records.title: The site has a warm and cozy…
records.text: The site has a warm and cozy atmosphere. All the employees there are passionate, professional and very patient. They won’t rush, but keep telling you to take your time and enjoy the process. Our sonographer explained in detail of what we saw on the screen, fingers, toes, eyes are open etc., which gets us really excited and involved. The only con of this site (Ealing) is the traffic. It’s better if you drive since they have a quiet number of parking right outside. However the public transportation to get there is not convenient.

records.title: Gender scan
records.text: We went for a gender scan and had such a lovely experience. The staff were super helpful and friendly, we had such a thorough scan and they answered any questions I had. The only negative I can give is that the pictures were such poor quality, you couldn’t work out what you were supposed to be looking at which was a little upsetting

records.title: We were talked through the whole…
records.text: We were talked through the whole process of what would happen during the scan. The sonographer and chaperone were both so lovely and welcoming explaining everything that was going on with little one. The only thing I would say is that they like to push for add-ons to the original price. This is obviously down to you to choose whether you want it or not but just seems like a lot at the time!

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service, great employees. If you want peace of mind for scans outside of the NHS, plus some pictures, great. However, in our experience, the quality of the scan pictures is better with the NHS. The 4D photos are fine for memories and to show your child they are older. However, the quality isn't that great, and all the babies look the same, so nothing amazing. It's more for the scan to check everything is ok.

records.title: Very nice place and staff ❤️ just…
records.text: Very nice place and staff ❤️ just pictures taken on ultrasound could be better quality and a little bit longer focus of taking the best pics

records.title: Receptionist always really friendly…
records.text: Receptionist always really friendly (have visited for an early reassurance scan and a gender scan). Only reason to not give 5 stars is due to late running of appointment, other than that it was a nice experience.

records.title: Very welcoming and friendly staff
records.text: Very welcoming and friendly staff, the ultrasound technician was very persistent even though little one wasn’t cooperating completely he made sure that we got some amazing photos. Would definitely recommend to friends and would go back again Only little issue is the waiting area is a little on the small side but they were very good about getting you in and not waiting around too long

records.title: The sweetest team of staff you’ll ever meet
records.text: Lovely warm and inviting staff. My experience was very positive and worth the money.The only reason why not 5 stars is that I found contacting the clinic a little on the trickier side when a few admin errors came up.Best clinic in Southampton by far. Thankyou Xxxxx🥰🩷

records.title: Overall, okay. Good to have reassurance
records.text: Overall, we were happy we got what we wanted to achieve from our experience, and that's to find out the gender of our baby. Whilst our experience wasn't bad, and most of the staff were very kind and friendly, there was something about our experience that didn't feel it met our hopes for the experience and we came away feeling a little flat. I have tried to reflect on why, and this is what I have felt contributed: the appointments were back-to-back, making it feel like you were just being churned through and it lost a feeling of personalisation. In the scan, our baby was upside-down and the 4D image was of their back, this meant that the pictures we had to choose from at the end weren't great, but no one even commented on this and I think again this was likely due to how close together the appointments were and that sense of feeling rushed through. The ultrasound technician was thorough, though it felt rushed and not very personal to us. The staff were lovely and offered to film our reactions, so they did go the extra mile where they could, but I think for us we would have liked just a moment longer to pause and discuss what we were seeing and get a chance to connect with our baby on the screen. I suppose overall, when paying for an experience like this, I hoped it would be elevated above what we received from our NHS 12 week scan, in some ways it was, but in others, it wasn't.

records.title: The appointment was rushed because they were running slightly late
records.text: I have been here twice, the atmosphere is nice and welcoming. The stuff is great too! The only thing I am disappointed about is that the second appointment was rushed and the sonographer didn't take time to take nicer pictures. They were running 30 minutes late, that can happen and it's okay, but rushing the appointment, considering the price of these clinics isn't nice. During the first appointment I wasn't allowed to choose the picture given. The picture wasn't clear. Also, they were supposed to sent all pictures they have taken but I only received the one they printed. I don't think I would go back there again.

records.title: Unfortunately not satisfied this time😓
records.text: I have always swore by WTTW and wouldn’t go anywhere else but today I didn’t feel my 4D scan was satisfactory. I had booked the 8pm appointment and didn’t get seen till 8:40 (which this didn’t bother me) but the images from my 4d scan were the best and with people before us & previously with me 1st they had asked me go for a walk move the baby but my scan felt abit rushed because it was closing time and there was still people in the clinic after me. There is only one good image and the scan was over £140 which I also upgraded to HD. I just feel let down by this experience compared to previous ones. I know it’s no fault of there’s the baby’s face wasn’t visible but I thought they would of allowed me go for a walk to try and move the baby but they just carried on and it felt rushed.

records.title: We went for the premium 4d package and…
records.text: We went for the premium 4d package and I thought this will cover the basis measurements of the baby and her weight but when we got there on the top of the £95 they said if we wanted to know her measurements that's an extra £25. Little disappointment on this but the pictures were great and the experience as well.

records.title: I visited window to the womb for gender…
records.text: I visited window to the womb for gender scan.The reception staff were lovely and welcoming.However I wasn’t too impressed with the sonographer. He wasn’t upbeat and spoiled the experience that’s all I have to say. For confirmation of gender in a monotone voice & no smile .you can forget the 4d, no effort to take a pic literally 10 seconds I expected at least a min for sneak peak.

records.title: No guarantee of nice photos
records.text: I enjoyed the overall experience. Staff were friendly. The place itself is lovely. I understand the sonographer can only do so much and if the baby isn’t in a good position then photos are difficult but to pay £60 and leave without one single nice photo is very disappointing. I feel there should be some offer to anyone unable to get a picture of their baby. Perhaps a rescan or money off etc.

records.title: Receptionist and assistant in the scan…
records.text: Receptionist and assistant in the scan room was helpful, lovely and friendly. The sonographer we had on the day wasn’t as good as the previous 2 times we have used WTTW in this pregnancy, I felt rushed & that out £75 experience of a gender wasn’t as good as we hoped for! However the other 2 staff made the experience a bit more “fun and exciting” for us

records.title: Lovely atmosphere but scan felt rushed.
records.text: The atmosphere was lovely and the front of house team really welcoming. Only thing that was quite disappointing was how rushed the scan felt. Not much communication/explanations from sonographer about the scanThis was meant to be a special moment for our daughter to see their sibling. We were told the scan would be 5‐7mins and after paying for extras we received the video of our scan which was only 3‐4mins long. Apart from that great service and 4D pics were great.

records.title: Good experience but wrong gender!
records.text: The experience was fantastic. I had the early reassurance scan at 8 weeks, and the early gender scan at 16 weeks.Cosy clinic. Good products. Amazing scanning technology and friendly staff.The only reason they're not getting full stars is unfortunately they got the gender of my baby wrong! We'd prepared for a little girl based on the scan results but had a boy instead! This was disappointing and an expensive affair now with lots of pretty pink dresses he can't wear! I was surprised they got it wrong as apparently this doesn't really happen these days and they did boast 99.9% accuracy...

records.title: A lovely scan but poor service after.
records.text: The staff were all very friendly and the sonographer took his time and shared the excitement with us. They clearly explained each part of the baby and reassured us that everything was well. It was an overall amazing experience until we came to waiting for the images. I've called and messaged the Coventry store for the past 2 days in order to get the code for the images just not the gender ones and have had no answer.

records.title: Reasonable prices
records.text: Fairly reasonable price for reassurance scans. I’ve used them 3 times. Lengthy sign in process. They don’t seem to keep a record of your previous visits. Emails confirming an appointment could highlight the list of documents they want you to bring with you.

records.title: It’s okay
records.text: Lovely staff working there, can’t fault them. The scan wasn’t very clear I have had better quality at NHS which is kind of disappointing since you’re paying. Photos weren’t great either. I understand it depends on baby position etc. but our baby was in a good position and active. We only had around 14 photos (2 of them in 3D) , would have been nice to have  more taken and shame to find that half of the photos weren’t even good photos, we struggled to even pick 2 to print out at the end because they wasn’t very good.. Gender reveal items are quite expensive £15 for a medium cannon / £20 for a large cannon (you can buy them for £5 online).£25/35 for a heart beat teddy, not a great choices of teddies either.  I was hoping to come back for 4D scan but don’t think I would anymore as it wasn’t really worth it personally.

records.title: I was expected for more
records.text: I was expected for more because is a private clinic. The pictures are unclear…even at the hospital it was more nice and clear. Everything was very quick, no informations at all just “the heart beat is good”, “doesn’t want to show us the face” “spine is formed” that’s it.

records.title: It’s a lovely service
records.text: It’s a lovely service. Being able to get piece of mind and see your baby outside of the nhs standard scans. It’s clean and relaxed and the reception staff are always friendly. We had 3 scans here including a 4D. I will say that the 4D scan was good but could have been better. The ultrasound technician isn’t particularly friendly, he’s professional but cold and speaks with 3 word sentences. it also feels quite rushed through the actual experience and when you’re paying such a huge amount of money that can be a little disappointing. You’re already paying nearly £80 for the 4D scan and then we decided to pay extra for the HD because the quality is better but then if you want a video that’s an extra £15 but that comes as standard with the normal scans and then you pay even more if you want a teddy with the heartbeat. A lot of places charge a similar amount and include all of that within the price so I feel a bit cheated considering I’ve been quite loyal and had 3 scans there

records.title: Great first 2 scans BUT disappointing gender scan
records.text: I loved the clinic and the staff were great. The first two scans, were very detailed and we received the full videos to our email along with around 18 pictures. The gender scan and reassurance, we invited our whole family to come. This scan wasn't very detailed at all. It was very grainy and we only got to see baby from tummy to head, no visuals of the hands or legs and feet. We were really disappointed as our first two scans had been brilliant. My sister said that she had a better scan at another clinic in Stepps, so it was a bit embarrassing as we had said how good it was. Really debating going back for our scans once a month until the end of our pregnancy now. Our baby is 17 weeks now.

records.title: Not satisfied this time round
records.text: I usually use window to the womb and the experience has been wonderful. This time, I was not happy with the results. The male sonographer didn't really take any good pictures of my baby. I paid £65 so I would expect to come out with some good pics. However this was not the case. Instead they were fuzzy.

records.title: Lovely staff but average scan
records.text: We had booked in for a Gender and well being check. We didn't want to know the gender, but that was the scan that fitted the stage we were at and gave you some prints and a 4D preview too. And we were bringing our daughter to reveal she was becoming a big Sister. We were seen over 40 minutes late, which meant I had to empty my bladder, and then try and drink as much as I could before the appointment. We were also really dissapointed in the 14 images available to choose from as none were clear on what it was. But they did put a cute message saying Hi big sis on one of them which was a nice touch. We had to also ask for the 4D preview as that was stated on the package but it wasn't done until we asked for it at the end. On the other hand the lady I think her name was Paula/Pauline on the front desk was amazing. So friendly and welcoming and was soo good with our daughter gave her a big Sister sticker, and her own envelope for the picture with the message on and made a fuss of her which was really lovely. She would be the reason I would return not for the actual scan. The room is lovely and the clinic is clean, and the scan assistant was nice too.. But if it wasn't for the receptionist I'm not sure if I would recommend this clinic. So big thanks to the lady on reception xx

records.title: 4D scan for first time parents
records.text: Attended a 4D scan on 18th February. This was the 2nd time we have been here and as always staff were lovely, we decided to return because of our first experience being very positive.We however were a little disappointed and disheartened with the sonographer on the day. He seemed lovely but he did say he is "not familiar with the model" referring to the ultrasound machine. Because of that, he appeared to have been "messing around" with the machine. We felt that although some pictures are good the majority didnt seem as well done, possibly because of the sonographer not being familiar with the model of the machine. We appreciated his honesty, however  with it being our first baby and first 4D scan, we expected our sonographer to be familiar with the machines. I do recommend them, as the staff are lovely and services are great, we just happened to have a less experienced sonographer on the day which left us a bit disheartened.

records.title: Don’t mention any recent scans
records.text: Lovely sonographer but complications because I’d had a scan the day before they charged me full price only to do 4D scan rather than everything.

records.title: Pros and cons
records.text: Pros and cons Lovely place and nice staff but I had a little gender reveal party and got the balloon from Coventry window to the womb and the balloon was see through in daylight. As soon as we got in the car and it hit the sun we could see through it and it completely ruined the surprise. Maybe it was pumped up too much? Not sure

records.title: No photos or memories to take from scan
records.text: We booked in for a gender and fetal well-being scan at 16 weeks in Worthing. The clinic staff were very friendly during our visit. The package includes the gender and fetal well-being scan but also says that you will get a peek of baby in 4D, two photo-quality prints and all digital images sent to you. Our baby was unfortunately in a difficult to see position (facing completely away) so all images and video are not of any use to us. We also struggled to enjoy the scan as we couldn't see anything clearly. We have therefore missed out on any prints or images to keep as memories. Although baby's position is of course not the fault of the clinic, I have been denied a rescan because we found out the gender and had the wellbeing checks. I booked the private scan to enjoy seeing baby and have the memories of prints and photos and I'm sure other people will too (otherwise I would have just waited for my 20 week NHS scan). So I'm writing this review to give anyone a heads up to this disappointment (as I'm sure if like us, this is a lot of money to you) it's best to be aware you may walk away with a disappointing experience and no images of use. We will not be returning to Window to the Womb.

records.title: Unprofessional
records.text: Walthamstow clinic has moved to a very run down building, and it was unclear where to wait as there was no one there when we arrived despite the email saying to arrive early. Reception staff were over 10 minutes late for the appointment, they returned with fast food which was very unprofessional and they offered little apology. One of them chaperoned us in the scan with the sonographer and spent the whole time texting on her phone. we wouldn’t use WTTW again considering the price and unprofessional experience, I would go elsewhere for private scans.

records.title: Gimmick, money wasting
records.text: Firstly is f you’re intending of going simple for a 4D scan, it’s not advisable to waste £100 and never be guaranteed to see your babies face. I wouldn’t bother using this service unless you just want the gender as that seems to be the main focus with this company. On both occasions that we visited, the two sonographers couldn’t speak very good English and hardly said anything during the scan. Personally I would stick to the scans that are available on the NHS, this just seems to be a gimmick!!

records.title: Avoid them!
records.text: Avoid them! Imagine a whole facility not having a female Sonographer and they catcall you into making a deposit and tell you at your appointment that you already signed up for it. Till date, I haven't gotten my deposit refund after spending £32 on transportation. The irony is that it is called 'window to the womb', yet no respect for sensitivity in this regard.

records.title: We visited for a gender reveal scan at…
records.text: We visited for a gender reveal scan at 23 weeks. I have a toddler daughter and my partner entering the room.My DD  starting crying for me and while she was crying the lady who takes the scan started asking me questions. I clearly and was obviously not ready to have that special moment if my daughter wasn't ready. But the lady wasn't sympathetic to that and just went along with the "task at hand"I paid the "premium rate", pictures didn't come come as clear as it did with my scan from my daughter either.The whole experience, compared to the one scan with my daughter were completely different. It made my experience a lot less expecial unfortunately.

records.title: Disappointing when receiving bad news…
records.text: Reviews for Window to the Womb seem very positive, but these seem to be for people who have had good news…I’ve very unfortunately had two scans for both my pregnancies and both have confirmed no heartbeat. Both the sonographer and chaperone did not provide much comfort and it felt like a very transactional situation. Croydon was much better where there was a separate room, but Bexleyheath I was just asked to wait in the main waiting room to hear other expectant mums being congratulated, whilst I was trying to process my sad news. The after care and approach for anyone not receiving happy news, should be reviewed and extra care should be taken.

records.title: I felt like my 4D scan was rushed just…
records.text: I felt like my 4D scan was rushed just because baby kept turning her head. There was no option to go for a short walk and go back in my parents came as it was supposed to be a special moment it felt defeated. Most of the 35 photos were either duplicates or 3 of the same picture so not much to choose from. Ended up having 3 of the same picture printed out which wasn’t great. £89 is a lot of money to travel to Portsmouth pay for parking and to then feel upset coming out of the scan when a couple before us got 3 chances to go back in inbetween others appointments. Felt like we should have had this opportunity. I am now having to rebook another scan in 2 weeks but at a different clinic

records.title: Not all it’s cracked up to be
records.text: My wife and I went for a viability scan tonight.  The receptionist was polite and friendly, however the male sonographer was very clinical, thorough, but very cold and matter of fact.  We found scans for half the price, closed to home which friends have used with great experiences.  The pictures (choice of two) that we had to choose from to take home we’re out of focus and disappointing.  Wouldn’t go again.  Over priced and underwhelming.  Shop around!

records.title: Not recommended for an early scan
records.text: Attended the Cardiff clinic for an early ‘reassurance’ scan. Whilst the scan itself served a purpose and we were thrilled to see that all was well, overall I would not recommend the clinic for an early scan.The waiting room was full of other couples and there was no privacy or confidentiality.  We were very stressed about the scan and the whole process felt very commercial.  My partner was asked to consent for a TV scan in the waiting area!We have attended other privately clinics for scans and had a much more positive experience.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: This is my third time coming here for scans. Unfortunately, it was very poor.Firstly, 27 minutes late being seen before our appointment. I know it can happen but that wasn't the only disappointment.We were only in the scan for around 10 minutes. It was very rushed. I expressed my concerns to Larry about having a big baby, but my comment was ignored. I was hoping there would be measurements on the report but nothing. For this bad experience, I won't be returning for my 4D.

description:
Project Screen by Prenetics is a world leader in COVID-19 testing. Each day we help Britain get a step closer to normal, everyday life. We offer a range of gold-standard, UK Government approved Covid-19 tests and services, including the UK's mandatory Green Day 2 Arrivals PCR Tests, Amber Days 2 & 8 Arrivals PCR Tests, Test to Release PCR Tests, Fit to Fly PCR Tests, General PCR Tests, and Lateral Flow Antigen Test Kits. 


Choose between ordering one of our home Covid-19 test kits or visiting one of our innovative Test Pods at 20 locations in the UK. 


Home Covid-19 Test Kits are shipped via Royal Mail Special Guarantee and include a free Royal Mail Tracked 24 return envelope. Please note: Royal Mail's business days are Monday to Friday - please consider this when placing your order or returning your sample to the laboratory. Tests taken at our Test Pods in England are couriered daily to our laboratory at 4pm. Learn more about our delivery & return details here: https://www.projectscreen.co.uk/delivery-returns/


Once we have received samples at our laboratory, results will be delivered online within 24 hours. You will be notified by email when your results are ready.

records.title: Great friendly and explain the options…
records.text: Great friendly and explain the options really well with some excellent tips

records.title: Pre Cruise Test
records.text: Nurse Rhoby conducted our online test in the most professional yet friendly manner. She talked us through the process, helping us to overcome technical problems like unmuting the sound. She also stayed online, from our point of view, to ensure we uploaded our results correctly.

records.title: Easy to follow and complete.
records.text: Kristian was very helpful and did not rush us. Being techno novices Kristian was very patient with us. Explained everything thoroughly step by step. We were made to be very relaxed by the whole experience, which initially were very nervous about. Really can recommend Prenetics.

records.title: Our observed LFT's
records.text: Our observed LFT's were arranged 2 weeks previously.Despite reservations and concerns the customer service was extremly helpful each time I called.On the day Vincent guided us through, he was punctual, friendly, informative, not rushed and patient. The whole thing went well, despite never having had to do such a thing on line before. The results were also communicated well.

records.title: Kristian
records.text: Kristian, who conducted our tests, was excellent. We hadn't used Zoom before but that didn't matter. We were guided through the process with ease. He explained each step and made sure that we were aware of any timescales.We could not have been in better hands.Thank you Kristian.

records.title: A good response to what could have been a major problem.
records.text: Request for test sets were sent promptly as requested.We had a slight  problem with one test kit in that the code number on the box that allowed us to carry out the Covid test on line failed to register and stopped us from carrying out the Covid test. Being a Sunday evening it caused some concern due to custom services closing at 5 pm and we carried out the test at 8 pm.We managed to contact custom services first thing Monday (8 am ). and they gave us a new code number which allowed us to enter the next step of the Covid test and send off the test results.An e mail confirming that the sample had pasted was quickly sent back to us and we were all set for an early departure  the following day.

records.title: We used Project Screen by Prenetics for COVID test for Cruise
records.text: We used Project Screen by Prenetics for our Proctored Antigen test for our cruise. Ordering and delivery of the test kit was very easy and they were delivered next day. The online video nurse was very helpful and gave clear instructions of what we had to do. Would definitely use them again.

records.title: So much easier than you would expect!
records.text: We were quite in awe of doing this test especially we are in Rome. But thanks to your systems and Jessica (who was excellent) it went so much better then expected.  So when required we will using it again especially as we now have an account.

records.title: Was very anxious about the appointment
records.text: Was very anxious about the appointment, not having had any previous experience of this kind of process or zoom.   The Nurse was great and led me through every step of the process and she took time to explain and tell me what to do all the way to uploading the result.   Very happy with my experience.

records.title: First class service from this company
records.text: All the queries I had before and after ordering the tests were answered quickly and efficiently to reassure me of the process. Nurse Rhoby who did the video observed test was very helpful and took myself and my wife through the test with a very efficient and pleasant manner.  The video appointment was picked up right on time with no delay in answering. I would highly recommend this company for remote Covid testing

records.title: Professional staff
records.text: Professional staff. Great sense of humour too. Bay 1. Pilgrim 2

records.title: Good company to use for supervised testing
records.text: Had to get video supervised Covid test for upcoming cruise, chose Prenetics based on other decent reviews. Test was conducted via Zoom, very straightforward and easy process, the friendly nurse guides you step by step through the actual test, then makes sure that you know what you have to do next - basically take a picture of your result and upload it to them. The certificate arrived in email a little later on that evening (mine arrived after their stated time limit of 3 hours, hence the 4 stars). I'd use them again if needed as although the certificate was slightly late, the professional and friendly service more than made up for it.

records.title: Overall the process worked
records.text: Overall the process worked and we received the test report required for our travel plans.  The company helpline (both email and phone) was quick to respond and helpful.The two key glitches were a problem with time zones selection when booking the supervised test appointment and a change to available test opening hours that was not notified and only discovered during a routine process query by phone.  This could have caused real anxiety if we had not known and been unable to connect to the video supervision service from our overseas hotel prior to commencing our cruise.  Ultimately the process worked which is the main thing.

records.title: Lovely polite lady
records.text: Lovely polite lady. Talked through the whole process. Her accent was quite strong and she was wearing a mask therefore communication was a struggle I kept having to ask her to repeat. Received results within an hour.

records.title: Good Service, test confusing though?
records.text: Everything from website, ordering and delivery was first class. Even the help at Customer Service Chavani Mhinga excellent.But............ opening account in preparation of test was not clear when to do it. All around the words "do not activate before your ready for test"Ok, I eventually realised with help to open account. Then the test. You follow instructions then you complete and get result. You are ready to activate etc and Connection says wait 15 minutes before activate to get actual result.All this I did, activate and THEN it shows "timer" to wait 15 Minutes.......... well I had already done this so I had to override and submit. About two hours for result.All is well........ but slightly stressful following a very detailed guideline.

records.title: Prompt and efficient service.
records.text: Package delivered quickly after ordering. Follow up phone call from the company to check all was ok. I wasn’t expecting to provide so much information before taking the test so it took a while to gather what was requested, however there were good instructions to take you through every stage and the results were available on a pdf document almost immediately.

records.title: Very good service, except results took longer than advertised.
records.text: Everything was perfect, with the exception of receiving results, which took about 8 hours compared to the advertised 3.  In the circumstances, this was fine but it could have been problematic if I was working to a tight timeline.

records.title: The process worked fine if a little…
