records.text: The process worked fine if a little more complicated than other companies' procedures for the same test. But, we got the result we needed in good time.

records.title: Observed Lat Flow test.
records.text: Not exactly great. The girl was very helpful and patient with us but as older people we find these tests for holidays very stressful. But we got through it with her help.

records.title: The process was fairly smooth but for…
records.text: The process was fairly smooth but for those with limited 'tech-ability' it might be a little daunting.

records.title: I was not familiar with Zoom
records.text: I was not familiar with Zoom, so found it a struggle to connect to your nurse. However, we got there in the end.

records.title: Helpful nurse Amour helped us do our…
records.text: Helpful nurse Amour helped us do our virtual lateral flow test

records.title: Very pleasant nurse
records.text: Very pleasant nurse, explained well. But the system for observed test is flawed and a bit of a rocky box thing.

records.title: A bit confused as to what to do…
records.text: A bit confused as to what to do particularly with the zoom call!!

records.title: Person doing tests were very nice and…
records.text: Person doing tests were very nice and professional results received quickly only badcthibgwas hard to get connected very stressful

records.title: A very long process,and doubled up…
records.text: A very long process,and doubled up documentation for profiles. From taking the video test, having the results sent via email should be enough. The Sail screen info is unnecessary; however, the support team were very helpful on getting issues rectified. Elvin was a blessing to have on two consecutive days helping us, rather than a different person and having to explain it twice, he is the reason i awarded you 4 stars and not 2!

records.title: very helpful when we got sound took 3…
records.text: very helpful when we got sound took 3 attempts

records.title: Janelle was very helpful and patient
records.text: Janelle was very helpful and patient  - just what we needed to calm our anxieties.  Just one little point...it was difficult at times to hear what she was saying.  This may have been because she was wearing a mask (is this necessary for an online meeting??).

records.title: All good
records.text: We were taken through the process step by step.Had difficulty downloading the photo of our test, we as were doing it on an old laptop and had to send our photos from phones to email and on from there. Our nurse was very patient with us and went through all the procedure. We'll know for next time

records.title: No problemDPD delivery service  with buying procedure…
records.text: No problem with buying procedure however the delivery service was good to a point with communication then didn’t deliver. Said we were not in when we were. Waiting patiently I might add. Left it at a shop a mile away. For two people our age we found it very stressful.

records.title: Trying to upload the photo was a like…
records.text: Trying to upload the photo was a like tricky, if this could be simplified it would make it very simple to do

records.title: Customer service adviser couldn't…
records.text: Customer service adviser couldn't resolve an issue I had as he "hadn't had that kind of training" and hung up on me when I expressed frustration at this!

records.title: Having bought the kit we had no idea…
records.text: Having bought the kit we had no idea what to do with it. There needs to be full instruction in the box!! However we rang pronetics who talked us through the whole process beginning to end. Then we were supposed to receive the email and pdf result by 8pm (3 hours later than completing the test). It didn’t arrive until after 1am the next morning. Very stressful indeed!!

records.title: Confusing initially
records.text: The Nurse Wendy was very good professional but friendly disposition once I connected with her via zoom all straightforward and well explained.Before the test I was sent a confusing amount of emails some containing irrelevant information and the video showing how to complete the test seemed to be for an unobserved test and was narrated too fast. If I had followed the advice on that video I may well have activated my test too early causing all sorts of stress and issues.

records.title: Had difficulty understanding the…
records.text: Had difficulty understanding the instructions.  Might help if nurses did not wear masks.

records.title: Purchasing and delivery excellent…however zoom awful
records.text: Purchasing and delivery excellent however the zoom experience was extremely stressful and confusing we would never do this again we would prefer to do a face to face test

records.title: The technology is the bugbear
records.text: The technology is the bugbear. It all works but is very stressful.

records.title: The instruction video did not match the…
records.text: The instruction video did not match the testing kit we were sent. Also we did not receive a booking reference and so had to contact the company to get that.However, once submitted, test results were returned within minutes.

records.title: stressful
records.text: Unfortunately we found this extremely stressful.  It needs to be made alot clearer how to be able to book the medically witnessed appointment, there is just a link on the first email, after which you are bombarded with other emails.  Helpline people were helpful though.  There was an initial problem with the link for the meeting also - people who run the service need to remember that no everyone is an IT genius, but the lady who witnessed it was very pleasant.

records.title: Activation Code Card missing.
records.text: I received my Test Kit ontime as promised, however the Activation Code card was missing from the box and I had to contact Project Screen for a new one, this was dealt with very quickly,  however the one I was given did not work on my test kit and caused issues on the day of the Observed Antigen Test.

records.title: Really easy to organise
records.text: Really easy to organise. You py, then you can book a slot.  There were so many slots every day that we were spoilt for choice. Then you receive the kit in the post. After that, someone calls you to check you have everything before your booked slot. At the time of your booked slot it was super easy, a lovely nurse called Princess guided me through everything and she was very patient and caring. Very easy to upload pictures after of the test and then recieved the result certificate after about 20 minutes. Couldn't have been easier.

records.title: Overall Ok
records.text: Overall, the process was good. We managed to complete the observed test and upload our photos without any issues. However, there were 7 of us travelling and after an hour we had received 3 results back. We did not receive the other 4 results until we chased them up after the 3 hours had passed.

records.title: Registering test results
records.text: Ordering and delivery of test straightforward, as was taking the supervised test.Problems we encountered were with registering our results- one test had technical issues with results being issued and were delayed, the other wouldn’t let me activate the test as code already used - it wasn’t.But customer service was very good.

records.title: I had difficulties uploading the test…
records.text: I had difficulties uploading the test photo, so ‘phoned for assistance and was advised to email it. However, when I tried I found that the email kept bouncing back. I ‘phoned again and received helpful advice that enabled me eventually to upload the photo and resolve the problem.

records.title: The nurse was very good but who is to…
records.text: The nurse was very good but who is to say it is correct test being submittedThe client has 15 minutes to get result and uploadAny test could be sentMoney for nothing

records.title: Need a lot better FAQ and examples
records.text: Need a lot better FAQ and examples.  Maybe some YouTube videos would help a lot for people who are not very tech savvy.  For example: Do I do a Zoom video on my web browser or on my iPhone app or both?

records.title: They haven’t thought thru end to end process
records.text: Mostly very good but the first kit had already been activated/ the number reused so we had a frantic call to customer services for a new number while trying to keep within the 12 minute appointment so my husband could make his appointment on time. You need two devices at least to do these tests especially if more than two of you are doing them as the time overlaps. It’s very stressful for groups without appointments being spaced out. The app doesn’t work at all. And if you’re taking the test in another country ensure you’re logged into the website before you leave the uk otherwise they won’t be able to send you a text code to access the site. Lots of very stressful things they haven’t thought through from a user perspective.

records.title: Use the website not the app
records.text: I found the instructions non existant and rather complicated and made the mistake of downloading the app onto my phone instead of using the website _dont use the app! You can google a video of a man carrying out the test and recording a result very informative - but it is only for corporate customers on the app - be warnedThe people on the phone help desk were very helpful however

records.title: Trouble with the website
records.text: It hasn't been a strait forward process. First it is not said you have to create an account to process the test, I guessed it after a while. Then the website wasn't working for me creating one account. It has to be done over the phone. Then I couldn't upload my result. I had to ring again to have an email address to send the result. In both cases the staff was extremely efficient, nice and patient.  5 star for them. I had my result within 2h, perfect.

records.title: Everything in life is easy when you…
records.text: Everything in life is easy when you know how. Things can be easier if an email is sent that all people. Not just computer literate can understand. Example. You need to download an app called Zoom and then explain step by step what you will be expected to do. The people I have been talking to were as helpful as they could be, and very courteous, but if the recipient is not computer literate life becomes difficult for everybody.

records.title: Not worth of the money you only get a…
records.text: Not worth of the money you only get a piece of paper on it doesn’t tell you if you’re negative or positive

records.title: Stressful process
records.text: Taking the test via the Zoom call itself was all very simple. We were told we’d have the email within 3hrs but if not, to send an email to an address we were given. Three hours goes by, no email. We send an email to chase, an hour goes by - nothing. We then use the Zoom meeting to speak with someone (as the landline of course was only monitored in office hours). He sends a chaser email. Finally 6hrs after we did the test we got the email - this was at 23:45, when we had to be up early to leave for our cruise. Such a stressful experience.

records.title: Rude and condescending
records.text: Spoke too quickly.  Was not clear and then rude and patronising.  When we were not able to hear him, he rude and repeated in a very condescending manner.  The office he was in was noisy and interefered with the sound quality.

records.title: You can not understand how to do it I…
records.text: You can not understand how to do it I don’t know how old people do this

records.title: We (3 of us) did a televisit and…
records.text: We (3 of us) did a televisit and completed our tests. There seemed to be some issue with logging into my account. The nurse said not to worry about it and that she would "escalate" it. She said we would be getting a call and an email confirmation of our negative tests that we could upload to the Disney cruise website. Neither ot these happened and I ended up spending hours trying to sort it out and my son ended up having to re-test as we got on to the ship.

records.title: The test and nurse were both easy and…
records.text: The test and nurse were both easy and very efficiently carried out. The loading up of accounts was also fairly easy. However we had to upload two results twice I order to complete the safe sail. Overall definitely use again as it’ll be even raise next time. Not sure why we had to reload but computer connection was slow.

records.title: Not enough info indicated before you…
records.text: Not enough info indicated before you are online .... ie. Didnt have passed 3 dates and covid injection, booster to hand, setting up an account first ? And not user friendly operation.The assumption everyone is at home with wifi is wrong as we were in hotel withe poor connection etc and no full access to info required on the portal.Not a good experience.

records.title: Very difficult to understand especially…
records.text: Very difficult to understand especially because the operative was wearing a mask in an empty office !!!

records.title: Not very good at all
records.text: Couldn't tell what the nurse was saying. She had a strong American dialect, talked quickly, and was wearing a facemask. I told her repeatedly that I could not understand what she was saying and she got annoyed with me, as it it was my fault!Also, I asked her on at least 2 occasions that surely it was the case that I also had to photograph the form. Both times she said no. Luckily my partner had a test 20 minutes later and we actually was given the correct information. This, is not good. Apart from that the results came through quickly.

records.title: The instructions never came to my email…
records.text: The instructions never came to my email address so my daughter called and ask to have it sent to her email. They said we didn't need the email address but she send it to hers anyway. When we got the kit, we did need the email address for instructions. We called them again and she said oh I never sent it to my daughter's email address. They finally sent it but it was about 3 or 4 p.m. and I was leaving at 9 the next morning. It was very frustrating.

description:
Oncologica is a world leading precision cancer medicine and Covid-19 testing and genomic sequencing laboratory. Oncologica provides personalized precision medicine testing and oncology genetic diagnostics to aid cancer patient therapy.

We perform high throughput genomic Covid-19 PCR self-swab laboratory testing services in order to safeguard communities from variants of concern.

records.title: Happy with the quick delivery  and simplicity …
records.text: Very happy with this service that simplifies to the max what it used to be an stressfull experience.Please keep work that.Although I could not buy a second one!I hope they continue, please!

records.title: We had an amazing experience
records.text: We had an amazing experience.  Kits ordered online came next day. We dropped the sample next day 9am and the result was uploaded by 3pm. Would definitely recommend. Thanks oncologica

records.title: Amazing service!
records.text: Amazing service. I posted the test on Monday via a priority box needing the results back by Wednesday latest due to having surgery on Thursday. It only got received on Wednesday morning at 10:15. I had called before hand to explain the situation so they said they would fast track for me and I got the results back at 15:15. Would definitely recommend. Thank you for helping me out.

records.title: Exceptional Customer support
records.text: Our test kits arrived a day late .........Royal Mail problem.This caused a problem as to when results would arrive over a Bank Holiday weekend.I spoke to Sarah Vincent at Oncologica who was very informative and efficient.She phoned me to tell me our swabs had arrived and we had results later that day. Excellent service.

records.title: Very good experience
records.text: Very good experience. No hassle. Got the report on time for travel.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service. Fully deserves 5 stars- from ordering and shipping to activating kits and getting swift results. Amazing team. Well done! I’ve ordered only from Oncologica in the last 2 years- PCR as well as day 2,5 and LFTs- never had an issue. Thank you!

records.title: It was very easy to use and…
records.text: It was very easy to use and instructions were clear and straightforward. I liked the fact that you can upload your result online with instant certificate received. Would definitely recommend. Used it for entry to France

records.title: Test arrived within a couple of days
records.text: Test arrived within a couple of days. Clear instructions. Received confirmation of fit to travel document with in the hour.Very good service.

records.title: Success Resolution
records.text: I truly appreciated the kind and helpful manner of Sarah. The complications that arise from technologies can sometimes be overwhelming for a senior! Sarah was consistently patient and walked me through the process and along with Laura we will able to complete the task so my husband and I could board the ship.

records.title: I purchased the lateral flow tests to…
records.text: I purchased the lateral flow tests to take for a trip abroad. The instructions were easy to use and the process was quick; complete the form online (add your passport number (document id), personal details etc), take the test and submit the results. Within 15 minutes the certificates arrived to my email inbox! Very pleased with this service, thank you!

records.title: I can’t fault the service but the only…
records.text: I can’t fault the service but the only thing stopping me giving it a 5* rating was that I could not get hold of anyone to ask some questions I had. The chat was never available and the phone no either didn’t answer or cut off or I was held in a queue for too long. But the test was done quickly and the paperwork was good. Thankyou.

records.title: The service was quick and efficient…
records.text: The service was quick and efficient with the result arriving earlier than expected.  My only problem was that I couldn't find the number that should have been included with the test. When I asked for help their response was swift.

records.title: Very efficient once you could fill in…
records.text: Very efficient once you could fill in the paperwork. Missed the passport number as neither myself or my husband who was watching me do it saw the documents part. Also the date of birth very bling winded when you are older.

records.title: The service was very fast and efficient…however beware
records.text: The service was very fast and efficient however the instructions in the video vs the ones in the box and in the app vary, which is super confusing at the time of taking the test. Also, took a while to find the Reference number required on the form as it was never mentioned in any of the instructions where to find it!

records.title: Test was straight forward & results…
records.text: Test was straight forward & results available within an hour. Reasonable price.

records.title: Everything was as stated
records.text: Everything was as stated, from order to dispatch to follow up advice.Impressive service and reasonable price as now have to pay. Thank you

records.title: 4 stars but generally worthy of 5!
records.text: I have used Oncologica several times now for PCR tests for travel. They have always been very good, very efficient, and very responsive to issues. On previous experience I would have given them 5 stars, however based on my test this week it has to be 4, because: i) web access had an error and I couldn't get my profile completed, ii) the wrong swab time was put on my certificate and I had to request a change. I have to say though that these things were remedied very quickly, so I do appreciate that, and I know it's much better than I'd get from elsewhere.

records.title: Good customer service and prompt…
records.text: Good customer service and prompt processing of the sample. The only problem was accessing the required PDF version of the result needed for a form to allow quarantine-free entry to the country to be visited. It would be helpful if there was a consent option to enable the PDF of the result to be downloaded rather than the current password protected version that cannot be downloaded and uploaded to forms as was required.

records.title: Arrived on time
records.text: Arrived on time, quick results.Issue with the password login in (there was a bug on the website) made it a 4 star instead of 5

records.title: The results took too long
records.text: The results took too long. It was almost 48hours after posting my PCR test. Maybe the delay was due to Royal Mail but I was at the check in desk at the airport when the results came through. Needless to say I was very appréhensive. Other than that the information was top and the instructions easy to follow.

records.title: Lateral flow test
records.text: Good for awkward flight times as done at home with quick response with fit to fly certificate for lateral flow test

records.title: Only downside was the time it took to…
records.text: Only downside was the time it took to deliver the tests

records.title: Antigen Test
records.text: All worked as expected. Economical cost too.

records.title: Amazing service.
records.text: Amazing service.The package arrived quickly, and I was kept on track with what was happening with my testing. The package has everything you need and when I had a problem with my previous test, they sent me over one free of charge to solve my problems. The customer service was nice and quick. My only complaint is that they took longer than 48 hours to give me back my test results.

records.title: Day 2 LFT test
records.text: My husband and I had a problem with uploading our LFT test results on return from our holiday. Apparently, the quality of our uploads was not good enough for them to verify them. However, after some email exchanges with the Coronafocus help desk, they helped us to resolve the problem and eased our anxiety. We are both quite elderly so appreciated their guidance.

records.title: All went relatively smoothly
records.text: All went very smoothly booking the test and test delivery, reasonable price and results returned to us very quickly. Only reason not 5 stars is that their app would not work with my iPhone camera no matter how hard I tried so in the end had to take an ordinary photo outside of their app and load it via a different PC. Have used before, and would use again, if testing still required.

records.title: It was easy to order
records.text: It was easy to order, efficient and reasonably priced. The only improvement I would say is to make the communication andinstructions clearer. I found them confusing at times. Especially when dealing with the app and uploading results. I think it could be streamlined. Also I had to change the date on one test I ordered and they could do that, which was great.

records.title: This process was fairly streamlined
records.text: This process was fairly streamlined. Some confusion between the steps for the specimen on the app - says 4 drops in step 4.5 abs then 2 drops in step 5. Instructions with kit say 4 so I ent with that. App would not access my camera for some reasons but there was an alternate process which worked. Overall very smooth.

records.title: Good day,
records.text: Good day,The test procedure instructions were perfectly clear but the login and when to activate the test kit were not so easy to follow. The activation instruction comes at the beginning of the guidance notes but when doing the test, the activation button comes right at the end which was a little confusing

records.title: The delivery and instructions were…
records.text: The delivery and instructions were excellent but the app failed several times and I couldn’t log in. I had to go on live chat and was told to contact the help desk, eventually I was sent a link with a form to fill in and upload the photo of my test result. The problem with the app and the resolution took too much time especially when I had another appointment to attend

records.title: On average
records.text: Fast shipping, ease of use of the portal and ease of test doing. Customer service could improve and solving customer issues.

records.title: OK, but customer service could be alot better
records.text: The actual delivery of kits quick, but can't ever get hold of anyone. Phones don't work and neither does chat. Managed to get an answer back in email, but nothing back on further emails. The actual delivery of results was quick. Shame about customer service.

records.title: Excellent customer service from Sarah…
records.text: Excellent customer service from Sarah Vincent. I talked to her about a purchase that needs changing.She was very helpful and responsive. Excellent service she deserves 5 stars! Unfortunately, I also had to deal with the team responsible for refunds and they weren't so helpful. Took 6 weeks to reply my first email after repeated inquiries. Over the phone they were not very willing to even listen to the problem. We came to a semi solution only after 4 months of emails and phone calls.Can't give 5 stars to the company because of that.

records.title: Inaccurate and late
records.text: I paid for a service which would guaranty a PCR fit to fly result within 24 hours as they use priority postal services, but it’s been 72 hours and still no result . When I contacted the lab they said that the delay may be caused by the post office and that it would be better to drive to the lab to drop off to guaranty fast results, which us very far from where I live. The delayed kit was posted together with 2 other kits for which we got the results within 24h. One of which was positive for my 8 year old, which had completely ruined our trip that had been changed twice already due to the pandemic. Furthermore, we had a second PCR test elsewhere which proved my daughter is negative. We have now had to change our flights again for £400 and my husband had lost his flight alltogether.

records.title: All the staff I dealt with were…
records.text: All the staff I dealt with were absolutely brilliant. However, why make the procedure so difficult and complicated. Very stressful for muu if st people especially older people. I am 73 and I was at the end of my tether.

records.title: Wrong test results
records.text: I have not yet sent my sample for the test, and have already received the wrong results. This is really disappointing. Am trying to get in touch with Oncologica to help with the issue. Hopefully they will be able to rectify this for me asap.

records.title: Reliable
records.text: Results arrived more quickly than expected - 8 hours instead of 24. The app was tricky to use. Phone support was very slow. Email support was a little quicker. Would use again.

records.title: Service event well until we had to…
records.text: Service event well until we had to download the certification which could not be done

records.title: Spent 40 £ to have unclear result
records.text: Spent 40 £ to have unclear result! And when I tested with rapid test I tested positive!

records.title: Not clear why my COVID test sample was…
records.text: Not clear why my COVID test sample was rejected

records.title: Day 2 Test
records.text: Day 2 TestDelivery was well documented. However I did buy a wrong package which only showed up in the confirmation email. When I phoned to change it they refused to refund me, cancel the order or change it for the one I needed. Initial sign up for the package I wanted wasn’t clear to me hence buying the wrong package. So in the end I’ve ended up paying double what I wanted. Take careful note of sign up. Results were swift and easy to access although my results were inconclusive?

records.title: Your timing is perfect for result and…
records.text: Your timing is perfect for result and test performance however a lack of clarity and concern when I had a concern with certain two close timings of two PCR tests which of one was first Positive then the second Negative I then had a concern for a flight a day after saying I cannot discuss results of tests did not help me so you get a 2.5 star you took my money but not explanation for NHS track and trace????!!!

records.title: Service and convenience good and prompt…
records.text: Service and convenience good and prompt .Getting the activation done online a nightmare as the ‘activate’ button disappeared both on the iPad and computer when we tried it having filled in the questionnaire. Both times we rang the help desk they were amazing and sorted it for us but not sure why we couldn’t do it ourselves.

records.title: Could be improved
records.text: Unfortunately, I haven't received my order on time. By tracking the parcels it was in London and took 4 days to get to Buckingham. So tracking system should be improved by adding a few checking points otherwise It doesn't have sence (At office - London(central office) - delivered). However, the people who work in supporting service are very operative and helpful.The way of getting results is quite complicated.

records.title: It seemed to take some time to get the…
records.text: It seemed to take some time to get the result maybe that is also related to the postal service. My TTR was said to be shipped on the 19th but it never got shipped on the 19th. I guess this is because Day 5 for my quarantine is on the 20th but then I don’t understand why I get notified that it’s being shipped when it is not. In short, your communication could be more precise.

records.title: When i ordered the test for a specific…
records.text: When i ordered the test for a specific delivery date, it arrived a day late as was dispatched on the delivery date required. Luckily we did the test as a dummy run to figure out ins and outs of testing for flying. So i left it a few days before testing and tried it out to ensure if it would be approved or not. Thankfully it was and does work. Very quick response but should state that you can order tests earlier in preparation, rather than required 48 hours before flying as stated.

records.title: iPhone 12 wouldn't scan cassette result
records.text: As explained in emails - my iPhone 12 wouldn't scan with your App and ended up taking photo and attaching in email. Could do with information on instruction sheet accompanying test kit to explain what to do in the event of this happening with an identified Oncol email address to send it as I had to search many previous emails from Oncol to try and find out what to do.

records.title: I phoned in
records.text: I phoned in . I am fully vaccinated and boostered  up came from France . I phoned as it said waiting for results . The lady said results up to 5 days . So instead of loosing it I put the phone down .. the result came 29 minutes later . I am so upset and annoyed as all aggregation . It’s best to say . You are logged in and results can come through in 30 minutes. - 5 days and I would have understood. You put yourselves down . No need

records.title: A bit slow but ok..
records.text: A bit slow but ok... The delivery of the kits was good (on day 1, in saturday), but day 2 test took a lot of time to arrive to the laboratory (IN CAMBRIDGE). However, day 8 test was faster to arrive, and I received results on day 10. In sum, the sample takes 2-3 working-days to arrive to the lab; from then, results are available in less than 24 hours. The web app is ok, as it allows you to see if your test have arrived to lab and if your results are ready.

records.title: Instructions were not straightforward…
records.text: Instructions were not straightforward and support negligible when QR code did not appear on the certificate.Results were back very quickly and test was delivered promptly.Also not clear that you cannot use a desktop and a mobile device together - ie you cannot set it up on the desktop as that information will not appear in the mobile app

records.title: Disappointed by the service the timing…
records.text: Disappointed by the service the timing of results resulted in having to have another test. Also it was meant to be a 2 pack test but was not the results were produced to meet Royal mail postage which then resulted in the results being produced to soon to validate eu travel. Very dissapoint with the second customer care agent who refused to discuss the tests arrival being late. An the further not being able to meet the needs for the travel date provided before the sale. Soon as they had payment they claimed all kinds of excuses for not meeting the requirements even though I went over an over the required dates and time frame required. An the test was to soon. Awful service does not do as they claim. Therefore it cost me more than twice as much to then have rush tests done hours before travel from another facility.

records.title: Instructions difficult to follow
records.text: Instructions online are inconsistent with those enclosed with the PCR test package, the latter also being incomplete. Juggling between passwords, codes and generated username was a nightmare. I put the sample bottle in the box and sealed the bag, only then discovered that you had to enter online the bar code on the bottle. The result was sent quickly after a slow postal process, but it was not in a form that could be downloaded (download button unresponsive). To get a pdf copy, essential for my purposes, necessitated contacting Oncologica staff and re-entering personal details. All-in-all a very slow, cumbersome process. On the plus side, the staff responded promptly to my queries.

records.title: Don’t use if you need to take PCR 48 hours before flight
records.text: Doesn’t suit travellers who need to take PCR tests within the 48 hour range, as they will not test in time and this is unreliable for fast turnovers. Had to buy another emergency one that cost £150 for same day results and although the staff were responsive and kind there were no concrete answers. Only use this service if your travel allows more time to take PCR tests. Wasted my money, so expensive as well. Didn’t want to be disappointed as a friend recommended this but I am.

records.title: I don't understand why my online fit to…
records.text: I don't understand why my online fit to fly test result certificate needs to have any other information on beside my passport number , name and flight number. Why was my address printed out there in detail for every undereducated cop to see and every untrained airport security person to see? That is against GDPR regulation as you are giving out more information than what is needed for the identification of the person. People in these flashy quick-to-sprout medical companies, you need to do your homework in terms of personal data protection. I have lost trust in you sorry.

records.title: The instructions are very complicated…
records.text: The instructions are very complicated including the variety of steps and the codes and passwords required. Each test took a lot of time and anxiety, eventually resolved by calling a relative for help through the steps.

records.title: They work well, when they work
records.text: They work well, when they work. The 2 star is for their terrible customer service. Had an issue with my test. I took the test the day of the flight. There was an issue with the certificate, and spent 1h 30 min in the phone. Gave up and took at test at the airport. Still waiting to hear back from them.

records.title: Unfortunately my specimen was not…
records.text: Unfortunately my specimen was not collected/delivered by your preferred supplier (Royal Mail) until after my departure date. The consequence was that I needed to pay and have another test done to enable me to fly out of the UK.I only received my results the day after I arrived back in South Africa.

records.title: Extremely slow and got results on 4th day.
records.text: Extremely slow and got results on 4th day after taking test. Friday to Tuesday! This is supposed to be an international 2 day test with results in 24 hours. Tried to call and couldn’t get through to anyone. Left them an email on their own ticketing service, but got no reply. I would not use this company again, and the airlines should take them off of their list of recommended companies to use.

records.title: Two main problems
records.text: Two main problems.  Firstly it was not at all clear what the "Document ID" is?  Passport number?  Test number?  Oncol booking ref?  Who knows?Secondly, the certificate has bright green for the "negative" panel and the signature is another colour.  WHen printed on a mono printer these disappear!

records.title: After an initial good contact review…
records.text: After an initial good contact review things suddenly went downhill.I initially ordered two wrong covid test kits and contacted the company immediately and they told me to order and pay again and the initial cost would be refunded.I have contacted the company 21 times by email and at least three times by telephone and it refunded the cost of only one test after about six weeks and the second test after ten weeks. These refunds have taken far too long and lots of form filling causing lots of stress.

description: Leading COVID-19 Medical Laboratory

records.title: Last minute saviours!
records.text: Checked last minute to realise my vaccination status was not valid for entry. Scoured everywhere for a last minute covid test with certification on the weekend.Paid for a PCR next day result on a Saturday as that was the only option available, flying out Monday. The person at the test centre was so friendly and helpful, got the test result and certificate the same day removing all the pent up stress pre-holiday.They didn’t bother checking my certificate on arrival so wasn’t needed in the end, Sod’s law. Couldn’t recommend enough, thank you.

records.title: Quick and efficient results back one day earlier
records.text: PCR for holiday, had discounts code from airline with others but then their Ad popped up on my Facebook, it’s was cheaper and closer. Booked and paid £49 online at Leeds 25/4 at 10:15, got email at 17:10 saying my sample had arrived at Lab, another at 18:00 saying entered testing and at 20:00 email confirmation with certificate attached and signed. Really happy to have got this same day, I’d paid for next day by 23:59 Tuesday but got results 20:00 Monday. Will use them again.

records.title: Absolutely incredible service
records.text: Absolutely incredible service from Shirley after a test upload failed. Even past midnight Shirley was responsive and reassuring and resolved everything. The travel anxiety was real but Shirley saved the day.Prior to this the tests came a few days before they were needed, well packaged and instructions were simple to follow. I’d recommend Assured Screening in a heartbeat. Fantastic service from start to finish.

records.title: Impressed with the fast and efficient…
records.text: Impressed with the fast and efficient service received. Dropped off our tests at our local drop-box around midday and had results back by 22:30 the same day. During the day we were informed by email when our tests were received at the lab, when they entered the lab for testing and then our results came back in a document complete with QR code.

records.title: Good experience, would use again
records.text: After reading recent reviews, we were a bit worried about the reliability of Assured. However, everything went very smoothly. We had a PCR at home and we used an Assured drop box and had our results midday the following day. We also received email updates at each stage of the journey which kept us at ease. Would use again. Royal Mail has been having a ton of issues post holidays so if you use the drop boxes you won’t be in for any surprises.

records.title: Highly recommended!
records.text: We used fit to fly pre travel pcr test at Ellesmere Port, 27th February 2022, second time we have used them, went to the unit at 1800, very helpful and polite young lady, test result was back (via email) at 1400 next day, the best way to get these tests done without trouble is to have it done at the unit, not postal test.We didn't get any update emails as to the progress of the tests so we used Chatbot, was answered immediately, spoke to a Natasha who updated us.Will definitely use them again

records.title: After reading the reviews I was so…
records.text: After reading the reviews I was so worried this company would let us down and ruin our holiday. However, we were allowed to enter 10 mins before our allocated time 12.00pm). Receptionist was very helpful and friendly, helping us when needed. Then at 3pm the following day our results arrived!! Pure relief. Thank you AssuredScreening.com - will use again and recommend.

records.title: Very happy
records.text: Was slightly worried after reading some of the reviews but everything went super smoothly! Did same day PCR test at the appoint clinic in Leeds - very easy, results came earlier than expected :)

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. Paid for outbound pcr test with next day result up to midnight Great communication - email sent on every step from receiving sample in the lab, Testing to results which arrived same day so even faster than expected.

records.title: Superb service from a trusted provider.
records.text: Superb service from a trusted provider.I have used Assured Screening on a few occasions now and i have always been so impressed by their service. The Drop Off boxes not only provide a risk free service, but also include actual humans sat behind a desk who are happy and willing to answer your questions. One such person was Carrie from the Newark office. She was above and beyond helpful and is a real credit to the organisation.There are cheaper providers out there that have provided me with terrible service with lost tests etc...for a stress free process pick these guys!!!

records.title: I had a mostly positive experience with…
records.text: I had a mostly positive experience with AssuredScreening.com. Trying to handle a last-minute covid test for a flight, I found their service efficient and reliable. The staff at the test center were friendly and helpful, ensuring I got my PCR result and certificate promptly, which eased my pre-trip stress. Despite some issues at another test center regarding cleanliness and equipment, the quick turnaround on results was appreciated. Communication and customer service seem to be areas needing improvement based on past experiences, but my recent interaction was smooth, with a great same-day result that exceeded expectations. Overall, a solid choice for PCR testing. 4 stars.

records.title: PCR for travel with certificate
records.text: We have used the site on Tyne Tunnel trading estate twice. Results as promised the next day however both times the results went into junk box despite all other emails from Assured going straight to inbox. Drop box and appointment services used. It does look a little shabby but overall happy. Also helped to change DOB on the certificate as this has been inputted incorrectly by a family member.

records.title: Booked this test after issues…
records.text: Booked this test after issues encountered with the BOOTS Day 2 test, similar to comments on Trust Pilot. As I was already on Day 2, I could not put in my actual day of arrival when ordering the kit, which was held up until the following day. The only downside I can see to the test was that Edinburgh had a single dropbox at the lab itself, not easily accessible by public transport for the test to be dropped off. Results were quick by email once complete. I will definitely use this service again

records.title: Great Service
records.text: I was due to fly to the USA in May last year and had paid for my day 2 and 8 return tests but my visit was cancelled due to covid so I email Assured to tell the that I was going in January 2022 and they send me a new conformation letter so I using the test now....just waiting for my day 2 results which is taking a long time....but overall great service

records.title: Very efficient service at test centre
records.text: Very efficient service at Silverlink Test centre.  Fast turnaround on PCR result.  A criticism would be that the centre is not very clean, lights for throat swab don't work, shelf for placing kit was hanging off the wall fixed by some duck tape.

records.title: I booked to go to the test site for my…
records.text: I booked to go to the test site for my day 2 international arrivals PCR after another company failed to deliver the test I had ordered 2 weeks before. I received a confirmation email of the appointment. It all went smoothly at the test site. I received an email saying it had been collected and another to say it was in the lab for testing. Then it  hit a snag  as they emailed to say the test had to be retested for some reason and I did start to worry. More emails to say it was back in for retesting and then my result. The retest added a few hours but it wasn't too bad.I would use Assured screening again, they maybe a bit more expensive than some others but at least they did what you pay for, other than another company which appear to be total scammers.

records.title: The QR code issue
records.text: I have previously used Assured Screening for pre-travel testing, driving to France, and been satisfied with the process and service.  However, I received my PCR test result this afternoon, ready for my flight in less than 24 hours, to Australia via a transit in Dubai.  It was only a chance remark from my son that alerted me to the QR code problem - they are mandatory for Emirates flights and I didn't have one.  After a stressful, panicky few hours I drove to East Midlands airport in the Friday evening half-term rush-hour for a second test and now have my certificate and QR code.  But I wasted £79 using Assured Screening; they really should make it VERY clear to the unsuspecting public that they do not provide QR codes - unlike most of the other private testing companies.  I could have been denied boarding tomorrow, which just doesn't bear thinking about.

records.title: Very smooth process throughout
records.text: Very smooth process throughout. Ordered, fast delivery. Dropped the test at the allocated spot and it was collected and processed well within the next day promise and this being 3-4 days before Xmas, I am so happy with that considering it is so much cheaper than all the alternatives. My only reason for 4stars instead of 5 was because the need for passport details when my son doesn't have one and doesn't need one because of the CTA, so that was annoying to organise and the lack of human communication in the questions page to answer any questions outside of FAQs. But I am so happy and will use this service again as a result.

records.title: Day 2 PCR test on time
records.text: Booked the Day 2 test and then had to complete a short questionnaire informing about my arrival in the UK, etc. I immediately then got the code to include in the PLF form. Once arrived in the UK, I visited the King's Cross test centre. The staff gave me the pack and then I had to do the test by myself. This is why I've given 4 and not 5 stars. Since it's a PCR test, I'd prefer if there was a professional to do it. I later received two emails. The first one informed me that the sample has arrived at the lab and the second one that the sample is being processed. I received the first email around 1am and the second one at 1pm the next day. I then received the test results at 8pm the next day. The overall experience was ok. I was a bit hesitant and didn't know what to expect after reading the negative reviews but this is just my personal experience.

records.title: Reasonable price and good helpful…
records.text: Reasonable price and good helpful staff. The staff at king cross are so professional and helpful. I paid for the results back in 2 pm next day, but the result was out by the same day. That was over expected. Really recommend.

records.title: Post Office delays
records.text: Assured screening very efficient and professional, as previously.   Pity Royal Mail took 5 days to deliver instead of next working day! (Posted on a Saturday).

records.title: Some difficulties but a positive response from customer services
records.text: We booked 4x PCR tests prior to travel back to Australia. We used the clinic in Edinburgh. At the time of booking tests were required 72 hours before departure. We booked next day test results costing Just over £300.However, 14 hours after booking UAE changed their requirements and we needed our test 48 hours before arrival.As we were within 48 hours of our test booking we were unable to change our booking. The chatbot was useless and just said we couldnt cancel our booking. It was impossible to speak to any one by phone and the email address had an automatic response to say it wasn't monitored. All we wanted to do was move our appointment by 24 hours.We were left with no option but to rebook and pay the £300+ again. (We will try and claim this on our travel insurance.)I accept that this is part of the terms and conditions, and it was made clear at the time of booking. However, it seems very inflexible when the change was forced upon us. Even the woman at the test centre expressed surprise (she recognised our name from the appointments the day before)That said, the testing process was very good. Appointment on time. Clear information on booking and attending. The trsting process was simple and clearly explained. we received results as promised. It was also reassuring to receive email alerts that sample had been received in the lab, was being processed etc.Results were received within promised time frame and report provided all the required information  for our flight.I would use this company again (and hope travel requirements didn't change at short notice) Much better than the testngo postal service which we used for our arrival in UK.Update Jan 25thAfter posting this review, I'm pleased to report that assured screening have refunded the cost of our unused test and appointments.Thank you Assured Screening. I've changed my rating from 3* to 4* (I can't give it 5* as we couldn't contact anyone at the time we had our difficulties) but we are thrilled that you have refunded our money.We will use your company again and would recommend you to others.

records.title: The only place i could find for a test…
records.text: The only place i could find for a test on Christmas Day. Place was easy to find and the process was easy. Test result received the next day as promised.

records.title: The lady at the desk was helpful and…
records.text: The lady at the desk was helpful and very kind.I didn't get her name but she deserves a great xmas

records.title: Online contact only
records.text: This service was efficient and results were emailed on time.  However this was the first time we had used this service and we had a couple of queries.  Unfortunately the on line robot only had answers to preset questions.  it was not possible to contact this company by email either and this was quite stressful so would probably not use again, preferring to have telephone contact with a human being in the case of a query.

records.title: Day 2 arrival pcr test
records.text: Generally a good service . Attended centre for day 2 arrival pcr test and result was  received day after test. I did have a query during the patient registration process but emails and messages were unanswered and can’t contact over phone . Having said that I completed the patient  registration  form unassisted in the end. Lack of ability to contact however may be an issue if there is a problem with receiving result etc.

records.title: Had a bit of a shock when the test…
records.text: Had a bit of a shock when the test results came back saying they needed to be re tested as we were flying the next day and the email said it could take up to 24 hours which would have meant potentially llllll not getting our flight. Found it frustrating we could not speak to anyone but after emailing them we did hear back and thankfully we got the test result back in time to be able to make our flight

records.title: Need to address title of text when…
records.text: Need to address title of text when arranging delivery.The text I received read  HONEYMAN and then about delivery. no mention of covid test. so i deleted mine, thinking it was spam!!!!you must admit HONEYMAN does sound a bit dodgy :)Luckily when i saw my husband later, he had arranged for his to be left in a safe place and the deliveryman had the sense to leave both. Good serviceMany thanks

records.title: Overall good service
records.text: Good service except for the fact that the T&C’s seemed to indicate that the tests would be sent within 2 days of receipt of the order whereas they are actually posted within 2 days of return travel. Had difficulty contacting Assured Screening for clarification regarding this issue, but otherwise a good service and would certainly use again if PCR tests are required in the future.

records.title: I did and posted my test on 10 October
records.text: I did and posted my test on 10 October. On 13th, I8.50 I finally got a message to say that the test had been received, processed and the result was negative. I tried to track my parcel on 11th, 12th and 13th and kept getting the same answer, not possible to connect to server. The links that were sent to me to track, or to follow the test in the process of being verified didn’t work.

records.title: Giving this 3* mainly because..
records.text: Giving this 3*, nothing against assured testing but more to do with the fact they use royal mail labels to deal with pcr being sent back to the lab. I posted in priority postbox, as I needed 72hr test cos I'm flying Monday, it is day 3 now and it hasn't even been tracked. Spoke to assured testing snd they havent even got my sample, so it has not arrived. It should've been tracked Friday evening when it was "collected", and delivered Saturday. I did it this way before and had my results by sunday so no idea what RM are playing at.So word of warning, even between Mon and Fri, do not take any chances. Go in clinic or post directly if you can, even if it is far cos I had to travel 35 miles to a clinic to get a same day pcr test done so I could fly on Monday.

records.title: Great customer service and results came in time even after RETEST
records.text: Great customer service and received final results in time. My PCR test result first came out as "RETEST", talked to customer service and they expedited retesting (using the original sample) and finally got results in next couple of hours. Back on track with my travel plans. I didn't give full 5 starts because it caused a huge panic when they sent out "RETEST" notice along with message that retesting would take another 24 hours, which would have ruined my travel plans . However, they expedited the retesting on my followup, so all is well that ends well. The final results were still within originally promised time.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Poor customer service this time. Cannot reach anyone and Cyberon hasn't been very helpful. The link in the email they provide for questions regarding my test doesn't work. The page cannot be found and it gets directed to a tawk.to page where a  parakeet appears. Would like to know how can they speed up the retest process as I needed my results urgently. This was last night but assured screening manage to turn around the retest in less than 24 hours and received a new confirmation with the result just before  midnight. They could have provided more information regarding how long the retest was going to really take to avoid the stress.

records.title: Good so long long as you do drop off.
records.text: We sent two tests by post, one arrived, one didn't, until we'd gone on a mad scramble and paid and extra £90 for one at the airport. We couldn't risk it. So post, or their receipt can be dodgy.

records.title: cancel button disabled and no contact info doesn't mean you can just keep my money.
records.text: I have to cancel my appt with AS as travel requirements to the country I am going to have changed. My appt is over a week away so terms say i should be able to cancel. However, there is no option to cancel when you click the link they provide to do this in the confirmation email. it just lets you reschedule. I've sent numerous requests through that stupid robot chat service on their site and not heard back.I'm within my rights to cancel on the terms i agreed to within paying and yet Assured seem to think that giving people no way to cancel and no contact information means they can just keep my money.Disgusting.Update I contacted the email below and got an immediate response. Please be aware that the email they give on confirmation receipts doesn't work (enquires) and there is no contact email listed on the site either so making this information more readily available could have saved a lot of frustration.

records.title: Really hard to use website
records.text: Really hard to use website, took ages. Gave up, and it's really an insult that they have a chat box with an automated person that goes nowhere. Money given to another firm for above reasons.

records.title: OK, but swab should be taken by professional
records.text: All good, except that the swab is nottaken by a professional but by the person themself (and it's not even supervised) - this is likely to lead to inaccuracy, and people could even cheat by swabbing incorrectly/not fully.

records.title: Although the LabAssuredS reeling - feedback
records.text: Although the Lab. staff were helpful and my result was delivered in time for us to travel to Romania, your testing site Unit 13 , Evans Business Park, in Ratho/ Edinburgh was VERY DIFFICULT to find. Please improve your signage and direction arrows to the site as it took us nearly an hour to find Unit 13 etc., even with an Edinburgh driver !!Thank you

records.title: Initially good - slow result
records.text: Easily arranged on the website, happy that we were advised when our test was despatched, whilst still on holiday. Test arrived as expected, instructions were easy to understand. Test was posted in priority post box on a tuesday afternoon, but didnt get the result until late saturday. No text as expected to say test had been received. Results took longer than expected.

records.title: Ordering & delivery worked well
records.text: Ordering & delivery worked well. My husband’s results came through very quickly but I had to chase mine and found the follow up aspects quite tricky. I have an account with a different company too, they are super easy to log in to to review results etc. Customer Service was a Bot, I was advised a follow up that never happened. So I would say some work to be done on issue resolution/customer service.

records.title: I arranged an appointment today within…
records.text: I arranged an appointment today within 10mins realized I’d put pm instead on am So talking to a bot does not help my anxiety I think it should state if you are going to get call or email within a certain time I’m more anxious as I’ve booked it for my sister in law who is going home to Canada. More information would be appreciated

records.title: The test kit did not arrive on the day…
records.text: The test kit did not arrive on the day it was meant to. I was around in the house at the correct slot and think I saw the DPD van arrive and then leave. I tried to send a message via phone or email to Assured Screening to ask what was happening and when would the test arrive but it is virtually impossible to contact Assured Screening. Others had complained of the same. The test eventually arrived the next day

records.title: Although the test requested was…
records.text: Although the test requested was delivered within the communicated timescales, it was very nearly missed which led to a lot of anxiety as we were unsure whether we would have the required information to be able to travel. The added difficulty that you could not contact anyone added to the stress at the time.Having said this, the tests were delivered within the communicated timescales but you may find yourselves tight for time!

records.title: Two stars for delivery and four stars for attending to enquiries
records.text: I rated you two stars in delivering against your promises: mainly delivering the test kits one day after arrival in the UK and informing us about the status of your processing by 12noon the day after dropping the test kit in the Dropbox. You did not meet either deadline. I hope you will manage to provide results in time before the end of the quarantine period.  Your replies to our enquiries were very good. I

records.title: I tried to review my result online but…
records.text: I tried to review my result online but read that it was not possible and yhat I would recieve an email when the lab recieved the package and another email with the result.I posted the special 24 hour package as instructed, but it seems it took 3 days to arrive at the lab. I did not recieve a lab arrival email either and after 4 days got a result.I think the postal service needs to be checked and the actual communication intended be clear.Thank you.

records.title: I would have given a higher score as my…
records.text: I would have given a higher score as my first experience with this company was excellent. This time I ordered a pack for my husband at the same time as my own, which did not arrive on time, and when I tried to contact AssuredScreening.com I received no acknowledgement or indication that a replacement pack had been sent. However a replacement was received the following day

records.title: To providing my Day 2 test was very…
records.text: To providing my Day 2 test was very good but because I arrived back in the UK my day 2 was a Saturday and I was not able to send it back until Monday due to postal collections in my area. I got my negative result on the Wednesday. A different situation for my husband whose Day 2 test wasn’t arriving till 5 days afterwards which makes a mockery of the system and we did contact Assured by phone and email and received no reply.

records.title: Found Staff rather grumpy but it was…
records.text: Found Staff rather grumpy but it was late in the evening. Zero telephone number available to get an update on the status of my test. I’ve used the chatbot and so far have had no response to my request. I’ve not received an email as expected to let me know my sample has arrived at the testing lab. It’s been almost 24 hours since I done my test. I paid for the next day result service.  Not great!!!!

records.title: All worked out OK in the end.
records.text: All worked out OK in the end.However, the Royal Mail return envelopes were not accepted by the post office. The post office said they could be put in the priority letterbox. However, the priority letter box was too small for the return parcel, so had to send it by private courier instead. The overall process and testing system is useless and broken, even if AssuredScreening do their bit OK.

records.title: Convenient but delayed.
records.text: It was convenient to talk to the 24*7 support and it answered my query regarding results. However, production of result was delayed inspite of the fact sample reaching the lab early. And one can not follow or track the sample status directly through the website and wait for the email to arrive, which may land up in the spam folder. That's cumbersome.

records.title: On arrival at Barbados with my negative…
records.text: On arrival at Barbados with my negative PCR certificate I had to take another test at the Airport as the certificate did not state whether I had provided a nasal or throat sample.I contacted Assured Screening upon my return and in brief was advised that it was my responsibility to confirm that the test given was acceptable by the country visited this despite one of the registration questions asks what country is being visited. If not used to check the requirements what is the point of asking the question.

records.title: Last of flexibility - avoid.
records.text: My flight was cancelled at the last minute and I asked if I could receive a refund. This was flatly refused. Given I had booked it less than 24 hours previously, I fail to see the sense in their terms and conditions. If I were you, I'd choose a different provider who understand how flexibility is important and how, especially in this post-Covid world, circumstances can change last minute. Very disappointed. Avoid.

records.title: Good price, no queue, but late results
records.text: The favorable price spurred ne on to choose your organisation for my children's pcr test (next day guaranteed).However, he website and process for group booking is confusing, and could have caused us disruption to our plans  had there not still been appointments free on our arrival, I suppose.Nevertheless,  we were seen quickly and ahead of schedule on arrival. The results did not arrive the next day. We had to wait until the day after.

records.title: Website not functioning fully
records.text: Several attempts at uploading both Covid vaccination evidence and PCR result - I've given up as neither went through - will present them at airport. Did manage to change my seats though!

records.title: Dumbfounded @ service levels
records.text: Pretty disappointed that their was no contact number, when I tried to log a query on the chat support no response. Then to receive an email stating that my test needed to be done again without providing any information as to why. Need to improve…

records.title: There is no reference number on my test…
records.text: There is no reference number on my test certificate so I cannot upload the result onto my NHS app. Also the link to asking questions does not work.

records.title: Sameday Turnaround: NOT THE CASE
records.text: I paid the extra fee for "Sameday Turnaround" and didn't get my results by 23:59 on the day of my test (which was at 9:00am that day). I then had to chat with a robot at midnight in an attempt to get my results, and when they arrived delayed (not thanks to the robot), I received no apology whatsoever. Furthermore, when contacting them for a refund, they reply that "it does state that the turnaround is an aim and not a guarantee". In fact, if you carefully read the long terms and conditions one automatically agrees with, it says:7.3 Timescales are estimates only. Whilst we will endeavour to dispatch testing kits and process returned specimens promptly, timescales provides are estimates only and no guarantee is given as to any timescale. As a result, our products cannot be relied upon where time is of the essence for the provision of the results.

records.title: Confined for 5 days!
records.text: Two tests taken on Day1 and posted in Royal Mail box. Test results for one arrived in less than 24 hours. Excellent. Nothing for the other test (mine). Day 4 after not even an acknowledgement that my test had been received I contacted the chat twice but could make no sense of it. I emailed. Sorry,  this site is no longer operating but try this one. At last I received a reply saying my test was in the lab.Today, Day 5, my result arrived. This took far too long and I had to confine for more days than I had anticipated.

records.title: Not a scam, just a bit pants
records.text: Not a scam, but the t&c's deflect all responsibilities away for assured screening with regards to timings, cancellations etc. I did a home day 2 test; it was delivered a day late, and the results are coming a day late, which can be chalked down to pandemic, but still, if you need a rock solid provider to get yourself released or tested, I wouldn't go with these guys.

records.title: Terrible
records.text: Terrible, go somewhere else.Clinic was a tent with no tables and no assistance. Test had to be taken by myself standing up. No phone service and lengthy wait for email/robot response.
